title: LAST: Bridging Vision-Language and Action Manifolds via Gromov-Wasserstein Alignment
summary: We take a Gromov-Wasserstein perspective on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) learning, where the goal is to make the relational geometry of action representations compatible with the semantic geometry of VL embeddings. However, this alignment is non-trivial due to the mathematical heterogeneity between the domains: the semantic space of vision-language is topologically linear and isotropic, whereas the physical manifold of robotic action is non-Euclidean and anisotropic. Their disjoint metric structures render direct regression ill-posed. To resolve this incompatibility, we introduce LAST (Lie-algebraic Action Space Tokenizer), which reconstructs the action space to establish local metric compatibility with the VL modality via a two-stage transformation: (1) Global Topological Linearization: linearizing the action manifold via Lie-algebraic mapping, converting trajectories into a fixed-length, physically additive representation. (2) Local Metric Discretization: hierarchically discretizing the representation into schemas and whitened residuals, yielding approximately isotropic local charts that are statistically aligned with the semantic metric. By resolving the structural mismatch at both global and local levels, LAST enables VLA models with superior convergence and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 提出LAST（李代数动作空间分词器），通过全局拓扑线性化（李代数映射）和局部度量离散化（模式化与白化残差）两阶段变换，将机器人动作的非欧几何与视觉-语言语义空间对齐，解决了Gromov-Wasserstein视角下VLA学习中跨模态度量不兼容问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言（VL）语义空间是线性各向同性的，而机器人动作空间是非欧几里得且各向异性的，两者度量结构不匹配导致直接回归是病态的，需要建立局部度量兼容性。
AI.method: 两阶段变换：(1) 全局拓扑线性化——通过李代数映射将动作流形线性化为定长、物理可加表示；(2) 局部度量离散化——分层离散化为模式（schemas）和白化残差（whitened residuals），得到与语义度量统计对齐的近似各向同性局部图。
AI.result: 解决了全局和局部两个层面的结构不匹配问题，使VLA模型获得更优的收敛性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过李代数方法在动作空间中建立与VL模态局部度量兼容的表示，是解决跨模态几何异质性问题的有效途径。

title: CFCamo: A Counterfactual Detect-or-Abstain Framework for Camouflaged Object Detection
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/suhang2000/CFCamo
summary: Vision-language reinforcement learning has recently shown strong target-present localization for camouflaged object detection (COD). Yet localization is only one side of the decision: when the agent faces an ordinary image with no camouflaged target, will it still claim that a camouflaged object exists? Standard COD training and evaluation data are positive-only, so agents optimized under this setting can acquire an over-detect bias, a task-specific form of object hallucination that standard COD evaluation leaves unmeasured. To quantify this target-absent behavior, we construct Counterfactual COD (CF-COD), a paired benchmark that removes the camouflaged target from each held-out COD evaluation image while preserving a plausible background. CF-COD evaluates whether a model detects the target on the original image and abstains on the target-absent counterfactual, summarized by Pair Accuracy (PA). We further introduce CFCamo, a paired counterfactual framework for COD with abstention. For training, CFCamo optimizes a Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct agent with Counterfactual Sequence Policy Optimization (CSPO), which samples paired original-counterfactual rollouts and uses a Counterfactual Paired Reward (CPR) to couple original-image detection with counterfactual abstention. On CAMO-test, CFCamo improves S_alpha by +3.7 pp over the prior RL-based COD baseline; across CF-COD, it reaches 80.0-90.8% PA. Ablations show that removing counterfactual coupling reduces PA to 1.4-5.2% despite strong target-present COD scores, showing that target-present evaluation alone does not characterize detect-or-abstain behavior. Overall, these results indicate that CFCamo improves COD agents by coupling target-present detection with target-absent abstention, rather than merely strengthening target-present localization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/suhang2000/CFCamo.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉-语言强化学习在伪装目标检测（COD）中存在的过度检测偏差（目标幻觉），本文构建了CF-COD基准（配对原始图像与去除伪装目标的反事实图像），并提出CFCamo框架，通过反事实序列策略优化（CSPO）和配对奖励（CPR）联合优化原始图像检测与反事实图像弃权。在CAMO-test上，S_alpha提升3.7个百分点；CF-COD上配对准确率达80.0-90.8%。消融实验表明，去除反事实耦合后配对准确率降至1.4-5.2%，证明仅靠目标存在评估无法刻画检测-弃权行为。
AI.motivation: 标准COD训练和评估数据仅有阳性样本（存在伪装目标），导致智能体产生过度检测偏差（一种任务特化的目标幻觉），而现有COD评估无法量化这种目标不存在时的行为。
AI.method: 1) 构建CF-COD基准：对每张COD评估图像生成去除伪装目标的反事实版本，用配对准确率（PA）衡量模型在原始图像上检测、反事实图像上弃权的能力。2) 提出CFCamo框架：基于Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct智能体，采用反事实序列策略优化（CSPO），采样配对原始-反事实轨迹，用反事实配对奖励（CPR）耦合原始图像检测与反事实弃权。
AI.result: CAMO-test上S_alpha提升3.7个百分点；CF-COD上PA达80.0-90.8%。消融实验显示去除反事实耦合后PA降至1.4-5.2%，而目标存在评分仍强。
AI.conclusion: CFCamo通过耦合目标存在检测与目标不存在弃权来提升COD智能体，而非仅仅强化目标存在定位能力。

title: OSCS-SupCon: Orthogonal Sigmoid-based Common and Style Supervised Contrastive Learning for Robust Feature Disentanglement
summary: Supervised Contrastive Learning (SupCon) has achieved strong performance by explicitly modeling pairwise relationships among samples. However, existing SupCon-based methods suffer from two key limitations: negative-sample dilution induced by the standard InfoNCE loss, and feature-space entanglement caused by the lack of explicit constraints separating category-relevant (common) and category-irrelevant (style) features. These limitations reduce feature discriminability and generalization ability. To address these issues, we propose OSCS-SupCon (Orthogonal Sigmoid-based Common and Style Supervised Contrastive Learning), a unified framework that combines a sigmoid-based pairwise contrastive objective with explicit orthogonality constraints. Specifically, we introduce a sigmoid-based contrastive loss with two learnable parameters, temperature and bias, which adaptively modulate pairwise decision boundaries and alleviate negative-sample dilution. Furthermore, we enforce orthogonality between common and style feature subspaces via a linear projection with ReLU nonlinearity, thereby reducing feature overlap and improving disentanglement of style-irrelevant representations. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that OSCS-SupCon consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised contrastive learning methods across multiple backbone architectures. In particular, on the fine-grained CUB200-2011 dataset with a ResNet-18 backbone, the proposed method achieves a 3.4% improvement in classification accuracy over CS-SupCon, highlighting its robustness and generalization capability. Ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出OSCS-SupCon框架，通过sigmoid对比损失和正交约束解决监督对比学习中的负样本稀释和特征纠缠问题，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有监督对比学习方法存在两个关键局限：标准InfoNCE损失导致的负样本稀释问题，以及缺乏显式约束来分离类别相关（通用）和类别无关（风格）特征导致的特征空间纠缠问题，这降低了特征的判别性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出OSCS-SupCon统一框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于sigmoid的对比损失，引入可学习的温度和偏置参数，自适应调节成对决策边界，缓解负样本稀释；(2) 通过带ReLU非线性的线性投影在通用特征和风格特征子空间之间施加正交约束，减少特征重叠，提升风格无关表示的解耦能力。
AI.result: 在6个基准数据集上，OSCS-SupCon在多种骨干架构下一致优于现有SOTA监督对比学习方法。在细粒度CUB200-2011数据集上使用ResNet-18骨干时，分类准确率相比CS-SupCon提升3.4%。消融实验验证了各组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OSCS-SupCon通过sigmoid对比损失和正交约束有效解决了负样本稀释和特征纠缠问题，提升了特征的判别性和泛化能力，在多个任务上取得了优越性能。

title: Traits Run Deeper: Trait-Specific Asymmetric Fusion for Personality Assessment
summary: Personality assessment aims to infer stable personality traits from dynamic behaviors across language, voice, and facial cues. Since different personality dimensions are revealed through distinct behavioral perspectives, modeling trait-specific evidence is challenging. However, most existing approaches adopt a uniform multimodal fusion strategy across all dimensions, assuming identical modality contributions. This overlooks trait-specific modality preferences and introduces cross-modal interference. To address this issue, we propose a novel personality assessment framework called Traits Run Deeper, which consists of three components. Specifically, the Multimodal Foundation Representation (MFR) module constructs personality-oriented multimodal inputs and leverages psychology-informed semantic templates as anchors, enabling foundation models to capture trait-relevant information. Building upon MFR, the Trait-Specific Modality Fusion (TSMF) module acts as an asymmetric fusion mechanism, allowing each dimension to selectively exploit different modality pathways from modality-specific modeling to complementary fusion. Thus, TSMF captures heterogeneous modality preferences while reducing cross-modal contamination. Furthermore, the Distribution-Calibrated Personality Regression (DCPR) module mitigates label imbalance and central tendency bias through target distribution calibration, improving robustness and stability. Experimental results on the AVI Challenge 2026 validation set demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, reducing mean squared error (MSE) by approximately 25% compared with the baseline. Consistent improvements are observed on the official test set, where our method achieves the best performance and ranks first in the Personality Assessment Track. The source code will be made available at https://github.com/MSA-LMC/AVI2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Traits Run Deeper框架，通过多模态基础表示、特质特定模态融合和分布校准人格回归三个模块，解决人格评估中不同维度的模态偏好差异问题，在AVI Challenge 2026上MSE降低约25%，排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对所有维度的多模态融合采用统一策略，忽视了不同人格维度的模态偏好差异，导致跨模态干扰问题。
AI.method: 提出Traits Run Deeper框架，包含三个模块：(1) MFR模块：构建人格导向的多模态输入，利用心理学启发的语义模板作为锚点；(2) TSMF模块：非对称融合机制，允许每个维度选择性利用不同模态路径；(3) DCPR模块：通过目标分布校准缓解标签不平衡和中心倾向偏差。
AI.result: 在AVI Challenge 2026验证集上MSE较基线降低约25%，在官方测试集上取得最佳性能，排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 通过特质特定的模态融合和分布校准，有效解决了跨模态干扰和标签偏差问题，显著提升了人格评估性能。

title: PoQ-Judge: A Multi-Architecture Evaluation Framework for Cost-Aware Proof-of-Quality in Decentralized LLM Inference
summary: Decentralized LLM inference networks need lightweight, reference-free quality evaluation for Proof of Quality (PoQ). We present PoQ-Judge, a framework that trains dedicated judge models to score query-output pairs without ground-truth references. We study three architectures across the quality-cost tradeoff: a TextCNN judge, a MiniLM cross-encoder, and a DeBERTa judge. Using two-stage training on UltraFeedback plus GPT-labeled in-domain data, the best model reaches 0.747 Pearson correlation with the ground-truth proxy on a held-out test set, outperforming reference-based evaluators from prior work. As a reference-free component in composite scoring, it achieves 0.645 Pearson correlation, matching the best single reference-based evaluator while removing the need for reference answers. We also show that online calibration identifies semantic quality as the dominant dimension and that cascade evaluation reduces cost by 72.7 percent with only modest quality loss. Results are much stronger on QA than summarization, pointing to proxy quality as the main remaining limitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoQ-Judge框架，训练专用裁判模型对去中心化LLM推理网络中的查询-输出对进行无参考质量评分。TextCNN、MiniLM和DeBERTa三种架构中，最佳模型在Pearson相关性上达到0.747，超越了现有参考依赖评估器。作为无参考组件时达0.645，与最佳单参考评估器持平。在线校准识别语义质量为关键维度，级联评估降低72.7%成本且质量损失微小。
AI.motivation: 去中心化LLM推理网络需要轻量级、无参考的质量评估机制来实现Proof of Quality（PoQ），现有方法依赖参考答案，成本高且不适用于去中心化场景。
AI.method: 训练专用裁判模型（TextCNN、MiniLM cross-encoder、DeBERTa三种架构），采用两阶段训练：先在UltraFeedback上训练，再用GPT标注的领域内数据微调。引入在线校准机制识别质量维度，设计级联评估策略降低计算成本。
AI.result: 最佳模型Pearson相关达0.747，超越参考依赖评估器；作为无参考组件时达0.645，与最佳单参考评估器持平；级联评估降低72.7%成本；在QA任务上显著优于摘要任务。
AI.conclusion: 无参考裁判模型可替代参考依赖评估器用于PoQ，级联策略有效平衡质量与成本，代理质量（proxy quality）是当前主要限制因素。

title: EventRadar: Long-Range Visual UAV Discovery through Spatiotemporal Event Sensing
summary: Unauthorized unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) activity around airports, public venues, and other sensitive sites has made protected-airspace monitoring increasingly important. A practical sensing system must search a wide angular region, find small long-range targets, and return both bearing support and UAV-specific evidence before a restricted perimeter is breached. Existing UAV detection paths often rely on spatially organized evidence, such as body extent, silhouette, or track continuity. At long range, however, these cues become difficult to preserve and verify as the target footprint weakens and its image-plane support shrinks. EventRadar follows a complementary cue: propeller-induced temporal periodicity, which recent event-camera sensing studies have shown can reveal UAV-specific motion after appearance becomes weak. We extend this cue to kilometer-scale active sensing with an event-camera prototype. Scene-Anchored Geometry Evidence (SAGE) fuses scanning events with IMU pose to maintain a bearing-indexed scene memory, separating transient candidate support from persistent background clutter. Comb-guided Harmonic-Group Learned Iterative Shrinkage and Thresholding Algorithm (CHG) then treats each candidate as a weak high-rate timing signal and recovers phase-insensitive harmonic evidence with fixed compute. Compared with related event-camera baselines on 700-1500 m UAV event recordings, EventRadar achieves 0.990 mAP$_{.3}$ and 0.949 F1$_{.3}$, reduces FN$_{.3}$ to 0.009, and shows real-time feasibility in prototype profiling.

AI.tldr: EventRadar利用事件相机捕获无人机螺旋桨引起的时序周期性，结合场景锚定几何证据（SAGE）和梳状引导谐波组学习迭代收缩阈值算法（CHG），在公里级距离上实现高精度无人机检测，在700-1500米距离上达到0.990 mAP@0.3和0.949 F1@0.3。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机检测方法依赖空间域证据（如轮廓、轨迹连续性），但在远距离场景下目标足迹微弱、图像支撑缩小，这些线索难以保持和验证。亟需一种能从弱信号中提取无人机特异性证据的远距离感知方案。
AI.method: 提出EventRadar系统，包含两个核心模块：(1) Scene-Anchored Geometry Evidence (SAGE)——融合事件流与IMU位姿，构建方位索引的场景记忆，分离瞬态候选支撑与持久背景杂波；(2) Comb-guided Harmonic-Group Learned Iterative Shrinkage and Thresholding Algorithm (CHG)——将候选视为弱高速时序信号，恢复相位不敏感的谐波证据，计算复杂度固定。
AI.result: 在700-1500米距离的无人机事件记录上，EventRadar达到0.990 mAP@0.3、0.949 F1@0.3，FN@0.3降至0.009，原型系统验证具有实时可行性。
AI.conclusion: 螺旋桨引起的时序周期性可作为远距离无人机检测的有效互补线索，事件相机结合结构化几何与谐波分析可实现公里级主动感知，为受保护空域监控提供了新的技术路径。

title: The Structural Attention Tax: How Retrieval Format Hijacks In-Context Learning Independent of Content
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems inject external knowledge to improve LLM outputs, yet the format of injected content -- distinct from its semantic relevance -- can independently distort the model's attention distribution. We identify and formalise a phenomenon we term the structural attention tax: knowledge graph (KG) triples, due to their relational delimiters and repeated slot patterns, capture 2-3x more attention per token than semantically equivalent natural-language text ($\hat{o}$(KG) $\approx$ 0.70 vs. $\hat{o}$(neutral) $\approx$ 0.25), compressing demonstration attention by up to 42% -- regardless of whether the triples are relevant or noise. We develop a formal framework decomposing attention scores into semantic and structural components (Eq. 2), derive a compression bound (Proposition 1) connecting token-level format bias to demonstration attention loss, and show that the structural term governs how much attention is diverted while the semantic term governs whether this helps or hurts. This decoupling reveals two orthogonal axes for improving retrieval-augmented ICL: optimising retrieval quality (semantic axis) and reducing format-driven attention capture (structural axis). Empirically, across two model families (Mistral-7B, LLaMA-3-8B) and three QA benchmarks, we observe that source-task alignment dominates: task-matched BM25 retrieval achieves 58-62% on HotpotQA vs. ConceptNet's 25-27%, a >30 pp gap that dwarfs all gating strategies ($\leq$2 pp). We derive five structure-aware mitigation strategies from the framework, ranging from zero-cost prompt modifications to training-time regularisation; format flattening (S3) is validated by both accuracy and attention-level evidence from a verbalized-triple control, while structural dispersal (S1) yields mixed results that illuminate the challenges of format-level intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文发现知识图谱三元组因其结构化格式（关系分隔符和重复槽位模式）会吸引2-3倍于语义等价自然语言文本的注意力（每token注意力约0.70 vs 0.25），导致示范注意力压缩高达42%，这种现象被称为"结构注意力税"。作者提出形式化框架将注意力分解为语义和结构成分，推导了压缩界限，并据此提出五类结构感知缓解策略，其中格式扁平化（S3）被验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统研究主要关注注入内容与查询的语义相关性，但忽略了注入内容的格式（如知识图谱三元组 vs. 自然语言文本）本身会独立地影响模型注意力分配，即使语义等价也可能导致截然不同的注意力行为。本文旨在形式化并量化这种格式驱动的注意力偏差。
AI.method: 1) 提出"结构注意力税"概念并形式化，将注意力分数分解为语义分量和结构分量（Eq.2）；2) 推导基于token级格式偏差的示范注意力损失压缩界限（Proposition 1）；3) 在Mistral-7B和LLaMA-3-8B两个模型家族、三个QA基准上实证验证；4) 提出五类结构感知缓解策略（S1-S5），包括零成本提示修改到训练时正则化。
AI.result: 1) KG三元组每token注意力约为0.70，中性文本约为0.25，差距2-3倍；2) 示范注意力压缩高达42%；3) 源任务对齐主导性能：BM25检索在HotpotQA上达58-62%而ConceptNet仅25-27%，差距>30pp，远超所有门控策略（≤2pp）；4) 格式扁平化（S3）通过口语化三元组控制实验验证了准确率和注意力层面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强ICL的优化存在两个正交维度：语义轴（优化检索质量）和结构轴（减少格式驱动的注意力捕获）。其中源任务对齐的语义匹配对性能影响远大于结构干预手段（超过30个百分点差距）。格式扁平化（将结构化知识转为自然语言表述）是最有效的结构缓解策略。

title: i1: A Simple and Fully Open Recipe for Strong Text-to-Image Models
summary: Diffusion models have consistently driven progress in text-to-image generation. However, it is challenging to attribute recent progress to specific modeling and data choices: state-of-the-art open-weight models provide limited ablations, and do not disclose their training data and full training details. The research community needs fully open (weights, data, and code) models as a foundation for further research; yet existing fully open models still fall significantly short of leading models in performance. In this project, we conduct a systematic investigation of the modeling and data design choices in text-to-image diffusion training and inference with 300+ controlled experiments totaling 700K+ TPU v6e hours. Our experiments highlight several empirical findings (e.g., equal weighting is a strong default for mixing curated datasets) and simple design decisions (e.g., larger text encoder adapters improve performance with minimal added parameters) for training strong models. Guided by these insights, we train i1, a 3B-parameter text-to-image diffusion model using only publicly available datasets. i1 is competitive with leading models on five representative benchmarks (GenEval, DPG, PRISM, CVTG-2K, and LongText), and outperforms the best existing fully open model by 29.5 absolute percentage points on average. We provide the i1 checkpoints, training and inference code, and the data processing pipeline. Together, our findings and the i1 recipe establish a practical foundation for future open research in text-to-image diffusion models. Our code is available at https://github.com/zlab-princeton/i1.

AI.tldr: 本文通过300+控制实验（总计70万+ TPU v6e小时）系统研究了文生图扩散模型的建模与数据设计选择，基于发现的实证结论训练出i1模型（3B参数，仅使用公开数据集），在五个基准测试上达到领先水平，比最优开源模型平均提升29.5绝对百分点，并开放了权重、数据和代码。
AI.motivation: 现有开源文生图扩散模型在性能上远落后于闭源领先模型，且开源顶级模型不公开训练数据和完整训练细节，研究社区缺乏真正完全开放（权重、数据、代码）的高性能模型作为进一步研究的基础。
AI.method: 1）开展300+控制实验（700K+ TPU v6e小时），系统研究建模与数据设计选择；2）基于实验发现（如等权混合策展数据集、更大的文本编码器适配器）训练i1模型（3B参数）；3）仅使用公开可用数据集，并开放完整代码、权重和数据流水线。
AI.result: i1在GenEval、DPG、PRISM、CVTG-2K、LongText五个代表性基准上达到与领先模型竞争的水平，比最优完全开源模型平均提升29.5绝对百分点。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为未来文生图扩散模型的开源研究建立了实用基础，证明了通过系统的实验设计选择和仅使用公开数据即可训练出与领先模型竞争的开源模型。

title: NightFeats @ MMU-RAGent NeurIPS 2025: A Context-Optimized Multi-Agent RAG System for the Text-to-Text Track
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. NeurIPS 2025 Competition Track (MMU-RAGent). System developed October 2025
summary: We present NightFeats, a structured multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system submitted to the MMU-RAGent competition at NeurIPS 2025, where it was awarded Best Dynamic Evaluation in the text-to-text track. Rather than targeting benchmark maximization, this work proposes a principled pipeline that decomposes knowledge synthesis into three coordinated phases: retrieval, curation, and composition, each governed by explicit intermediate representations and handoff contracts. Inspired by Agentic Context Engineering (ACE), the system introduces temporal-semantic reranking, bounded contradiction reconciliation, and citation-preserving composition as core architectural primitives. Competition results show that NightFeats surpasses proprietary baselines including Claude-SonnetV2 and Nova-Pro on LLM-as-a-Judge and Human Likert evaluations, confirming that architectural transparency and verifiable evidence grounding are better aligned with human preferences than systems optimizing narrowly for automatic similarity metrics.

AI.tldr: NightFeats 是一个提交至 NeurIPS 2025 MMU-RAGent 竞赛的结构化多智能体 RAG 系统（获得最佳动态评估奖），通过检索-策展-组成的三阶段流程、时序语义重排序、矛盾调和与引文保留机制，在 LLM 裁判与人类评估上超越 Claude-SonnetV2 和 Nova-Pro，证明架构透明度与可验证证据比仅优化自动指标更符合人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 系统过度追求自动相似度指标，缺乏架构透明性与可验证的证据链，导致与人类偏好脱节。作者希望通过结构化的多阶段知识合成流程来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 将知识合成分解为检索、策展、组成三阶段，每阶段由显式中间表示与交接合同控制；引入时序语义重排序、有界矛盾调和、引文保留组成作为核心架构原语，采用 Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) 思想构建多智能体系统。
AI.result: 在 LLM-as-a-Judge 和 Human Likert 评估中超越 Claude-SonnetV2 和 Nova-Pro 等闭源基线，获得 NeurIPS 2025 MMU-RAGent 竞赛文本赛道最佳动态评估奖。
AI.conclusion: 架构透明度与可验证的证据基础比单纯优化自动相似度指标更能对齐人类偏好，结构化多阶段的 RAG 设计是提升系统可信度与实用性的有效路径。

title: TRON: Tracing Rays to Orchestrate a Neural Renderer for 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
summary: We introduce TRON, a rendering framework that combines 3D Gaussian ray tracing with neural rendering to enable realistic and controllable rendering of real-world 3D scenes under novel lighting, dynamic object motion, object insertion, and material editing. Prior approaches that rely solely on physically based rendering (PBR) of Gaussian representations struggle to achieve realistic relighting due to imperfections in reconstructed geometry, material estimates, and light transport estimation. At the same time, neural rendering methods often lack an explicit scene representation, limiting their ability to support interactive editing with fine-grained manipulation. TRON bridges these two paradigms. We use intrinsic decomposition priors from a learned inverse rendering model to regularize the material properties of a Gaussian field, and repurpose a ray tracer to provide radiometric guidance rather than final pixels. By treating this output as a structured 3D scaffold, we empower a lightweight neural renderer to bridge the domain gap between shading-model constrained estimates and photorealistic output. Our key insight is that the combination of explicit 3D knowledge with robust material priors provides speed and controllability, while neural rendering enables the synthesis of photorealistic images. To support real-world scenarios, we train our neural renderer with a multi-stage strategy consisting of large-scale pretraining and targeted fine-tuning on a newly constructed dataset of 2.1M rendered synthetic and real-world frames from 3D reconstructions. TRON outperforms Gaussian-based relighting methods in realism, and prior neural renderers in editability and speed. To the best of our knowledge, TRON is the first method to enable practical interactive applications in captured 3D environments, offering realistic appearance under dynamic geometric, lighting and material conditions.

AI.tldr: TRON是一个结合3D高斯光线追踪与神经渲染的框架，通过显式3D场景表示与材质先验实现可控编辑（重光照、动态物体运动、物体插入、材质编辑），同时利用神经渲染实现逼真输出。采用多阶段训练策略（2.1M帧数据），在真实感和可编辑性上优于现有方法，是首个支持交互式编辑的捕获3D环境渲染方法。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯表示的物理渲染（PBR）因几何、材质和光传输估计不完美而难以实现逼真重光照；而神经渲染方法缺乏显式场景表示，无法支持细粒度的交互编辑。TRON旨在桥接这两种范式，同时实现逼真渲染与可控编辑。
AI.method: 1) 利用逆渲染模型的内禀分解先验对高斯场的材质属性进行正则化；2) 重用途光线追踪器提供辐射度量引导（而非最终像素）作为结构化3D支架；3) 轻量级神经渲染器弥合着色模型约束估计与逼真输出之间的域差距；4) 多阶段训练策略：大规模预训练+在包含210万帧合成与真实数据的数据集上微调。
AI.result: TRON在真实感方面优于基于高斯的重光照方法，在可编辑性和速度方面优于先前的神经渲染器。它是首个在捕获的3D环境中实现实用交互式应用（动态几何、光照和材质条件下的逼真外观）的方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式3D知识与鲁棒材质先验的组合提供了速度和可控性，而神经渲染则实现了逼真图像合成。这种混合范式有效解决了PBR和纯神经渲染各自的局限性。

title: Detecting AI-Generated Content on Social Media with Multi-modal Language Models
summary: Generative AI has enabled the creation of photorealistic images and videos that are increasingly disseminated on social media, often used for spam, misinformation, manipulation, and fraud. Existing AI-generated content (AIGC) detection methods face challenges including poor generalization to new generation models, reliance on single modalities, and lack of interpretable explanations. We present our pipeline that mitigates these issues by continuously curating diverse multi-modal social media data and training a compact vision-language model for detection and explanation. Our model achieves state-of-the-art detection performance on public benchmarks and demonstrates robust detection and explanation capabilities on internal social media datasets across multiple platforms. We deployed our model for post recommendation on social media platforms and observed positive downstream impacts on user engagement, demonstrating that it is feasible to perform effective AIGC detection in dynamic, real-world social media environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多模态视觉-语言模型管道，通过持续收集社交媒体数据并训练紧凑模型，实现对AI生成内容的检测与解释，在公共基准和内部数据集上达到SOTA性能，并成功部署于社交平台推荐系统以提升用户参与度。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC检测方法存在对新型生成模型泛化能力差、依赖单一模态、缺乏可解释性等问题，难以在动态真实的社交媒体环境中有效运作。
AI.method: 持续收集多样化的多模态社交媒体数据，训练紧凑型视觉-语言模型，同时进行检测与可解释性输出。
AI.result: 在公开基准上达到SOTA检测性能；在跨平台的内部社交媒体数据集上展现出鲁棒的检测和解释能力；部署后对用户参与度产生积极影响。
AI.conclusion: 在动态真实的社交媒体环境中进行有效的AIGC检测是可行的，且能对下游推荐任务产生正面效果。

title: Semantic Segmentation of Node and Edge Diagrams for Assistive Technology
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. In Proceedings of the 23rd Conference on Robots and Vision (2026)
summary: In this paper, we present a novel set of related models for semantic segmentation of node-link diagrams. These diagrams are frequently used to represent mathematical graphs, relationships between concepts, and flowcharts. Such diagrams are difficult to access non-visually; while some assistive interfaces have been designed for node-link diagrams, they rely upon a machine-readable representation of the diagram, whereas such diagrams will generally be made available as bitmap images. Our compact deep learning models show excellent quantitative and qualitative performance on a large synthetic dataset of node-link diagrams, reaching per-pixel accuracy over 93\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套用于节点链接图语义分割的紧凑深度学习模型，在合成数据集上达到93%以上的像素级准确率，旨在解决非视觉访问难题。
AI.motivation: 节点链接图（如数学图、概念关系图、流程图）在视觉障碍用户中难以非视觉访问。现有辅助接口依赖机器可读表示，但实际中这些图通常以位图图像形式提供，缺乏结构化信息。
AI.method: 提出一套新颖的紧凑深度学习模型，用于节点链接图的语义分割，在大型合成数据集上训练和评估。
AI.result: 模型在像素级准确率上超过93%，定性和定量表现均优异。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的深度学习模型能够有效从位图图像中分割节点链接图的结构元素，为后续的非视觉辅助访问奠定基础。

title: One Jailbreak, Many Tongues: Learning Language-Insensitive Intention Representations for Multilingual Jailbreak Detection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications for global multilingual users, yet safety training remains concentrated in dominant languages and has not progressed in parallel with multilingual capability, creating exploitable gaps for jailbreak attacks. Current jailbreak defenses are largely developed and evaluated in dominant languages, and their effectiveness is limited by the scarcity of aligned multilingual supervision and representations dispersion caused by language variation. To address this issue, we propose MLJailDe, a multilingual jailbreak detection framework designed to improve both multilingual robustness and cross-lingual generalization. MLJailDe first introduces a multilingual back-translation data augmentation algorithm to construct a semantically consistent and functionally effective dataset spanning 11 languages, consisting of 2,232 benign and 1,239 jailbreak samples. On this basis, MLJailDe employs relative-distance constraints to reduce cross-lingual representation dispersion and encourage jailbreak prompts with similar intent to form consistent clusters across languages, while an imbalance-aware classification objective is further used to alleviate class imbalance and learn more reliable multilingual decision boundaries. Experimental results show that MLJailDe outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple languages, achieving an F1 score of 98.5\%, and obtains an average F1 score of 97.1\% on unseen languages, demonstrating strong effectiveness and cross-lingual generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出MLJailDe多语言越狱检测框架，通过多语言回译数据增强、相对距离约束减少跨语言表示分散、以及不平衡感知分类目标，在11种语言上实现98.5% F1分数，对未见语言达到97.1% F1分数。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型安全训练集中在主导语言，多语言安全防护存在漏洞，现有越狱防御方法缺乏多语言泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 多语言回译数据增强算法构建11种语言的语义一致数据集；2) 相对距离约束减少跨语言表示分散，使相似意图的越狱提示形成跨语言一致聚类；3) 不平衡感知分类目标缓解类别不平衡，学习可靠的多语言决策边界。
AI.result: 在多语言上F1分数达98.5%，在未见语言上平均F1分数达97.1%，优于现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: MLJailDe框架有效提升了多语言越狱检测的鲁棒性和跨语言泛化能力。

title: DarkVGGT: Seeing Through Darkness Using Thermal Geometry without Daylight Tax
summary: Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods have demonstrated strong performance and flexibility in efficient end-to-end scene geometry estimation from image streams. However, their reliance on visible-light appearance makes them vulnerable in dark and low-visibility environments, where RGB cues are severely degraded and geometric evidence becomes ambiguous. To address this challenge, we propose DarkVGGT, an RGB-T feed-forward geometry framework that uses physics-aware thermal modeling for robust 3D estimation in low-light scenes. DarkVGGT introduces two complementary modules. First, physics-inspired thermal factorization extracts emissive-dominant, geometry-consistent thermal cues while isolating sparse reflective residuals that may introduce geometric ambiguity. Second, geometry-shared thermal routing isolates modality-invariant geometric structures from thermal-specific patterns, selectively injecting reliability-aware structural guidance into the RGB stream. Together, these components enable accurate thermal-informed geometry estimation under degraded RGB conditions while largely preserving performance in well-lit environments. Experiments on low-visibility RGB-T benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in both depth and camera pose estimation over existing feed-forward geometry baselines.

AI.tldr: DarkVGGT是一个RGB-T前馈几何框架，通过物理感知热建模实现低光照环境下的鲁棒3D估计，包含物理启发热分解和几何共享热路由两个模块，在低可见度RGB-T基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D重建方法依赖可见光外观，在黑暗和低可见度环境中RGB线索严重退化导致几何估计不准确，因此需要引入热红外模态来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 提出DarkVGGT框架，包含两个互补模块：(1) 物理启发的热分解模块，提取发射主导、几何一致的热线索并隔离稀疏反射残差；(2) 几何共享热路由模块，从热特有模式中分离模态不变几何结构，选择性注入可靠性感知的结构引导到RGB流中。
AI.result: 在低可见度RGB-T基准上，深度估计和相机位姿估计均一致优于现有前馈几何基线方法，且在良好光照环境下也能保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知的热建模能够有效提升低光照条件下3D几何估计的鲁棒性，RGB-T融合策略在退化RGB条件下实现了准确的热信息几何估计。

title: LatticeBridge: Rare-Event Sequential Inference for Faithful Structured Sequence Synthesis
comment: 19 pages. Code and benchmark files available at https://github.com/farukalpay/latticebridge
summary: Structured sequence generation often requires a model to satisfy several input-derived constraints in a single output. Standard decoding methods may assign high probability to fluent continuations while placing low mass on continuations that realize all required anchors jointly. We study this regime as a rare-event sequential inference problem. LatticeBridge combines a compact prefix language model, instance-compiled surface automata, and a twisted sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoder with resampling, multilevel splitting, and a source-support proposal term derived from instance-provided phrases. The constraint representation is compiled from each input instance and does not rely on manually curated lexical classes. On 2,610 attainable validation tasks spanning CommonGen, E2E NLG, and WikiBio, the particle decoder improves exact anchor satisfaction and mean anchor coverage over greedy, beam-filtered, and best-of-k ancestral baselines under a shared proposal model. Since exact anchor satisfaction alone does not rule out unsupported attribute substitutions, the evaluation reports required-anchor coverage, source coverage, source-intrusion diagnostics, overlap, runtime, and particle statistics jointly. The benchmark characterizes the faithfulness-overlap-latency frontier under a fixed proposal model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LatticeBridge，一种结合前缀语言模型、实例编译表面自动机和扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码器的结构化序列生成方法，用于解决多约束条件下的稀有事件推理问题。在CommonGen、E2E NLG和WikiBio等任务上，该方法在精确锚点满足率和平均锚点覆盖率上优于贪婪搜索、波束过滤和best-of-k等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 标准解码方法倾向于为流畅的延续分配高概率，而未能联合实现所有输入约束（锚点），这是一种稀有事件推理问题。现有方法依赖人工策划的词汇类别，缺乏实例级别的约束表示。
AI.method: LatticeBridge包含三个关键组件：1）紧凑前缀语言模型；2）实例编译表面自动机（用于表示输入约束）；3）扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码器，结合重采样、多级分裂和基于源支持的建议项（来自实例提供的短语）。约束表示从每个输入实例编译而来，无需人工策划的词汇类别。
AI.result: 在2,610个可达成验证任务（涵盖CommonGen、E2E NLG、WikiBio）上，粒子解码器在精确锚点满足率和平均锚点覆盖率上优于贪婪搜索、波束过滤和best-of-k祖先采样基线。
AI.conclusion: 精确锚点满足率本身不能排除不支持的属性替换，因此需要联合评估锚点覆盖率、源覆盖率、源入侵诊断、重叠度、运行时间和粒子统计信息。该基准测试在固定提议模型下刻画了忠实度-重叠度-延迟的前沿。

title: NSVQ: Mitigating Codebook Collapse by Stabilizing Encoder Drift in Vector Quantization
summary: Vector quantization is central to modern generative modeling pipelines, but large-codebook VQ models often suffer from codebook collapse. We identify encoder drift as a key driver of this failure: as the encoder moves the latent distribution, sparsely updated code vectors can lag behind, lose assignments, and increase quantization error, creating a feedback loop through the straight-through estimator. We propose NSVQ, a non-stationary-aware VQ training strategy that combines a dense non-stationary embedding loss, codebook replacement, and stage-wise encoder freezing. NSVQ first helps the codebook track encoder drift during early training, then freezes the encoder to consolidate the codebook under a fixed latent geometry, and finally reintroduces adversarial refinement. Experiments on ImageNet-1k show that NSVQ improves reconstruction quality while maintaining full codebook utilization. On ImageNet-1k at 128$\times$128 with 65,536 codes, NSVQ reduces rFID from 2.39 to 2.10 compared with SimVQ, while both methods maintain 100\% utilization. Additional latent diffusion experiments show that NSVQ also improves downstream ImageNet generation FID.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NSVQ，一种非平稳感知的向量量化训练策略，通过密集非平稳嵌入损失、码本替换和分阶段编码器冻结来解决大码本VQ模型中的码本崩溃问题，在ImageNet-1k上提升了重构质量和码本利用率。
AI.motivation: 大码本VQ模型常出现码本崩溃问题，现有方法未能充分解决编码器漂移（encoder drift）这一关键驱动因素：编码器移动潜在分布时，稀疏更新的码向量滞后，失去分配，增加量化误差，通过直通估计器形成反馈循环。
AI.method: 提出NSVQ训练策略，包含三个关键组件：1）密集非平稳嵌入损失，帮助码本在早期训练中跟踪编码器漂移；2）码本替换机制；3）分阶段编码器冻结——先让码本适应漂移，然后冻结编码器以在固定潜在几何下巩固码本，最后重新引入对抗精炼。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1k 128×128分辨率下，使用65,536个码字，NSVQ将rFID从2.39降至2.10（与SimVQ相比），两者均保持100%码本利用率。下游潜在扩散实验表明NSVQ也提升了ImageNet生成的FID。
AI.conclusion: NSVQ通过非平稳感知训练策略有效解决了编码器漂移导致的码本崩溃问题，在保持100%码本利用率的同时提升了重构质量和下游生成性能。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Safety Data Extraction
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, submitted to Applied Intelligence
summary: Accurate extraction of structured information from Safety Data Sheets (SDS) remains challenging in industrial safety due to heterogeneous document formats and the limitations of traditional rule-based methods. This study benchmarks state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated SDS data extraction, comparing text-based and multimodal processing pipelines. We systematically evaluate four models: Gemini 1.5 Pro, GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and Llama 3.1-70B, across three prompting strategies: zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought. The evaluation framework assessed accuracy, latency, and cost across more than 50,000 extracted data fields. Results show that text-based extraction consistently outperforms multimodal processing across all metrics. Gemini 1.5 Pro combined with a Chain-of-Thought prompt achieved the highest accuracy (84%), outperforming GPT-4o (81%) and Claude 3.7 Sonnet (79%). However, no model surpassed the 90% accuracy threshold commonly required for reliable real-world deployment. These findings indicate that general-purpose LLMs are not yet robust enough for unsupervised industrial use, though performance suggests strong potential with task-specific fine-tuning. Future research should focus on domain-adapted training, model calibration, and the integration of Human-in-the-Loop verification to ensure safety-critical reliability.

AI.tldr: 该研究基准测试了四种大语言模型（Gemini 1.5 Pro、GPT-4o、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Llama 3.1-70B）在安全数据表（SDS）结构化信息提取任务上的表现。基于三种提示策略（零样本、少样本、思维链），在超过50,000个数据字段上评估准确率、延迟和成本。结果表明：文本提取优于多模态处理；Gemini 1.5 Pro+思维链提示取得最高准确率（84%），但所有模型均未达到实际部署所需的90%准确率阈值。通用LLM尚不足以用于无监督工业场景，但通过任务特定微调具有潜力。
AI.motivation: 安全数据表（SDS）中的结构化信息提取在工业安全中至关重要，但由于文档格式异构以及传统基于规则方法的局限性，该任务仍然面临挑战。本研究旨在探索大语言模型能否克服这些局限性，实现自动化SDS数据提取。
AI.method: 对四种LLM（Gemini 1.5 Pro、GPT-4o、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Llama 3.1-70B）采用三种提示策略（零样本、少样本、思维链）进行系统评估，比较文本处理和多模态处理两种管线，在超过50,000个数据字段上从准确率、延迟和成本三个维度进行基准测试。
AI.result: 文本提取管线在所有指标上均优于多模态处理。Gemini 1.5 Pro结合思维链提示取得最高准确率84%，高于GPT-4o（81%）和Claude 3.7 Sonnet（79%）。但所有模型均未达到90%的准确率阈值。
AI.conclusion: 通用大语言模型尚未足够稳健以支持无监督的工业部署，但性能结果表明通过任务特定微调具有显著潜力。未来研究应聚焦领域适应训练、模型校准以及引入人机协同验证以确保安全关键场景的可靠性。

title: From Simulation to Real-World: An In-Field 6D Pose Dataset and Baseline for Robotic Strawberry Harvesting
summary: Robotic strawberry harvesting requires precise 6D pose estimation; however, collecting 6D pose ground truth in real agricultural fields is inherently challenging. Existing 6D pose estimation methods have therefore relied solely on synthetic data that lacks scene-level realism, leaving their performance under real agricultural field conditions unquantified. In this work, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first real-world 6D pose ground truth dataset of strawberries collected in actual agricultural fields (12,040 images). We also introduce a synthetic dataset rendered in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, featuring scene-level realism and domain randomization. Nevertheless, our experiments reveal that a significant sim-to-real gap persists, underscoring the necessity of real agricultural field data for reliable evaluation. We further quantify the sim-to-real gap through baseline 6D pose estimation results across backbone encoders, serving as a reference for future work. The real-world dataset will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文首次构建了真实农业场景下的草莓6D位姿数据集（12,040张图像），并基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim生成了具有场景级真实感的合成数据集。实验表明，尽管合成数据具备场景级真实感，但模拟到现实的差距依然显著，必须使用真实农业数据才能进行可靠评估。作者通过骨干编码器的基线实验结果量化了这一差距。
AI.motivation: 机器人草莓采摘需要精确的6D位姿估计，但在真实农业场景中采集6D位姿真值极其困难，现有方法仅依赖缺乏场景级真实感的合成数据，其在真实田间的性能尚未被量化评估。
AI.method: 1) 在真实农业田间采集12,040张带有6D位姿真值的草莓图像；2) 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中生成具有场景级真实感和域随机化的合成数据集；3) 通过不同骨干编码器进行基线6D位姿估计实验，量化模拟到现实的差距。
AI.result: 即使合成数据具备场景级真实感，模拟到现实的差距仍然显著存在，证明了真实农业田间数据对可靠评估的必要性；同时提供了多个骨干编码器下的基线性能结果作为参考。
AI.conclusion: 真实农业场景的6D位姿真值数据对于可靠的评估至关重要，现有仅依赖合成数据的方法无法充分反映实际田间的表现，未来研究应重视真实数据的获取与应用。

title: Compatibility-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the predominant paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs), yet it suffers from optimization instability and limited generalization. Recent work attributes this issue to pathological gradient scaling and proposes Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT) to correct it at the token level. However, DFT assumes all demonstrations are equally suitable learning targets, an assumption violated by the strong heterogeneity of large-scale instruction data, where demonstration-policy mismatch induces high-variance updates at the sample level. We introduce Compatibility-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning (CADFT), a principled extension of DFT that controls sample-level optimization variance. CADFT derives a dynamic, policy-dependent compatibility signal from model likelihoods to modulate supervised updates, suppressing high-variance gradients from incompatible demonstrations. We further propose a delayed, low-frequency compatibility-guided rewriting strategy to transform persistently incompatible demonstrations into learnable targets. We show that CADFT can be interpreted as a variance-controlled estimator that generalizes token-level stabilization in DFT to the sample level. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved stability, generalization, and cold-start reinforcement learning initialization, while remaining fully supervised and independent of explicit reward modeling.

AI.tldr: CADFT提出了一种兼容性感知的动态微调方法，通过在样本层面控制优化方差，解决了SFT在异构指令数据上的不稳定性和泛化不足问题。
AI.motivation: SFT在大规模异构指令数据上存在优化不稳定和泛化有限的问题。现有DFT方法虽能修正token层面的梯度缩放问题，但错误地假设所有示范数据都是同等的学习目标，忽略了示范-策略不匹配导致的样本层面高方差更新。
AI.method: CADFT从模型似然中推导出动态的、策略依赖的兼容性信号来调节监督更新，抑制来自不兼容示范的高方差梯度；并提出延迟、低频的兼容性引导重写策略，将持续不兼容的示范转化为可学习目标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CADFT在稳定性、泛化性和冷启动强化学习初始化方面均有改进，且保持完全监督、无需显式奖励建模。
AI.conclusion: CADFT可被解释为一种方差控制估计器，将DFT中的token级稳定性推广到样本级，有效解决了异构指令数据下的微调问题。

title: DeceptionX: Explainable Deception Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Deception detection is a critical and highly challenging task within affective computing and behavioral analysis. Existing deep learning methods typically treat this task as a straightforward classification problem; however, this black-box approach lacks interpretability and fails to capture the complex logical deduction processes utilized by human experts when identifying lies. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown potential, applying them effectively requires a bridge between low-level audiovisual cues and high-level logical reasoning. In this paper, we propose DeceptionX, a novel MLLM framework that shifts the paradigm of deception detection from black-box classification to an interpretable Observe-Think-Summarize reasoning process. To address the scarcity of high-quality reasoning data, we first constructed DeceptChain, a high-quality dataset developed through a human-in-the-loop process. This dataset synthesizes fine-grained visual and auditory evidence (such as micro-expressions and vocal tremors) into structured chain-of-thought reasoning data. Furthermore, we propose a three-stage training pipeline and a Discrepancy-Aware Redundancy Elimination~(DARE) strategy for DeceptionX to further enhance the model's generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeceptionX not only outperforms existing MLLM baselines and state-of-the-art methods on standard real-world benchmarks but also provides transparent, expert-level reasoning paths, bridging the critical gap between accuracy and interpretability in multimodal deception detection.

AI.tldr: 提出DeceptionX，一种可解释的多模态大语言模型框架，将欺骗检测从黑箱分类转变为"观察-思考-总结"推理过程，通过构建DeceptChain数据集和三阶段训练策略，在保持高准确率的同时提供专家级可解释推理路径。
AI.motivation: 现有欺骗检测方法通常被视为简单分类问题，缺乏可解释性，无法捕捉人类专家辨别谎言时使用的复杂逻辑推理过程；而多模态大语言模型虽具潜力，但需要连接低层视听线索与高层逻辑推理的桥梁。
AI.method: 1) 构建DeceptChain高质量数据集（通过人在回路流程合成细粒度视觉和听觉证据的结构化思维链推理数据）；2) 提出DeceptionX框架，采用"观察-思考-总结"可解释推理范式；3) 设计三阶段训练流程；4) 提出差异感知冗余消除（DARE）策略以增强泛化能力。
AI.result: 在标准真实世界基准上，DeceptionX不仅优于现有MLLM基线和最先进方法，还能提供透明、专家级的推理路径，弥合了多模态欺骗检测中准确性与可解释性之间的关键差距。
AI.conclusion: DeceptionX成功将欺骗检测从黑箱分类转变为可解释推理过程，在保持高性能的同时提供了专家级可解释性，为多模态欺骗检测领域建立了新的范式。

title: BioDivergence: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Hidden Contextual Contradictions in Biomedical Abstracts
summary: Biomedical findings often seem to conflict across studies, but many of these differences are context-dependent rather than true contradictions. Variations in cohort, geography, assay protocol, disease subtype, and clinical setting can make both claims locally valid. Existing NLI and scientific claim-verification benchmarks reduce such cases to entailment, contradiction, or neutral, failing to capture the contextual structure behind divergence. To address this, we introduce BioDivergence, an evaluation framework with a six-class conflict taxonomy, a 13-axis divergence ontology, and four structured outputs per claim pair: conflict type, divergence axes, dominant confounder, and reconciliation explanation. We release BioDivergence-Silver-v1.0, an article-disjoint silver benchmark of 11,865 claim pairs across five biomedical domains, alongside a legacy deduplicated variant for comparison. Results show notable ranking differences between the two variants, with the fine-tuned reference model dropping about 12 points under the article-disjoint setting, while Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 achieves 0.5523 accuracy and 0.3894 contextual-F1 on the 842-example primary test set. BioDivergence offers a more faithful way to distinguish contextual divergence from direct contradiction and to separate article-level memorization from genuine task learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BioDivergence框架，用于区分生物医学研究中由上下文差异导致的发现分歧与真正的矛盾。该框架包含六类冲突分类法、13轴分歧本体论，并为每对声明输出冲突类型、分歧轴、主导混淆因素和解释说明。同时发布含11,865对声明的基准数据集BioDivergence-Silver-v1.0，实验表明微调模型在文章隔离设置下性能下降约12个点，Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3在842样本测试集上达到0.5523准确率和0.3894 contextual-F1。
AI.motivation: 现有NLI和科学声明验证基准将研究发现简化为蕴含、矛盾或中立三类，无法捕捉研究间分歧背后的上下文结构（如队列、地理、检测方案、疾病亚型、临床环境等差异），导致无法区分真正的矛盾与上下文相关的表面分歧。
AI.method: 构建包含六类冲突分类法（如直接矛盾、上下文分歧等）和13轴分歧本体论（覆盖队列、地理、亚型等维度）的评估框架，为每对声明输出冲突类型、分歧轴、主导混淆因素及解释四个结构化输出。同时构建文章隔离的银标准数据集（11,865对声明）及去重变体，用于评估模型是否真正学习任务而非记忆文章级模式。
AI.result: 微调参考模型在文章隔离设置下性能下降约12个点；Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3在842样本主测试集上准确率为0.5523，contextual-F1为0.3894；两个数据集变体（文章隔离 vs. 去重）的排名差异显著。
AI.conclusion: BioDivergence能更忠实地区分上下文分歧与直接矛盾，并能分离文章级记忆与真正的任务学习，为生物医学声明验证提供了更细粒度的评估范式。

title: A Scalable PyTorch Abstraction for Multi-GPU Gaussian Splatting
comment: 14 pages, 6 tables, 2 figures, and 1 listing. Includes supplementary material
summary: Gaussian splatting methods have become increasingly popular for neural reconstruction of the real world. However, they are often limited in scale and resolution due to compute and memory constraints. We present a multi-GPU Gaussian splatting approach that scales reconstruction to higher resolutions and larger scenes while abstracting away the code complexity typically associated with distributing a model. To accomplish this, we propose a PyTorch backend that distributes the Gaussian parameters and splatting operators across GPUs via CUDA unified memory and NVLink. Because distribution occurs at the operator level, the model code requires no explicit cross-device communication. More broadly, the backend exposes multiple GPUs as an aggregate PyTorch device and supports other PyTorch operators. We demonstrate city-scale reconstructions with street-level detail consisting of over 1 billion Gaussian splats, more than 25 times as many as the current state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多GPU高斯溅射方法，利用CUDA统一内存和NVLink实现算子级分布式计算，支持超过10亿个高斯原语的城市场景重建，比现有技术多25倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯溅射方法受限于单GPU的计算和内存约束，无法扩展到高分辨率和大规模场景。
AI.method: 设计了一个PyTorch后端，通过CUDA统一内存和NVLink将高斯参数和溅射算子分布到多个GPU上，在算子级别实现分布式计算，将多个GPU暴露为聚合PyTorch设备，无需显式跨设备通信代码。
AI.result: 实现了包含超过10亿个高斯原语的城市场景重建，是当前最先进方法的25倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效突破了单GPU的规模限制，大幅提升了高斯溅射在大场景重建中的可扩展性，同时保持了代码的简洁性。

title: ProcessThinker: Enhancing Multi-modal Large Language Models Reasoning via Rollout-based Process Reward
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. 7 pages, 1 figure
summary: Visual question answering increasingly requires multi-step reasoning. Recent post-training with reinforcement learning under verifiable rewards (RLVR) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) can improve multimodal reasoning, but most approaches rely on sparse outcome-only rewards. As a result, they struggle to tell whether an incorrect answer comes from a small mistake late in the reasoning or from an unhelpful trajectory from the start. A common solution is to train a process reward model (PRM) for step-level supervision, but this typically requires large-scale high-quality chain-of-thought annotations and additional training cost. We propose ProcessThinker, a practical post-training pipeline that provides step-level process rewards without training an explicit PRM. ProcessThinker first rewrites reasoning traces into a step-tagged format for cold-start supervised fine-tuning, then applies GRPO with a standard format reward and our rollout-based process reward. Concretely, for each intermediate step, we sample multiple continuations from that step and use the empirical success rate (final-answer verification) as the step reward. This gives dense credit assignment and encourages reasoning steps that more reliably support a correct conclusion, helping reduce inconsistent or self-contradictory progress across steps -- a key issue in logical reasoning. Across four challenging video benchmarks (Video-MMMU, MMVU, VideoMathQA, and LongVideoBench), ProcessThinker consistently improves over the baseline model Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct

AI.tldr: ProcessThinker提出了一种无需训练显式过程奖励模型(PRM)的实用后训练流水线，通过对推理轨迹进行步骤标记格式化冷启动SFT，并应用基于rollout的过程奖励与GRPO结合，为多步视觉问答推理提供密集的步骤级信用分配，在四个视频基准测试中一致超越基线Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态推理后训练方法（如RLVR+GRPO）主要依赖稀疏的最终结果奖励，无法区分错误是由于推理后期的小失误还是从一开始就无益的轨迹所致。训练过程奖励模型(PRM)需要大规模高质量思维链标注和额外训练成本，因此需要一种无需显式PRM的实用步骤级过程奖励方法。
AI.method: 1) 将推理轨迹重写为步骤标记格式进行冷启动监督微调(SFT)；2) 应用GRPO，结合标准格式奖励和基于rollout的过程奖励：对每个中间步骤采样多个后续延续，用最终答案验证的经验成功率作为该步骤的奖励，实现密集信用分配。
AI.result: 在Video-MMMU、MMVU、VideoMathQA和LongVideoBench四个具有挑战性的视频基准测试上，ProcessThinker一致性地优于基线模型Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 基于rollout的过程奖励结合GRPO能够有效提供密集的步骤级监督，无需训练额外的PRM，改善逻辑推理中步骤间不一致或自相矛盾的问题，是一种实用且有效的多步推理优化方案。

title: 3D-CBM: A Framework for Concept-Based Interpretability in Generative 3D Modeling
summary:
This research introduces a framework for incorporating Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) into 3D generative architectures to address the inherent 'semantic gap' in deep geometric learning. As deep models become central to 3D content creation, explainability shifts from a peripheral feature to a fundamental requirement for trust and accountability in safety-critical domains such as healthcare and manufacturing. CBMs provide an intrinsic interpretability solution by constraining latent representations to align with human-defined concepts, yet their application to unstructured 3D data remains largely unexplored.
  We design, implement, and validate a formal 3D-CBM architecture that maps raw geometric inputs, including point clouds and meshes, into a multi-tiered taxonomy of interpretable primitives and functional attributes. The framework further identifies strategic datasets, such as PartNet and ShapeNet, specialized for concept-based supervision. Experimental results from a 3D part-manipulation proof-of-concept experiment demonstrate the framework's efficacy, achieving a concept prediction accuracy of 88.8\% and a Chamfer Distance of 0.0115. Critically, the model enables precise test-time intervention, allowing for the interactive correction of structural errors. This work establishes a foundation for semantically-steerable 3D generation and invites further exploration into collaborative human-in-the-loop design systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将概念瓶颈模型（CBM）融入3D生成架构的框架（3D-CBM），以弥合深度几何学习中的“语义鸿沟”。该框架将原始几何输入（点云、网格）映射到可解释的原语和功能属性多层分类体系，并在PartNet和ShapeNet等数据集上进行概念监督训练。实验表明，在3D部件操作任务中概念预测准确率达88.8%，Chamfer距离为0.0115，并支持测试时干预以交互修正结构错误，为语义可控的3D生成和人机协同设计系统奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 深度模型在3D内容创作中日益核心，但可解释性在医疗、制造等安全关键领域仍显不足。现有CBM方法主要针对2D数据，其在非结构化3D数据（点云、网格）上的应用尚属空白，存在显著的“语义鸿沟”。
AI.method: 设计并实现3D-CBM架构：将原始3D几何输入映射到多层可解释原语与功能属性分类体系；选取PartNet、ShapeNet等专门数据集进行概念监督学习；通过3D部件操作实验进行概念预测与Chamfer距离评估。
AI.result: 概念预测准确率88.8%，Chamfer距离0.0115；模型支持精确的测试时干预，可交互式修正结构错误。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了语义可控的3D生成基础，为未来人机协同设计系统提供了可行方向。

title: T2MM: An LLM Supported Architecture For Inquiry-Based Modeling
summary: Model Construction is a foundational practice in science learning that relies on visualization and interactivity. Large Language Models, increasingly augmented with multimodal capabilities, have been integrated in education contexts to support learning. However, these tools lack visual interactivity that is required by some learning contexts. We introduce Text to Multimodal Model (T2MM), a robust, dynamic LLM supported architecture that assists in model construction within the open inquiry ecology-based modeling software Virtual Experimental Research Assistant (VERA). T2MM accounts for the current context of the learner's model and creates interactive models, rather than static images, enabling the model to remain responsive to manual adjustment. To measure technical feasibility, we evaluate T2MM through a custom procedurally generated dataset of natural language learner modeling requests and target models within the VERA system. T2MM outperforms a baseline model generation architecture implemented through LLM-supported full code generation, common in the literature, across all measured success metrics. Our contribution not only outlines LLM integration into a inquiry-based learning modeling tool, but also describes a possible architecture through which more interactive multimodal LLM tools can be created.

AI.tldr: 本文提出T2MM架构，将多模态LLM集成到基于探究的生态建模软件VERA中，通过理解学习者当前模型上下文生成可交互模型而非静态图像，在自定义数据集上优于基线全代码生成方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在教育中缺乏视觉交互性，无法满足科学学习中模型构建所需的可视化与交互需求。
AI.method: 提出T2MM（Text to Multimodal Model）架构，利用LLM理解学习者自然语言请求及当前模型上下文，动态生成可交互的模型而非静态图像，并保持对人工调整的响应性。
AI.result: 在自定义程序化生成的VERA系统数据集上，T2MM在全部评估指标上优于基于LLM全代码生成的基线模型架构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅展示了LLM在探究式学习建模工具中的集成，还描述了创建更具交互性的多模态LLM工具的可行架构。

title: Exploring Adaptive Masked Reconstruction for Self-Supervised Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
comment: Accepted by CVPR2026. The code is available at https://github.com/AshenOne1005/AMR
summary: Recently, masked skeleton reconstruction models have emerged as strong action representation learners, driving significant progress in self-supervised skeleton-based action recognition. However, existing state-of-the-art methods must predict an exceedingly large number of spatiotemporal patches, significantly prolonging training time. Besides, by treating all spatiotemporal regions equally during reconstruction, these models are distracted from learning the critical motion patterns that underlie action semantics. To address these challenges, we propose Adaptive Masked Reconstruction (AMR), a faster and stronger pre-training framework. We first decouple the decoder from the encoder, enabling flexible prediction of larger spatiotemporal patches and dramatically reducing reconstruction complexity. Given that larger patches contain more complex information, which is challenging to predict and consequently degrades performance, we accordingly introduce an adaptive guidance module. This module identifies regions of high motion informativeness, guiding the model to focus on the most discriminative parts of each patch and alleviating reconstruction difficulty. Experiments on NTU RGB+D 60, NTU RGB+D 120, and PKU-MMD datasets demonstrate that AMR not only accelerates pre-training substantially but also improves downstream recognition accuracy, surpassing current state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应掩码重建（AMR）框架，通过解耦编码器-解码器以预测更大的时空块来加速训练，并引入自适应引导模块聚焦高运动信息区域以提升重建质量，在多个数据集上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码骨架重建模型存在两个问题：(1) 需要预测大量时空块，训练时间过长；(2) 对所有时空区域一视同仁，忽略了关键运动模式的学习。
AI.method: (1) 解耦解码器与编码器，使解码器能够灵活预测更大的时空块，降低重建复杂度；(2) 设计自适应引导模块，识别高运动信息区域，引导模型聚焦每个块中最具判别力的部分，缓解大块预测困难。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D 60、NTU RGB+D 120和PKU-MMD数据集上，AMR显著加速预训练并提升下游识别准确率，超越当前SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: AMR通过解耦架构和自适应引导实现了更快更强的人体骨架自监督预训练，验证了在稀疏时空重建中聚焦关键运动模式的有效性。

title: Calibration Drift Under Reasoning: How Chain-of-Thought Budgets Induce Overconfidence in Large Language Models
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Introduces Calibration Drift Under Reasoning (CDUR) with theoretical analysis and preliminary experiments; includes CABStop; code and data available
summary:
The ability of large language models (LLMs) to express calibrated uncertainty is important for safe deployment. Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely used to improve accuracy and reliability, but its effect on calibration is not fully understood. We show that this picture is incomplete: in some settings, increasing the reasoning budget beyond a task-specific threshold can cause models to become systematically overconfident, assigning high confidence to incorrect answers. We call this phenomenon Calibration Drift Under Reasoning (CDUR) and study it both theoretically and empirically.
  We define reasoning budget B and analyze conditions under which Expected Calibration Error ECE(B) follows a non-monotonic pattern: it first decreases as reasoning corrects errors, then increases as longer reasoning produces internally consistent but incorrect explanations. We propose a Hypothesis Lock-In model based on autoregressive generation to explain this behavior.
  We evaluate Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.3-70B on 47 reasoning-trap questions across four reasoning budgets and three seeds (1,368 API calls; 574 valid responses). The 8B model shows non-monotonic calibration behavior, while results for the 70B model are limited to baseline evaluation and are inconclusive for budget-dependent effects.
  We introduce CABStop, a calibration-aware stopping rule that halts reasoning when confidence diverges from an auxiliary accuracy estimate. These results suggest that increasing reasoning depth does not always improve reliability and should be monitored carefully.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型在链式推理中，当推理预算超过任务特定阈值时，模型会变得系统性过度自信，即校准漂移现象(CDUR)，并提出了一种校准感知的停止规则CABStop来缓解此问题。
AI.motivation: 链式推理(CoT)被广泛用于提升LLM的准确性和可靠性，但其对校准质量（模型置信度与真实正确率之间的一致性）的影响尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 定义了推理预算B，理论上分析了期望校准误差ECE(B)的非单调模式（先降后升）；提出基于自回归生成的假设锁定模型解释该现象；引入CABStop校准感知停止规则，当置信度偏离辅助准确性估计时停止推理。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.3-70B上的47个推理陷阱问题实验中，8B模型展示了非单调校准行为；70B模型仅完成基线评估，预算依赖效应的结果不具结论性。
AI.conclusion: 增加推理深度并不总能提升可靠性，需要谨慎监控；CABStop可作为缓解校准漂移的有效手段。

title: PT-WNO: Point Transformer with Wavelet Neural Operator for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
summary: Point cloud semantic segmentation requires architectures that capture both fine-grained local geometry and broad global scene structure. Transformer-based networks have demonstrated strong performance by focusing on detailed local feature aggregation; however, global context is conveyed primarily through skip connections across encoder-decoder stages, which we argue is insufficient for full scene understanding. We hypothesize that augmenting skip connections with a learnable global feature extraction module allows the network to acquire scene-level knowledge before descending into local detail, leading to richer and more contextually grounded representations. To this end, we propose Point Transformer with Wavelet Neural Operato (PT-WNO), which integrates a shared Wavelet Neural Operator (WNO) branch alongside the skip connections of a point cloud transformer backbone. At each encoder-decoder transition, point features are projected onto a dense 3D volumetric grid where the WNO captures multi-scale global spectral context through learnable wavelet decomposition and reconstruction. These global features are fused back into the network via lightweight adapters, complementing rather than replacing the existing skip connections. Experiments on four large-scale 3D point cloud benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of PT-WNO. On S3DIS (Area 5), PT-WNO achieves 71.59% mIoU, outperforming the Point Transformer v3 (PTv3) baseline by +1.03 points. On DALES it achieves 81.05% mIoU (+1.47 over the baseline). On ScanNet~v2, PT-WNO obtains 76.19% mIoU, remaining competitive with the baseline (76.36%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出PT-WNO，在点云Transformer的跳跃连接旁引入可学习的小波神经算子（WNO）分支，通过将点特征投影到3D体素网格进行多尺度全局频谱上下文建模，增强了场景级语义理解。在S3DIS、DALES等基准上超越基线，在ScanNet v2上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的点云语义分割网络主要通过跳跃连接在编码器-解码器阶段间传递全局上下文，作者认为这不足以实现完整的场景理解，需要增强网络获取场景级知识的能力。
AI.method: 在点云Transformer主干网络的跳跃连接旁，集成一个共享的小波神经算子（WNO）分支。每个编码器-解码器过渡阶段，将点特征投影到稠密3D体素网格，WNO通过可学习的小波分解与重建捕获多尺度全局频谱上下文，再通过轻量适配器将全局特征融合回网络，与原有跳跃连接互补。
AI.result: S3DIS (Area 5) 达71.59% mIoU，超越PTv3基线+1.03；DALES达81.05% mIoU，+1.47；ScanNet v2达76.19% mIoU，与基线(76.36%)持平。
AI.conclusion: 引入可学习的全局特征提取模块（WNO）辅助跳跃连接，能够有效增强点云Transformer的场景级语义表征能力，在多个大规模数据集上验证了其有效性。

title: EverydayGPT: Confidence-Gated Routing for Efficient and Safe Hybrid GPT-RAG Conversational QA
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code and evaluation scripts available at: https://github.com/merciless-admiral-3083/EverydayGPT. This paper studies routing strategies for hybrid GPT-RAG systems under resource constraints, focusing on efficiency-safety tradeoffs rather than state-of-the-art accuracy
summary: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines route every query through retrieval and generation unconditionally, incurring unnecessary computation and propagating low-quality context to the generator. We introduce EverydayGPT, a lightweight conversational QA system built around a Confidence-Gated Routing (CGR) mechanism that formalises the routing decision as a joint policy over retrieval distance and extraction adequacy. The backbone is a 205M-parameter GPT trained from scratch on 10B tokens of FineWeb-Edu. CGR avoids invoking the costly GPT pathway (~5.9s) for 85 percent of queries by resolving them via fast RAG extraction (~45 ms), yielding over 120x latency reduction on the majority of queries while maintaining answer quality. On a 500-question in-domain benchmark, the system achieves F1 = 0.226 +/- 0.004 compared to 0.171 for GPT-only and 0.210 for unconditional RAG. Gains over strong baselines are modest but consistent, while efficiency improvements are substantial (6.3x mean latency reduction). A structured grounding audit finds no unsupported claims in the sampled set, with explicit scope limitations. We position this work as a study of routing strategies under resource constraints rather than a claim of state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: EverydayGPT是一个基于置信度门控路由（CGR）机制的轻量级对话问答系统。其核心是一个从零训练的205M参数GPT模型，通过CGR策略为85%的查询绕过昂贵的生成路径（~5.9s），转而使用快速RAG提取（~45ms），实现120倍以上的延迟降低，同时保持回答质量。在500题评估中，F1得分为0.226，优于GPT-only（0.171）和无条件RAG（0.210）。作者将该工作定位为资源约束下路由策略的研究，而非SOTA性能的主张。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG流水线对每个查询都无条件执行检索和生成步骤，导致大量不必要的计算开销，且低质量上下文被传递到生成器，影响效率和质量。
AI.method: 提出置信度门控路由（CGR）机制，将路由决策形式化为检索距离和提取充分性的联合策略。使用从零训练的205M参数GPT模型（10B tokens FineWeb-Edu），对查询进行分类：85%的查询通过快速RAG提取（~45ms）直接回答，仅15%的查询触发完整的GPT生成路径（~5.9s）。
AI.result: 在500题域内基准上，F1=0.226±0.004（优于GPT-only的0.171和无条件RAG的0.210）；85%查询延迟降低120倍以上，平均延迟降低6.3倍；结构化接地审计未发现无根据的主张。
AI.conclusion: CGR策略在保持回答质量的同时显著提升了推理效率，尤其适用于资源受限场景。但作者强调这是路由策略研究，而非追求SOTA性能。

title: Towards Fully Automated Exam Grading: Fairness-Aware Recognition of Handwritten Answers with Foundation Models
summary: Correcting handwritten exams by hand is time-consuming and error-prone, particularly for large cohorts, while fully digital exams tend to force a didactic narrowing towards closed question formats. A practical middle ground keeps paper-based, problem-oriented tasks but records the assessment-relevant answers as single capital letters in a table that a machine can read. The open question is whether this reading can be made accurate and, above all, fair enough for unsupervised grading. Earlier automated approaches reached only about 88%--91% recognition -- too low -- and failed on the cases that matter most: answers placed outside the cell, crossed out, or written in cursive. We show that general-purpose vision-language foundation models (VLMs), which interpret the page rather than match pixel templates, close this gap. On a benchmark of 61 anonymised exams (3141 answer positions) the best model reaches 98.4% accuracy, well above the previous baseline. Crucially, we centre the evaluation on fairness: we distinguish false negatives (a correct answer marked wrong, which disadvantages the student) from false positives, and a lightweight prompt that supplies the reference solution as context lowers the false-negative rate to 0.58%. Under an exemplary grading scheme only three of the 61 exams would be graded worse, all caught by a student self-review step. Fully automated, fairness-aware exam grading at scale is therefore defensible; we release the anonymised benchmark to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出利用通用视觉语言基础模型（VLM）来批改手写试卷，在不牺牲公平性的前提下实现了98.4%的识别准确率，将假阴性率降至0.58%，使得大规模自动化考试批改成为可行。
AI.motivation: 传统手写阅卷耗时且易出错，而全数字化考试又迫使教学向封闭式问题倾斜。需要一个折中方案：保留纸质问题导向型任务，但将答案以大写字母形式记录在机器可读的表格中。关键问题在于能否实现足够准确且公平的自动识别，以便进行无监督批改。
AI.method: 使用通用视觉语言基础模型（VLM）解读试卷页面，而非传统的像素模板匹配。设计轻量级提示（prompt）将参考答案作为上下文信息输入模型。在61份匿名考试（3141个答案位置）的基准测试上评估，并区分假阴性（正确答案被标记为错误，对学生不利）和假阳性两种错误类型。
AI.result: 最佳模型达到98.4%的准确率，远超此前88%-91%的基线水平。通过提供参考答案上下文的轻量级提示，假阴性率降至0.58%。在示例性评分方案下，61份试卷中仅3份评分变差，且均可通过学生自我复核步骤发现。
AI.conclusion: 完全自动化、公平性感知的大规模考试批改是可行的，研究团队已发布匿名基准测试以支持可重复性。

title: Beyond Compaction: Structured Context Eviction for Long-Horizon Agents
summary:
We present Context Window Lifecycle (CWL), a context-management scheme that gives long-horizon LLM agents an effectively unbounded working horizon. As a session accumulates history, CWL keeps the context within budget through graduated, semantically-aware eviction: the agent annotates its trajectory as typed, dependency-linked episodes as work proceeds, and a deterministic, LLM-free policy evicts content in priority order within that structure when a token budget is exceeded. CWL preserves user turns and the exploratory context the agent is actively reasoning over, while aggressively shedding action episodes whose effects are already persisted in the environment, keeping active context near a stable ceiling that also avoids the performance degradation associated with very large prompts.
  Compared to summarization-based compaction, CWL avoids four well-known limitations: unpredictable lossiness, destruction of causal structure, blocking model cost, and compression-induced hallucination. Compared to recency truncation, CWL is semantically aware: it drops the oldest-and-most-recoverable content according to the dependency graph rather than oldest-in-time regardless of relevance. We describe the annotation protocol, the episode graph, the eviction policy, and the token-accounting loop, and evaluate CWL on long-horizon agentic benchmarks: a single agent session completing 89 sequential tasks across 80 million tokens with no measurable degradation in task accuracy relative to per-task isolated sessions

AI.tldr: 提出上下文生命周期管理方案，通过语义感知的渐进式驱逐策略，使LLM智能体在8000万token的长序列任务中保持稳定性能，避免压缩和截断的常见问题。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM智能体面临上下文窗口预算有限的问题，现有方法（摘要压缩和最近截断）存在信息丢失、因果结构破坏、高成本和幻觉等缺陷。
AI.method: CWL通过带类型的依赖链接片段注释轨迹，在超出token预算时基于优先级顺序执行确定性驱逐策略：保留用户轮次和智能体正在推理的探索上下文，丢弃已在环境中持久化的动作片段。
AI.result: 在单个智能体会话中完成89个连续任务，总token量达8000万，任务准确率与每任务独立会话相比无 measurable 下降。
AI.conclusion: CWL提供了有效无限的工作窗口，避免了摘要压缩的四个局限性和时间截断的语义盲区，为长周期智能体任务提供了实用的上下文管理方案。

title: On the Study of Biometric Spoofing Detection using Deep Learning
summary: Biometric systems are increasingly deployed in security applications; however, they remain vulnerable to spoofing attacks, in which attackers exploit counterfeit biometric data to gain unauthorized access. This research evaluates the effectiveness of state-of-the-art machine learning models, MobileNetV2, DenseNet-121, Inception-v3, and Spoof Trace Disentanglement (STD) in detecting spoofing attacks within facial recognition systems. Using the CelebA-Spoof dataset, the study evaluates model effectiveness using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 Score. Cross-dataset validation is carried out on the MSU-MFSD dataset to assess generalizability. The results show MobileNetV2 as the most efficient model, achieving 92% accuracy while balancing computational effectiveness, making it appropriate for real-life applications. Inception-v3 shows moderate robustness, while DenseNet-121 and STD struggle with generalization. The findings highlight the need for advances in domain adaptation and hybrid architectures to enhance biometric security systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了MobileNetV2、DenseNet-121、Inception-v3和STD四种机器学习模型在面部识别系统欺骗攻击检测中的效果，基于CelebA-Spoof数据集和MSU-MFSD跨数据集验证。MobileNetV2以92%的准确率和计算效率最优，适合实际应用；而DenseNet-121和STD泛化能力不足。研究指出需推进域适应和混合架构以增强生物识别安全性。
AI.motivation: 生物识别系统在安全应用中部署广泛，但仍易受欺骗攻击（spoofing attacks），攻击者利用伪造的生物特征数据获取未授权访问。现有检测方法的泛化能力和计算效率有待提升，亟需系统评估最新深度学习模型在面部反欺骗中的表现。
AI.method: 采用CelebA-Spoof数据集训练MobileNetV2、DenseNet-121、Inception-v3及STD模型，通过准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数评估性能；并在MSU-MFSD数据集上进行跨数据集验证以测试泛化能力。
AI.result: MobileNetV2在准确率（92%）和计算效率之间取得最佳平衡；Inception-v3表现出中等鲁棒性；DenseNet-121和STD在跨数据集泛化方面表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 当前的深度学习模型在面部反欺骗任务中仍有泛化瓶颈，未来需加强域适应技术和混合架构的研究，以提升生物识别安全系统的可靠性。

title: Afrispeech Semantics: Evaluating Audio Semantic Reasoning in Spoken Language Models Across Domains and Accents
summary: Audio language models (ALMs) are increasingly used for speech-based understanding, yet their ability to perform semantic reasoning beyond transcription, Text-to-Audio Retrieval, Captioning, and Question-Answering accuracy remains insufficiently benchmarked. In particular, the effects of accent variation, domain shift, and semantic over-inference on audio reasoning are poorly understood. We evaluate audio language models across five semantic and paralinguistic reasoning tasks: entailment, consistency, plausibility, accent drift, and accent restraint. Collectively, these tasks assess a model's ability to reason over spoken audio as the primary evidence source, including whether a textual hypothesis can be inferred, contradicted, or left undetermined by the audio, whether statements align or conflict with spoken content, whether claims are plausible given the discourse, and whether model predictions remain stable or appropriately constrained across accent variation. These findings highlight critical limitations in current audio reasoning evaluations and hope to provide guidance for more robust and equitable ALM design and assessment

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套包含五项语义与副语言推理任务的基准，用于系统评估音频语言模型在口音变化、领域迁移和语义过度推断下的推理能力，揭示了当前评估体系的严重局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有音频语言模型评估过度关注转录、文本到音频检索、字幕生成和问答等准确性指标，缺乏对语义推理能力的系统评测，特别是口音变化、领域迁移和语义过度推断对音频推理的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 设计了五项语义和副语言推理任务：蕴含（entailment）、一致性（consistency）、合理性（plausibility）、口音漂移（accent drift）和口音约束（accent restraint），全面评估模型以语音音频为主要证据源进行推理的能力。
AI.result: 当前音频语言模型在五项推理任务上表现存在显著不足，尤其在口音变化和语义过度推断场景下，模型的推理稳定性和约束性有待提升。
AI.conclusion: 现有音频推理评估存在关键局限性，需要更鲁棒和公平的音频语言模型设计与评估方法。

title: SceneMiner: Identity-Preserving Multi-Task Fine-Tuning for Unified BEV Scene Mining
summary: Mining hard, safety-critical scenes from driving logs is bottlenecked by the absence of difficulty labels, and no single proxy, collision risk, trajectory ambiguity, or semantic rarity suffices to find such scenes on its own. We present SceneMiner, a unified, camera-only bird's-eye-view pipeline that emits complementary mining signals from a frozen vision-language backbone in a single forward pass, with no LiDAR or radar: a retrieval embedding for text-prompted scenario search, a multi-label scene-tag distribution, and a continuous physics-based risk score (a motion forecast is a byproduct, not a contribution). Building such a multi-head model exposes our central finding, a failure mode we term cross-task interference: adding or upgrading one head shifts a shared activation stream and degrades weight-frozen sibling heads, so freezing parameters alone is insufficient. Our contribution, identity-preserving multi-task fine-tuning, removes this interference by zero-initializing every new sub-module and freezing every parameter that feeds the shared stream. The mining heads are thereby preserved bit-identically while training only ~102k parameters. The tagging head reaches mAP 0.4614 (micro-F1 0.5557) on 20 scene tags by pooling each scene into 32 visual tokens, and the embedding head supports text-prompted retrieval, validated qualitatively. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sceneminer_anonymous-64E5

AI.tldr: SceneMiner提出了一种仅基于摄像头的鸟瞰图统一流水线，利用冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络在一次前向传播中发出互补的挖掘信号，用于从驾驶日志中挖掘难例和安全关键场景。其核心创新是身份保持的多任务微调方法，通过零初始化新子模块并冻结所有共享流参数，解决了跨任务干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 驾驶日志中难例和安全关键场景的挖掘因缺乏难度标签而受阻，且单一代理指标（碰撞风险、轨迹模糊性或语义稀有性）不足以独立发现此类场景。
AI.method: 提出SceneMiner统一流水线：(1) 基于冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络，仅使用摄像头输入输出鸟瞰图特征；(2) 单次前向传播生成三种互补信号：文本提示场景检索嵌入、多标签场景标签分布、连续物理风险评分；(3) 身份保持的多任务微调：零初始化新子模块，冻结所有共享流参数，避免跨任务干扰。
AI.result: 标签头在20个场景标签上达到mAP 0.4614（micro-F1 0.5557），通过将每个场景池化为32个视觉令牌；嵌入头支持文本提示检索（定性验证）；仅训练约10.2万个参数。
AI.conclusion: 冻结参数不足以保持多任务学习的性能，提出的身份保持微调方法能消除跨任务干扰，以极少可训练参数实现有效场景挖掘。

title: LifeSentence: Language models can encode human life course trajectories from longitudinal panel data
summary: Forecasting human life outcomes is important to gain insights into how individuals attain long and healthy lives. Conventional statistical approaches yield limited accuracy, potentially due to discarding the sequential structure of the life course. Modern methods such as transformer architectures require large scale training data that most longitudinal panel studies lack. Here we introduce LifeSentence, a model for life-course reasoning that bridges large language models with longitudinal panel data. By representing each life event as a structured natural-language record and instruction-tuning a pretrained 24-billion-parameter language model across an 18-task evaluation taxonomy spanning prediction, robustness and reasoning, LifeSentence supplements panel data with distributional knowledge already encoded during pretraining. Trained on approximately 65,000 individuals from the German Socio-Economic Panel - roughly 45 times fewer than prior transformer-based approaches - LifeSentence outperforms classical and deep learning baselines across all task families, achieving a threefold improvement in joint event-and-timing prediction from best baselines and 91.2% Kendall's tau when reconstructing chronological order from timestamp-stripped event sets. Without explicit supervision, the model recovers documented patterns of social stratification, including the education premium, the gender wage gap and the motherhood penalty, from discrete event sequences alone. A natural-language interface further enables qualitatively new research queries, such as connecting an early-life history to a specified late-life endpoint, establishing LifeSentence as both a predictive tool and a probe for counterfactual exploration of human biographies.

AI.tldr: LifeSentence是一个将大语言模型与纵向面板数据结合的模型，通过在结构化自然语言记录中表示人生事件并对24B参数语言模型进行指令微调，在仅约65,000个体的训练数据上（比之前Transformer方法少约45倍），超越了传统统计和深度学习方法，在联合事件-时间预测上实现三倍提升，时间顺序重建达到91.2% Kendall's tau，并能无监督地恢复社会分层模式，支持反事实探索。
AI.motivation: 传统统计方法预测人生结果精度有限，因其丢弃了生命历程的顺序结构；而现代Transformer方法需要大规模训练数据，多数纵向面板研究缺乏此类数据。
AI.method: 将每个人生事件表示为结构化自然语言记录，对预训练的24B参数语言模型进行指令微调，在18个任务的评估分类体系上进行训练，利用预训练中已编码的分布知识补充面板数据。
AI.result: 在约65,000个体的德国社会经济面板数据上训练，在所有任务家族上超越传统统计和深度学习方法基线；联合事件-时间预测相比最佳基线提升三倍；时间顺序重建达到91.2% Kendall's tau；无监督地恢复了教育溢价、性别工资差距和母职惩罚等社会分层模式。
AI.conclusion: LifeSentence既是预测工具，也是对人类传记进行反事实探索的探针，其自然语言接口支持将早期生命历程连接到指定晚年端点等新型研究查询。

title: VL-DINO: Leveraging CLIP Vision-Language Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detectio
summary: Vision-language models like CLIP can provide rich semantic priors for open-vocabulary object detection. However, jointly integrating both textual and visual knowledge into detection architectures remains challenging. In this paper, we propose VL-DINO, an open-vocabulary detector that enhances DINO through more effective exploitation of CLIP's vision-language knowledge. Specifically, a Query-guided Positive Sample Construction (QPSC) module is first developed to construct additional high-quality positive samples, enabling the vanilla DINO framework to better accommodate mixed training across heterogeneous data sources while providing more vision-language alignment signals, thereby incorporating richer textual knowledge during training. A Visual Semantic Encoder (VSE) module is then introduced to distill CLIP visual knowledge into backbone-extracted features, producing fused features for subsequent encoder refinement. Based on the fused features, an Object-Region Semantic Alignment (ORSA) module extracts object-centric region features and aligns them with the corresponding textual embeddings, further incorporating textual cues. In the zero-shot setting, VL-DINO-T and VL-DINO-L achieve 36.3 and 38.1 AP on the LVIS benchmark, respectively, consistently outperforming prior advanced approaches. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and competitive performance of the proposed design.

AI.tldr: 提出VL-DINO，通过QPSC模块构建高质量正样本、VSE模块蒸馏CLIP视觉知识、ORSA模块对齐目标区域与文本嵌入，在LVIS零样本检测上分别达到36.3和38.1 AP，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型能为开放词汇目标检测提供语义先验，但如何将文本和视觉知识有效整合到检测架构中仍具挑战。
AI.method: 1) QPSC：查询引导的正样本构建，生成额外高质量正样本以提供更多视觉-语言对齐信号；2) VSE：视觉语义编码器，将CLIP视觉知识蒸馏到骨干网络提取的特征中；3) ORSA：目标-区域语义对齐模块，提取目标中心区域特征并与对应文本嵌入对齐。
AI.result: 零样本设定下，VL-DINO-T和VL-DINO-L在LVIS基准上分别达到36.3和38.1 AP，持续优于此前先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明所提设计在开放词汇检测中有效且具有竞争力的性能。

title: A Geometric Profile of Semantic Information in Text: Frame-Conditional Uniqueness and a Trade-Off Triangle for Scalar Summaries
summary:
How much meaning does a text carry? Shannon's theory measures uncertainty over symbols and is intentionally indifferent to meaning, while pairwise metrics such as BERTScore compare two texts rather than characterizing one. We develop a geometric framework that measures semantic content from the structure of a text's sentence embeddings.
  The framework has three parts. First, within a fixed embedding and baseline, six natural axioms uniquely determine a scalar measure up to scale, a frame-conditional uniqueness theorem. The resulting scalar is empirically too coarse, motivating a richer representation. Second, we propose a three-coordinate semantic profile capturing novelty (displacement from generic discourse), breadth (diversity of distinct ideas), and integration (connectedness among them), together with a discrete minimal unit (the semantic quantum) whose resolution is fixed by a clustering threshold $τ$. Third, we prove a no-go theorem: no scalar summary of the profile can simultaneously satisfy analytic stability under paraphrase and concatenation, ordinal robustness across text scales, and cross-representation comparability. We exhibit two practical scalars, $S_{\mathrm{minmax}}$ and $S_{\mathrm{rank}}$, each occupying a distinct corner of this trade-off triangle.
  Validation across 23 synthetic categories, 5 Project Gutenberg novels, and 3 embedding models confirms the trade-off. The recommended rank-normalized configuration passes 25 of 28 ordinal checks as point estimates (21 of 28 after Benjamini-Hochberg correction), outperforming seven baselines including unigram entropy and a BERTScore-based novelty signal. A separate variational result connects the breadth coordinate to the log-determinant of a determinantal point process (Spearman $ρ= 0.985$ over 507 Gutenberg chapters), giving an optimization-theoretic foundation for breadth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于句子嵌入几何结构的语义内容量化框架，包含公理化标量测度、三维语义画像（新颖性、广度、整合性）及不可行定理，并通过实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有度量（如Shannon熵）对语义内容漠不关心，而成对度量（如BERTScore）只能比较两段文本而非刻画单段文本的语义含量，因此需要一种能从文本自身结构出发的语义内容度量方法。
AI.method: 首先在固定嵌入和基线下，通过六条自然公理唯一确定一个标量测度（帧条件唯一性定理）；其次提出三维语义画像：新颖性（偏离一般话语的位移）、广度（不同思想的多样性）、整合性（思想间的连通性），并通过聚类阈值τ定义语义量子；最后证明不可行定理：任何标量摘要无法同时满足解析稳定性、序数鲁棒性和跨表示可比较性，并给出两种实用标量S_minmax和S_rank。
AI.result: 在23个合成类别、5部Gutenberg小说和3个嵌入模型上的验证确认了权衡关系。推荐的秩归一化配置在28个序数检验中通过25个（校正后21个），优于7个基线（包括unigram熵和基于BERTScore的新颖性信号）。广度坐标与行列式点过程的对数行列式之间Spearman ρ=0.985。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为单段文本的语义内容提供了可公理化的几何度量方法，揭示了不同度量目标之间的根本性权衡，并通过实验验证了其实际有效性与优化理论基础。

title: Cross-Modal Benchmarking for Robotic Perception in Natural Environments
comment: Accepted to the IEEE ICRA Workshop on Open Challenges for Rigorous Robot Perception 2026
summary: Natural environments present a complex challenge to robotics perception systems. Current models, particularly vision foundation models, are largely trained on structured, urban environments leading to weaknesses in their perception for field robotics tasks. We showcase the limitations of current models using our recently released WildCross benchmark, a new cross-modal benchmark for place recognition and metric depth estimation in large-scale natural environments. WildCross comprises over 476K sequential RGB frames with semi-dense depth and surface normal annotations, each aligned with accurate 6DoF pose and synchronized dense lidar submaps. In this work, we provide an expanded analysis of the benchmark results from the recent WildCross benchmark, with particular emphasis on expanded metric depth estimation experiments. Access to the code repository and dataset for this work can be found at https://csiro-robotics.github.io/WildCross.

AI.tldr: WildCross基准测试揭示了当前视觉基础模型在自然环境中的局限性，该基准包含47.6万帧RGB图像及深度、法线标注，用于评估地点识别和度量深度估计。本文重点扩展分析了度量深度估计实验的结果。
AI.motivation: 自然环境的复杂性给机器人感知系统带来挑战，而现有视觉模型主要基于结构化城市环境训练，在野外机器人任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 利用WildCross基准测试（包含476K+时序RGB帧、半稠密深度/表面法线标注、6DoF姿态和密集激光雷达子图）进行跨模态评估，重点扩展度量深度估计实验。
AI.result: 现有视觉基础模型在大规模自然环境中表现不佳，WildCross基准测试量化展示了这些局限性。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉基础模型在自然环境感知方面存在显著不足，WildCross为评估和改进野外机器人感知提供了重要基准。

title: Every Act Has Its Price: Compressed Moral Composition in Frontier LLMs
summary: Existing LLM moral benchmarks usually ask which isolated moral act, value, or foundation a model prefers. This is useful but incomplete.
