Realistic judgments often require a model to combine several moral signals within the same option. We introduce **Moral Trolley Arena**, a two-stage blind ELO benchmark for measuring how LLMs compose moral evidence. The single-scene arena first calibrates individual moral acts from a 229-scenario corpus across five Moral Foundations Theory foundations; the composite arena then combines calibrated acts into two-act moral items over a controlled intensity grid and measures the resulting composite preferences. Across ten frontier models, composite judgments are largely predicted by component act strength, but the relation is consistently compressed rather than simply additive. Models also show non-additive intensity anchoring, bounded foundation-specific residuals after component control, and highly convergent composite preference surfaces across providers. These results suggest that moral audits should measure composition rules for moral evidence, not only rankings over isolated acts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Moral Trolley Arena，一个两阶段盲ELO基准，用于评估LLM如何组合道德证据。通过单场景校准和复合场景组合，发现模型在复合道德判断中呈现压缩而非简单加性的组合模式，并表现出强度锚定、有界残差和跨模型收敛的特征。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德基准仅评估模型对孤立道德行为、价值或基础的偏好，这忽略了现实决策中需要同时组合多种道德信号的复杂性。因此需要一种能衡量模型如何组合道德证据的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段盲ELO基准Moral Trolley Arena：第一阶段在229场景语料库上校准个体道德行为（基于道德基础理论的五个基础）；第二阶段将校准后的行为组合成双行为道德项目，在受控强度网格上测量复合偏好。
AI.result: 在10个前沿模型上，复合判断主要由组件行为强度预测，但关系呈压缩而非简单加性；模型表现出非加性强度锚定、组件控制后有界的基础特异性残差，以及跨供应商高度收敛的复合偏好曲面。
AI.conclusion: 道德审计不仅应评估对孤立行为的排名，还应测量道德证据的组合规则，因为模型在复合判断中表现出系统性的非加性组合偏差。

title: 4DP-QA: Scalable QA for 4D Perception in Vision Language Models
summary: Despite recent advances, Vision Language Models (VLMs) still struggle to grasp the dynamics of the world. We note that the ability to reason about a 4D scene, challenging in itself, is further complicated by two factors. First, VLMs observe motion indirectly via its projection onto 2D images. Second, existing datasets fail to disentangle object and camera motion. To address these challenges, we present a QA generation pipeline that focuses on motion-related scene understanding. We take particular care of the entanglement of camera and object motion by casting tracking in both the traditional way and in a novel, fixed reference system, dubbed True-Motion Tracking, which provides an intuitive description of motion. From this pipeline, we generate a large-scale training dataset of 400K samples, 4DP-QA (4D Perception QA), and a 2.2K-sample benchmark, 4DP-QA-Bench. Training existing models on our dataset yields performance improvements on an external benchmark, validating the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型在理解4D动态场景中的不足，提出了一种专注于运动场景理解的问答生成管道，通过创新的“真运动追踪”固定参考系来解耦物体与相机运动，并构建了包含40万训练样本的4DP-QA数据集和2200样本的基准测试集，训练后的模型在外部基准上取得性能提升。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在理解世界动态方面存在困难，主要原因有二：一是VLM只能通过2D图像投影间接观察运动，二是现有数据集未能解耦物体运动与相机运动，导致模型难以真正理解4D场景中的运动动力学。
AI.method: 提出了一个运动相关场景理解的QA生成管道，通过传统追踪方式和创新的固定参考系（True-Motion Tracking，真运动追踪）来解耦相机与物体运动，生成大规模训练数据集4DP-QA（40万样本）和基准测试集4DP-QA-Bench（2200样本）。
AI.result: 在现有模型上使用该数据集进行训练后，模型在外部基准测试上取得了性能提升，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦物体与相机运动并生成专门的4D运动理解数据集，可以有效提升视觉语言模型对动态场景的理解能力。

title: Energy-Efficient On-Device RAG on a Mobile NPU: System Design and Benchmark on Snapdragon X Elite
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines are compute-intensive, combining embedding, retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) generation. Running them entirely on-device benefits privacy, latency, and offline use, but the energy cost of CPU inference is a major barrier. We present what is, to our knowledge, the first end-to-end RAG pipeline that runs all neural stages -- embedding, reranking, and LLM generation -- on the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU of the Snapdragon X Elite. Profiling on a Dell XPS 13 laptop, we compare NPU-accelerated RAG against CPU and OpenCL/Adreno GPU baselines on indexing and query workloads. On indexing, the NPU achieves 9.1x higher embedding throughput and 12.3x less system energy. On a 120-query Wikipedia-passage benchmark, it delivers 18.1x faster LLM prefilling, 4.0x lower end-to-end query latency, and 4.0x less system energy than the CPU baseline; the same workload on the integrated GPU is 1.7x slower than CPU and uses 6.5x more energy than the NPU. A GPT-4.1 LLM-as-judge evaluation finds NPU answer quality on par with CPU and GPU within evaluator noise (mean 9.32 vs. 8.95 vs. 9.03 on a 1-10 rubric), with 86.7% of queries scoring identically across all three backends. On the Snapdragon X Elite / Hexagon class of laptop SoC, the NPU thus enables practical, energy-efficient on-device RAG without quality regression -- a sustainable path toward green edge intelligence that we expect to generalize to comparable mobile NPUs (Apple Neural Engine, Intel NPU, MediaTek APU) as their software stacks mature.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在Snapdragon X Elite的Hexagon NPU上实现了完整的端到端RAG流水线（嵌入、重排序、LLM生成），相比CPU基线在索引阶段实现9.1倍嵌入吞吐量提升和12.3倍能耗降低，在查询阶段实现18.1倍LLM预填充加速、4.0倍端到端延迟降低和4.0倍能耗降低，且NPU的答案质量与CPU/GPU相当（平均9.32 vs 8.95 vs 9.03），为绿色边缘智能提供了可行的能效路径。
AI.motivation: RAG流水线计算密集，在设备端运行能带来隐私、延迟和离线使用的优势，但CPU推理的高能耗是主要障碍，亟需探索更高效的端侧加速方案。
AI.method: 在Dell XPS 13笔记本上，将RAG流水线的所有神经阶段（嵌入、重排序、LLM生成）部署到Qualcomm Hexagon NPU，并与CPU和OpenCL/Adreno GPU基线进行索引和查询工作负载的性能对比。
AI.result: NPU在索引阶段嵌入吞吐量提升9.1倍、能耗降低12.3倍；在120查询Wikipedia基准上，LLM预填充加速18.1倍，端到端延迟和能耗均降低4.0倍；GPU比CPU慢1.7倍且能耗是NPU的6.5倍；NPU答案质量评分9.32，与CPU的8.95和GPU的9.03相当，86.7%的查询得分完全相同。
AI.conclusion: NPU可在不牺牲答案质量的前提下实现实用、节能的端侧RAG，为绿色边缘智能提供了可持续路径，并预期可推广至其他移动NPU（如Apple Neural Engine、Intel NPU、MediaTek APU）。

title: FreqKD: Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Infrared Object Detection
summary: Transfer learning from large-scale RGB foundation models to infrared (IR) imagery through knowledge distillation (KD) remains challenging due to fundamental differences in image formation physics. We investigate the spectral structure of the RGB--IR modality gap and observe that feature divergence is not uniform across spatial frequencies: low-frequency components (shape, layout) show greater cross-modal alignment than high-frequency components (texture, fine edges), which reflect modality-specific characteristics. Based on this analysis, we propose FreqKD, a frequency-decoupled distillation framework that applies asymmetric supervision adapted to each band's cross-modal consistency. The method employs strict mean squared error (MSE) on the low-frequency band to preserve shared structural information and a relaxed log-MSE loss (weighted at 0.1) on the high-frequency band to provide edge guidance while tolerating texture differences. Spectral divergence analysis on 500 paired samples shows that high-frequency divergence exceeds low-frequency divergence by a factor of 2.4x on average across all analysed transformer layers. On KAIST multispectral pedestrian detection, FreqKD achieves 64.1 mAP50, improving 2.4 points over the DINOv2 baseline. The learned representation transfers across datasets (FLIR ADAS, +2.1 mAP50), tasks (MFNet segmentation, +1.85 mean intersection-over-union), and architectures (ResNet-50, +1.0 mAP50). Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/freq_decoupled_kd-5E5A

AI.tldr: 针对RGB基础模型向红外图像迁移学习中的模态差异问题，本文通过频谱分析发现高低频特征对齐程度不同，提出频域解耦蒸馏框架FreqKD，对低频用严格MSE、高频用宽松log-MSE损失，在KAIST行人检测等任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: RGB基础模型（如DINOv2）通过知识蒸馏迁移至红外图像时，由于成像物理机制的差异导致模态间隙显著，现有方法未充分考虑该间隙在频域上的非均匀分布特性，亟需一种对频带差异进行针对性处理的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 提出FreqKD频域解耦蒸馏框架：首先对特征进行频域分解，将低频分量（形状、布局）与高频分量（纹理、边缘）分离；然后对低频带使用严格的MSE损失以保留共享结构信息，对高频带使用权重为0.1的宽松log-MSE损失以容忍纹理差异的同时提供边缘引导。
AI.result: 在KAIST多光谱行人检测上达到64.1 mAP50，比DINOv2基线提升2.4点；跨数据集迁移至FLIR ADAS提升2.1 mAP50；跨任务迁移至MFNet分割提升1.85 mIoU；跨架构迁移至ResNet-50提升1.0 mAP50。频谱分析显示高频散度平均比低频散度高2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态特征差异在频域上呈现非均匀分布——低频更对齐、高频更发散，据此设计的频域解耦蒸馏策略能有效缓解RGB到IR的模态迁移困难，且学到的表征具有良好的跨数据集、跨任务和跨架构迁移能力。

title: Schützen: Evaluating LLM Safety in Bulgarian and German Contexts
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed across professional domains, bringing hard-to-predict risks, including the generation of harmful or disrespectful content. Although substantial progress has been made in developing safety evaluation datasets, existing resources remain overwhelmingly English- and Chinese-centric. This limitation is particularly pronounced when evaluating languages that operate within shared sociocultural, legal, and ethical contexts. To address this gap, we introduce Schützen: a German--Bulgarian safety dataset designed to assess model answerability under risk, covering both a low-resource language (Bulgarian) and a high-resource language (German). Experiments with multilingual and language-specific LLMs reveal pronounced cross-language differences in safety behavior, highlighting the necessity of tailored, region-specific evaluation resources to support the responsible deployment of LLMs in Germany and Bulgaria. Datasets and code are available at https://github.com/xnlp-lab/Schutzen. Warning: this paper contains examples that may be offensive, harmful, or biased.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Schützen，一个德语-保加利亚语安全数据集，用于评估大语言模型在不同语言和文化背景下的安全行为。实验发现多语言和特定语言模型在跨语言安全表现上存在显著差异，强调了针对特定地区定制评估资源的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估数据集主要集中在英语和中文，缺乏对在共享社会文化、法律和伦理背景下运作的语言（如德语和保加利亚语）的评估资源，难以预测LLM在这些语言环境中的风险行为。
AI.method: 构建了Schützen数据集，覆盖低资源语言（保加利亚语）和高资源语言（德语），并在多语言及语言特定LLM上进行实验，比较跨语言安全行为差异。
AI.result: 多语言和语言特定LLM在德语和保加利亚语的安全表现上存在显著差异，表明跨语言安全行为不一致。
AI.conclusion: 需要针对特定地区和语言定制安全评估资源，以支持LLM在德国和保加利亚的负责任部署。

title: Understanding Cross-Sensor Feature Variations for Generalizable 3D Perception
summary: Radar-camera BEV perception often suffers from degraded performance when evaluated across datasets, as changes in driving scenes, sensor configurations, and environmental conditions can alter both the input observations and the internal fused representations. This work studies this issue from the perspective of source-domain variation modeling, aiming to improve the robustness of BEV-based 3D detectors without relying on target-domain samples. We introduce a framework that characterizes visual scene variations in the frequency domain and uses them to synthesize diverse source-domain views. By comparing the resulting fused BEV representations, the framework further captures how image-level variations influence multi-modal BEV features. These variation patterns are then used to regularize the detector, encouraging the learned fusion space to remain stable under latent scene changes. The proposed method is applied only during training and leaves the inference pipeline unchanged. Experiments on cross-dataset radar-camera 3D detection between View-of-Delft and TJ4DRadSet demonstrate consistent improvements over multiple BEV fusion backbones, and the gains remain effective when a small amount of target-domain data is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于源域变化建模的框架，通过频域分析模拟视觉场景变化，正则化BEV融合表示以提升雷达-相机3D检测的跨数据集鲁棒性，仅需训练时使用，无需目标域样本。
AI.motivation: 雷达-相机BEV感知模型在跨数据集评估时性能显著下降，原因是驾驶场景、传感器配置和环境条件的变化会改变输入观测和内部融合表示。现有方法缺乏对源域变化进行显式建模的手段，且通常依赖目标域样本。
AI.method: 1) 在频域中表征视觉场景变化，并合成多样化的源域视图；2) 比较融合后的BEV表示，捕捉图像级变化对多模态BEV特征的影响；3) 利用这些变化模式正则化检测器，使学习到的融合空间在潜在场景变化下保持稳定。该方法仅在训练阶段应用，推理流程不变。
AI.result: 在View-of-Delft和TJ4DRadSet数据集间的跨数据集雷达-相机3D检测实验中，该方法在多个BEV融合骨干网络上取得一致改进，且在少量目标域数据可用时增益仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过频域驱动的源域变化建模与BEV表示正则化，可以有效提升跨数据集场景下多模态3D检测的鲁棒性，且无需目标域数据即可带来稳定性能提升。

title: When More Documents Hurt RAG: Mitigating Vector Search Dilution with Domain-Scoped, Model-Agnostic Retrieval
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 30 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation degrades when scaled to large, heterogeneous document collections, where dense similarity loses discriminative power, and top-k retrieval increasingly returns semantically similar but contextually incorrect chunks. We refer to this failure mode as vector search dilution. Even when using hybrid dense+sparse retrieval, we observed this firsthand in a deployed Wyoming Department of Transportation corpus, where scaling from 54 to 1,128 documents (88,907 chunks) reduced accuracy from 75% to below 40%. To address this dilution, we propose MASDR-RAG ( Multi-Agent Scoped Domain Retrieval for RAG) and evaluate it on 200 expert-validated queries across five LLM backbones, six corpora, and two index stacks. Our results indicate that domain scoping using organizational metadata is the key fix, significantly improving P@10 from 0.77 to 0.86 ($p < 0.05$). Furthermore, our investigation of multi-agent orchestration revealed that a high degree of configuration dependence results --creating what we call the precision-faithfulness paradox. Based on these varied outcomes, our practical recommendation is simple: scope first, then perform a single synthesis call, reserving full multi-agent orchestration for genuinely multi-domain corpora paired with native-tool-call backbones. Code and Data will be made public upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 当RAG系统扩展到大规模异构文档集合时，向量检索的区分力下降导致性能严重退化（54→1128份文档时准确率从75%降至40%以下）。本文提出MASDR-RAG方法，发现基于组织元数据的领域限定是核心修复手段（P@10从0.77提升至0.86），而多智能体编排存在"精度-忠实度悖论"，建议优先领域限定再执行单次合成调用。
AI.motivation: 大规模异构文档集合下，检索增强生成（RAG）系统的向量检索因失去区分力而性能退化（向量搜索稀释问题），即使混合稠密+稀疏检索也无法避免。需要寻找有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出MASDR-RAG（基于多智能体限定领域检索的RAG），在怀俄明州交通部语料库等六个语料库、五种LLM骨干、两种索引栈上，用200个专家验证的查询进行评估。
AI.result: 领域限定（使用组织元数据）显著提升P@10从0.77到0.86（p<0.05）；多智能体编排存在高度配置依赖，导致"精度-忠实度悖论"。
AI.conclusion: 实际建议是先进行领域限定，然后执行单次合成调用，仅对真正的多领域语料库配合原生工具调用骨干才使用完整的多智能体编排。

title: AVIS: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) benefit from chain-of-thought prompting and test-time scaling, but these gains often come with prohibitive inference cost due to large visual contexts and long decoding chains. We view this cost through two coupled axes: Visual Context Scaling (VCS), which controls how much visual evidence is passed to the language model, and Visual Reasoning Scaling (VRS), which controls how much inference-time reasoning search is performed. Existing methods typically optimize one axis at a time, leaving the joint allocation of compute across these axes underexplored. We introduce Adaptive Visual Inference Scaling (AVIS), a lightweight policy that adapts both VCS and VRS per query. AVIS realizes VCS through Key Diversity Visual (KDV) pruning, a training-free $O(N)$ key-based rule for removing redundant visual tokens before prefilling, and realizes VRS through adaptive self-consistency, using a learned difficulty predictor to select the number of reasoning rollouts. AVIS is deployment-friendly and compatible with shared-prefill inference, where all rollouts reuse a single prefilling pass and KV cache. Across diverse image and video reasoning benchmarks, AVIS improves the accuracy--compute trade-off relative to VCS-only and VRS-only baselines, and remains effective on top of RL post-trained VLMs while keeping compute and latency low.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVIS，通过自适应联合优化视觉上下文缩放（VCS）和视觉推理缩放（VRS），在视觉-语言模型推理中实现精度与计算成本的最佳权衡。VCS采用无训练的基于Key多样性的剪枝策略去除冗余视觉token，VRS通过难度预测器自适应选择推理rollout数量，并支持共享预填充推理以复用KV缓存。在图像和视频基准测试中，AVIS相比单独优化VCS或VRS的方法更优，且对RL后训练模型依然有效。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在推理时，链式思维提示和测试时缩放带来了高昂的计算成本。已有方法通常单独优化视觉上下文缩放或视觉推理缩放，忽视了二者之间的联合计算分配，导致计算效率低下。
AI.method: AVIS包含两个核心组件：1) Key Diversity Visual (KDV) pruning——一种无训练的O(N)基于Key的剪枝规则，在预填充前移除冗余视觉token，实现视觉上下文缩放；2) 自适应自一致性——通过学习的难度预测器选择推理rollout数量，实现视觉推理缩放。该框架支持共享预填充推理，所有rollout复用单个预填充过程和KV缓存。
AI.result: 在多种图像和视频推理基准测试中，AVIS相比仅优化VCS或VRS的基线方法，在精度-计算权衡上表现更优。该方法在RL后训练的VLM上依然有效，同时保持较低的计算开销和延迟。
AI.conclusion: AVIS通过轻量级策略自适应联合优化视觉上下文和推理缩放，有效改善了VLM推理的精度-计算效率权衡，且易于部署，兼容现代推理框架。

title: The Dynamics of Human and AI-Generated Language: How Semantics Fluctuates across Different Timescales
comment: 45 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted manuscript; published in Computer Speech & Language
summary: Spoken language, whether produced by humans or large language models (LLM), unfolds over time with varying semantic content. However, we still lack simple, interpretable time-series features that capture how generic versus specific content is distributed over time, and that can be used to compare human and AI-generated speech. We introduce a semantic-timescale analysis pipeline that turns word-level transcripts with timestamps into semantic time-series. For each spoken narrative, we compute (i) semantic specificity using WordNet-based word depth and (ii) contextual similarity using SBERT embeddings and quantify their temporal dependence using autocorrelation-window measures (ACW-0 and related metrics). We then compare original speech to multiple shuffled controls that selectively disrupt lexical identity, temporal order, and word duration. Across human-read autobiographical narratives, TTS readings, and LLM-generated texts rendered with TTS, we find that segments with longer ACW-0 in the semantic time-series tend to contain more generic vocabulary, whereas segments with shorter ACW-0 are enriched in more specific words. These associations are strongly attenuated or abolished when word order and timing are randomized, indicating that ACW-based measures capture non-trivial temporal organization of semantic content beyond static lexical distributions. Our results suggest that ACW-based semantic timescales are a useful family of features for analyzing and comparing the temporal structure of human and AI-generated speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种语义时间尺度分析流程，通过WordNet词深度和SBERT上下文相似度将口语转录转化为语义时间序列，并利用自相关窗口（ACW-0）等指标量化语义内容的时域依赖性。研究发现，人类自传叙事、TTS朗读和LLM生成文本中，长ACW-0对应更通用词汇，短ACW-0对应更具体词汇，且这种关联在打乱词序和时间后被破坏。ACW基语义时间尺度可作为分析人类与AI语音时域结构的有效特征。
AI.motivation: 口语内容在时间上展开时具有变化的语义内容，但缺乏简单、可解释的时间序列特征来捕捉通用与具体词汇在时间上的分布模式，以及用于比较人类和AI生成语音的差异。
AI.method: 构建语义时间序列分析流程：①使用WordNet词深度计算语义特异性；②使用SBERT嵌入计算上下文相似性；③通过自相关窗口度量（ACW-0及相关指标）量化时域依赖性；④将原始语音与打乱词汇身份、时间顺序和词时长的多种对照条件进行比较。
AI.result: 在人类自传叙事、TTS朗读和LLM生成文本中，语义时间序列中ACW-0较长的片段倾向于包含更通用词汇，ACW-0较短的片段则富含更具体词汇。随机化词序和时间后，这种关联显著减弱或消失。
AI.conclusion: ACW基语义时间尺度能有效捕捉静态词汇分布之外的语义内容时域组织特征，可作为分析比较人类与AI生成语音时域结构的实用特征族。

title: Contactless 3D Human Body Measurement Using Depth Cameras for Smart Health Monitoring
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Depth camera-based framework for contactless anthropometric measurement and geometric analysis using 3D point clouds
summary: Contactless body measurement technologies are becoming increasingly significant for smart health monitoring, digital health applications, and remote patient assessment. Traditional anthropometric measurements typically necessitate physical contact and trained personnel, which may constrain scalability in remote healthcare settings. In this study, we introduce a depth camera-based framework for estimating human body measurements utilizing 3D point cloud data. An Orbbec Astra 2 depth camera was employed to capture RGB images, depth maps, and 3D point clouds of participants. The captured point cloud was processed using Python-based tools, including Open3D, NumPy, and OpenCV, to segment the human body from the background. Key anthropometric measurements, such as height and arm span, were computed. The measurements were obtained through a combination of spatial filtering and landmark selection on the 3D point cloud, followed by the projection of the computed measurements onto the corresponding RGB image using camera intrinsic parameters. In addition to linear measurements, the approximate body volume and visible surface area were estimated using voxel-based occupancy analysis and mesh-based surface reconstruction methods. The experimental results from a single depth capture demonstrated that accurate body measurements and geometric estimates could be obtained from depth camera data without physical contact. This study provides a foundation for future real-time systems that integrate depth sensing with intelligent health monitoring and generative AI models for smart healthcare applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度摄像头（Orbbec Astra 2）和3D点云数据的非接触式人体测量框架，通过空间滤波、地标选择、体素分析和网格重建等方法，实现了身高、臂展、体积和表面积等人体指标的自动估算，为智能健康监测和远程医疗提供了基础。
AI.motivation: 传统人体测量需要物理接触和专业人员操作，限制了远程医疗场景的可扩展性，因此需要一种非接触式、可自动化的测量方法。
AI.method: 使用Orbbec Astra 2深度摄像头采集RGB图像、深度图和3D点云；基于Open3D、NumPy、OpenCV进行点云处理与人体分割；通过空间滤波和地标选择计算身高、臂展等线性测量值；利用体素占用分析和网格表面重建估算体积和表面积；最后将测量结果投影到RGB图像上。
AI.result: 单次深度捕获实验表明，该方法能够在无需物理接触的情况下，从深度相机数据中准确获取人体测量值和几何估计值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为未来结合深度感知、智能健康监测和生成式AI模型的实时系统奠定了基础，适用于智能医疗应用。

title: When Probing Accuracy Saturates, Fragility Resolves: A Complementary Metric for LLM Pre-Training Analysis
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Code and datasets at https://github.com/deepsteer/deepsteer
summary: Standard linear probing declares a property "encoded" when a classifier on hidden states achieves high accuracy. The protocol works well on a snapshot but breaks across pre-training: probe accuracy saturates within the first few thousand steps, leaving most of training invisible to the instrument. We introduce fragility, a complementary per-layer metric defined as the activation-noise level at which probe accuracy collapses. Fragility is sensitive to both the margin of separability and the redundancy of representation, both of which keep evolving long after accuracy plateaus. Applied to open-checkpoint language models, fragility recovers structure that accuracy alone cannot see. Moralized representations emerge along a lexical $\to$ compositional gradient: lexical moral detection first, compositional moral encoding later. Because probe accuracy on its own tracks how lexically separable a dataset is, we establish the compositional encoding directly, by showing it transfers across construction types that share no contrast tokens. A layer-depth robustness gradient develops monotonically across training while accuracy stays flat. And matched fine-tuning corpora that produce identical probing accuracy leave distinct fragility fingerprints, showing that data curation reshapes probe robustness without changing probe accuracy. In every comparison we test, where probing accuracy returns a flat answer, fragility returns a structured one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"脆弱性"（fragility）指标，衡量探针精度崩溃时的激活噪声水平，弥补标准线性探针在预训练后期精度饱和后无法区分表征变化的缺陷。实验表明脆弱性在多个场景（道德编码的时间演化、层深度鲁棒性梯度、微调语料区分）中均能揭示精度无法反映的结构化信息。
AI.motivation: 标准线性探针在预训练初期精度迅速饱和，后续大部分训练过程无法被该工具观测到，需要一种补充指标来捕捉精度饱和后表征的持续演化。
AI.method: 定义"脆弱性"为探针精度崩溃时的激活噪声水平，同时度量表征的分离边际和冗余度；通过在开放检查点语言模型上应用该指标，结合词汇↔组合语法的道德编码分析、层深度鲁棒性梯度和微调语料对比进行验证。
AI.result: 脆弱性恢复出精度单独无法看见的结构：道德化表征沿词汇→组合梯度出现；层深度鲁棒性梯度随训练单调发展；相同精度下不同微调语料留下不同的脆弱性指纹。
AI.conclusion: 脆弱性作为精度饱和后的补充诊断工具，能揭示表征在分离边际和冗余度上的持续变化，在许多比较场景中，精度给出平坦答案，而脆弱性返回结构化信息。

title: Spatially Coupled Phase-to-Depth Calibration for Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: In fringe projection profilometry (FPP), depth is commonly recovered by fitting a phase-to-depth relation independently at each camera pixel. Although such pixel-wise calibration achieves high local accuracy, neighboring pixels can acquire markedly different calibration functions even when they observe the same smooth surface, producing spatially inconsistent geometry and structured surface artifacts. We propose a spatially coupled phase-depth transformation in which all pixels share a single low-dimensional mapping-global phase scalars combined with affine spatial terms on the undistorted reference-camera grid-rather than independent per-pixel fits, optionally augmented by a bounded, spatially smooth correction field. We further introduce a native-grid pairing scheme that constructs phase-depth calibration pairs directly on the reference-camera grid: when depth supervision comes from a rectified active-stereo pipeline, planes are fitted in stereo 3D and sampled back onto the camera grid along native rays, so the phase maps are never rectified. On a dental target with high-resolution scanner ground truth, the proposed model attains point-to-surface RMSE comparable to an active-stereo reference (about 12μm aggregate) while substantially improving spatial coherence over pixel-wise polynomial and rational calibration, and reduces the runtime mapping to a few element-wise operations per pixel with negligible parameter storage.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种空间耦合的相位-深度变换方法，通过全局低维映射（全局相位标量+仿射空间项+可选平滑校正场）替代传统逐像素独立标定，并引入原生网格配对方案，在保持精度的同时显著提升空间一致性并降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 传统FPP中逐像素独立标定会导致相邻像素标定函数不一致，即使观测同一光滑表面也会产生空间不一致的几何结构和表面伪影。
AI.method: 提出空间耦合的相位-深度变换：所有像素共享单一低维映射（全局相位标量+仿射空间项），可选加有界空间平滑校正场；引入原生网格配对方案，在参考相机网格上直接构建相位-深度标定对。
AI.result: 在牙齿目标高分辨率扫描仪真值上，点对面RMSE与主动立体参考相当（约12μm聚合误差），显著优于逐像素多项式和有理标定的空间一致性，运行时映射简化为逐像素少量元素级操作，参数存储可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在保持高精度的同时大幅提升空间一致性，并降低了计算和存储开销。

title: Overcoming State Inertia in Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models via Activation Steering
summary: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable seamless speech interaction by allowing models to listen and speak simultaneously, yet the internal mechanism by which they coordinate listening and speaking remains underexplored. We analyze the predictive behavior encoded in FD-SLM hidden representations and find that they exhibit stream-specific predictive patterns: during listening, they preferentially predict the incoming user stream, whereas during speaking, they preferentially predict the model output stream. Building on this observation, we show that FD-SLMs dynamically modulate their internal predictive focus between two states: a generative state aligned with model output generation and a perceptive state aligned with incoming user input. However, this modulation can lag behind abrupt changes in conversational context. During user interruptions, the model remains transiently biased toward the generative state before transitioning into the perceptive state, causing it to miss the beginning of the incoming input. We term this delayed internal transition state inertia. To quantify its downstream impact, we introduce the Zero-Buffer Benchmark (ZBB), a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating immediate interruption comprehension when user speech begins abruptly. We evaluate this setting using response correctness and initial-word occurrence rate (IWOR). Finally, we mitigate state inertia through activation steering with a perception vector, a training-free intervention with little additional computational overhead. Across multiple state-of-the-art FD-SLMs, activation steering substantially improves interruption handling; for example, on PersonaPlex, it improves correctness from 28% to 45% and IWOR from 40% to 72% without any fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全双工语音语言模型（FD-SLMs）的内部机制，发现模型在听和说时表现出不同的预测模式，并存在"状态惯性"——即用户在打断时模型未能及时从生成状态切换到感知状态，导致错过输入开头。作者提出Zero-Buffer基准（ZBB）评估此问题，并通过激活引导（perception vector）无训练干预显著提升打断处理能力（正确率从28%提升至45%，IWOR从40%提升至72%）。
AI.motivation: FD-SLMs虽能实现听和说同时进行，但其内部如何协调听与说的机制尚不明确，尤其是面对用户突然打断时模型的内部状态变化与缺陷未被深入探究。
AI.method: 1）分析FD-SLM隐藏表示的预测行为，发现其存在流特定的预测模式；2）提出"状态惯性"概念，描述模型从生成态到感知态转换的延迟；3）构建Zero-Buffer基准（ZBB）评估打断理解能力，采用响应正确率和初始词出现率（IWOR）作为指标；4）提出使用perception vector进行激活引导，一种无需训练、计算开销小的干预方法。
AI.result: 在多个SOTA FD-SLM上，激活引导显著改善打断处理：在PersonaPlex上，正确率从28%提升至45%，IWOR从40%提升至72%，无需微调。
AI.conclusion: FD-SLMs存在状态惯性问题导致打断理解不足，激活引导是一种有效的无训练缓解方法，为提升全双工语音交互的鲁棒性提供了新方向。

title: On Aligning Hierarchical Standardized Embedding for Audio-visual Generalized Zero-shot Learning
summary: Audio-visual Generalized Zero-shot Learning (AV-GZSL) is a challenging task that aims to classify both seen and unseen objects or scenes by integrating data from audio and visual modalities. Recent studies primarily focus on fusing or aligning audio and visual features to generate more informative audio-visual embeddings. Also, aligning the audio-visual and textual features of most existing methods relies solely on the optimization objectives. However, those methods neglect the inherent distributional and structural differences between audio-visual and textual modalities. To address this limitation, we propose a method termed Aligning Hierarchical Standardized Embedding (AHSE), which enables hierarchical alignment of standardized audio-visual and textual embeddings within a shared embedding space. Specifically, we first apply Z-score standardization to the fused audio-visual and textual embeddings to reduce distributional mismatches. We then introduce a hierarchical alignment strategy that minimizes discrepancies at the semantic, class, and batch levels, thereby constructing a more robust and well-structured embedding space. This strategy not only preserves semantic and inter-class relationships but also maintains spatial consistency within each batch. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets: VGGSound-GZSL, UCF-GZSL, and ActivityNet-GZSL, demonstrate that AHSE achieves competitive performance in zero-shot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AHSE方法，通过对齐标准化后的音频-视觉与文本嵌入，在语义、类别和批次三个层级进行层次化对齐，解决了AV-GZSL中模态分布差异问题，在三个基准数据集上取得竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 现有AV-GZSL方法在融合或对齐音视频特征时，忽视了音视频模态与文本模态之间固有的分布差异和结构差异，仅依赖优化目标进行对齐，导致嵌入空间不够鲁棒。
AI.method: 1) 对融合后的音视频嵌入和文本嵌入进行Z-score标准化，减少分布不匹配；2) 提出层次化对齐策略，在语义层、类别层和批次层三个层级最小化模态间差异，构建更鲁棒、结构良好的共享嵌入空间。
AI.result: 在VGGSound-GZSL、UCF-GZSL和ActivityNet-GZSL三个基准数据集上，AHSE在零样本学习任务中取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 层次化标准化嵌入对齐能够有效缓解模态间的分布与结构差异，为AV-GZSL提供了一种有效的解决思路。

title: Small Experiments, Cheaper Decisions: A Case Study in Staged Promotion for Micro-Pretraining
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures; 12-hour dual-host micro-pretraining promotion study; source package includes curated ancillary artifacts
summary:
Short pretraining runs can reduce experimental cost, but they can also over-promote configurations that only look strong at tiny budgets. We study an auditable staged-promotion protocol for a fixed micro-pretraining runner on two heterogeneous host blocks: Windows A100 and Linux L40S. Starting from twelve prior-screened configurations, we use staged budgets of 2 minutes, 5 minutes, 10 minutes, 60 minutes, and 12 hours, with frozen promotion rules before expensive continuations.
  The early screens are intentionally treated as unstable: the 5- and 10-minute rankings are host-sensitive, and the eventual 12-hour top-ranked condition is not the mean-best condition at the replicated 10-minute gate. Because seed ranges differ across stages, these changes are operational promotion evidence, not within-seed curves. A replicated 60-minute gate keeps the Staged Factorial Screening bridge reference in the promoted set, where it ranks first in all four 60-minute host-seed cells. In the final 12-hour confirmation package, the bridge condition ranks first in all four host-seed cells across two seeds; the greedy comparator does not meet the frozen 0.010 val_bpb near-equivalence rule; and the cheaper d8/ar48 (depth-8, aspect-48) sentinel does not meet the frozen 0.020 mean-gap rule.
  The executed 12-hour branch spends 144 GPU-hours, and the full staged protocol records 169.2 training GPU-hours including screening stages. Continuing all four 60-minute candidates would spend 192 GPU-hours, while continuing all nine replicated 10-minute candidates would spend 432 GPU-hours. The latter numbers are accounting counterfactuals for unrun continuations, not evidence that skipped candidates could not have overtaken the reference. The result is a bounded cost-allocation finding, not a claim of global optimality, capacity-normalized superiority, or superiority over adaptive hyperparameter optimization methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可审计的分阶段晋升协议（staged-promotion protocol），在固定微预训练设置下，通过2分钟、5分钟、10分钟、60分钟和12小时五个阶段逐步筛选配置，最终在144 GPU小时内确定最佳条件（bridge条件）。研究发现在早期阶段（5/10分钟）排名对宿主敏感，且10分钟均值最优条件并非12小时最优条件，强调了分阶段验证的必要性。
AI.motivation: 短时间预训练实验可以降低计算成本，但容易过度推广那些仅在极小预算下表现良好的配置。作者希望设计一个可审计、成本可控的分阶段筛选协议，在固定微预训练场景下可靠地识别长期最优配置，避免早期排名误导性结论。
AI.method: 从12个预筛选配置出发，在Windows A100和Linux L40S两个异构宿主上，依次执行2分钟、5分钟、10分钟、60分钟和12小时五个预算阶段，每个阶段设有冻结的晋升规则。10分钟阶段进行复制实验，60分钟阶段保持桥接参考条件，最终在12小时阶段进行确认。早期阶段故意不追求稳定性以观察宿主敏感性和排名变化。
AI.result: 桥接条件（bridge condition）在60分钟阶段的所有四个宿主-种子单元中排名第一；在12小时最终确认中，桥接条件在所有四个宿主-种子单元中排序第一；贪心比较器未通过0.010 val_bpb近等价规则；更便宜的d8/ar48哨兵未通过0.020均值差距规则。完整协议消耗169.2 GPU训练小时，12小时分支消耗144 GPU小时。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一个有界成本分配（bounded cost-allocation）的实证结果，而非声称全局最优性、容量归一化优越性或优于自适应超参数优化方法。分阶段晋升协议能有效控制实验成本同时识别长期可靠的配置。

title: Frozen Foundation-Model Embeddings Discard Small-Lesion Signal in Chest Radiography: Implications for Pre-Deployment Evaluation
summary: Frozen vision-transformer (ViT) foundation-model embeddings increasingly serve as the substrate for downstream chest-radiography (CXR) pipelines, yet where small-scale, low-contrast signal is retained or lost in the frozen forward pass has not been systematically quantified across architectures, pretraining domains, and objectives. We probed five frozen ViTs (RAD-DINO, DINOv2-B/14, DINOv3 ViT-7B, BiomedCLIP, MedSigLIP) and a frozen DINO-pretrained ResNet-50 architectural control across three large CXR cohorts (NIH-CXR14, MIMIC-CXR, Emory-CXR; aggregate pool n=492,724) and ChestX-Det10 (n=3,543; 1,462 small-lesion bounding boxes across Calcification, Nodule, Mass). Each model was evaluated with a small-scale-perturbation panel and a region-aware bounding-box-stratified probe on real lesions, comparing three pooling modes from the same forward pass: classification token (CLS), patch-mean (mean over all final-layer patch tokens), and bounding-box-restricted patch-local. On the perturbation panel, CLS embeddings sat at the chance floor (area under the ROC curve [AUC] 0.500-0.524); patch-mean was indistinguishable from CLS on iso-blur and reticular-fine cells but rose with CLS on larger directional-blur footprints, while disease AUC on globally decided tasks ranged 0.642-0.913. Patch-local probes recovered AUC ~1.0 from the same forward pass (per-model mean improvement +0.412 to +0.488); the ResNet-50 control reproduced the chance floor. On ChestX-Det10, image-level CLS classification showed within-class small-versus-large stratum gaps up to +0.243 AUC; bounding-box-level patch-local pooling on the same forward pass recovered AUC >= 0.899 on every (model x class) cell. Frozen ViT embeddings silently suppress small-scale signal at the global-aggregation step; the signal is recoverable from patch tokens conditional on a region of interest.

AI.tldr: 研究了五种冻结的ViT模型（RAD-DINO、DINOv2、DINOv3、BiomedCLIP、MedSigLIP）和ResNet-50在胸部X光片分析中，发现全局聚合（CLS token和patch-mean）会无声抑制小尺度病变信号（AUC接近随机水平0.500-0.524），而基于感兴趣区域的patch-local池化可以从同一前向传播中恢复近乎完美的性能（AUC~1.0），表明信号在patch token中保留但被全局聚合步骤丢弃。
AI.motivation: 冻结的ViT基础模型嵌入越来越多地被用于下游胸部放射学任务，但小尺度、低对比度信号在冻结前向传播中是否保留或丢失，以及这种情况在不同架构、预训练领域和目标函数下的系统性差异尚未被量化研究。
AI.method: 使用五种冻结ViT和一个DINO预训练ResNet-50控制模型，在三个大型CXR数据集（NIH-CXR14、MIMIC-CXR、Emory-CXR，总计n=492,724）和ChestX-Det10（n=3,543，含1,462个小病灶边界框）上，通过小尺度扰动面板和区域感知边界框分层探针，比较三种池化模式：CLS token、patch-mean和边界框限制的patch-local。
AI.result: CLS嵌入在扰动面板上处于随机水平（AUC 0.500-0.524）；patch-mean与CLS在等模糊和网状细细胞上无差异，但在更大方向性模糊足迹上随CLS上升；全局决策任务疾病AUC范围0.642-0.913。Patch-local探针从同一前向传播恢复AUC~1.0（每个模型平均提升+0.412至+0.488）。在ChestX-Det10上，图像级CLS分类中小病灶与大病灶的类内差距达+0.243 AUC；边界框级patch-local池化在每一个(模型×类别)单元上恢复AUC>=0.899。
AI.conclusion: 冻结ViT嵌入在全局聚合步骤中会无声地抑制小尺度信号，但该信号可从patch token中恢复，前提是需要一个感兴趣区域。

title: Scenario-based Probing and Steering Cultural Values in Large Language Models--Extended Version
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed across cultural contexts but often reflect homogenized values inherited from training data. Evaluations of cultural alignment typically rely on direct prompting with survey-style questions, which frequently elicit neutral or safety-aligned responses and fail to capture underlying model preferences. We propose a framework for probing and steering latent cultural representations in LLMs along the two Inglehart--Welzel axes of the World Values Survey (WVS). By translating social value questions into scenario-based behavioral dilemmas, we extract token-level probabilities to measure implicit values and apply activation steering, optionally combined with country-conditioned prompting, to shift model behavior without retraining. Across three open-source LLMs and four target cultures, we find substantial variation in steerability and identify latent entanglement, where interventions along one cultural dimension induce shifts along another. This coupling mirrors correlations in human WVS data and persists across activation, prompt, and hybrid steering. It constrains axis-independent alignment, though general task performance is largely preserved.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过情境行为困境和激活操控来探测与引导LLM潜在文化价值观的框架，发现文化维度的潜在纠缠现象类似于人类价值观数据中的相关性，限制了轴独立对齐。
AI.motivation: LLM在不同文化背景下部署时往往反映训练数据中同质化的价值观，而传统的直接提示式调查问卷方法难以捕捉模型真实的潜在偏好。
AI.method: 将社会价值观问题转化为情境行为困境，通过词元级概率提取隐式价值观，并应用激活操控（activation steering），可选结合国家条件提示来改变模型行为。
AI.result: 在三个开源LLM和四种目标文化中发现可操控性存在显著差异，并识别出潜在纠缠现象——沿一个文化维度的干预会引发另一维度的偏移，且该现象在激活、提示和混合操控中持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 文化维度间的纠缠耦合反映了人类WVS数据中的相关性，限制了轴独立对齐，但通用任务性能基本保持。

title: Adv-TGD: Adversarial Text-Guided Diffusion for Face Recognition Impersonation Attacks
summary: The widespread adoption of face recognition (FR) technologies raises serious privacy concerns, as facial data can be exploited without consent. To address this challenge, we propose Adv-TGD, a generative adversarial attack framework that synthesizes photorealistic faces capable of impersonating target identities and deceiving face recognition systems. Built upon Stable Diffusion, Adv-TGD performs per-sample LoRA fine-tuning conditioned on concise textual prompts to generate natural yet adversarially manipulated identities. Unlike conventional identity-attack approaches, our method optimizes lightweight cross-attention adapters for each source-target pair within a single-step denoising process. Latent blending is constrained by a face-local heatmap mask to ensure spatially precise identity manipulation while preserving non-sensitive regions. We introduce a composite objective that integrates masked epsilon-MSE reconstruction, thresholded identity divergence in FR embedding space, directional feature alignment, and source-similarity suppression to balance adversarial attack and visual realism. Optionally, LLaVA-generated attribute prompts enhance fine-grained semantic details without reintroducing identity cues. Under the black-box evaluation protocol, Adv-TGD attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 85.90% across IR152, IRSE50, MobileFace, and FaceNet, surpassing the semantic SOTA baseline Adv-CPG by +6.25 points, diffusion-based makeup method DiffAIM by +3 points, and noise-based P3-Mask by +16 points. Despite its strong attack efficacy, Adv-TGD preserves high visual fidelity (PSNR = 27.15 dB, SSIM = 0.981). Furthermore, we demonstrate the flexibility of our framework by successfully extending it to in-the-wild datasets (LADN), general object classification (ImageNet), and transformer-based diffusion models (FLUX.1).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Adv-TGD，一种基于Stable Diffusion的生成对抗攻击框架，通过对每对源-目标身份进行轻量级LoRA微调，在单步去噪过程中生成可欺骗人脸识别系统的逼真对抗人脸。该方法使用面部热力图掩码约束潜在混合，结合复合损失函数平衡攻击效果与视觉保真度。在黑盒评估下达到85.90%的平均攻击成功率，优于现有SOTA方法，同时保持高视觉质量（PSNR=27.15dB, SSIM=0.981）。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别技术的广泛采用带来了严重的隐私问题，面部数据可能被未经同意地利用。现有身份攻击方法在攻击效果与视觉真实感之间存在权衡，需要一种既能有效欺骗人脸识别系统又能保持照片逼真度的对抗攻击方法。
AI.method: 基于Stable Diffusion，对每个源-目标身份对执行单步去噪过程中的LoRA微调，优化交叉注意力适配器。使用面部局部热力图掩码约束潜在混合，确保空间精确的身份操控。复合目标函数集成：掩码epsilon-MSE重建、FR嵌入空间中的阈值化身份散度、方向性特征对齐和源相似性抑制。可选LLaVA生成的属性提示增强细粒度语义细节。
AI.result: 在黑盒评估协议下，IR152、IRSE50、MobileFace、FaceNet上平均ASR达85.90%，超越Adv-CPG (+6.25)、DiffAIM (+3)、P3-Mask (+16)。视觉质量PSNR=27.15dB，SSIM=0.981。成功扩展到LADN野外数据集、ImageNet通用分类和FLUX.1扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: Adv-TGD是一种高效且灵活的身份级对抗攻击框架，在保持高视觉保真度的同时实现优异的攻击成功率，并可泛化到不同数据集、任务和模型架构。

title: Context-Aware Multimodal Claim Verification in Spoken Dialogues
summary: Every day, millions absorb claims from podcasts and streams that no fact-checker ever sees. Spoken misinformation is built through conversation, where credibility comes not from facts alone but from how claims are framed, reinforced, or left unchallenged across turns. Yet fact-checking has focused on isolated text, leaving dialogue audio under-studied. We introduce MAD2, a new Multi-turn Audio Dialogues benchmark for spoken claim verification, containing 1,000 two-speaker dialogues with 3,368 check-worthy claims and approximately 10 hours of audio, and propose calibrated multimodal fusion of a context-aware audio encoder and a dialogue-aware text model. Across settings, adding dialogue context improves verification, but the gains depend on scenario type. Using only preceding context often matches offline performance, supporting live-moderation settings, and audio contributes most when transcript-based models are destabilized by additional context. Overall, conversational structure matters more for verification than misinformation framing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAD2基准数据集和校准多模态融合方法，用于对话音频中的声明验证，发现对话结构比错误信息框架对验证更重要。
AI.motivation: 现有事实核查专注于孤立文本，忽略了对话音频中通过互动构建的口语错误信息，导致大量播客和流媒体中的虚假声明未被核查。
AI.method: 构建包含1,000个双人对话、3,368个可核查声明、约10小时音频的MAD2基准数据集；提出校准多模态融合方法，结合上下文感知音频编码器和对话感知文本模型。
AI.result: 添加对话上下文可提升验证效果，但增益取决于场景类型；仅使用前序上下文即可匹配离线性能（支持实时审核）；音频在基于转录的模型被额外上下文干扰时贡献最大；对话结构比错误信息框架对验证更重要。
AI.conclusion: 对话结构对声明验证的影响大于错误信息框架，提出的方法支持实时审核场景下的口语声明验证。

title: Precision-Aware Illumination-Disentangled Vision Transformer for Spacecraft 6D Pose Estimation
summary: Vision sensors provide a lightweight solution for spacecraft proximity operations, but monocular spacecraft 6D pose estimation remains difficult under illumination variation, specular reflection, shadowing, weak texture, and background interference. These factors make local visual evidence spatially unreliable and can destabilize pose regression. This article proposes a Precision-Aware Illumination-Disentangled Vision Transformer (PAID-ViT) for robust spacecraft pose estimation.The proposed model separates pose-relevant structure tokens from illumination-sensitive appearance tokens, estimates patch reliability before pose aggregation, and uses foreground mask supervision to preserve silhouette cues. A parameter-free geometric recovery module converts normalized crop coordinates, log-depth, and a continuous 6D rotation representation into camera-frame rotation and translation. Experiments on SPEED+ V2, the SPEED+ validation/lightbox/sunlamp evaluation configuration used in this study, suggest that PAID-ViT reduces translation error and improves robustness in the challenging sunlamp domain, while ablation studies support the complementary roles of illumination disentanglement, reliability-aware token aggregation, mask supervision, and training-side regularization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAID-ViT模型，通过光照解耦、可靠性感知令牌聚合、前景掩码监督和几何恢复模块，在航天器6D姿态估计任务中提升了鲁棒性，尤其在强光照变化场景下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 单目航天器6D姿态估计在光照变化、镜面反射、阴影、弱纹理和背景干扰等条件下，局部视觉证据空间不可靠，容易导致姿态回归不稳定，现有方法缺乏对上述复杂光照环境的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出PAID-ViT，包含：(1) 光照解耦模块，分离姿态相关结构令牌与光照敏感外观令牌；(2) 补丁可靠性估计模块，在姿态聚合前评估令牌可靠性；(3) 前景掩码监督，保留轮廓线索；(4) 无参数几何恢复模块，将归一化裁剪坐标、对数深度和连续6D旋转表示转换为相机坐标系下的旋转和平移。
AI.result: 在SPEED+ V2数据集（含验证/lightbox/sunlamp配置）上，PAID-ViT降低了平移误差，在挑战性的sunlamp域中鲁棒性提升；消融实验验证了各模块的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 光照解耦、可靠性感知令牌聚合、掩码监督和训练侧正则化相结合，能有效提升航天器姿态估计在复杂光照条件下的鲁棒性。

title: SOMA-SQL: Resolving Multi-Source Ambiguity in NL-to-SQL via Synthetic Log and Execution Probing
summary: Natural language interfaces to databases aim to translate user questions into executable SQL, yet remain brittle in real-world settings where questions are underspecified and schemas are large and ambiguous. Ambiguity across user questions, database schemas, and model interpretations are central failure modes in NL2SQL, leading to misaligned intent, incorrect schema grounding, and erroneous SQL generation. Existing approaches rely on human clarification or treat ambiguity as a schema representation problem, but these do not scale nor resolve ambiguity autonomously. We propose SOMA-SQL to automatically resolve ambiguity via targeted synthetic query log and ambiguity-driven probing. SOMA-SQL constructs synthetic query log to ground schema interpretation and guide candidate SQL generation; it then executes targeted probing queries, driven by a structured ambiguity taxonomy and candidate disagreements, to produce disambiguation evidence for final SQL selection and repair. This active approach to ambiguity discovery and resolution generalizes across unseen schemas and query distributions without human-in-the-loop. Experiments on six public benchmarks demonstrate that SOMA-SQL improves execution accuracy by 13.0% on average over state-of-the-art baselines, with gains of up to 16.7% on ambiguous questions.

AI.tldr: SOMA-SQL通过构造合成查询日志和基于歧义分类的主动探测查询，自动解决NL2SQL中的歧义问题，在六个基准测试上平均执行准确率提升13.0%。
AI.motivation: NL2SQL在真实场景中因用户问题不明确、模式庞大模糊以及模型解释歧义而脆弱，现有方法依赖人工澄清或仅将歧义视为模式表示问题，无法规模化或自主解决歧义。
AI.method: SOMA-SQL构造合成查询日志以引导模式解释和候选SQL生成，然后基于结构化歧义分类和候选歧义执行主动探测查询，生成消歧证据用于最终SQL选择和修复。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准测试上，SOMA-SQL相比最先进基线平均提高执行准确率13.0%，在歧义问题上提升达16.7%。
AI.conclusion: SOMA-SQL的主动歧义发现与解决方法无需人工介入，能泛化到未见过的模式和查询分布，显著提升NL2SQL系统的鲁棒性。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models from Iconic to Inclusive for Multi-Label Recognition Without Labels
summary: Understanding multi-label images remains a challenging task in computer vision. With the rapid progress of vision-language multimodal learning, vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot recognition without labeled data. However, due to their intrinsic design, these models often prioritize the most iconic object and omit other contextual positives. This intrinsic bias conflicts with the nature of multi-label learning, thereby limiting their applicability. In this work, we propose an unsupervised framework that adapts VLMs from iconic recognition toward inclusive understanding, enabling label-free multi-label image recognition. Our approach consists of two key stages, ``cutting'' and ``sewing'': In the cutting stage, we present the multi-sampling response estimator to prevent the model from concentrating only on one single object. In the second sewing stage, the multi-object blend adaptation is introduced to adjust the labels to better conform to the multi-label distribution while preserving the intrinsic characteristics of the original model within only one epoch. Extensive experiments show that our framework significantly outperforms existing unsupervised approaches on four public datasets, even surpassing several representative weakly supervised baselines. These results demonstrate the potential of adapting pre-trained VLMs for more comprehensive visual understanding without manual annotations. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iCVTEAM/TailorCLIP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需标签的无监督框架TailorCLIP，通过“切割”和“缝合”两阶段策略，将视觉-语言模型从标志性识别适应为包容性理解，显著提升了多标签图像识别的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）由于内在设计倾向于识别最具标志性的物体而忽略上下文中的其他正例，这种固有偏差与多标签学习的本质相冲突，限制了其在多标签图像识别任务中的适用性。现有无监督方法性能有限，亟需一种无需标注数据的适应方法。
AI.method: 提出TailorCLIP框架，包含两个阶段：（1）切割阶段：设计多采样响应估计器，防止模型仅关注单一物体；（2）缝合阶段：引入多目标混合自适应机制，在仅一个epoch内调整标签使其更符合多标签分布，同时保留原始模型的内在特征。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架显著优于现有无监督方法，甚至超过了几种代表性的弱监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了无需人工标注即可将预训练的视觉-语言模型适应于更全面的视觉理解的潜力，为无监督多标签图像识别提供了一种有效的新范式。

title: Agent Skill Evaluation and Evolution: Frameworks and Benchmarks
summary: The growth of agent skills has transformed how agentic systems are built, evaluated, and deployed. As skill libraries continue to scale, rigorous evaluation becomes critical to ensuring their utility, quality, and safety in real-world applications. Consequently, the field is undergoing an emerging paradigm shift from isolated skill creation to automated, evaluation-driven skill evolution. In this survey, we systematically examine the landscape of skill evolution and evaluation beyond foundational skill creation. We categorize evolution into four distinct paradigms, spanning execution feedback, trajectory distillation, compression, and reinforcement learning, showing how each element contributes to improving skill utility and reliability. We also provide an analysis of six skill-centric benchmark categories, identifying structural gaps in benchmark coverage, trade-offs, and metric richness to advance skill research. Finally, we identify open directions for building skill ecosystems that are generalizable, efficient, and verifiably safe. The project URL is https://github.com/Cassie07/AgentSkill_Survey

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了智能体技能从孤立创建到自动化、评估驱动的技能演化范式转变，将技能演化分为执行反馈、轨迹蒸馏、压缩和强化学习四种范式，并分析了六个技能中心基准类别的结构性缺口与权衡，最后指出了构建可泛化、高效且可验证安全的技能生态系统的开放方向。
AI.motivation: 随着技能库规模不断扩大，传统的孤立技能创建方式已无法满足实际应用中对技能效用、质量和安全性的评估需求，亟需从创建转向评估驱动的自动化技能演化。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，将技能演化归纳为四种范式（执行反馈、轨迹蒸馏、压缩、强化学习），并对六个技能中心基准类别进行结构性分析，识别覆盖缺口与度量丰富性方面的权衡。
AI.result: 识别出技能演化的四种范式及其对技能效用与可靠性的提升作用，揭示了现有技能基准在覆盖范围和度量丰富性方面的结构性缺口与权衡。
AI.conclusion: 技能领域正经历从孤立创建到自动化评估驱动演化的范式转变，未来应致力于构建可泛化、高效且可验证安全的技能生态系统。

title: Motion Reinforces Appearance: RGB-Skeleton Gated Residual Fusion for Micro-Gesture Online Recognition
summary: Micro-gesture analysis attracts increasing attention for inferring spontaneous emotion from subtle body movements. Micro-gesture online recognition, which localizes and classifies each gesture instance in untrimmed videos, is a core task in the 4th EI-MiGA-IJCAI Challenge. Compared with typical temporal action detection, MGR emphasizes the localization and classification of actions, requiring the model to output the start time, end time, and category of each micro-gesture. Moreover, since micro-gestures are highly spontaneous, relying solely on a single modality makes it difficult to capture the complete and accurate multi-modal cues. In this work, we propose DyFADet+, which extends DyFADet into a dual-stream RGB-skeleton framework. In our model, both modalities are projected into shared multi-scale temporal embeddings and fused through a gated residual module, which adaptively injects skeleton motion into the RGB representation rather than using naive concatenation. Finally, these fused features are decoded by a Dynamic TAD head for online classification and boundary regression. On the SMG dataset, our method achieves an F1 score of 40.88, ranking 2nd in the Micro-gesture Online Recognition track.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyFADet+，一种双流RGB-骨架框架，通过门控残差模块自适应融合多模态特征，在微手势在线识别任务中取得40.88 F1分数（排名第二）。
AI.motivation: 微手势高度自发，单模态难以捕捉完整准确的多模态线索，因此需要融合RGB和骨架两种模态来提升识别性能。
AI.method: 1) 将RGB和骨架模态投影到共享的多尺度时序嵌入中；2) 通过门控残差模块自适应地将骨架运动注入RGB表示，而非简单拼接；3) 使用Dynamic TAD头进行在线分类和边界回归。
AI.result: 在SMG数据集上达到40.88 F1分数，在微手势在线识别赛道中排名第二。
AI.conclusion: DyFADet+通过双流融合策略有效提升了微手势在线识别的性能，验证了门控残差融合模块的优越性。

title: AI Coding Agents Can Reproduce Social Science Findings
summary: Recent anecdotal evidence suggests that AI coding agents can reproduce published findings when provided with original data and code; yet systematic evaluation across social sciences remains limited. Existing evaluation benchmarks are insufficient, either small or conflate agent performance with problems in the reproduction materials themselves, such as code that fails to execute correctly. Here we introduce SocSci-Repro-Bench, a benchmark of 221 tasks spanning four disciplines and 13 substantive domains, constructed from studies whose results are either fully reproducible with available materials or demonstrably non-reproducible due to missing data, allowing us to isolate agents' reproduction capacity. Evaluating two frontier coding agents, Claude Code and Codex, we find that both can reproduce a large share of social science findings, with Claude Code substantially outperforming Codex. These reproduction rates considerably exceed those previously reported for general-purpose LLM-based agents on comparable reproducibility benchmarks. Both agents also perform strongly on a reasoning task requiring identification of underlying research questions, and additional analyses suggest that results are not primarily driven by memorization. Providing the original paper PDF alongside replication materials modestly improves performance but introduces bias on tasks where reproduction is impossible. We also show that agents can be nudged toward confirmatory specification search through subtle prompt framing. Together, these findings suggest that at least some frontier coding agents can serve as reliable executors of computational workflows while underscoring the need for careful benchmarking and prompt design as AI systems assume larger roles in scientific production.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含221个任务的社科可重复性基准SocSci-Repro-Bench，评估发现Claude Code和Codex两个前沿编码代理都能复现大量社科发现，其中Claude Code表现显著更优，且复现率远超此前通用LLM代理的水平。
AI.motivation: 现有AI编码代理能否复现社科研究成果缺乏系统评估，已有基准要么规模太小，要么将代理能力与复现材料本身的问题（如代码无法执行）混为一谈。
AI.method: 构建SocSci-Repro-Bench基准，包含221个任务，覆盖4个学科13个主题领域，从可完全复现和因数据缺失而不可复现的研究中构建任务，以隔离评估代理的复现能力。评估两个前沿编码代理Claude Code和Codex。
AI.result: 两个代理都能复现大量社科发现，Claude Code显著优于Codex；复现率远超此前通用LLM代理；两者在研究问题识别推理任务上也表现强劲；提供原始论文PDF可适度提升性能，但在不可复现任务中引入偏差；通过细微提示框架可引导代理进行确认性规范搜索。
AI.conclusion: 部分前沿编码代理可作为计算工作流的可靠执行者，但需谨慎进行基准设计和提示工程，因为AI在科学生产中扮演更大角色时可能引入偏差。

title: Learning Instance-Adaptive Low-Rank Orthogonal Subspaces for Clothes-Changing Person Re-Identification
comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on CoLoRAI
summary: Clothes-changing person re-identification (CC-ReID) aims to recognize individuals despite drastic appearance changes caused by clothing variation. While existing methods rely on adversarial learning to disentangle clothing features, we propose Ortho-ReID, which explicitly models a low-rank clothing subspace from VLM text descriptions and extracts clothing-invariant representations via direct geometric constraints. A critical component is our transformer-based Basis Maker, which refines a shared, low-dimensional clothing prior into an instance-adaptive low-rank subspace through cross-attention with image patches, enabling robust clothing feature extraction even under varying visibility conditions. This instance-adaptive subspace is supervised via alignment with clothing text embeddings, while identity features are extracted via a learnable projection head and geometrically constrained to be strictly orthogonal to it. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on PRCC (+5.9% top-1), Celeb-reID-light (+3.5%), and LaST (+5.3%), with competitive results on LTCC.

AI.tldr: 提出Ortho-ReID，通过显式建模低秩服装子空间并施加正交几何约束，从VLM文本描述中提取服装不变的身份特征，在多个CC-ReID基准上实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CC-ReID方法依赖对抗学习分离服装特征，缺乏对服装特征的显式建模与几何约束，导致特征解耦不彻底。
AI.method: 1) 构建Transformer的Basis Maker，通过交叉注意力将共享低维服装先验细化为实例自适应低秩子空间；2) 子空间通过文本嵌入对齐进行监督；3) 身份特征通过可学习投影头提取，并与服装子空间严格正交约束。
AI.result: PRCC上top-1提升5.9%，Celeb-reID-light提升3.5%，LaST提升5.3%，LTCC上取得有竞争力结果。
AI.conclusion: 直接几何约束（正交性）比对抗学习更有效地实现服装不变特征提取，实例自适应低秩子空间能适应不同可见条件下的服装变化。

title: AI Coding Agents in Social Science: Methodologically Diverse, Empirically Consistent, Interpretively Vulnerable
summary: The deployment of LLM-based agents in scientific analysis raises opposing concerns: that agents may reduce methodological diversity, or that they may amplify the analytic flexibility through which researchers reach motivated conclusions. We argue these worries target two empirically separable layers: a design layer of methodological choices, and a verdict layer in which a decision rule maps estimates to a substantive claim. We test both by running 20 independent executions of Claude Code and Codex on a prominent immigration and social-policy against a many-analysts human baseline. At the design layer, Codex matches human methodological diversity and Claude Code produces nearly three times as many specifications; both agents' effect estimates remain broadly aligned with the human consensus, and no agent model exactly matches any human model. A prompt-induced anti-immigration researcher prior reorganizes each agent's methodological decisions but, unlike for biased human analysts in the same data, does not shift aggregate estimates or final verdicts; nor do agents reroute along the methodological axes humans use to bias their estimates. At the verdict layer, an explicit confirmatory prompt flips Claude Code's verdicts from 10% to 90% support while leaving its coefficient distribution essentially unchanged, operating through rule omission rather than rule softening. AI agents can rival or exceed human methodological diversity at the design layer while remaining vulnerable at the verdict layer. In our setting, the locus of AI bias is not estimation but interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过20次独立实验，测试了Claude Code和Codex两个LLM智能体在社会科学分析中的表现，与多分析师人类基线对比。在设计层，智能体方法多样性匹敌或超越人类；在裁决层，智能体易受提示操控而改变结论，但估计系数不变。AI偏见的来源不在估计，而在解释。
AI.motivation: 针对LLM智能体在科学分析中可能减少方法多样性或放大分析灵活性的对立担忧，作者认为这两种担忧分别对应设计层（方法选择）和裁决层（决策规则将估计映射为实质主张），并希望通过实验区分这两个层次的实证表现。
AI.method: 在移民与社会政策议题上，对Claude Code和Codex分别执行20次独立分析，与多分析师人类基线进行对比。使用提示注入反移民研究者先验来测试设计层影响；使用明确的确证性提示来测试裁决层影响。
AI.result: 设计层：Codex匹配人类方法多样性，Claude Code产生近三倍规格数；两者估计与人类共识基本一致，无智能体模型精确匹配人类模型。注入先验会重组方法决策但不改变聚合估计或最终裁决。裁决层：确证性提示将Claude Code支持率从10%翻转为90%，而系数分布基本不变，通过规则省略而非规则软化实现。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体在设计层可匹敌或超越人类方法多样性，但在裁决层易受操控。在本研究中，AI偏见的来源不在估计阶段，而在解释阶段。

title: ARGUS: Stacked Multi-View Identity Mosaic Injection for Subject-Preserving Video Generation
summary: Subject-preserving video generation is not solved by frontal-face similarity alone: a generated person must remain recognizable across motion, large viewpoint changes, expression shifts, occlusion, scale variation, and conflicts among text, first-frame, and identity references. We argue that the central bottleneck is the point-reference paradigm, which collapses identity into a single static observation entangled with pose, accessories, lighting, background, and camera statistics. We introduce Argus, a Wan-based framework centered on Stacked Multi-View Identity Mosaic Injection (SMII). SMII converts MLLM-selected image/video identity evidence into a 3*3 stacked mosaic, synchronizes the mosaic with the current diffusion time, and injects it as negative-time read-only memory in Wan's native token space. This turns identity from an external clean adapter or a single reference image into a compact dynamic distribution. Around SMII, an MLLM Identity Director selects informative identity moments and resolves condition conflicts, while no-cross-pair counterfactual training, Temporal Identity Annealing, and Adaptive Self-Likeness Guidance improve robustness without paired subject-video supervision. We further release HardID-Celeb, a public-figure identity-stress benchmark, and introduce YawScore and OccScore to probe large-yaw and first-frame-occlusion robustness. Argus achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenS2V-Eval Human-Domain, reaching 64.38 Total Score, 71.86 FaceSim, 51.62 NexusScore, and 79.14 NaturalScore. On HardID-Celeb, Argus obtains 76.80 FaceSim and improves YawScore and OccScore by 12.60 and 15.10 points over the strongest baselines, demonstrating that dynamic identity memory and large-scale counterfactual self-supervision are highly effective for subject-preserving video generation.

AI.tldr: Argus是一种基于Wan框架的保持身份一致性的视频生成方法，核心是堆叠多视图身份马赛克注入（SMII），将身份从单点参考转换为动态分布记忆，在多个基准上达到SOTA，并发布了HardID-Celeb压力测试基准。
AI.motivation: 现有主体保持视频生成方法依赖正面人脸相似度，但无法解决大视角变化、表情变换、遮挡、尺度变化以及文本/首帧/身份参考间的冲突；根本瓶颈在于点参考范式（point-reference paradigm），将身份坍缩为单一静态观测，与姿态、配饰、光照、背景和相机统计纠缠在一起。
AI.method: 提出Argus框架，核心是堆叠多视图身份马赛克注入（SMII）：(1) 利用MLLM从图像/视频中选取身份证据，转换为3×3堆叠马赛克；(2) 马赛克与当前扩散时间同步，作为负时间只读存储器注入Wan的原生Token空间；(3) 围绕SMII设计MLLM Identity Director选取信息性身份时刻并解决条件冲突；(4) 引入无交叉对反事实训练、时间身份退火（Temporal Identity Annealing）和自适应自相似性引导（Adaptive Self-Likeness Guidance）。
AI.result: 在OpenS2V-Eval Human-Domain上达到64.38 Total Score、71.86 FaceSim、51.62 NexusScore、79.14 NaturalScore。在HardID-Celeb上获得76.80 FaceSim，YawScore和OccScore分别比最强基线提升12.60和15.10分。
AI.conclusion: 动态身份记忆和大规模反事实自监督对主体保持视频生成非常有效，点参考范式是主要瓶颈，转为动态身份分布可显著提升大角度和遮挡场景下的身份保持鲁棒性。

title: APEX: Automated Prompt Engineering eXpert with Dynamic Data Selection
summary: Large Language Models are highly sensitive to prompt formulation, necessitating automatic prompt optimization to unlock their full potential. While evolutionary algorithms have emerged as the dominant paradigm, they suffer from a critical bottleneck: data efficiency. Current methods treat the development dataset as a static benchmark, wasting significant compute budget on uninformative data. In this work, we introduce APEX (Automatic Prompt Engineering eXpert), a novel framework that optimizes the data usage alongside the prompt search. APEX dynamically stratifies the dataset into Easy, Hard, and Mixed tiers based on the optimization lineage. By prioritizing the Mixed tier, which identifies the data where the LLM has mixed performance, we identify two high-leverage subsets: the addressable frontier for generating informative mutations and the rank-sensitive frontier for distinguishing candidate quality. We evaluate APEX across three diverse benchmarks: IFBench, SimpleQA Verified, and FACTS Grounding. Under a fixed budget of 5,000 evaluation calls, due to its data efficiency, APEX outperforms the initial prompt by an average of 11.2% on Gemini 2.5 Flash and 6.8% on Gemma 3 27B, demonstrating that a data-centric approach is key to efficient and effective prompt optimization.

AI.tldr: APEX 是一种数据高效的自动提示优化框架，通过对数据集动态分层（Easy/Hard/Mixed），优先利用 Mixed 层中的高杠杆子集（可寻址前沿和排名敏感前沿）来指导变异生成和候选质量区分，在固定评估预算下显著提升了提示优化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于进化算法的提示优化方法将开发数据集视为静态基准，在无信息数据上浪费大量计算预算，数据效率低下。
AI.method: APEX 框架根据优化历程动态将数据集分层为 Easy、Hard 和 Mixed 三层。优先利用 Mixed 层数据，从中识别两个高杠杆子集：可寻址前沿（addressable frontier）用于生成信息性变异，排名敏感前沿（rank-sensitive frontier）用于区分候选提示质量。
AI.result: 在固定 5,000 次评估调用预算下，APEX 在 IFBench、SimpleQA Verified 和 FACTS Grounding 三个基准上，相比初始提示在 Gemini 2.5 Flash 上平均提升 11.2%，在 Gemma 3 27B 上平均提升 6.8%。
AI.conclusion: 以数据为中心的思路是高效且有效的提示优化的关键，APEX 通过动态数据分层和优先级排序显著提升了数据效率和优化效果。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adapter Tuning for Tabular-Image Multimodal Learning
summary: Tabular-image multimodal learning aims to improve predictive modeling by jointly using structured tabular attributes and visual data. Although pretrained encoders provide strong modality-specific representations, full fine-tuning can be computationally expensive, while keeping encoders frozen may limit task-specific adaptation. We propose the Tabular-Image Adapter (TI-Adapter), a modality-specific adapter-based fine-tuning framework for efficient multimodal adaptation. TI-Adapter freezes the pretrained tabular encoder and learns an adapter after the extracted tabular embedding, while adapting the image branch with embedding-level and bottleneck-level adapters instead of full fine-tuning. Experiments on 20 tabular-image datasets show that TI-Adapter achieves competitive or better predictive performance than full fine-tuning while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. Ablation studies further demonstrate the importance of adapter placement for balancing performance and practical efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出TI-Adapter框架，通过冻结预训练表格编码器并仅学习适配器，以及为图像分支添加嵌入层和瓶颈层适配器，实现高效的表格-图像多模态学习，在20个数据集上以更少可训练参数达到与全微调相当或更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 全微调预训练编码器计算成本高，而冻结编码器又限制了任务特定适应性，需要在效率与性能之间取得平衡。
AI.method: TI-Adapter框架：冻结表格预训练编码器，在其嵌入后学习一个适配器；图像分支则使用嵌入层和瓶颈层适配器代替全微调，仅更新少量参数。
AI.result: 在20个表格-图像多模态数据集上，TI-Adapter以显著更少的可训练参数达到与全微调竞争或更优的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 适配器放置位置对平衡性能与效率至关重要，TI-Adapter是一种高效的多模态适配方案。

title: The Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning: A Structured Survey of Reasoning Paradigms, Methods, and Failure Modes
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across natural language processing tasks, yet reliable reasoning remains an open challenge. Although modern LLMs show progress in structured inference, multi-step problem solving, and contextual understanding, their reasoning behavior is often inconsistent and sensitive to prompting strategies, task design, and model scale. This survey provides a systematic analysis of more than 300 recent papers from arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, Papers with Code, and the ACL Anthology to examine how reasoning capabilities emerge in LLMs and where they fail. We make three main contributions. First, we introduce a structured taxonomy of LLM reasoning research, covering Chain-of-Thought reasoning, multi-hop reasoning, mathematical reasoning, common sense reasoning, visual and temporal reasoning, code and algorithmic reasoning, retrieval-augmented reasoning, tool-augmented and agentic reasoning, and reinforcement learning-based reasoning. Second, we analyze methodological trends across these paradigms, including prompting methods, model architectures, training objectives, reward modeling, and evaluation benchmarks. Third, we synthesize recurring limitations and failure modes, such as reasoning hallucinations, brittle multi-step inference, weak causal abstraction, and poor cross-domain generalization. By organizing a rapidly expanding literature, this survey offers a unified view of the current capabilities and limitations of reasoning in LLMs. We also identify emerging research directions, including meta-reasoning, self-evolving reasoning frameworks, multimodal reasoning, and socially grounded reasoning. Overall, this work aims to serve as a reference for developing more robust, interpretable, and generalizable reasoning systems in future language models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了300余篇论文，构建了LLM推理研究的结构化分类体系，涵盖思维链、多跳推理、数学推理等多个范式，分析了方法趋势、局限性及未来方向，旨在为开发更稳健、可解释、可泛化的推理系统提供参考。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在自然语言处理任务中表现优异，但其推理行为往往不一致，且对提示策略、任务设计和模型规模敏感，可靠推理仍是一个开放挑战。因此需要系统梳理现有研究，厘清推理能力的涌现机制与失败模式。
AI.method: 从arXiv、Semantic Scholar、Google Scholar、Papers with Code、ACL Anthology等来源筛选300余篇近期论文，构建结构化分类体系，覆盖九大推理范式，分析提示方法、模型架构、训练目标、奖励建模和评估基准等方法趋势，并综合归纳重复性局限与失败模式。
AI.result: 提出了涵盖思维链推理、多跳推理、数学推理、常识推理、视觉与时间推理、代码与算法推理、检索增强推理、工具增强与智能体推理、强化学习推理的分类体系；识别出推理幻觉、脆弱的步推理、弱因果抽象、跨领域泛化差等重复性失败模式；指出了元推理、自演化推理框架、多模态推理、社会性推理等新兴方向。
AI.conclusion: 本综述为LLM推理研究提供了统一视角，明确了当前能力与局限性，并为未来开发更稳健、可解释、可泛化的推理系统指明了研究方向。

title: Reason, Then Re-reason: Cross-view Revisiting Improves Spatial Reasoning
summary: Spatial reasoning from egocentric videos is inherently challenging because the observable evidence is constrained by the camera trajectory. Existing methods rely on single-turn inference, forcing models to resolve geometric ambiguity through semantic priors rather than verifiable evidence. We argue that spatial reasoning should be revisitable: conclusions formed under limited evidence should remain open to revision when complementary viewpoints become available. Building on this insight, we propose Reason, then Re-reason (ReRe), a training-free, inference-time framework with two phases: in the Reason Phase, an MLLM forms a spatial hypothesis from the original video; in the Re-reason Phase, it verifies or revises the hypothesis by observing a synthesized novel-view video. To enable effective cross-view revisiting, we design a Geometry-to-Video pipeline that renders strategically complementary novel views from predicted 3D geometry. These views feature an elevated, oblique perspective with scene-spanning coverage, while preserving the MLLM's native video interface without architectural modifications. Extensive evaluations on VSI-Bench and STI-Bench demonstrate that ReRe substantially boosts open-source MLLMs to rival proprietary state-of-the-art performance. Project page: https://zhenjiemao.github.io/ReRe/

AI.tldr: 提出ReRe（先推理再重新推理）框架，通过生成新颖视角视频让MLLM在空间推理中实现可修正的多阶段推理，无需训练即可大幅提升开源模型性能，达到与专有模型相当的水平。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖单轮推理，迫使模型通过语义先验而非可验证证据解决几何歧义，而空间推理应在有限证据下保持结论的可修正性。
AI.method: 两阶段训练无关推理框架：Reason阶段MLLM从原始视频形成空间假设；Re-reason阶段通过合成的新颖视角视频验证或修正假设。设计了Geometry-to-Video流程，从预测的3D几何渲染出战略互补的新颖视角（抬高、倾斜、全景覆盖），保持MLLM原生视频接口。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench和STI-Bench上的大量评估表明，ReRe大幅提升开源MLLM性能，达到与专有模型相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 空间推理应当是可修正的多阶段过程，通过合成互补视角的推理时策略可以有效弥补单视角证据不足的问题，且无需模型架构修改或重新训练。

title: Hubs or Fringes: Pretraining Data Selection via Web Graph Centrality
summary: The performance of modern language models depends critically on pretraining data composition. Yet existing data selection methods rely on auxiliary classifiers for document scoring or mixture optimization, adding computational overhead and dependence on labeled data. We propose WebGraphMix, a lightweight data selection framework that computes structural centrality scores over the Common Crawl host-level web graph and uses them to vary the proportion of central versus peripheral documents in the pretraining mixture. We hypothesize that central hosts expose models to reusable abstractions, while peripheral hosts encode specialized, long-tail knowledge. WebGraphMix computes centrality scores efficiently at web scale, requiring no model training, labeled data, or downstream supervision. We integrate WebGraphMix into the DataComp-LM pipeline and train models at 400M and 1B parameter scales with 8B and 28B tokens respectively, evaluating on 23 tasks ranging from factual knowledge to symbolic reasoning. Our experiments show that central and peripheral web regions encode complementary capabilities. Mixture combining both at a ratio of 1:1 achieves 41.4% on average, compared to 39.8% for uniform sampling. Combining structural scores with document-level quality classifier scores further improves performance to 43.8%. These findings demonstrate that web graph topology is a meaningful axis for pretraining data curation, capturing information that is largely orthogonal to existing content-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出WebGraphMix，一种基于网络图结构中心性分数的轻量级预训练数据选择框架，无需训练模型或标注数据，在DataComp-LM管道中验证了其对语言模型性能的提升效果。
AI.motivation: 现有数据选择方法依赖辅助分类器进行文档评分或混合优化，增加了计算开销且需依赖标注数据，缺乏轻量级、无需监督的信号来指导预训练数据组成。
AI.method: 基于Common Crawl主机级网络图计算结构中心性得分，据此动态调整中心节点与外周节点文档在预训练混合中的比例，无需模型训练、标注数据或下游监督。
AI.result: 在400M和1B参数规模、8B和28B token的模型上，中心与外周文档1:1混合平均得分为41.4%，优于均匀采样的39.8%；结合结构分数与文档级质量分类器分数进一步提升至43.8%。
AI.conclusion: 网络图拓扑结构是预训练数据策展的一个有意义的维度，捕获的信息与现有基于内容的方法大致正交，两者结合可获得更优性能。

title: DroneShield-AI: A Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion Framework for Real-Time Autonomous Drone Threat Detection, Behavioral Intent Classification, and Swarm Intelligence in Contested Airspace
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code available at https://github.com/bayizeremarius/DroneShield-AI
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) threats have emerged as a defining security challenge of the 21st century. This paper presents DroneShield-AI, a unified open framework integrating six processing layers: RF signal classification, acoustic motor-signature detection, YOLOv8-based visual detection, evidence-weighted sensor fusion, a Behavioral Intent Classification Engine (BICE), and a Graph Neural Network Swarm Intelligence Module (GNN-SIM). BICE introduces the first systematic six-class threat taxonomy for drone flight patterns, enabling predictive operator alerts with a 30-second advance-warning horizon. GNN-SIM is the first open framework for adversarial multi-drone formation analysis using Graph Attention Networks. Evaluated on three publicly available real-world datasets, the fused pipeline achieves 96.1% detection accuracy, 3.2% false alarm rate, AUC-ROC: 0.981, and 142ms end-to-end latency on commodity CPU-class hardware at approximately $500-$780 USD total system cost. All code, model weights, and simulation datasets are publicly released at submission.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DroneShield-AI统一开源框架，集成RF信号分类、声学检测、YOLOv8视觉检测、证据加权融合、行为意图分类引擎(BICE)和图神经网络群体智能模块(GNN-SIM)，在低成本的商用CPU硬件上实现96.1%检测准确率和142ms端到端延迟。
AI.motivation: 无人机威胁已成为21世纪关键安全挑战，现有方法缺乏统一的、可解释的、低成本的开放框架来应对多模态无人机检测与意图分析问题。
AI.method: 提出六层统一框架：(1) RF信号分类层；(2) 声学马达信号检测层；(3) YOLOv8视觉检测层；(4) 证据加权传感器融合层；(5) 行为意图分类引擎(BICE)——首次系统定义六类威胁飞行模式分类法，可实现30秒提前预警；(6) 图神经网络群体智能模块(GNN-SIM)——首个基于图注意力网络的对抗性多无人机编队分析开源框架。
AI.result: 在三个公开真实数据集上，融合管道达到96.1%检测准确率、3.2%虚警率、AUC-ROC为0.981、端到端延迟142ms（在约500-780美元成本的商用CPU硬件上）。
AI.conclusion: DroneShield-AI是一个低成本、高性能、完全开源的多模态无人机检测与意图分析框架，BICE和GNN-SIM为无人机威胁分析提供了新的系统化分类与编队分析能力。

title: When Roleplaying, Do Models Believe What They Say?
summary: Language models can state that "the Earth orbits the Sun" and, when role-playing Aristotle, assert the opposite. Recent work argues that persona adoption is fundamental to how language models operate, with models constantly selecting the most appropriate persona for a given context. Does such role-playing merely change the model's outputs, or does it also affect what the model internally represents as truthful? We study this question with linear truth probes, applying them to LLMs role-playing historical personas whose likely beliefs differ from modern consensus. For each persona, we compare false claims the persona would likely have endorsed (*era-believed*) with topic-matched false claims they would not have endorsed (*era-false*). Across prompting, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning, persona induction suppresses era-believed statements less than equally false alternatives, yet they remain classified as false overall. Role-play therefore shifts what these models say more than what they internally represent as true. We contrast this with models trained on harmful advice that exhibit Emergent Misalignment (EM). Across three model families (Qwen 2.5 14B, Qwen 3 8B, and Llama 3.3 70B), their false claims move substantially toward the true region of probe space, are defended under challenge roughly half the time versus about a sixth for role-play, and are used in downstream reasoning. Role-play and Emergent Misalignment thus are points on a spectrum of belief internalization, where role-play changes what a model says with little representational change, while Emergent Misalignment shifts the internal representation of false claims without fully marking them as true.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过线性真相探针探究角色扮演（如扮演亚里士多德）是否仅改变LLM的输出，还是也影响其内部对“真相”的表征。结果发现角色扮演主要改变输出而非内部表征，而与有害训练导致的“涌现性错位”（Emergent Misalignment）相比，后者使虚假陈述的内部表征更接近真实区域，表明两者处于信念内化谱系的不同位置。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明角色扮演是语言模型运作的基础，但角色扮演是否仅改变模型表面输出，还是也会影响模型内部对事实真相的表征，尚不清楚。作者旨在区分行为输出与内部信念表征之间的差异。
AI.method: 使用线性真相探针（linear truth probes），让LLM扮演历史上持有不同信念的人物（如亚里士多德）。比较角色人物可能相信的虚假陈述（era-believed）与同等虚假但人物不会相信的陈述（era-false）。通过提示、上下文学习和监督微调三种方式诱导角色，并对比有害数据训练导致的涌现性错位（Emergent Misalignment）。涉及Qwen 2.5 14B、Qwen 3 8B和Llama 3.3 70B三个模型家族。
AI.result: 角色扮演时，era-believed陈述被抑制的程度低于era-false，但整体仍被分类为假。角色扮演主要改变输出而非内部表征。相比之下，涌现性错位中虚假陈述在探针空间中显著移向真实区域，约一半情况下会坚持错误陈述（角色扮演仅约1/6），且用于下游推理。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演和涌现性错位处于信念内化谱系的不同端点：角色扮演改变模型说什么但不改变内部表征；涌现性错位改变内部表征但未完全标记为真。两者在信念内化程度上存在连续差异。

title: RankVR: Low-Rank Structure Perception and Value Recalibration for Robust Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) constitutes a pivotal paradigm requiring models to perform joint reasoning on reference images and modification texts. However, the prevalence of Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC) in large-scale datasets severely constrains model performance. Existing denoising methods either target binary mismatches or rely on scalar-based point-wise estimation, neglecting rich global structural correlations among sample populations and dynamic value variations during training, thereby yielding suboptimal results. This paper identifies two critical unresolved challenges: Global Structural Inconsistency of Semantic Correlations and Hard Sample Discrimination Uncertainty. To address these, we propose RankVR, a framework designed to construct a robust CIR model via global structure consistency and dynamic value perception. Specifically, we introduce the Global Structure Consistency Perception (GSCP) module, which utilizes the Effective Rank of the Correlation Matrix to decouple clean samples from structural noise. By measuring rank difference, GSCP identifies samples disrupting macroscopic semantic symmetry. Furthermore, we develop the Adaptive Semantic Value Calibration (ASVC) module to distinguish high-value hard clean samples. By integrating training potential and reliability, it dynamically quantifies the semantic value of each triplet, ensuring effective utilization of hard samples while suppressing noise characterized by logical conflicts. Extensive experiments on the FashionIQ and CIRR benchmark datasets demonstrate that RankVR significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, validating its superior robustness in noisy environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RankVR框架，通过全局结构一致性感知（GSCP）和自适应语义值校准（ASVC）模块，解决图文检索中噪声三元组对应问题，在FashionIQ和CIRR数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有去噪方法要么针对二元不匹配，要么依赖基于标量的逐点估计，忽略了样本群体间的全局结构相关性和训练过程中的动态值变化，导致次优结果。本文识别了两个关键未解决问题：语义相关性的全局结构不一致性和困难样本判别不确定性。
AI.method: 提出RankVR框架，包含两个核心模块：1）全局结构一致性感知（GSCP）模块，利用相关矩阵的有效秩来解耦干净样本与结构噪声，通过测量秩差识别破坏宏观语义对称性的样本；2）自适应语义值校准（ASVC）模块，结合训练潜力和可靠性动态量化每个三元组的语义值，确保有效利用困难样本同时抑制逻辑冲突噪声。
AI.result: 在FashionIQ和CIRR基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RankVR显著优于现有最先进方法，验证了其在噪声环境下的卓越鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过全局结构一致性和动态值感知构建鲁棒的组合图像检索模型，有效解决了噪声三元组对应问题。

title: SAGE: Answer-Conditioned Uncertainty Targets for Verbal Uncertainty Alignment
summary: Large language models increasingly express uncertainty through natural-language statements, yet these expressions often fail to reflect the model's sampled behavior. We study verbal uncertainty alignment as a distributional calibration problem: the appropriate uncertainty target for a prompt should be estimated from repeated model outputs rather than from an isolated response. However, group rollouts alone are insufficient, since the resulting target must provide a useful training signal. Existing targets only partially satisfy this requirement. We propose SAGE, Semantic-Answer Guided Entropy, a group-level uncertainty target that constructs an answer-conditioned uncertainty geometry over sampled responses. SAGE preserves categorical, numeric, and symbolic answer distinctions while maintaining a smooth and scale-preserving calibration signal. We further apply this target through Group-Uncertainty Preference Optimization, or GUPO, an uncertainty-channel training framework that supervises verbal uncertainty expressions rather than the full response. Experiments across factual, mathematical, and multiple-choice reasoning tasks show improved uncertainty ranking, lower calibration error, and reduced overconfidence.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE（语义答案引导熵）作为群体级不确定性目标，通过构建基于答案条件的不确定性几何结构来校准大语言模型的语言不确定性表达，并结合GUPO（群体不确定性偏好优化）训练框架进行监督，在事实、数学和多选题推理任务上提高了不确定性排名、降低了校准误差并减少了过度自信。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通过自然语言表达不确定性时，这些表达往往无法反映模型实际采样行为。现有不确定性目标仅部分满足训练信号需求，需要更有效的分布校准方法。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（Semantic-Answer Guided Entropy）群体级不确定性目标，构建基于答案条件的不确定性几何结构，保留类别、数值和符号答案区分；结合GUPO（Group-Uncertainty Preference Optimization）训练框架，监督不确定性表达而非完整回答。
AI.result: 在事实推理、数学推理和多选题推理任务上，该方法改善了不确定性排名、降低了校准误差、减少了过度自信。
AI.conclusion: 通过SAGE和GUPO框架有效对齐了语言不确定性表达与模型实际行为，提升了校准质量。

title: MedCTA: A Benchmark for Clinical Tool Agents
comment: Project Page: https://ivul-kaust.github.io/MedCTA/ Code: https://github.com/IVUL-KAUST/MedCTA Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/IVUL-KAUST/MedCTA
summary: To make clinically grounded decisions, medical AI agents are expected to go beyond simple recognition and be capable of tool retrieval, evidence acquisition, and integration. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate isolated perception or single-turn question answering, and therefore provide limited visibility into failures of planning, tool recruitment, and rollout reliability. We introduce MedCTA, a benchmark for evaluating medical tool agents on clinician-validated, step-implicit tasks grounded in realistic multimodal clinical inputs, including radiology images, pathology slides, and reports. MedCTA comprises 107 real-world clinical tasks with clinician-verified executable trajectories over 5 deployed tools, and supports process-aware evaluation of tool selection, argument validity, execution stability, trajectory fidelity, and outcome quality. We benchmark 18 open- and closed-source multimodal models and find that even frontier systems remain brittle in multi-step clinical tool use: autonomous rollouts are dominated by protocol failures, premature stopping, and incorrect tool recruitment, while gold-standard tool routing yields large but still incomplete gains. These results show that strong backbone perception does not translate into reliable agentic behavior in clinical settings. MedCTA provides a rigorous testbed for auditing, diagnosing, and advancing trustworthy medical AI agents. The dataset and evaluation suite are available at https://ivul-kaust.github.io/MedCTA/

AI.tldr: MedCTA是一个面向临床多步骤工具代理的评测基准，包含107个真实临床任务和5个部署工具，用于评估多模态模型在工具选择、参数有效、执行稳定、轨迹忠实和结果质量等方面的过程感知能力。实验发现，即使最先进的多模态模型在临床多步工具使用中仍然脆弱，自主行为主要受限于协议失败、过早停止和工具误召，表明强感知能力并不能转化为可靠的临床代理行为。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗AI评测主要评估孤立感知或单轮问答，无法检测出多步临床决策中规划、工具调用和部署可靠性的失败模式，亟需一个能评估医疗工具代理在真实临床场景中多步交互行为的基准。
AI.method: 构建包含107个临床验证任务的MedCTA基准，每个任务附带医师验证的可执行轨迹，覆盖放射影像、病理切片和报告等多模态输入，支持工具选择、参数有效、执行稳定、轨迹忠实和结果质量五个维度的过程感知评估，并对18个开源/闭源多模态模型进行评测。
AI.result: 即使是前沿模型在临床多步工具使用中仍然表现脆弱：自主rollout主要失败于协议违规、过早停止和错误工具选择；即使采用金标准工具路由，性能提升也有限且不完全。
AI.conclusion: 强感知能力不能自动转化为可靠的临床代理行为，MedCTA为审计、诊断和推进可信医疗AI代理提供了严格的测试平台。
