title: ISE: An Execution-Grounded Recipe for Multi-Turn OS-Agent Trajectories
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures. Dataset and code: https://github.com/Valiere01/ISE-Trace
summary: Training capable OS agents requires data that simultaneously captures structured user intents, multi-turn task delegation, and grounded tool execution--properties absent from existing datasets. We propose ISE (Intent -> Simulate -> Execute), a three-stage synthesis paradigm that addresses these gaps jointly. Stage 1 constructs roughly 50000 structured intents via a 4D framework (Persona x Domain x Task x Complexity); after deduplication the pool contains 43956 unique intents and attains a Vendi Score of 61.57 over the entire pool on mpnet-base-v2 embeddings (cosine kernel, q=1). Stage 2 drives multi-turn user-agent interaction through a role-locked user simulator that grounds each user turn in actual execution outcomes, producing 23132 complete trajectories averaging 8.12 user turns and 68.24 total dialogue turns. Stage 3 runs every tool call inside a live, isolated OS workspace, generating authentic failure-recovery dynamics instead of simulated responses. Fine-tuning on ISETrace improves ClawEval pass@1 from 19.3 to 37.7 using Qwen3-8B on agent tool-use tasks with a standard protocol. This result outperforms zero-shot GPT-4o and the larger Qwen3-32B base model which is four times bigger. An ablation on Stage 2 proves multi-turn simulation brings a large portion of the performance gain. We release all source code and dataset at https://github.com/Valiere01/ISE-Trace.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ISE三阶段合成范式（意图→模拟→执行），生成包含结构化用户意图、多轮任务委派和真实工具执行的OS代理训练数据。微调Qwen3-8B使ClawEval pass@1从19.3提升至37.7，超越零样本GPT-4o和四倍大的Qwen3-32B。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集缺乏同时包含结构化用户意图、多轮任务委派和真实工具执行三个关键属性的数据，无法有效训练具备能力的操作系统代理。
AI.method: 三阶段合成范式：Stage 1通过4D框架（人设×领域×任务×复杂度）构建约5万条结构化意图（去重后43956条，Vendi Score 61.57）；Stage 2使用角色锁定用户模拟器驱动多轮交互，生成23132条完整轨迹（平均8.12用户轮次/68.24总对话轮次）；Stage 3在真实隔离OS环境中执行每个工具调用，产生真实故障恢复动态。
AI.result: 微调Qwen3-8B在ClawEval上将pass@1从19.3提升至37.7，超越零样本GPT-4o和四倍大的Qwen3-32B；消融实验证明Stage 2的多轮模拟贡献了大部分性能提升。
AI.conclusion: ISE范式有效解决了OS代理训练数据缺失问题，通过结构化意图生成、多轮模拟和真实执行三个环节的协同设计，显著提升了小模型的代理工具使用能力。

title: ERN-Net : Evolving Reason Node-Net for Document Binarization
summary: This paper presents ERN-Net, an Evolving Reason Node-Net for efficient document image binarization. ERN-Net enhances degradation-sensitive regions, such as faint strokes, broken characters, and noisy backgrounds, through evolving reason nodes and multi-scale reasoning. We further compare ResNet-101, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and ConvNeXt-Base, and find that ConvNeXt-Tiny provides the best practical trade-off between accuracy and memory usage. In addition, DIBCO-based pretraining improves binarization performance without increasing model memory consumption, requiring only about 1.5 additional training hours. Experiments on DIBCO-style benchmarks show that ERN-Net is effective under low-data and low-memory settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERN-Net（演化推理节点网络），通过演化推理节点和多尺度推理增强退化敏感区域（如淡笔划、断裂字符、嘈杂背景），实现高效文档图像二值化。对比ResNet-101、ConvNeXt-Tiny和ConvNeXt-Base，发现ConvNeXt-Tiny在精度与内存间取得最佳平衡。DIBCO预训练可提升二值化性能且不增加显存消耗，仅需额外1.5小时训练。实验表明ERN-Net在低数据量和低内存设置下同样有效。
AI.motivation: 解决文档图像二值化中退化敏感区域（淡笔划、断裂字符、噪声背景）难以准确处理的问题，同时希望在低数据量和低内存资源条件下仍能保持良好性能。
AI.method: 提出ERN-Net（Evolving Reason Node-Net），核心包括演化推理节点和多尺度推理机制来增强退化敏感区域的特征表示；对比不同骨干网络（ResNet-101、ConvNeXt-Tiny、ConvNeXt-Base）选择最优架构；采用DIBCO风格的预训练策略提升效果。
AI.result: ConvNeXt-Tiny在精度与内存使用之间达到最佳平衡；DIBCO预训练可提升二值化性能且不额外增加模型内存消耗，仅需约1.5小时额外训练时间；ERN-Net在DIBCO基准测试的低数据量和低内存设置下表现有效。
AI.conclusion: ERN-Net是一种高效且资源友好的文档图像二值化方法，特别适用于资源受限场景，通过合理的骨干网络选择和预训练策略可在不增加内存负担的前提下提升性能。

title: Measuring language complexity from hierarchical reuse of recurring patterns
summary: We introduce the ladderpath index as a measure of language complexity grounded in algorithmic information theory. It counts the minimum steps needed to reconstruct a sequence through hierarchical reuse of repeated substructures, capturing an exactly computable but constrained form of algorithmic compressibility related to, but distinct from, Kolmogorov complexity. We apply the ladderpath approach to 21 parallel corpora from the Parallel Universal Dependencies dataset. The ladderpath index is approximately invariant across the languages, and varies much less than the corpus length. This is more pronounced when all corpora are mapped to a unified binary representation, providing evidence for the equi-complexity hypothesis from a representation-independent perspective. We also observe trade-offs between character inventory size and corpus length, and between vocabulary-level and corpus-level reconstruction complexity, supporting the trade-off hypothesis that total complexity is conserved and redistributed across linguistic levels. The reusable substructures identified by the ladderpath approach, without any linguistic input, overlap with words and morphological components attested in the natural vocabulary. The hierarchical reuse captured by the ladderpath approach parallels the chunking mechanisms proposed in cognitive science, where the human cognitive system compresses linguistic input into nested, reusable units under shared memory and processing constraints. This connection between cognitive chunking and the ladderpath approach provides a new interpretation for the equi-complexity and trade-off hypotheses, grounding both in the shared cognitive architecture that underlies language processing across human languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出梯子路径指数（ladderpath index）作为语言复杂度的度量，基于算法信息论，通过层次化重用重复子结构的最小重构步数来衡量序列复杂度。在21种平行语料上实验发现该指数跨语言近似不变，支持等复杂度假说；同时观察到字符库大小与语料长度、词汇级与语料级重构复杂度之间存在权衡关系，支持权衡假说。识别出的可重用子结构与自然词汇和形态成分吻合，并与认知科学中的组块机制相呼应。
AI.motivation: 当前语言复杂度度量多依赖语言学先验知识或计算不可行的Kolmogorov复杂度，缺乏一种既可精确计算、又与算法信息论相关、且能揭示语言普遍性与认知机制的度量方法。
AI.method: 提出梯子路径指数，计算通过层次化重用重复子结构对序列进行重构所需的最小步数。基于Parallel UD数据集的21种平行语料，在不同表示（原始文本、统一二进制表示）下计算该指数，分析其跨语言变化及与语料长度、字符库大小的关系。
AI.result: 梯子路径指数跨语言近似不变，变化幅度远小于语料长度，在统一二进制表示下更为明显。字符库大小与语料长度之间存在权衡，词汇级与语料级重构复杂度之间也存在权衡关系。识别出的可重用子结构与自然语言中的词汇和形态成分存在重叠。
AI.conclusion: 梯子路径指数为语言等复杂度假说和权衡假说提供了来自表示无关视角的证据。该指数与认知组块机制的类比表明，等复杂度和权衡假说可根植于人类语言处理共享的认知架构。

title: Ouroboros-Spatial: Closing the Data-Model Loop for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches largely rely on large-scale, statically curated datasets, where all training samples are treated uniformly regardless of the model's evolving capabilities. This static paradigm is inherently data-inefficient: training capacity is often spent on samples that are either trivial or overly difficult for the model at its current stage. To address this limitation, we propose Ouroboros-Spatial, a self-evolving training framework in which the model plays dual roles as a proposer and a solver. In each iteration, a frozen proposer generates spatial question-answer (QA) pairs from 3D scene metadata and raw video frames, together with executable code for deriving reliable ground truth. A learnable solver is then fine-tuned on the accepted samples, and its per-sample prediction confidence is used as a difficulty signal. This signal is fed back to the proposer in the next iteration, guiding it to generate questions better matched to the solver's current capabilities. Through this closed-loop design, the training distribution co-evolves with model ability, reducing redundant trivial examples while filtering out ambiguous or uninformative samples with limited learning value. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks, Ouroboros-Spatial substantially improves Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B while using an order of magnitude fewer training examples than recent large-scale curated datasets. On VSI-Bench, it yields absolute gains of 9.9 and 6.8 points for the 4B and 8B models, respectively, enabling both to outperform a wide range of strong open-source and proprietary baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Ouroboros-Spatial，一种自我演进的训练框架，让模型同时扮演提问者和求解者，通过闭环反馈机制动态调整训练分布，使训练数据与模型能力协同进化，在6个空间推理基准上显著提升Qwen3-VL-4B/8B性能，数据效率提升一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM空间推理方法依赖静态大规模数据集，所有样本被无差别对待，不考虑模型当前能力水平，导致数据效率低下——训练资源浪费在模型当前阶段过于简单或过于困难的样本上。
AI.method: 提出Ouroboros-Spatial自我演进训练框架：1) 冻结的proposer从3D场景元数据和原始视频帧中生成空间QA对及可执行代码；2) 可学习的solver在接受的样本上微调；3) 利用solver的逐样本预测置信度作为难度信号反馈给proposer，指导其生成与solver当前能力更匹配的问题。形成闭环迭代。
AI.result: 在6个空间推理基准上，Ouroboros-Spatial显著提升Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B性能，仅使用比近期大规模数据集少一个数量级的训练样本。在VSI-Bench上，4B和8B模型分别获得9.9和6.8个绝对点提升，均超越多种开源和闭源强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过闭环的自我演进训练框架，使训练数据分布与模型能力协同进化，在显著提升空间推理性能的同时大幅提高数据效率，验证了动态课程学习范式在多模态空间推理任务中的有效性。

title: Pretrained self-supervised speech models can recognize unseen consonants
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at Interspeech 2026
summary: Modern pretrained self-supervised automatic speech recognition models are trained on large-scale audio data to encode speech into contextualized representations. However, their training data are heavily skewed toward high-resource languages with little data from low-resource languages, raising concerns about the potential underrepresentation of typologically uncommon speech sounds such as click consonants primarily found in Khoisan languages. This leads to our central research question: Can these models recognize click consonants as accurately as other speech sounds? To address this question, we fine-tune and compare pretrained self-supervised speech models (Wav2Vec2 and HuBERT) on data from two click-rich Khoisan languages (G|ui and West !Xoon). Our results reveal that the fine-tuned models consistently recognize clicks more accurately than non-clicks, suggesting that self-supervision enables generalization across human speech sounds including rare phonemes.

AI.tldr: 本文探究预训练自监督语音模型（Wav2Vec2和HuBERT）对Khoisan语系中罕见搭嘴音（click consonants）的识别能力。通过在两种富含搭嘴音的语言（G|ui和West !Xoon）上进行微调实验，发现模型对搭嘴音的识别准确率反而高于非搭嘴音，表明自监督学习能够有效泛化到罕见音素。
AI.motivation: 预训练自监督语音模型的训练数据严重偏向高资源语言，低资源语言数据极少，导致一些类型学上罕见的语音（如Khoisan语系的搭嘴音）可能被模型低估或误识别。作者希望验证这些模型是否能够准确识别搭嘴音。
AI.method: 选取两种富含搭嘴音的Khoisan语言（G|ui和West !Xoon）数据，分别对Wav2Vec2和HuBERT两种预训练自监督语音模型进行微调，随后比较模型对搭嘴音与非搭嘴音的识别准确率。
AI.result: 微调后的模型对搭嘴音的识别准确率始终高于非搭嘴音，即模型在罕见音素上的表现反而优于常见音素。
AI.conclusion: 自监督学习机制使得模型能够有效泛化到包括罕见音素在内的各种人类语音，预训练阶段学习到的通用语音表征对低资源语言中的特殊音素具有较好的鲁棒性。

title: Multi-View In-Cabin Monitoring System for Public Transport Vehicles
summary: We introduce a multi-view in-cabin monitoring dataset for public transportation with synchronized RGB and depth images from four inward-facing cameras and a rotating LiDAR covering the vehicle interior of a digitalized and partly automated German city bus. The dataset contains 9.136 synchronized samples with annotations and is accompanied by a calibration and pseudo-labeling pipeline that generates 3D human pose estimates and oriented 3D bounding boxes for occupants. We further provide a nuScenes-format conversion and benchmark representative multi-view 3D detection models (e.g., Lift-Splat-Shoot and BEVFusion), supporting comparative evaluation and small-scale training of multi-view in-cabin perception models. The dataset and tools are available at https://github.com/EvgenyGorelik/multiview_incabin_dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个面向公共交通的多视角座舱监控数据集，包含来自四台内置摄像头和一台旋转LiDAR的同步RGB与深度图像，并提供9,136个带标注的样本、标定与伪标签流程（生成3D人体姿态估计和定向3D边界框），以及nuScenes格式转换和多视角3D检测模型（如Lift-Splat-Shoot和BEVFusion）的基准评估。
AI.motivation: 公共交通座舱内人员感知对于安全和运营管理至关重要，但缺乏多视角、多模态（RGB+深度+LiDAR）的公开数据集，尤其是针对数字化城市巴士的室内环境。
AI.method: 使用4台面向内部的RGB-D相机和1台旋转LiDAR同步采集数据，构建标定与伪标签流程生成3D人体姿态和定向3D边界框，并提供nuScenes格式转换，支持多视角3D检测模型的训练与评估。
AI.result: 构建了包含9,136个同步样本的数据集，并在该数据集上对Lift-Splat-Shoot、BEVFusion等代表性多视角3D检测模型进行了基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和工具链填补了公共交通座舱内多视角感知的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化的评估平台和开源资源。

title: Teaching Diffusion to Speculate Left-to-Right
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their autoregressive decoding process incurs substantial inference costs due to inherently sequential token generation. Speculative decoding addresses this bottleneck by employing a lightweight draft model to propose multiple future tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent work has demonstrated that diffusion language models are well suited for this setting, as they can generate entire blocks of draft tokens in parallel and thereby alleviate the sequential constraints of autoregressive drafting. A subtlety of this regime is that block-diffusion drafters generate tokens bidirectionally within a block, whereas verification is performed by an autoregressive target model that evaluates tokens in a strictly left-to-right manner, leaving a gap between the symmetric training-time objective and the asymmetric verification-time reward. In this work, we offer an empirical analysis of three training-time interventions that narrow this gap: token positional weighting, a first-error focal loss that targets the position that breaks the accepted prefix within each block, and a chain loss term that substitutes a differentiable surrogate for the expected accepted length. The three interventions act along orthogonal axes (position, block-conditional first error, joint prefix) and compose additively; they are likewise orthogonal to test-time alignment mechanisms such as multi-draft self-selection, with which they can in principle be combined. Across four target models and six reasoning, code, and dialogue benchmarks, the three interventions raise accepted draft length by 21-76% per benchmark over a position-uniform baseline, without adding additional forward passes and without changing the inference pipeline or the rejection-sampling exactness contract.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种正交的训练时干预方法（令牌位置加权、首个错误焦点损失、链损失项），以缩小块扩散草稿模型的双向生成与自回归目标模型单向验证之间的不对称性，在不增加推理开销的前提下，将接受的草稿长度提升21-76%。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽能以块并行方式生成草稿令牌加速推理，但其双向生成模式与自回归验证模型的严格从左到右评估之间存在不对称性（对称的训练目标 vs. 非对称的验证奖励），导致性能差距。本文旨在通过训练时干预缩小这一差距。
AI.method: 提出三种正交的训练时干预：1) 令牌位置加权（Token Positional Weighting），根据令牌在块中的位置赋予不同权重；2) 首个错误焦点损失（First-Error Focal Loss），聚焦于块中打破已接受前缀的第一个错误位置；3) 链损失项（Chain Loss），用可微分替代项近似期望的接受长度。三种干预互为正交且可加性组合。
AI.result: 在4个目标模型和6个推理/代码/对话基准上，三种干预方法相较于位置均匀基线将接受的草稿长度提升21-76%，且不增加额外前向传播、不改变推理流程或拒绝采样的精确性约束。
AI.conclusion: 三种干预方法沿正交轴（位置、块条件首个错误、联合前缀）发挥作用，可加性组合，且与测试时对齐机制（如多草稿自选择）正交可互补，为加速推测解码提供了有效的训练端解决方案。

title: UniReason-Med: A Shared Grounded Reasoning Interface for 2D-to-3D Transfer in Medical VQA
summary: We study whether grounded reasoning supervision from abundant 2D medical images can improve 3D medical VQA when both input types are aligned through a common reasoning interface. We introduce UniReason-Med, a single-checkpoint framework that processes either a 2D image or a slice-serialized 3D volume at inference time, generating interleaved textual reasoning and localized visual evidence through shared box syntax, region-token injection, and a common grounded reasoning policy. To train this interface, we construct UniMed-CoT, a 220K instruction-tuning dataset with interleaved textual reasoning and grounded visual evidence, including 170K 2D and 50K 3D samples. Through supervised fine-tuning followed by outcome-level reinforcement learning, UniReason-Med learns to generate grounded reasoning traces without IoU/Dice-based localization rewards during RL. Data-mixture and component ablations show that joint 2D+3D grounded supervision substantially improves 3D reasoning over 3D-only training, while grounding and region-token injection consistently benefit both 2D and 3D tasks. These results suggest that a shared grounded reasoning interface can transfer reasoning structure from 2D images to slice-serialized volumetric medical understanding. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/unireason-med.

AI.tldr: 提出UniReason-Med框架，利用2D医学图像的接地推理监督提升3D医学VQA性能，通过共享推理接口（边界框语法、区域标记注入、接地推理策略）统一处理2D图像和切片序列化3D体积，并构建220K指令微调数据集UniMed-CoT，结合监督微调与结果级强化学习实现无需IoU/Dice奖励的接地推理生成。
AI.motivation: 探索是否可以利用丰富的2D医学图像中的接地推理监督来提升3D医学视觉问答的性能，当两种输入类型通过共同的推理接口对齐时。
AI.method: 提出UniReason-Med单检查点框架，推理时统一处理2D图像或切片序列化3D体积，通过共享边界框语法、区域标记注入和共同接地推理策略生成交织的文本推理和定位视觉证据。构建包含170K 2D和50K 3D样本的220K指令微调数据集UniMed-CoT，采用监督微调+结果级强化学习训练，无需IoU/Dice定位奖励。
AI.result: 联合2D+3D接地监督显著提升3D推理性能优于纯3D训练；接地和区域标记注入同时有益于2D和3D任务。
AI.conclusion: 共享的接地推理接口能够将推理结构从2D图像迁移到切片序列化的体积医学理解中。

title: When is Your LLM Steerable?
summary: Activation steering offers a lightweight approach to control language models' behavior at inference time, but whether it succeeds or fails heavily depends on the prompt, concept, model, and steering configuration. Finding the regime and boundaries of successful steering typically requires expensive grid searches and post-hoc evaluation of full autoregressive rollouts. In this work, we investigate whether steerability can be predicted from the model's internal states at the beginning of the generation process, e.g., after generating the first few tokens, and how to leverage such a predictor to improve steering success rate. To this end, we first introduce ASTEER, a testbed including 1.4M steered generations, spanning 150 concepts with each steering success/failure labeled. Leveraging this testbed, we analyze the model's early decoding dynamics by extracting features that compare hidden states before and after steering across layers and initial decoding steps. These features help us understand how steering's effects propagate along layers and token positions, which provide key information for steerability prediction. We then train a Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDT) classifier on these features to predict whether an intervention will under-steer, succeed, or over-steer without requiring full rollout. Our predictor achieves around 0.7 macro-F1 score on unseen concepts, demonstrating that early hidden states encode substantial, structured information about eventual steering efficacy. We further leverage this steerability predictor as guidance for steering strength searching, achieving near-optimal performance with a small fraction of decoding cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASTEER测试集（含140万次导向生成），通过分析模型早期解码阶段的隐藏状态特征来预测激活导向是否成功，并利用该预测器优化导向强度搜索，在不进行完整生成的情况下实现近最优性能。
AI.motivation: 激活导向的成败高度依赖于提示、概念、模型和配置，而寻找成功导向的参数边界通常需要昂贵的网格搜索和事后评估完整自回归生成结果。本文旨在探究能否从生成过程早期的模型内部状态预测导向性，并利用这种预测器提升导向成功率。
AI.method: 构建ASTEER测试集（140万次导向生成，150个概念，标注成功/失败）；提取早期解码动态特征（对比不同层和初始解码步骤中导向前后的隐藏状态）；训练GBDT分类器预测导向结果（欠导向、成功、过导向）；利用预测器指导导向强度搜索。
AI.result: 在未见概念上达到约0.7的macro-F1分数，表明早期隐藏状态编码了关于导向效果的结构化信息；利用该预测器进行导向强度搜索，以极小解码成本实现近最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 早期隐藏状态蕴含了足够的信号来预测激活导向的最终效果，可大幅降低导向调优的计算成本。

title: From Prompts to Tokens: Internalizing Causal Supervision in Vision-Language Model for Multi-Image Causal Reasoning
summary: Visual causal reasoning is essential for understanding and intervening in the physical world, requiring identification of causal variables from visual inputs and reasoning over intervention effects. Despite recent progress, large vision--language models (VLMs) remain brittle at such tasks, especially for interventional and counterfactual queries over multi-image inputs. Most existing explorations inject causal knowledge via textual prompts, leaving causal mechanisms external to model execution and limiting reliable control during inference. To address this problem, we propose BridgeVLM, which internalizes visual causal reasoning by inducing a causal graph from multi-image inputs and converting it into structured Causal Tokens executed by RAMP layers injected into the LLM decoder for causal message passing. We further introduce a unified training interface M3S for fine-grained causal supervision from different granularities (local/global level). BridgeVLM achieves 54.4% accuracy on intervention tasks on CausalVLBench (vs. 33.2% with prompt-level supervision), improves results on Causal3D from 43.6% to 49.0%, and substantially improves causal structure learning on CausalVLBench ($F_1$: 33.4% $\rightarrow$ 75.1%).

AI.tldr: BridgeVLM通过将多图像输入中的因果图内化为结构化因果令牌（Causal Tokens），并利用RAMP层在LLM解码器中进行因果消息传递，实现了视觉因果推理，在干预任务上准确率从33.2%提升至54.4%，因果结构学习F1分数从33.4%提升至75.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）在视觉因果推理任务（尤其是干预和反事实查询）上表现脆弱，且传统方法通过文本提示注入因果知识，将因果机制置于模型执行外部，限制了推理过程中的可靠控制。
AI.method: 提出BridgeVLM框架：1）从多图像输入中归纳因果图，并将其转化为结构化因果令牌（Causal Tokens）；2）在LLM解码器中注入RAMP层，用于因果消息传递；3）引入统一训练接口M3S，提供不同粒度（局部/全局）的细粒度因果监督。
AI.result: 在CausalVLBench干预任务上准确率达54.4%（提示级监督为33.2%）；Causal3D上从43.6%提升至49.0%；CausalVLBench因果结构学习F1分数从33.4%大幅提升至75.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将因果知识内化为结构化表示并融合进模型解码过程，能有效提升VLM在视觉因果推理任务上的表现，尤其在干预推理和因果结构学习方面效果显著。

title: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Adaptive Worker Allocation for Stance Detection
summary:
Stance detection requires identifying an author's position toward a target, often from short-form texts where stance is implicit, indirect, or rhetorically framed. Although large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on this task, single-pass prompting can be brittle when multiple interpretations are plausible. Existing aggregation strategies, such as majority voting or self-consistency, improve robustness by combining labels, but they discard the intermediate reasoning needed to resolve conflicting interpretations.
  We introduce a multi-agent reasoning framework with adaptive worker allocation for stance detection that shifts aggregation from label-level voting to reasoning-level synthesis. The framework employs a Manager-Worker architecture in which a Manager adaptively allocates a variable number of Worker agents based on input complexity. Each Worker analyzes the input from a distinct perspective and produces a reasoning-only explanation without emitting a stance label; the Manager then synthesizes these explanations to produce the final prediction.
  We evaluate the proposed framework on SemEval-2016, P-Stance, and COVID-19 Stance using Llama, Mistral, and Gemini. Results show that the framework yields the largest gains on implicit and context-dependent stance cases, achieving 86.07 Macro-F1 on COVID-19 and 82.90 on SemEval-2016, while remaining competitive on more explicit stance datasets such as P-Stance. These findings suggest that adaptive reasoning-level aggregation is most beneficial when stance cannot be reliably inferred from surface cues alone.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多智能体推理框架的自适应工人分配方法，用于立场检测。该框架采用Manager-Worker架构，Manager根据输入复杂度动态分配Worker数量，每个Worker从不同视角进行推理而不输出立场标签，最后由Manager整合推理过程生成最终预测。在SemEval-2016、P-Stance和COVID-19 Stance数据集上，使用Llama、Mistral和Gemini评估，在隐式和上下文依赖的立场检测上取得显著提升（COVID-19: 86.07 Macro-F1, SemEval-2016: 82.90），在显式立场数据集上也具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在立场检测中单次提示存在多义性脆弱问题，而多数投票或自一致性等聚合策略虽提升鲁棒性，但丢弃了解决冲突解释所需的中间推理过程。
AI.method: 提出Manager-Worker多智能体推理框架：Manager根据输入复杂度自适应分配Worker数量，每个Worker从不同视角进行仅推理的思考过程（不输出立场标签），Manager整合所有推理合成最终预测。
AI.result: 在隐式和上下文依赖的立场检测上增益最大，COVID-19达到86.07 Macro-F1，SemEval-2016达到82.90 Macro-F1；在显式立场数据集P-Stance上也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应推理级聚合在立场无法仅从表层线索可靠推断时最为有效，表明推理链的合成优于标签级投票。

title: AnchorEdit: Maintaining Temporal Consistency in Multi-turn Image Editing via Causal Memory
summary: Multi-turn image editing is essential for iterative design, yet current models often struggle with identity drift and error accumulation over successive steps. While existing research leverages video priors for consistency, their reliance on bidirectional attention is fundamentally misaligned with the causal, sequential nature of interactive editing. In this paper, we propose AnchorEdit, the first autoregressive (AR) diffusion-based framework designed specifically for high-resolution, long-term multi-turn editing. AnchorEdit bridges the gap between video priors and causal inference through a three-stage training curriculum: identity-preserving sing-turn pretraining, causal AR forcing fine-tuning with a novel self-rollout strategy to mitigate exposure bias, and consistency distillation for efficient 4-step generation. During inference, we introduce a memory mechanism to anchor the initial subject identity and ensure stable extrapolation across extended editing trajectories. To evaluate performance, we provide a new high-resolution multi-turn editing benchmark designed to stress-test long-horizon stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnchorEdit achieves state-of-the-art results, maintaining exceptional subject fidelity and instruction following even over 10+ interaction rounds.

AI.tldr: AnchorEdit是一种自回归扩散框架，通过三阶段训练课程和记忆机制，在10轮以上的多轮图像编辑中实现了高分辨率、身份保持和指令跟随的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮图像编辑模型在连续编辑中面临身份漂移和错误累积问题，而基于视频先验的方法依赖双向注意力机制，与交互式编辑的因果序列本质不匹配。
AI.method: 提出AnchorEdit框架，包含：(1) 三阶段训练：身份保持单轮预训练、因果自回归强制微调（含自展开策略缓解暴露偏差）、一致性蒸馏实现4步生成；(2) 推理时引入记忆机制锚定初始主体身份；(3) 提供高分辨率多轮编辑基准。
AI.result: 在10轮以上的编辑轨迹中，AnchorEdit在主体保真度和指令跟随方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 自回归扩散框架结合因果推理与身份记忆机制，有效解决了多轮图像编辑中的身份漂移和错误累积，为长期交互式编辑提供了新范式。

title: Evaluating Bias in Phoneme-Based Automatic Speech Recognition Systems: An Analysis of IPA Transcription Models
summary: The popularization of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems has increased exploration of the demographic biases related to race, age, gender, and accent, often formed from imbalanced training data. Most of these studies focused on standard grapheme-based ASR systems with comparatively little emphasis on phoneme-based systems, such as models that produce International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) representations. As ASR systems shift toward multilingual support and low-resource language modeling, IPA-based layers serve as a critical, language-agnostic foundation. In this study, we evaluate the performance of two state-of-the-art open-source ASR systems, WhisperIPA and ZIPA, that generate IPA transcriptions across diverse accents and language sources. Our evaluation includes existing multilingual speech corpora and demographically annotated English-language corpora. We measure model performance by comparing model-generated IPA transcriptions against grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) systems using both standard phoneme error rate (PER) and a proposed Soft PER metric that tolerates linguistically similar phoneme substitutions. Our analysis examines how performance varies across languages and demographic groups such as gender, accent, ethnicity, and age, revealing persistent disparities even after accounting for acceptable phonemic variation. These findings provide insight into potential sources of bias and inform the development of more inclusive and linguistically robust phoneme-based ASR systems. Our code and data will be made publicly available to the community.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了WhisperIPA和ZIPA两个开源IPA音素ASR系统在多语言和多样化人口群体上的性能，提出了Soft PER指标，发现即使考虑可接受的音素变异，系统在不同语言和人口群体（性别、口音、种族、年龄）间仍存在持续性性能差异和偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR偏差研究主要集中于基于字素的系统，对基于音素（IPA）的ASR系统关注不足。随着ASR向多语言和低资源语言支持发展，IPA作为语言无关基础层变得关键，因此需要系统评估IPA-based ASR系统在不同语言和人口群体中的性能差异与偏差。
AI.method: 使用WhisperIPA和ZIPA两个开源ASR系统，在多语言语音语料库和带人口统计标注的英语语料库上进行评估；提出Soft PER指标以容忍语言学上相似音素替换；通过比较模型生成的IPA转录与G2P系统的结果，分析在不同语言、性别、口音、种族和年龄群体上的性能差异。
AI.result: 即使在考虑可接受音素变异后，WhisperIPA和ZIPA在不同语言和人口群体（性别、口音、种族、年龄）间仍表现出持续性的性能差异和偏差，揭示了IPA-based ASR系统中的持久性人口统计偏见。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了音素级ASR系统中存在的偏见来源，为开发更包容和语言学上更鲁棒的音素级ASR系统提供了重要见解。

title: Battery detection of XRay images using transfer learning
comment: Published at the European Symposium on Artificial Neural Networks (ESANN 2022)
summary: The need for detecting and sorting batteries is drastically increasing for many applications. This study proves the potential of transfer learning in predicting whether the image contains a battery or not, the location and identifying three types of batteries, namely: prismatic, pouch, and cylindrical Lithium-Ion Batteries (LIB). Particularly, it focuses on the transfer learning method in two applications: Training a large-scale dataset to detect electronic devices using a pre-trained YOLOv5m, then using these latter trained weights to detect and classify the batteries. The precision of battery detection achieves 94%, which outperforms the pretrained YOLOv5m weights with 5%, in 22 ms inference time.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明了迁移学习在电池检测与分类中的潜力，通过预训练的YOLOv5m模型，实现了94%的检测精度（提升5%）和22ms的推理时间，能够识别电池有无、位置及三种类型（棱柱形、软包、圆柱形锂离子电池）。
AI.motivation: 许多应用对电池检测和分类的需求急剧增加，需要更高效准确的方法。
AI.method: 采用迁移学习方法，先在大规模电子设备数据集上预训练YOLOv5m，再将训练好的权重迁移用于电池的检测和分类任务。
AI.result: 电池检测精度达到94%，相比直接使用预训练YOLOv5m权重提升了5%，推理时间为22ms。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习在电池检测与分类任务中具有显著潜力，能够有效提升检测精度和效率。

title: Improving Cross-Format Robustness in Language Models with Multi-Format Training
summary: Large language models often remain sensitive to answer format: a question solved correctly in one form may fail in another semantically equivalent form. To study this gap, we define cross-format robustness as the extent to which a model answers the same underlying question consistently across formats. We then compare full-format training with FormatMix, which expands only a subset of training items into multiple equivalent formats using either random or targeted selection. Across GLM4 and Llama-3.1, multi-format supervision consistently improves both task performance and cross-format robustness, whereas Multiple-choice question (MCQ)-only supervision alone brings little benefit and can even reduce robustness. We further find that expanding only about 30% of the training set into multiple formats often recovers most of the gain from full-format training, and this effect appears across the model families and sizes we study. These results suggest that format diversity, rather than additional supervision alone, is the key driver of robustness. That lightweight multi-format augmentation is a practical way to make LLMs less sensitive to answer format without changing the base model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型对答案格式的敏感性，提出了跨格式鲁棒性的概念，并通过FormatMix方法证明了格式多样性（而非额外监督）是提升鲁棒性的关键，仅需扩展约30%的训练数据为多格式即可获得大部分收益。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型常对答案格式敏感，同一问题不同格式可能导致不同结果，影响模型可靠性，因此需要研究如何提升模型在不同格式间的一致性。
AI.method: 定义跨格式鲁棒性指标，提出FormatMix方法——将部分训练样本扩展为多种等价格式（随机或定向选择），并与全格式训练及仅MCQ训练进行对比，在GLM4和Llama-3.1系列模型上验证。
AI.result: 多格式监督一致提升任务性能和跨格式鲁棒性；仅MCQ监督收益甚微甚至降低鲁棒性；扩展约30%训练集为多格式即可恢复全格式训练的大部分增益，且该效果跨模型系列和规模一致。
AI.conclusion: 格式多样性是提升鲁棒性的关键驱动因素，轻量级多格式增强（FormatMix）是一种实用的、无需修改基座模型即可降低LLM对答案格式敏感性的方法。

title: Seeing What Matters: Perceptual Wrapper with Common Randomness for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves impressive real-time rendering, it frequently struggles to synthesize high-frequency textures, a limitation heavily exacerbated in memory-constrained and rate-distortion-optimized (RDO) pipelines. To address this, we propose a versatile 2D perceptual wrapper that enhances the rendered outputs of existing 3DGS representations in a content- and view-dependent manner. Our method leverages a lightweight synthesis network conditioned on pseudo-random Gaussian noise to synthesize perceptually plausible textures. Supervised by Wasserstein Distortion, the network learns to match local feature statistics rather than strictly enforcing pixel-wise reconstruction fidelity, effectively mitigating the blurriness inherent in standard frameworks. We demonstrate the broad applicability of our plug-and-play approach across vanilla, memory-constrained, and RDO 3DGS methods. Comprehensive subjective and objective experiments confirm that our method significantly improves over existing baselines, yielding superior perceptual quality at sharply reduced file or model sizes.

AI.tldr: 针对3DGS在内存受限和率失真优化管道中难以合成高频纹理的问题，提出一种轻量级2D感知包装器，利用条件高斯噪声和Wasserstein距离监督，以内容与视图相关的方式增强现有3DGS表示的渲染输出，显著提升感知质量并减小模型尺寸。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽然在实时渲染中表现出色，但在合成高频纹理方面存在不足，尤其是在内存受限和率失真优化场景下这一问题更加严重。
AI.method: 提出一种即插即用的2D感知包装器：1) 轻量级合成网络以伪随机高斯噪声为条件输入；2) 采用Wasserstein距离作为损失函数监督训练，匹配局部特征统计而非逐像素重建；3) 以内容与视图相关的方式增强渲染输出。
AI.result: 在原始、内存受限和RDO三种3DGS方法上均适用，主观和客观实验均优于现有基线，在显著减小文件/模型大小的同时实现了更优的感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法是一种通用且有效的即插即用方案，能够从根本上缓解3DGS框架中的模糊问题，在感知质量与存储效率之间取得更好的平衡。

title: Can AI Reason Like an Urban Planner? Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Professional Judgment
summary:
Problem, Research Strategy, and Findings: The rise of large language models (LLMs) raises a key question for urban planning: which forms of professional planning knowledge can AI replicate, and which still require human judgment? Although AI tools are increasingly used in planning practice, there is still no systematic framework for testing whether they can reason with the contextual sensitivity, value awareness, and institutional literacy central to planning expertise. This paper introduces Urban Planning Bench (UPBench), a domain-specific evaluation framework that assesses LLM reasoning through a 4x5 matrix of four knowledge pillars and five cognitive levels adapted from Bloom's revised taxonomy. Evaluating 25 LLMs with automated scoring and expert review, we find a non-monotonic cognitive curve: models perform better on higher-order analytical tasks than on factual recall and integrative judgment. This suggests that planning knowledge often treated as lower-order is deeply shaped by institutional, jurisdictional, and temporal context, making it hard for LLMs to generalize. We summarize these limits as four epistemic diagnostics: regulatory hallucination, conceptual conflation, wickedness paralysis, and phronetic deficit.
  Takeaway for Practice: The findings support differential delegation in planning. LLMs can assist with cross-disciplinary synthesis, literature review, scenario generation, and preliminary policy analysis. However, they remain unreliable for jurisdiction-specific regulation, normative conflict resolution, and context-sensitive procedure. Agencies should require verification for AI-assisted regulatory analysis, while planning education should emphasize institutional literacy, normative judgment, and contextual sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Urban Planning Bench (UPBench)框架，通过4×5矩阵评估25个LLM在规划专业知识上的推理能力，发现模型在高阶分析任务上表现优于事实回忆和整合判断，揭示了LLM在规划领域的四项认知缺陷：监管幻觉、概念混淆、wicked问题瘫痪和实践智慧缺陷。
AI.motivation: LLM在规划实践中应用日益广泛，但缺乏系统性框架来评估其是否能像人类规划专家一样进行具备情境敏感性、价值意识和制度素养的推理，因此需要构建专门的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建UPBench框架，采用4大知识支柱（知识类型）和5个认知层级（基于Bloom修订分类学）组成的4×5评估矩阵，对25个LLM进行自动评分和专家评审相结合的方式评估其规划推理能力。
AI.result: 发现了非单调认知曲线：LLM在高阶分析任务上表现优于事实回忆和整合判断；识别出四项认知缺陷：监管幻觉、概念混淆、wicked问题瘫痪和实践智慧缺陷。
AI.conclusion: LLM可辅助跨学科综合、文献综述、情景生成和初步政策分析，但在辖区特定法规、规范冲突解决和情境敏感程序方面不可靠；建议对AI辅助监管分析进行验证，规划教育应强调制度素养、规范判断和情境敏感性。

title: A Comprehensive Ecosystem for Open-Domain Customized Video Generation
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted by ICASSP 2026
summary: Recent progress in video generation has shown impressive visual synthesis capabilities. However, open-domain customized video generation remains limited by the lack of large-scale, annotated datasets capturing diverse identity-specific attributes. To address this, we introduce PexelsCustom-1M, the first publicly available million-scale dataset for identity-preserving video generation, containing one million curated <identity, text, video> triplets across 8,000+ categories. Leveraging this, we propose CustoMDiT, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a pretrained multimodal Diffusion Transformer into a customized video generator with only 8% additional learnable parameters. Our method surpasses prior state-of-the-art. However, benchmarks such as DreamBooth cover only 100 classes, which is insufficient for real-world applications. To overcome this, we construct OpenCustom, a new benchmark with 1,000+ categories, created via cross-dataset knowledge fusion from ImageNet and MS-COCO. Extensive experiments confirm the advantages of both our dataset and model. We will open-source the entire ecosystem--including dataset, pipeline, benchmark, and implementations--to support further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个百万级身份保持视频生成数据集PexelsCustom-1M（包含100万个<身份,文本,视频>三元组，覆盖8000+类别），并基于多模态扩散Transformer设计了参数高效框架CustoMDiT（仅增加8%可学习参数），同时构建了含1000+类别的OpenCustom基准，全面超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 开放域定制化视频生成受限于缺乏大规模、带标注的身份特定属性数据集；现有基准（如DreamBooth）仅覆盖100个类别，远不足以支撑真实应用场景。
AI.method: 1) 构建PexelsCustom-1M数据集，包含百万级<身份,文本,视频>三元组；2) 提出CustoMDiT框架，通过参数高效方式适配预训练多模态扩散Transformer用于定制化视频生成（仅8%额外参数）；3) 构建OpenCustom基准，通过ImageNet和MS-COCO的跨数据集知识融合获得1000+类别。
AI.result: CustoMDiT在定制化视频生成任务上超越先前最佳方法；OpenCustom基准以1000+类别显著扩展了原有评估范围（DreamBooth仅100类）。
AI.conclusion: 大规模数据集和参数高效框架能有效提升开放域定制化视频生成性能；作者将开源整个生态系统（数据集、流程、基准和实现）以推动后续研究。

title: UR-BERT: Scaling Text Encoders for Massively Multilingual TTS Through Universal Romanization and Speech Token Prediction
summary: We propose UR-BERT, a Romanized transcription-based text-to-speech (TTS) encoder for massively multilingual TTS systems. Conventional grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P)-based approaches are limited to around 100 languages due to the availability of reliable G2P resources. In contrast, UR-BERT scales to 495 languages by unifying diverse writing systems into a shared Romanization representation. To further enhance phonetic fidelity and text-speech alignment, we introduce a speech token prediction objective during training, which encourages the encoder to learn speech-aware phonetic representations in a data-efficient manner. Experiments show that TTS systems built on UR-BERT consistently outperform recent text encoder baselines across a wide range of languages and resource conditions, and demonstrate strong generalization to unseen languages.

AI.tldr: UR-BERT是一种基于罗马化转录的多语言TTS编码器，通过统一书写系统为共享罗马化表示，将支持语言扩展到495种，并引入语音令牌预测目标提升音素保真度，在多种语言和资源条件下优于现有基线，并展现出对未见语言的强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于字素到音素（G2P）的多语言TTS方法受限于可靠G2P资源的可用性，最多仅支持约100种语言，亟需一种能扩展到更多语言的高效文本编码方法。
AI.method: 提出UR-BERT编码器，将不同书写系统统一转换为共享的罗马化表示，实现495种语言的支持；同时引入语音令牌预测（speech token prediction）训练目标，使编码器以数据高效的方式学习语音感知的语音表示。
AI.result: 基于UR-BERT构建的TTS系统在多种语言和资源条件下一致优于最新的文本编码基线，并展现出对未见语言的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: UR-BERT通过罗马化统一表示和语音感知预训练目标，有效突破了G2P方法在语言覆盖范围上的瓶颈，为大规模多语言TTS系统提供了可扩展且性能优越的文本编码方案。

title: MultiToP: Learning to Patch Visual Tokens to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
summary: Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet they remain prone to hallucinations, where generated responses are not faithfully supported by the input video. In this paper, we propose MultiToP, a multimodal-context-aware visual token patching framework that mitigates hallucinations by refining unreliable visual tokens before language generation. MultiToP introduces a lightweight Visual Token Patcher to predict token-level replacement distributions and selectively substitute unreliable visual tokens with a dynamic global patch token. To train the patcher effectively, we further propose information-guided rank calibration, which uses answer-conditioned frame-level information cues derived from the backbone to guide token replacement. Combined with ground-truth answer supervision and sparsity regularization, MultiToP enables localized visual evidence refinement without modifying the original model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MultiToP effectively reduces hallucinations on Vript-HAL with negligible inference overhead, improving the F1 scores of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct by 50.60% over the vanilla model. Meanwhile, MultiToP preserves general video understanding ability, yielding an 18.58% relative accuracy gain on ActivityNet-QA for Video-LLaVA-7B.

AI.tldr: 提出MultiToP框架，通过视觉token修补模块在语言生成前替换不可靠的视觉token，结合信息引导排序校准来减少视频多模态大模型的幻觉问题，在多个基准测试上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 视频多模态大模型虽然取得了显著进展，但仍然容易出现幻觉现象，即生成的响应无法被输入视频忠实支持，影响模型的可信度和实用性。
AI.method: 提出MultiToP框架：1）轻量级视觉token修补器，预测token级替换分布并用动态全局补丁token选择性替换不可靠的视觉token；2）信息引导排序校准，利用基于答案的帧级信息线索指导token替换；3）结合真实答案监督和稀疏正则化训练修补器，无需修改原始模型即可实现局部视觉证据精炼。
AI.result: 在Vript-HAL上有效减少幻觉，Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的F1分数相比原始模型提升50.60%；在ActivityNet-QA上Video-LLaVA-7B的准确率相对提升18.58%，且推理开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: MultiToP通过多模态上下文感知的视觉token修补，在几乎不增加推理负担的情况下有效缓解视频理解中的幻觉问题，同时保持通用视频理解能力。

title: Layer-Isolated Evaluation: Gating the Deterministic Scaffold of a Production LLM Agent with a No-LLM, Regression-Locked Test Harness
summary: End-to-end task-success is the dominant way to evaluate LLM agents, but one aggregate number tells you that an agent regressed, not where. We present layer-isolated evaluation: a deployed ordering agent is decomposed into a fixed taxonomy of layers (ontology, intent, routing, decomposition, escalation, safety, memory, and cross-cutting envelope/defense), each exercised by its own assertion slice in a deterministic, no-LLM "pure" mode. The pure suite (238 cases across 23 slices; 225 run in 2.39 s, ~10 ms/case) runs in CI on every change against a locked per-slice baseline. We validate by controlled regression injection, degrading one layer at a time across seven non-safety layers. The effect we did not design in is masking: the aggregate pass-rate barely moves (-1.7 to -5.9 pp for six local regressions), while the matching slice craters (-25 to -91 pp). A layer's slice reacting to its own fault is partly by construction; the measured results are (i) the aggregate masking and (ii) that damage stays off the other slices: the injected layer's slice is the single worst-hit in 5 of 7 cases and top-3 in 7 of 7 (mean rank 1.29 of 19). Localization replicates on a second, structurally different tenant (Starbucks SG): all seven matching slices crater, so it is not a single-catalog artifact. We position it as a concrete, deterministic instantiation of the component-level evaluation EDDOps prescribes but leaves unimplemented, with CheckList as ancestor and as the deterministic mirror image of whole-workflow stochastic mutation testing. Our contributions: (a) a fully decomposed, sub-second, no-LLM per-layer harness for a production agent, (b) a coverage-honesty test-adequacy criterion that refuses to score an unexercised layer, and (c) the regression-injection demonstration that per-slice baseline-locked gates localize regressions an aggregate metric masks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层隔离评估方法，将LLM智能体分解为固定分层（本体、意图、路由、分解、升级、安全、记忆、跨切面包络/防御），每层有独立的确定性无LLM纯模式断言切片。238个案例在2.39秒内完成，可检测聚合指标掩盖的分层回归。
AI.motivation: 端到端任务成功率作为LLM智能体的评估指标只能给出聚合数字，无法定位问题所在层级，存在回归掩盖问题。
AI.method: 将生产级订购智能体按固定分类法分解为8层，每层构建独立确定性断言切片（无LLM纯模式），共23个切片238个案例。在CI中运行并锁定每层基线；通过控制性回归注入验证（逐层退化7个非安全层）。
AI.result: 聚合通过率仅下降1.7-5.9个百分点（6个局部回归），而匹配切片下降25-91个百分点。注入层的切片在5/7案例中是唯一最严重命中，7/7案例中排前三（平均排名1.29/19）。在第二个租户（星巴克SG）上复现。
AI.conclusion: 层隔离评估是一种确定性的、亚秒级的生产智能体组件级评估方法，能够暴露聚合指标掩盖的回归问题，填补了EDDOps框架中组件级评估的具体实现空白。

title: TextHOI-3D: Text-to-3D Hand-Object Interaction via Discrete Multi-View Generation and Joint Mesh Optimization
summary: Text-conditioned 3D generation has progressed rapidly for images and isolated objects, but producing a hand-object mesh remains challenging: the output must preserve language semantics, cross-view consistency, object geometry, articulated hand shape, and physically plausible contact. We present TextHOI-3D, a staged framework that uses generated multi-view observations as an explicit interface between text-conditioned visual generation and geometry-aware hand-object recovery. TextHOI-3D learns a compact VQ token space for fixed-camera hand-object observations, predicts multi-view visual tokens from text with a CLIP-conditioned visual autoregressive model, and recovers a unified hand-object mesh through prior initialization, multi-view joint optimization, and anti-penetration refinement. The design separates semantic generation from geometric recovery while keeping both stages connected by a discrete multi-view representation. On HO3D-derived evaluations, the multi-view setting reduces object CD from 17.26 mm to 4.92 mm and penetration volume from 5.3721 cm^3 to 0.2193 cm^3 compared with a single-view counterpart, while improving hand errors and surface F-scores. These results support multi-view visual tokens as an effective intermediate representation for text-driven 3D hand-object mesh creation.

AI.tldr: TextHOI-3D提出了一种分阶段框架，利用生成的多视图观测作为文本条件视觉生成与几何感知手物恢复之间的显式接口，通过VQ token空间、CLIP条件视觉自回归模型和多视图联合优化，实现从文本到手物交互网格的生成，显著降低了物体倒角距离和穿透体积。
AI.motivation: 文本条件3D生成在图像和孤立物体方面进展迅速，但生成手物交互网格仍具挑战性：输出需同时保留语言语义、跨视图一致性、物体几何、手部形状及物理合理的接触。现有方法难以兼顾这些要求。
AI.method: 1) 学习紧凑的VQ token空间用于固定相机手物观测；2) 使用CLIP条件视觉自回归模型从文本预测多视图视觉token；3) 通过先验初始化、多视图联合优化和抗穿透细化恢复统一的手物交互网格。该方法将语义生成与几何恢复分离，并通过离散多视图表示保持两阶段连接。
AI.result: 在HO3D衍生评估中，多视图设置相较单视图，物体倒角距离从17.26mm降至4.92mm，穿透体积从5.3721cm³降至0.2193cm³，同时手部误差和表面F分数均有改善。
AI.conclusion: 多视图视觉token作为文本驱动3D手物网格创建的有效中间表示，支持了该方法相较于单视图基线的显著优势。

title: Goal-Autopilot: A Verifiable Anti-Fabrication Firewall for Unattended Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents are not trusted to run unattended: with no human watching, they confidently report success they never verified. We treat honesty -- bounding what an agent may claim at termination -- as a first-class metric for unattended autonomy, distinct from capability. We present Autopilot, an execution model that makes silent fabricated success structurally impossible rather than merely rarer. Autopilot externalizes all working state into a durable, gated finite-state machine that a scheduler advances one stateless tick at a time; a hard floor forbids any terminal "done" claim whose falsifiable gate did not actually execute and pass. We prove a No-False-Success theorem -- under gate soundness, floor enforcement, and plan coverage, termination implies the goal holds -- whose only trust points are empirically measurable, and show the worst case degrades to an honest stall, never a fabricated success. Because each tick rehydrates only the state machine, per-step context cost is constant in the horizon. Across a 3,150-cell paired corpus (70 tasks $\times$ 3 systems $\times$ 3 models $\times$ 5 seeds, including 50 SWE-bench Lite tasks across 11 OSS repos), Autopilot fabricates on 0.95% of cells [95% CI 0.38--1.62] while Reflexion and StateFlow baselines fabricate on 8.10% [6.48--9.81] and 25.05% [22.48--27.62] respectively. The headline contrast lives in the hard regime: on SWE-bench Lite, the firewall reduces fabrication from 33.7% (StateFlow) to 0.67%, a paired difference of $-33.07$ pp [95% CI $-36.53, -29.73$]. The mechanism is the gate, not the model: all ten Autopilot fabrications come from the strongest model, while two weaker mid-tier models never fabricate across 700 paired cells. The firewall trades coverage for honesty by design -- an honest stall is recoverable; a confident wrong output shipped downstream is not.

AI.tldr: 提出Autopilot执行模型，通过将工作状态外部化为耐久门控有限状态机，使LLM代理无法虚假报告成功。实验表明，该模型将虚假成功率从基线方法的8.10%-25.05%降至0.95%，在SWE-bench Lite上从33.7%降至0.67%，且最坏情况退化为诚实停滞而非虚假成功。
AI.motivation: 长程LLM代理在无人监督时不可信：它们会在未验证的情况下自信报告成功。现有方法仅降低虚假成功率，但无法从根本上阻止虚假报告。需要一种结构性的方法，使虚假成功在架构上不可能发生，而非仅仅更罕见。
AI.method: 提出Autopilot执行模型：(1) 将所有工作状态外部化到耐久门控有限状态机中；(2) 调度器以无状态tick推进状态机；(3) 硬性floor禁止"done"声明，除非其可证伪的门实际执行并通过。理论上证明No-False-Success定理，依赖三个可实证测量的信任点：门控正确性、floor强制、计划覆盖。
AI.result: 在3,150单元配对语料（70任务×3系统×3模型×5种子，含50个SWE-bench Lite任务）上，Autopilot虚假率0.95% [95% CI 0.38-1.62]，Reflexion为8.10% [6.48-9.81]，StateFlow为25.05% [22.48-27.62]。SWE-bench Lite上从33.7%降至0.67%，差异-33.07 pp。所有10例虚假来自最强模型，较弱的两模型在700单元中无一虚假。每步上下文成本在时间跨度上恒定。
AI.conclusion: Autopilot通过架构设计实现了诚实保障与能力（规划覆盖）之间的可控权衡。防火墙以覆盖换取诚实：诚实停滞可恢复，而虚假输出一旦下游传播不可挽回。该方法将信任点缩小到三个可实证测量的维度，而非依赖模型行为。

title: LASA: A Weak Supervision Method for Open-Vocabulary Scene Sketch Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary scene sketch semantic segmentation aims to assign dense semantic labels to sparse line drawings based on flexible category vocabularies specified at inference time, without relying on pixel-level annotations during training. Unlike natural images, sketches lack texture and color cues, making semantic understanding heavily dependent on stroke layout and spatial configuration, a challenge that renders single-layer vision-language features inherently unstable. Our key observation is that attention maps from different Vision Transformer layers encode complementary spatial cues: shallow layers capture global structural layouts, while deeper layers focus on local stroke intersections and object parts. This suggests that cross-layer aggregation provides a more robust structural prior than any individual layer alone. Leveraging this insight, we propose a structure-aware framework built upon \textbf{L}ayer-wise \textbf{A}ccumulated \textbf{S}tructural \textbf{A}ttention (\textbf{LASA}), which aggregates multi-layer attention to guide hierarchical semantic alignment under weak supervision and refine predictions during inference. Experiments on FS-COCO, SFSD, and FrISS show that LASA improves mIoU by $+3.43$, $+8.01$, and $+15.74$ over the prior weakly supervised baselines, demonstrating consistent gains in both segmentation accuracy and spatial coherence. Our source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LASA框架，通过聚合Vision Transformer多层注意力图（浅层捕获全局结构，深层聚焦局部细节），实现弱监督下的开放词汇场景草图语义分割，在三个数据集上分别提升mIoU 3.43、8.01和15.74。
AI.motivation: 草图缺乏纹理和颜色线索，语义理解高度依赖笔触布局和空间配置；单层视觉-语言特征因缺乏结构先验而不稳定，导致开放词汇草图语义分割性能受限。
AI.method: 提出LASA（Layer-wise Accumulated Structural Attention）框架，聚合ViT不同层的注意力图——浅层提供全局结构布局，深层聚焦局部笔触交叉与物体部件，以跨层累积的结构先验引导层级化语义对齐，在弱监督下训练并在推理时细化预测。
AI.result: 在FS-COCO、SFSD、FrISS数据集上，相比弱监督基线，mIoU分别提升+3.43、+8.01、+15.74。
AI.conclusion: 跨层注意力聚合能为草图语义分割提供更稳健的结构先验，LASA在分割精度和空间连贯性上均实现持续提升。

title: Substrate Asymmetry in User-Side Memory: A Diagnostic Framework
summary: User-side memory in LLMs is typically scored as a single "personalization" capability: given a user's history, is the output more user-aware? We show this aggregate metric hides opposite-direction failures. Memory factorises into at least three orthogonal axes -- behavioral consistency (style, voice), factual presence (recall facts in history), and factual absence (abstain when a fact is absent) -- and no single substrate wins all three. Comparing per-user gamma-LoRA (a small LoRA adapter trained on each user's history; gamma denotes per-user, not per-task) against BGE-large dense top-K retrieval on a controlled 50-user synthetic corpus and a real-data probe (LaMP-3), we find gamma-LoRA decisively wins behavioral style while RAG decisively wins factual absence -- and the same query-projection cells in attention layers 21-35 causally load-bear both effects in opposite directions (zeroing those LoRA weights raises absence-probe TPR by +33 pp and drops presence-probe TPR by 20 pp). On the more heavily RLHF-tuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct the asymmetry strengthens, not heals: parametric memory's behavioral advantage collapses while its absence-calibration deficit against retrieval widens -- an alignment tax on parametric user-memory. On real-data LaMP-3, gamma-LoRA underperforms a majority baseline; a 9-condition mitigation sweep diagnoses this as instruction-following collapse, not substrate failure (a 9x2 cross-product shows the eval-time {1..5} logit mask drives main_acc to >=0.995 on every recipe), and the best training-time fix replicates bit-identically on Llama. Finally, substrate-selection routing is question-classification, not calibration: a 110M DistilBERT on the question text alone beats every logit-based router. We contribute the diagnostic framework, the diagnosed real-data negative, the alignment-tax replication, and the routing-as-classification finding.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM中的用户侧记忆并非单一能力，而是可分解为行为一致性、事实存在和事实缺失三个正交维度。通过对比per-user gamma-LoRA与RAG检索发现，LoRA在行为风格上占优，RAG在事实缺失上占优，且它们在注意力层共享相同的查询投影单元但作用方向相反。RLHF对齐加剧了这种不对称性，在真实数据LaMP-3上gamma-LoRA表现不如多数基线。路由选择本质上是问题分类问题，而非校准问题。
AI.motivation: 传统上将LLM中的用户侧记忆视为单一的"个性化"能力，这种聚合指标掩盖了不同方向上的失败模式。作者希望揭示用户记忆的不同维度及其权衡关系。
AI.method: 使用50用户合成语料库和LaMP-3真实数据，对比per-user gamma-LoRA（每个用户单独训练的LoRA适配器）与BGE-large稠密top-K检索（RAG）。通过因果干预（归零LoRA权重）分析注意力层的作用。在9种条件下进行缓解实验。使用110M DistilBERT进行路由分类。
AI.result: gamma-LoRA在行为风格上完胜，RAG在事实缺失上完胜；注意力层21-35的查询投影单元在两者中起作用但方向相反；归零LoRA权重使缺失探测TPR提高33pp，同时使存在探测TPR下降20pp；RLHF增强而非修复这种不对称性；LaMP-3上gamma-LoRA不如多数基线，原因是指令跟随崩溃而非子方法失败；路由本质上是问题分类问题。
AI.conclusion: 用户侧记忆是多维度的，不同方法在不同维度上有根本性权衡；RLHF对齐会加剧参数量化记忆的行为优势崩溃和缺失校准缺陷；路由应视为分类问题而非校准问题。

title: Plan-and-Verify Video Reward Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Scene Graph Grounding
summary: Reward models for text-to-video (T2V) generation guide post-training but often fail at fine-grained semantic alignment. We trace this to two structural weaknesses in existing reasoning-based reward models: they do not systematically verify every condition described in the prompt, and the visual evidence supporting each judgment remains implicit in their free-form reasoning. We propose SG-PVR, a video reward model that addresses these limitations through plan-and-verify reasoning grounded in spatio-temporal scene graphs. The verification plan decomposes the prompt into atomic claims, ensuring every requirement is checked. The spatio-temporal scene graph, encoding entities, attributes, and temporally-grounded relations, is extracted from the video and maintained as a persistent structured visual reference throughout reasoning. Each claim is verified against both the video and the scene graph, anchoring judgments in explicit visual evidence. SG-PVR achieves strong performance on semantic alignment, including fine-grained temporal semantics. As a test-time reranker, it further enhances compositional alignment in T2V generation.

AI.tldr: SG-PVR 提出基于时空场景图的计划-验证视频奖励模型，通过将提示分解为原子性声明并借助结构化视觉参考进行细粒度语义对齐，在 T2V 生成中显著提升时序语义和组合对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2V 奖励模型在细粒度语义对齐上表现不佳，根本原因在于：1）缺乏对提示中每个条件的系统性验证；2）自由形式推理中支撑判断的视觉证据不明确。
AI.method: 提出 SG-PVR，采用计划-验证推理框架：先分解提示为原子性声明确保全面覆盖，再从视频中提取时空场景图（包含实体、属性及时序关联）作为持久化结构化视觉参考，每个声明同时基于视频和场景图进行验证。
AI.result: 在语义对齐（包括细粒度时序语义）上取得强性能；作为测试时重排序器，进一步提升了 T2V 生成的组合对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: SG-PVR 通过结构化、可验证的视觉推理有效弥补了现有推理型奖励模型的系统性与可解释性缺陷，为 T2V 生成的后训练对齐提供了更可靠的细粒度评估方案。

title: Hey Chat, Can You Teach Me? Structuring Socratic Dialogue for Human Learning in the Wild
summary: Large language models are now widely used for everyday learning, but the underlying interactions are typically unstructured chats rather than following a curriculum. Unlike formal online learning systems, these interactions carry no prior record of the student, so any estimate of what the student already knows must be inferred from the dialogue itself. We show that this gap is not closed by scaling models alone. Frontier and education-tuned LLMs perform poorly when asked to tutor a student over an extended session, because doing so requires three things at once. The tutor must sequence a curriculum, conduct Socratic dialogue, and infer the student's knowledge state from that dialogue. We propose separating these responsibilities. Given a student query, our system constructs a prerequisite knowledge graph in which subtopics are nodes and dependencies are edges, and frames tutoring as deciding which node to teach next and how many dialogue turns to spend on it before moving on. A lightweight PPO policy handles this sequencing decision, while an LLM conducts the Socratic exchange at the chosen node and returns a signal of student progress. Across held-out STEM and non-STEM topics, our PPO-paired tutor outperforms heuristic baselines, frontier general-purpose models, and a model specialised for Socratic dialogue: on both the rate at which students reach full curriculum mastery and the number of turns required. Explicit curriculum structure delivers gains that scaling the underlying model does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将课程规划与苏格拉底式对话解耦的 tutoring 框架：利用轻量级 PPO 策略在知识图谱上决定教学节点与对话轮次，LLM 负责具体对话执行。该方法在课程掌握率和对话效率上优于纯大模型（包括教育微调模型）和启发式基线，证明显式课程结构比单纯缩放模型更有效。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在非结构化聊天中用于学习时，缺乏对学生知识状态的显式建模和课程规划能力，仅靠模型规模扩展无法弥补这一缺陷。现有模型在长时间辅导中需要同时完成课程排序、苏格拉底式对话和知识状态推断三项任务，表现不佳。
AI.method: 构建前提知识图谱（节点为子主题，边为依赖关系），将辅导任务建模为决定下一个教学节点及其对话轮次的序列决策问题。采用轻量级 PPO 策略进行课程排序决策，LLM 负责在选定节点执行苏格拉底式对话并返回学生进度信号，实现课程规划与对话执行的职责分离。
AI.result: 在 STEM 和非 STEM 保留主题上，PPO 配对的辅导系统在课程完全掌握率和所需对话轮次数量上均优于启发式基线、前沿通用模型以及专门针对苏格拉底式对话微调的模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式课程结构带来的性能提升是单纯缩放底层模型所无法实现的，职责分离的框架是提升 LLM 教学辅导效果的有效路径。

title: Scene-Adaptive Nonlinear Tone Curves for Pseudo Ground-Truth Generation in Low-Light 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Low-light novel view synthesis is challenging because dark multi-view images contain noise, weak structural detail, and compressed dynamic range. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods address these challenges by generating pseudo ground-truth (pseudo-GT) images as supervision targets when paired normal-light references are unavailable. Existing pseudo-GT methods apply a uniform linear gain to all pixels, which clips bright regions while providing insufficient enhancement in dark regions, limiting reconstruction quality. We observe that nonlinear tone mappings, long established in 2D low-light enhancement, have not been explored for pseudo-GT generation in 3D reconstruction. Accordingly, we propose a scene-adaptive nonlinear tone-curve framework that replaces linear pseudo-GT with nonlinear alternatives. The framework introduces percentile-based normalisation for scene-agnostic curve application, a scene-adaptive offset for automatic black-level adjustment, and two complementary curves: Adaptive SoftExp (ASE), a bounded exponential curve, and Adaptive Poly3 (AP3), a data-driven cubic polynomial. The module changes only the pseudo-GT computation and leaves the 3DGS backbone unchanged. Experiments on three benchmarks covering 21 scenes show that both curves consistently outperform the linear baseline with PSNR improvements up to +4.34 dB on LOM and +3.25 dB on RealX3D. Both curves achieve similar performance despite their different mathematical forms, suggesting the improvement is curve-agnostic. Code is available at https://github.com/lvmingzhe/adaptiveToneCurve

AI.tldr: 针对低光照新视角合成任务中现有伪真值方法使用线性增益导致亮部过曝、暗部增强不足的问题，本文提出场景自适应非线性色调曲线框架，替换线性伪真值为非线性替代方案，引入基于百分位数的归一化、场景自适应偏移及两种互补曲线（ASE和AP3），在保持3DGS骨干不变的前提下，在LOM和RealX3D上分别取得了最高+4.34 dB和+3.25 dB的PSNR提升。
AI.motivation: 低光照多视图图像包含噪声、弱结构细节和压缩的动态范围，现有3DGS方法使用均匀线性增益生成伪真值图像作为监督目标，导致亮部过曝而暗部增强不足，限制了重建质量。本文旨在探索长期以来在2D低光照增强中成熟的非线性色调映射方法用于3D重建中的伪真值生成。
AI.method: 提出场景自适应非线性色调曲线框架，包含：1) 基于百分位数的归一化用于场景无关的曲线应用；2) 场景自适应偏移用于自动黑电平调整；3) 两种互补曲线——Adaptive SoftExp (ASE)有界指数曲线和Adaptive Poly3 (AP3)数据驱动三次多项式。该模块仅改变伪真值计算方式，不改变3DGS骨干网络。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试的21个场景上进行实验，两种曲线均一致优于线性基线，在LOM上PSNR提升最高达+4.34 dB，在RealX3D上提升达+3.25 dB。两种曲线尽管数学形式不同但性能相近，表明改进是曲线无关的。
AI.conclusion: 非线性色调映射可以有效替代线性增益用于低光照3D重建中的伪真值生成，显著提升新视角合成质量，且该改进不受特定曲线形式的限制。

title: Automated Creativity Evaluation of Language Models Across Open-Ended Tasks
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 (Main Conference). 35 pages, 16 figures. Code: https://github.com/tanminsen/creativity-eval
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in language understanding, reasoning, and generation, sparking growing interest in their creative potential. Realizing this potential requires systematic and scalable methods for evaluating creativity across diverse tasks. However, most existing creativity metrics are tightly coupled to specific tasks, embedding domain assumptions into the evaluation process, and limiting scalability and generality. To address this gap, we introduce an automated, domain-agnostic framework for quantifying LLM creativity across open-ended tasks. Our approach separates the measurement apparatus from the creative task itself, enabling scalable, task-agnostic assessment. Divergent creativity is measured using semantic entropy, a reference-free and robust metric for novelty and diversity, validated against human annotations, LLM-based novelty judgments and baseline diversity measures. Convergent creativity is assessed via a novel retrieval-based multi-agent judge framework that delivers context-sensitive evaluation of task fulfilment with over 60% improved efficiency. We validate our framework in three qualitatively distinct domains: problem-solving (MacGyver), research ideation (HypoGen), and creative writing (BookMIA), using a broad suite of LLMs. Empirical results show that our framework reliably captures key facets of creativity, including novelty, diversity, and task fulfilment, and reveal how model properties, such as size, temperature, recency, and reasoning, impact creative performance. Our work establishes a reproducible and generalizable standard for automated LLM creativity evaluation, paving the way for scalable benchmarking and accelerating progress in creative AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化、领域无关的框架，用于量化大语言模型在开放式任务中的创造力，通过语义熵测量发散性创造力，通过基于检索的多智能体法官框架评估收敛性创造力，并在三个不同领域验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有创造力评估方法大多与特定任务紧密耦合，嵌入了领域假设，限制了可扩展性和通用性，亟需一种自动化、领域无关的评估框架。
AI.method: 将测量装置与创造性任务分离，发散性创造力采用语义熵（无参考、鲁棒的新颖性和多样性度量），收敛性创造力采用基于检索的多智能体法官框架，实现上下文敏感的任务完成度评估。
AI.result: 在问题解决（MacGyver）、研究构思（HypoGen）和创意写作（BookMIA）三个领域验证了框架可靠性，收敛性评估效率提升超过60%，并揭示了模型规模、温度、时效性和推理能力对创造力的影响。
AI.conclusion: 建立了可重复、可泛化的自动化LLM创造力评估标准，为可扩展的基准测试和创造性AI的加速发展铺平了道路。

title: SheafStain: Sheaf-Theoretic Schrödinger Bridge for Spatially and Biologically Coherent Virtual Staining
summary: Current virtual staining approaches offer the potential for time- and cost-efficient biomarker quantification in cancer diagnostics and prognostics. However, patch-wise inference for gigapixel whole slide images (WSIs) fails to maintain spatial continuity, yielding artifacts that cause catastrophic mismatches with ground-truth images. Although pathology Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer rich representations, their self-attention causes varying global contexts to produce inconsistent embeddings for the same physical region. We formalize and validate this ``context contamination'' as a sheaf-theoretic problem where these embeddings form a presheaf that violates the gluing axiom. To address this, we propose SheafStain, a new approach that reinterprets VFM features as sheaf-like sections for spatially and biologically coherent virtual staining. Specifically, SheafStain integrates class and patch tokens into a Schrödinger Bridge framework as sheaf-like sections. While the class token anchors biological consistency, patch tokens form a per-position spatial map. A backbone co-pretrained on Hematoxylin \& Eosin (H\&E) and Immunohistochemistry (IHC) yields non-degenerate cross-stain stalks, so a single VFM feature space supervises both input conditioning and output stain alignment. Departing from prior work that evaluates on isolated $256 \times 256$ patches and either random-crops or resizes the $1024 \times 1024$ ground truth, we translate at $256 \times 256$ and evaluate on the stitched $1024 \times 1024$ outputs across HER2, ER, PR, and Ki-67. SheafStain demonstrates promising results against six prior methods while mitigating patch-boundary stitching artifacts. Code will soon be released.

AI.tldr: 针对虚拟染色中补丁推理导致的上下文污染和拼接伪影问题，本文提出SheafStain方法，将视觉基础模型特征重新解释为类层状截面，通过薛定谔桥框架整合类令牌和补丁令牌，在保持空间连续性和生物学一致性的同时，有效缓解了拼接伪影。
AI.motivation: 当前虚拟染色方法在全切片图像的补丁推理中存在空间不连续性问题，导致拼接伪影与真实图像严重不匹配。病理视觉基础模型的自注意力机制会使同一物理区域在不同全局上下文中产生不一致的嵌入（即"上下文污染"），需要一种能同时保证空间连续性和生物学一致性的虚拟染色方法。
AI.method: 将上下文污染形式化为层论问题（预层破坏粘合公理），提出SheafStain方法：将VFM特征重新解释为类层状截面，通过薛定谔桥框架整合类令牌（锚定生物学一致性）和补丁令牌（形成逐位置空间图）；使用在H&E和IHC上共同预训练的主干网络生成非退化跨染色茎，使单一VFM特征空间同时监督输入条件和输出染色对齐。
AI.result: 在HER2、ER、PR和Ki-67四种标记物上，以256×256平移推理并在拼接后的1024×1024输出上评估，SheafStain相比六种先前方法表现出更优性能，同时有效缓解了补丁边界拼接伪影。
AI.conclusion: SheafStain通过层论视角解决了虚拟染色中的上下文污染问题，实现了空间连续且生物学一致的虚拟染色，为全切片图像的虚拟染色提供了新范式。

title: Lius: Translation Model Based Instructional Lingustic Using Continual Instruction Tuning In Kupang Malay
comment: This paper is the result of the Master Thesis in Master of Artificial Intelligence at Universitas Gadjah Mada
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new potential for translation tasks but often experience performance degradation when handling low-resource languages. To address this limitation, we propose an approach for fine-tuning LLMs on a low-resource language, Kupang Malay. Our approach involves designing a set of instructions by leveraging explicit lexical and semantic features from a bilingual dictionary, and introducing Continual Instruction Tuning (CIT), a training paradigm that enables iterative instruction-based training. Experimental results demonstrate that our model, named Lius, yields notable improvements over standard instruction-tuned models by outperforming 4-6 points, and surpassing both Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and Multilingual LLM models by 10-13 points on several evaluation metrics. These findings highlight the potential of our approach to mitigate the reliance on large-scale parallel data in low-resource language translation.

AI.tldr: 针对低资源语言（古邦马来语），提出利用双语词典的词汇语义特征设计指令，并结合持续指令微调（CIT）范式微调LLM，获得显著翻译性能提升。
AI.motivation: LLM在低资源语言翻译任务中性能显著下降，而现有方法依赖大规模平行语料，低资源语言难以获取此类数据。
AI.method: 利用双语词典提取显式词汇和语义特征设计指令集；提出持续指令微调（CIT）训练范式，实现迭代式指令训练。
AI.result: 模型Lius在多项评测指标上比标准指令微调模型提升4-6个点，比NMT和多语言LLM模型提升10-13个点。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了对大规模平行语料的依赖，为低资源语言翻译提供了可行路径。

title: Task-Aware Structured Memory for Dynamic Multi-modal In-Context Learning
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) depend on in-context learning (ICL) for rapid task adaptation, but their scalability is severely limited by finite context windows and the growing cost of key-value (KV) caches in long multi-modal sequences. Existing memory compression approaches typically rely on rigid token removal or sample-dependent importance estimation, which introduces bias, disrupts semantic structure, particularly for visual representations, and yields static memories that cannot adapt to new queries. We introduce TASM (Task-Aware Structured Memory), a training-free framework that addresses these limitations through task-aware, structure-preserving, and dynamically accessible memory construction. TASM employs task-vector guided compression to replace sample-specific signals with a task-level direction that captures shared relevance across demonstrations. To preserve the underlying manifold, it applies semantics-aware token merging via bipartite graph matching, aggregating tokens without destructive pruning. Finally, TASM structures memory into a hierarchy comprising a compact Core Memory and a Latent Bank, facilitating query-adaptive dynamic retrieval. Evaluations confirm TASM maintains high performance under heavy compression, effectively balancing efficiency with adaptability.

AI.tldr: TASM提出了一种无需训练的任务感知结构化记忆框架，通过任务向量压缩、语义感知的token合并和分层记忆结构（核心记忆+潜在库），解决多模态大语言模型在上下文学习中的上下文窗口和KV缓存扩展问题，在保持高性能的同时实现高效压缩与动态适应。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs依赖ICL进行快速任务适应，但受限于有限的上下文窗口和长多模态序列中KV缓存成本不断增长。现有的记忆压缩方法依赖于刚性token删除或样本依赖的重要性估计，引入偏差、破坏语义结构（尤其对视觉表示），且生成的静态记忆无法适应新查询。
AI.method: TASM是一种无需训练的记忆构建框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 任务向量引导压缩——用任务级方向替代样本级信号，捕获跨演示的共享相关性；(2) 语义感知的token合并——通过二分图匹配保留底层流形结构，聚合token而非破坏性剪枝；(3) 分层记忆结构——将记忆组织为紧凑的Core Memory和Latent Bank，实现查询自适应的动态检索。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，TASM在重度压缩下仍能保持高性能，有效平衡了效率与适应性。
AI.conclusion: TASM通过无需训练、保留语义结构且支持动态检索的记忆构建，解决了现有压缩方法在ICL场景下的偏见、语义破坏和静态记忆等问题，为多模态大语言模型的高效上下文学习提供了可行的解决方案。

title: External Experience Serving in Production LLM Systems: A Deployment-Oriented Study of Quality-Cost Trade-offs
summary: Production LLM systems accumulate reusable operational experience, but the practical deployment issue is not merely whether such experience can help. It is how different serving strategies trade off quality against online cost under realistic constraints. Injecting external experience can improve task quality, yet it also increases prompt burden, latency, and serving pressure. We study \textit{external experience serving} as a deployment-oriented quality-cost trade-off problem. We evaluate this question in a real production moderation setting, with tool-use and GPQA as supporting contrast tasks that expose different output-cost regimes. We compare no-experience baselines, random experience controls, global prompt injection, and retrieval-based selective injection, and analyze both task quality and serving cost. The results show that, once experience becomes case-dependent, selective retrieval provides a stronger operating point than unconditional global injection. They further show that retrieval quality matters more than simply increasing Top-$K$, and that the same serving policy can exhibit substantially different cost-benefit profiles across short-output and decode-heavy regimes. These findings suggest that external experience is best treated as a selective, cost-aware serving decision rather than as a universal add-on. Overall, in the settings studied here, external experience pays off only when both the serving interface and the task-specific cost structure make its quality gains worth the online cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了外部经验注入在LLM生产系统部署中的质量-成本权衡问题，发现选择性检索注入优于全局无条件注入，且经验的有效性取决于服务接口和任务特定的成本结构。
AI.motivation: 生产级LLM系统会积累可复用的操作经验，但实际部署中不同服务策略在质量和在线成本之间存在权衡。注入外部经验虽可提升任务质量，但会增加提示负担、延迟和服务压力，因此需要系统研究这种权衡。
AI.method: 在真实生产审核场景中开展实验，以工具使用和GPQA作为对比任务；比较无经验基线、随机经验控制、全局提示注入和基于检索的选择性注入四种策略，同时分析任务质量和服务成本。
AI.result: 经验一旦具有案例依赖性，选择性检索优于无条件全局注入；检索质量比简单增加Top-K更重要；同一服务策略在不同输出长度和解码密集型场景下成本效益差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 外部经验应被视为一种选择性、成本感知的服务决策而非通用附加组件；只有当服务接口和任务特定成本结构使得质量收益值得在线成本时，外部经验才是有价值的。

title: SG2Loc: Sequential Visual Localization on 3D Scene Graphs
comment: The code will be available at https://github.com/DmblnNicole/sg2loc
summary: Visual localization in complex indoor environments remains a critical challenge for robotics and AR applications. Sequential localization, where pose estimates are refined over time, is important for autonomous agents. However, traditional methods often require storing extensive image databases or point clouds, leading to significant overhead. This paper introduces a novel, lightweight approach to sequential visual localization using 3D scene graphs. Our method represents the environment with a compact scene graph, where nodes represent objects (with coarse meshes) and edges encode spatial relationships. For each image in the localization phase, we extract per-patch semantic features, predicting object identities. Localization is performed within a particle filter framework. Each particle, representing a camera pose, projects the coarse object meshes from the scene graph into the image, assigning object identities to patches based on visibility. The similarity of the per-patch features, in the input image, and object features from the scene graph determines the weight of a particle. Subsequent images are incorporated sequentially, refining the pose estimate. By leveraging a compact scene graph and efficient semantic matching, our method significantly reduces storage while maintaining performance on real-world datasets. The code will be available at https://github.com/DmblnNicole/sg2loc.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于3D场景图的轻量级顺序视觉定位方法，使用紧凑的场景图（包含物体粗略网格和空间关系）代替传统图像数据库或点云，通过粒子滤波框架和语义特征匹配在复杂室内环境中实现高效定位，显著降低存储需求。
AI.motivation: 传统顺序视觉定位方法需要存储大量图像数据库或点云，导致显著的开销，亟需一种轻量级的替代方案以适应资源受限的机器人或AR应用。
AI.method: 1) 使用3D场景图表示环境，节点为物体（含粗略网格），边为空间关系；2) 定位时提取输入图像的逐块语义特征，预测物体身份；3) 在粒子滤波框架中，每个粒子（相机位姿）通过场景图投影物体网格并分配物体身份；4) 基于输入图像块特征与场景图物体特征的相似度计算粒子权重；5) 顺序处理后续图像以不断精化位姿估计。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上，该方法在显著降低存储需求的同时保持了与现有方法相当的定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用紧凑场景图和高效语义匹配，该方法为复杂室内环境下的顺序视觉定位提供了一种轻量级、存储高效的解决方案，适用于机器人自主导航和增强现实等应用场景。

title: WorldReasoner: Evaluating Whether Language Model Agents Forecast Events with Valid Reasoning
summary: Forecasting real-world events requires language-model agents to reason under uncertainty from incomplete, time-bounded information. Yet evaluating whether agents genuinely forecast requires more than final-answer accuracy: a model may be correct by recalling memorized training facts, citing fabricated evidence, or producing an unsupported causal story. We present WorldReasoner, an evaluation framework for temporally valid event forecasting. Each task gives an agent a resolved forecasting question, a simulated forecast date, and access only to evidence available before that date; after resolution, the framework scores the submitted probability, cited evidence, and optional causal event graph. WorldReasoner reports three complementary axes: outcome quality against resolved answers, evidence quality over cited sources, and reasoning quality against post-resolution hindsight graphs. The benchmark is built by an agentic construction pipeline that generates forecasting questions, collects time-stamped evidence, and builds hindsight reference graphs at scale, yielding 345 resolved tasks derived from 14,141 articles with graphs covering 8,087 extracted events. Across six controlled agent settings, temporally valid retrieval is the strongest driver of outcome accuracy; causal graph construction improves key-event recovery; and correct graph-enabled forecasts are more strongly grounded in key events and relevant sources, yet agents still struggle to convert grounded evidence into calibrated probabilities.

AI.tldr: WorldReasoner是一个评估语言模型智能体在时间受限条件下进行真实事件预测能力的框架，从结果准确性、证据质量和推理质量三个维度进行评估，并基于14,141篇文章构建了345个解析任务。研究发现时间有效检索是结果准确性的最强驱动因素，因果图构建能改善关键事件恢复，但智能体仍难以将基于证据的信息转化为校准的概率。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法仅关注最终答案准确性，无法区分模型是基于真实推理、记忆训练数据、编造证据还是生成无因果支持的叙述来做出预测，需要更全面的评估框架来检验智能体是否真正具备预测能力。
AI.method: 构建WorldReasoner评估框架：为每个任务提供已解决的预测问题、模拟预测日期和仅在该日期前可用的证据；在问题解决后，对提交的概率、引用的证据和可选因果事件图进行评分。采用智能体构建管道生成预测问题、收集时间戳证据并构建事后参考因果图。最终从14,141篇文章中构建345个已解决任务，包含8,087个提取事件的因果图。
AI.result: 在六种受控智能体设置下：1）时间有效检索是结果准确性的最强驱动因素；2）因果图构建能改善关键事件恢复；3）正确的基于图的预测与关键事件和相关来源有更强关联；4）智能体仍难以将基于证据的信息转化为校准的概率。
AI.conclusion: WorldReasoner揭示了当前语言模型智能体在事件预测中的关键瓶颈：虽然检索和因果推理能力有所提升，但从证据到校准概率的转换仍存在显著差距，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Image Quality Assessment of Identity Cards Using Measures from Open Face Image Quality
comment: Presented on IWBF 2026 (14th International Workshop on Biometrics and Forensics)
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of assessing image quality in ID cards in remote verification systems by applying capture-related quality measures from the Open Face Image Quality (OFIQ) standard to ID card images. Our preprocessing pipeline includes corner detection, perspective normalization, and comprehensive foreground masking to ensure accurate and unbiased quality measure computation. We evaluate the effectiveness of these measures by analyzing their correlation with the performance of three presentation attack detection (PAD) algorithms across four diverse ID card datasets, where two datasets contain bona fide, i.e. pristine, images and two contain printed mock ID cards. Our results suggest that quality assessment based on some OFIQ measures can significantly improve PAD performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将OFIQ标准中的图像质量评估指标应用于身份证图像，通过预处理流水线（角点检测、透视归一化、前景掩膜）计算质量度量，并分析这些度量与三种呈现攻击检测（PAD）算法性能的相关性。实验表明，基于部分OFIQ度量的质量评估能显著提升PAD性能。
AI.motivation: 远程验证系统中身份证图像质量评估面临挑战，现有方法未能有效将人脸图像质量标准适配到身份证图像场景，且质量度量与呈现攻击检测性能之间的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 设计预处理流水线（角点检测、透视归一化、前景掩膜），将OFIQ标准中的捕获相关质量度量应用于身份证图像；通过分析质量度量与三种PAD算法性能的相关性，评估度量有效性；使用四个不同身份证数据集（两个真图、两个打印假卡）进行实验验证。
AI.result: 部分OFIQ质量度量与PAD算法性能之间存在显著相关性，基于这些度量的质量评估能够有效提升呈现攻击检测的表现。
AI.conclusion: OFIQ标准中的部分图像质量度量可被成功迁移应用于身份证图像质量评估，并能为远程验证系统中的呈现攻击检测提供有效支持。

title: I Understand How You Feel: Enhancing Deeper Emotional Support Through Multilingual Emotional Validation in Dialogue System
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at SIGdial Meeting on Discourse and Dialogue 2026 (SIGDIAL 2026)
summary: Emotional validation - explicitly acknowledging that a user's feelings make sense - has proven therapeutic value but has received little computational attention. Emotional validation in dialogue systems can be decomposed into (i) validating response identification, (ii) validation timing detection, and (iii) validating response generation. To support research on all three subtasks, we release M-EDESConv, a 120k English-Japanese multilingual corpus created through hybrid manual and automatic annotation, and M-TESC, a multilingual spoken-dialogue test set. For timing detection, we propose MEGUMI, a Multilingual Emotion-aware Gated Unit for Mutual Integration, that fuses frozen XLM-RoBERTa semantics with language-specific emotion encoders via cross-modal attention and gated fusion. MEGUMI shows superior performance on both the M-EDESConv and M-TESC datasets, both objectively and subjectively. Finally, our EmoValidBench benchmarks of GPT-4.1 Nano and Llama-3.1 8B indicate that current LLMs generate contextually similar and diverse validating responses, but emotional understanding remains a major area for improvement. Project page: https://github.com/zihaurpang/Multilingual-Emotional-Validation

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多语言情感验证框架，包含M-EDESConv（12万条英日双语语料库）、M-TESC（多语言口语对话测试集）、MEGUMI（多语言情感感知门控融合模型）和EmoValidBench基准测试，实验表明MEGUMI在验证响应识别、时机检测和生成上表现优异，但当前LLM在情感理解上仍有提升空间。
AI.motivation: 情感验证（明确承认用户情绪合理性）在对话系统中具有治疗价值，但此前缺乏计算层面的系统研究，尤其是多语言场景下的相关工作几乎空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建M-EDESConv语料库：混合人工与自动标注的12万条英日双语数据集；2) 构建M-TESC多语言口语对话测试集；3) 提出MEGUMI模型：将冻结的XLM-RoBERTa语义表示与语言特定情感编码器通过跨模态注意力和门控融合机制进行集成；4) 设计EmoValidBench基准测试评估GPT-4.1 Nano和Llama-3.1 8B。
AI.result: MEGUMI在M-EDESConv和M-TESC数据集上，在主客观评估中均取得优于基线模型的性能；当前LLM虽能生成上下文相似且多样的验证响应，但情感理解能力仍是主要短板。
AI.conclusion: 多语言情感验证对话系统具备可行性，MEGUMI模型有效融合了跨语言语义与情感信息，但现有LLM在深层情感理解方面仍需改进。

title: Task-Aligned Stability Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving Hazard Detection
comment: 8 pages (5 main body + 3 references / appendices). ICML 2026 Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for scene understanding in autonomous driving, but robustness analysis often relies on task-agnostic embedding stability alone. We study whether corruption-induced embedding drift predicts changes in a task-aligned hazard score derived from CLIP image-text similarities. Using controlled corruptions on BDD100K road scenes, we compare embedding drift against margin drift, defined as the change in hazard score under perturbation. The relationship is highly corruption-dependent: some families exhibit strong coupling between representation drift and decision drift, while others induce hazardous decision instability despite relatively modest embedding change. Furthermore, corruption families differ in failure direction: most suppress hazard detections via false negatives, while occlusion instead triggers false alarms, suggesting that benchmark design should account for asymmetric failure modes, not just overall instability rates. These results suggest that robustness benchmarks should include task-aligned stability measures in addition to embedding-level perturbation statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型在自动驾驶场景理解中的鲁棒性，发现嵌入层漂移与任务对齐的风险分数漂移之间的关系高度依赖具体损坏类型，且不同损坏家族会导致不对称的失败模式（多数产生假阴性，遮挡则引发假阳性），建议鲁棒性基准应包含任务对齐的稳定性指标。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs鲁棒性分析过度依赖任务无关的嵌入稳定性指标，缺乏对任务对齐指标（如风险分数）与嵌入漂移之间关系的理解。
AI.method: 在BDD100K道路场景上施加受控损坏，比较嵌入漂移与基于CLIP图文相似度定义的风险分数边际漂移之间的关系，分析不同损坏家族下的失效方向。
AI.result: 嵌入漂移与决策漂移的关系高度依赖损坏类型：部分损坏下二者强耦合，部分损坏下微小嵌入变化即可导致危险决策不稳定；多数损坏通过假阴性压制风险检测，而遮挡则引发假阳性报警。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性基准应包含任务对齐的稳定性指标（如边际漂移），而不仅仅是嵌入级扰动统计，且需考虑不对称的失败模式。

title: Notes2Skills: From Lab Notebooks to Certainty-Aware Scientific Agent Skills
summary: Scientific discovery workflows usually contain and rely heavily on lab notes, where researchers record observations, interpret uncertain results, and plan follow-up experiments. Such informative lab notes preserve evolving scientific reasoning and author uncertainty, rather than polished final results exhibited in publications, providing a valuable opportunity for AI to engage in scientific exploration at a more comprehensive and deeper level. However, most prior work on scientific text focuses on papers, protocols, or structured databases, leaving informal laboratory notes underexplored as inputs to AI agents for science. This gap matters because lab notes often intermingle validated observations, tentative judgments, and possible experimental next steps within the same passage. If these signals are conflated, an AI agent may mistake uncertain scientific judgments for confirmed conclusions or executable actions. To this end, we present Notes2Skills, a two-stage framework for turning lab notebooks into verifiable skills for scientific AI agents while preserving the author's certainty. Across seven conditions and three wet-lab sessions, Notes2Skills is the only configuration that neither mistakes uncertain notes for firm instructions nor discards firm ones. We show that certainty preservation is the missing piece between lab notebooks and reliable agent skills, opening a path toward safer AI co-scientist systems.

AI.tldr: Notes2Skills是一个两阶段框架，能够将实验室笔记转化为可验证的AI科学代理技能，同时保留作者的不确定性信息，避免混淆不确定判断与确认结论。
AI.motivation: 实验室笔记记录了科学家不断演变的推理和不确定性，为AI参与科学探索提供了更全面的机会，但现有研究主要关注论文、协议或结构化数据库，忽视了非正式的实验室笔记。这种差距会导致AI代理将不确定的科学判断误认为已确认的结论或可执行操作。
AI.method: 提出Notes2Skills，一个两阶段框架，将实验室笔记转化为可验证的AI代理技能，同时保留作者的确定性程度。
AI.result: 在七个条件和三个湿实验环节中，Notes2Skills是唯一既不将不确定笔记误认为确定指令、也不丢弃确定笔记的配置方案。
AI.conclusion: 确定性保留是连接实验室笔记与可靠代理技能的关键缺失环节，为构建更安全的AI联合科学家系统开辟了道路。
