title: Wild3R: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Sparse Photo Collection
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) removes the need for time-consuming per-scene optimization required by traditional 3DGS. However, existing feed-forward approaches struggle with real-world photo collections that include diverse lighting conditions and transient objects. In this paper, we present Wild3R, a feed-forward approach for unconstrained sparse photo collections. The main bottleneck is the lack of training data that provides multiple viewpoints, a variety of illuminations, and transient variations necessary for learning robust scene representations. To address this, we introduce the WildCity dataset, which comprises 200 scenes, 170 lighting conditions, and transient objects, resulting in 337,500 images in total. By leveraging the dataset, our model learns appearance consistency across viewpoints conditioned on reference views, while removing transient content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing feed-forward approaches and achieves results competitive with prior per-scene optimization-based methods.

AI.tldr: Wild3R提出了一种前馈式3D高斯泼溅方法，用于处理无约束的稀疏照片集，通过构建包含多样光照和瞬态物体的WildCity数据集，学习跨视角的外观一致性并去除瞬态内容，性能优于现有前馈方法，与逐场景优化方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈式3DGS方法难以处理真实世界照片集中的多样光照条件和瞬态物体，核心瓶颈在于缺乏包含多视角、多样光照和瞬态变化的训练数据。
AI.method: 构建WildCity数据集（200场景、170光照条件、337,500张图像），在此基础上学习以参考视图为条件的跨视角外观一致性，同时去除瞬态内容。
AI.result: Wild3R在无约束稀疏照片集上优于现有前馈方法，与逐场景优化方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 大规模多样化数据集的构建能有效提升前馈式3DGS在真实场景中的泛化能力，弥合前馈方法与逐场景优化方法之间的差距。

title: GraspLLM: Towards Zero-Shot Generalization on Text-Attributed Graphs with LLMs
summary: Research on Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) has gained significant attention recently due to its broad applications across various real-world data scenarios, such as citation networks, e-commerce platforms, social media, and web pages. Inspired by the remarkable semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), there have been numerous attempts to integrate LLMs into TAGs. However, existing methods still struggle to generalize across diverse graphs and tasks, and their ability to capture transferable graph structural patterns remains limited. To address this, we introduce the GraspLLM, a framework that combines Graph structural comprehension with semantic understanding prowess of LLMs to enhance the cross-dataset and cross-task generalizability. Specifically, we represent node texts from different graphs in a unified semantic space with a frozen general embedding model, on top of which we perform motif-aware contrastive learning across multiple motif-induced adjacency matrices to extract dataset-agnostic structural information. Then, with our proposed optimal contextual subgraph, we extract the most contextually relevant subgraph for each target node and align these subgraphs to the token space of LLM via an alignment projector. Extensive experiments on TAG benchmark datasets spanning diverse domains reveal that GraspLLM consistently outperforms previous LLM-based methods for TAGs, especially in zero-shot scenarios, highlighting its strong generalizability across different datasets and tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Heinz217/GraspLLM.

AI.tldr: GraspLLM是一个结合图结构理解与LLM语义理解能力的框架，通过统一语义空间、模体感知对比学习和最优上下文子图对齐，显著提升了文本属性图在跨数据集和跨任务场景下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有将LLM集成到TAGs的方法在跨不同图和任务的泛化能力上表现不佳，捕获可迁移的图结构模式的能力有限。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结的通用嵌入模型将不同图的节点文本映射到统一语义空间；2) 在多个模体诱导的邻接矩阵上进行模体感知对比学习，提取与数据集无关的结构信息；3) 提出最优上下文子图提取方法，为目标节点提取最相关的上下文子图；4) 通过对齐投影器将这些子图对齐到LLM的token空间。
AI.result: 在多个TAG基准数据集上的实验表明，GraspLLM在零样本场景下尤其突出，一致优于先前基于LLM的方法。
AI.conclusion: GraspLLM通过结合图结构理解与LLM语义理解，实现了跨不同数据集和任务的强泛化能力。

title: From Content to Knowledge: Lightning Fast Long-Video Understanding with Neural Knowledge Representations
summary: We propose a new paradigm for long video understanding by treating a long video as a Neural Knowledge Representation (NKR). NKR represents video contents neither as a stream of tokens nor pre-organized databases, but as an individual small portion of network weights attached to the VLM backbone. The NKR weights are optimized to encapsulate the video's semantic content via a novel Agentic Knowledge Distillation (AKD) process, where an agent automatically synthesizes dense descriptions and question-answer pairs to distill the video's knowledge into the NKR. While AKD serves as a comprehensive, one-time encoding phase, the resulting NKR transforms the video into a portable, reusable asset. At inference, the lightweight NKR is mounted onto a frozen Vision-Language Model (VLM), enabling direct, query-based understanding without reloading or re-encoding the original video. This approach decouples video length from inference cost, offering high amortized efficiency for multi-turn video understanding. Experiments on the LVBench benchmark show our method achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art approaches while reducing end-to-end latency by over two orders of magnitude, opening new possibilities for interactive long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的长视频理解范式，将长视频编码为神经网络知识表征（NKR），通过智能体知识蒸馏（AKD）将视频语义压缩到少量网络权重中，推理时将其挂载到冻结的VLM上实现高效查询，无需重新加载或编码原视频。在LVBench上达到SOTA水平，同时将端到端延迟降低两个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解方法要么将视频视为令牌流（计算成本随视频长度线性增长），要么依赖预组织数据库（缺乏灵活性和可移植性）。本文旨在解耦视频长度与推理成本，实现高效的多轮交互式长视频理解。
AI.method: 提出NKR范式，包含两个阶段：（1）编码阶段：通过智能体知识蒸馏（AKD），让智能体自动生成密集描述和问答对，将视频知识蒸馏到少量网络权重中；（2）推理阶段：将轻量级NKR权重挂载到冻结的VLM骨干网络上，直接进行查询式理解。
AI.result: 在LVBench基准上，所提方法性能与现有最先进方法相当，但端到端延迟降低了两个数量级以上（即超过100倍），显著提升了推理效率。
AI.conclusion: NKR范式成功将视频长度与推理成本解耦，实现了高摊销效率的多轮视频理解，为交互式长视频理解开辟了新可能。

title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to linguistic variation remains poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic multilingual evaluation of VLA models by translating the LIBERO benchmark into ten languages, revealing severe performance degradation under non-English instructions, with success rates dropping by 30-50%. Through fine-grained analysis of task executions, we find that language influence is highly non-uniform across steps: certain steps exhibit strong language dependence and dominate overall task failure, while others are largely language-agnostic. Based on this insight, we propose a step-wise inference-time intervention that aligns representations according to step language sensitivity, substantially improving performance under linguistic variation. Our results indicate that language robustness in VLA models is fundamentally a step-wise control problem, highlighting the importance of temporally structured analysis for reliable embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了VLA模型在多语言环境下的鲁棒性，发现非英语指令下成功率下降30-50%，并通过步骤级分析揭示语言影响的非均匀性，进而提出基于步骤语言敏感性的推理时干预方法以提升性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在语言条件机器人操控中表现强劲，但其对语言变体的鲁棒性尚不明确，尤其是多语言场景下的性能退化问题未被系统研究。
AI.method: 将LIBERO基准翻译为十种语言进行多语言评估；通过细粒度任务执行分析发现语言影响在步骤间高度非均匀；提出基于步骤语言敏感性的推理时表示对齐干预方法。
AI.result: 非英语指令下成功率下降30-50%；某些步骤表现出强语言依赖性并主导任务失败，其他步骤则几乎与语言无关；提出的干预方法显著提升了语言变体下的性能。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型的语言鲁棒性本质上是一个步骤级控制问题，强调了时间结构化分析对于构建可靠具身智能体的重要性。

title: Corpus Augmentation for Sign Language Translation via LLM-Guided Video Stitching
summary: Sign language translation (SLT) converts sign language video into spoken language text and holds significant promise for improving accessibility and enabling communication between signing and non-signing communities. While large weakly-aligned datasets have enabled pre-training at scale and gloss-free methods have reduced reliance on expert annotation, high-quality parallel sign video-text pairs for fine-tuning remain scarce, limiting generalisation on long-tail vocabulary and unseen constructions. We propose a corpus augmentation approach that requires no additional human annotation, external sign-language video corpora, or generative video models, relying only on the existing gloss-annotated training corpus and an LLM for sentence generation: per-gloss clips are extracted from training videos via CTC forced-alignment, novel gloss-sentence pairs are generated by a corpus-anchored LLM, and synthetic sequences are assembled through random sentence sampling and clip assignment. The resulting synthetic RGB video-text pairs are architecture-agnostic at the downstream training stage and can be consumed directly by RGB-based SLT models, or converted into pose or feature representations by pipelines that derive such inputs from video. Sincan et al. re-evaluated five recent gloss-free methods under strictly identical conditions; the largest verified gain over the GFSLT-VLP baseline was only 0.98 BLEU-4. Our augmentation, applied within the same framework, achieves +2.92 BLEU-4 without any change to architecture or training protocol. We further identify that synthetic data harms vision-language pretraining despite improving its objectives, and that optimising clip transitions for visual smoothness is counter-productive under L2-based criteria; we propose that abrupt boundaries may act as a form of implicit regularisation. Code is available at https://github.com/robizso/slt-datagen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需人工标注、外部数据或生成模型的手语翻译语料增强方法：利用CTC强制对齐从现有训练视频中提取逐词手语片段，借助LLM生成句子-片段对，通过随机采样组装成合成视频-文本对。该方法在GFSLT-VLP基线上提升+2.92 BLEU-4，并发现合成数据在视觉预训练中虽提升目标但损害表征学习，且突变的片段边界比平滑过渡更有效。
AI.motivation: 高质量平行手语视频-文本对稀缺，限制了模型在长尾词汇和未见组合上的泛化能力。现有方法依赖人工标注或外部数据，成本高且扩展性差。
AI.method: 1) 通过CTC强制对齐从训练视频中提取逐词手语片段；2) 使用锚定语料库的LLM生成新颖的词汇-句子对；3) 通过随机句子采样和片段分配组装合成RGB视频-文本对。该增强方法架构无关，可直接被RGB模型使用或转换为姿态/特征表示。
AI.result: 在严格一致的五种无词汇方法复现中，最大增益仅0.98 BLEU-4；本文方法在同一框架下实现+2.92 BLEU-4提升，且无需修改架构或训练协议。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据在视觉-语言预训练中虽提升目标函数但会损害表征学习；优化片段间视觉平滑度在L2准则下适得其反，突变边界可能作为一种隐式正则化起作用。

title: An Ontology-Guided Multi-Anchor Graph Retrieval Framework for Traffic Legal Liability Determination
summary: Traffic law liability determination is critical for assigning legal penalties, requiring the simultaneous identification of interdependent statutory provisions across multiple legal dimensions. However, existing retrieval-augmented generation methods suffer from a multi-dimensional retrieval bottleneck: single axis architectures compress complex legal queries into a single pathway, causing interdependent statutory dimensions to be overlooked. To address this, we propose OMAGR, an ontology-guided framework that decomposes queries into ontology-aligned anchors and executes parallel graph retrieval across each dimension, ensuring independent retrieval across dimensions before fusion. To evaluate the proposed method, we created the TrafficLaw-QA dataset, an expert-validated benchmark dataset containing 200 questions and 527 legal provisions. Results show that TrafficOmni-RAG outperforms baselines on Context Precision and Faithfulness metrics. The findings demonstrate that parallel multi-anchor retrieval effectively resolves the multi-dimensional retrieval bottleneck, offering a promising direction for traffic law liability determination research.

AI.tldr: 针对交通法责任认定中的多维度检索瓶颈，本文提出OMAGR框架，通过本体引导的查询分解与并行图检索，有效解决了传统RAG方法在多维度法律条文检索中的局限性，并在自建数据集TrafficLaw-QA上取得了优于基线方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强生成方法在处理交通法责任认定时存在多维度检索瓶颈——单一轴架构将复杂的法律查询压缩到单一通路，导致相互依赖的法条维度被忽略，无法同时识别跨多个法律维度的相互关联的法条。
AI.method: 提出OMAGR框架，采用本体引导（ontology-guided）的方式将查询分解为与本体对齐的锚点（anchors），并在每个维度上执行并行图检索（parallel graph retrieval），确保各维度独立检索后再进行融合。
AI.result: 构建了专家验证的TrafficLaw-QA基准数据集（200个问题、527项法律条款），实验表明所提方法TrafficOmni-RAG在上下文精确度（Context Precision）和忠实度（Faithfulness）指标上优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 并行多锚点检索能够有效解决多维度检索瓶颈，为交通法责任认定研究提供了有前景的方向。

title: Feature extraction for plant growth estimation
summary: Precision agriculture requires the estimation of plant growth stages in real-time. When the plant growth stage is known, the wastage of resources in cultivation, such as nutrients and water, is reduced as only the required resources need to be supplied. Plants at different growth stages, however, have similar morphological features, which can make autonomous growth stage estimation difficult. This paper presents two feature extraction methods for growth stage estimation: one that uses a bank of Gabor filters and morphological operations, and the other that uses pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transfer learning. We test these methods on a publicly available plant growth stage dataset (``bccr-segset``) for two species, canola and radish, grown and captured under indoor conditions. The two proposed feature extraction methods are compared, using support vector machines and boosted trees as classifiers. We find that both methods are suitable for real-time applications, and that CNN features outperform the hand-crafted features, both with regard to speed and accuracy. The best system (VGG-19 features, classified with a radial basis function support vector machine) obtained an accuracy of 98.4% for both species, processing an image in 0.08 seconds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种植物生长阶段估计方法：基于Gabor滤波器和形态学操作的手工特征方法，以及基于预训练CNN和迁移学习的深度特征方法。在公开数据集上测试表明，CNN方法（VGG-19+RBF SVM）在速度和精度上均优于手工特征方法，准确率达98.4%，单张图像处理仅需0.08秒，适合实时应用。
AI.motivation: 精准农业需要实时估计植物生长阶段以减少水肥等资源的浪费，但不同生长阶段的植物具有相似的形态特征，导致自主生长阶段估计困难。
AI.method: 提出两种特征提取方法：(1) 基于Gabor滤波器组和形态学操作的手工特征；(2) 基于预训练CNN和迁移学习的深度特征。使用SVM和Boosted Trees作为分类器，在油菜和小萝卜两种植物的公开数据集上进行比较。
AI.result: 两种方法均适合实时应用，CNN特征在速度和精度上均优于手工特征。最佳系统（VGG-19特征+RBF SVM）对两种植物均达到98.4%的准确率，单张图像处理时间为0.08秒。
AI.conclusion: 基于预训练CNN和迁移学习的深度特征方法比手工特征方法更适合植物生长阶段的实时估计任务，能够在保证高精度的同时满足实时性需求。

title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
summary: Scientific progress depends on a repeated loop of exploration, experimentation, and abstraction. Researchers test candidate directions, interpret the evidence, and carry the resulting lessons into later attempts. We study how an AI agent can run this loop autonomously over long horizons. We introduce Arbor, a general framework for autonomous research that combines a long-lived coordinator, short-lived executors, and Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR), a persistent tree that links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across time. The coordinator manages global research strategy over the tree, while executors implement and test individual hypotheses in isolated worktrees. As results return, Arbor updates the tree, propagates reusable lessons, refines the search frontier, and admits verified improvements. This design turns autonomous research from a sequence of local attempts into a cumulative process in which strategy, execution, and evidence are carried across time. We evaluate Arbor under Autonomous Optimization (AO), an operational setting where an agent improves an initial research artifact through iterative experimentation without step-level human supervision. Across six real research tasks in model training, harness engineering, and data synthesis, Arbor achieves the best held-out result on all six tasks, attaining more than 2.5x the average relative held-out gain of Codex and Claude Code under the same task interface and resource budget. On MLE-Bench Lite, Arbor reaches 86.36% Any Medal with GPT-5.5, the strongest result in our comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Arbor，一个支持AI智能体自主进行长期科研的通用框架，通过假设树精炼（HTR）机制将策略、执行和证据跨时间累积，在六个真实科研任务和MLE-Bench Lite上均取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 科学研究依赖探索、实验和抽象的重复循环，现有AI系统缺乏在长时间跨度内自主运行这一循环的能力，需要一种能够跨时间累积策略、执行和证据的自主科研框架。
AI.method: 提出Arbor框架，包含长期存在的协调器（coordinator）、短期执行的执行器（executors）以及假设树精炼（HTR）持久化树结构。协调器管理全局研究策略，执行器在隔离工作树中实现和测试单个假设，HTR树链接假设、工件、证据和跨时间提炼的洞察，持续更新和传播可复用的经验教训。
AI.result: 在六个真实科研任务（模型训练、工具工程、数据合成）上，Arbor均取得最优留出结果，平均相对留出增益超过Codex和Claude Code的2.5倍；在MLE-Bench Lite上，使用GPT-5.5达到86.36%的任意奖牌率。
AI.conclusion: Arbor的设计将自主科研从局部尝试序列转变为累积过程，在多个科研任务上显著优于现有基线，验证了跨时间策略-执行-证据累积框架的有效性。

title: SpecLoR: Spectral Lookahead Rectification for Motion-Coherent Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Flow Matching has enabled robust text-to-video generation via latent ODE sampling. However, velocity approximation and numerical discretization errors inevitably accumulate, causing sampling trajectories to drift. Consequently, generated videos often suffer from severe spatiotemporal inconsistencies. Nevertheless, directly correcting these drifted, noisy latents is challenging: (i) timestep-dependent noise obscures reliable structural cues; (ii) spatial interventions risk disrupting intricate local geometry while incurring heavy computational costs. To address this, we propose Spectral Lookahead Rectification (SpecLoR), a plug-and-play inference method that bypasses noise via lookahead prediction, and circumvents spatiotemporal entanglement by shifting corrections to the frequency domain, where universal statistical priors of natural videos are readily available. First, during early sampling stages, SpecLoR looks ahead to estimate the clean latent $z_{t,0}$ and computes its 3D spatiotemporal spectrum. Next, SpecLoR rectifies the amplitude spectrum to match the prior, leaving the phase intact. Finally, the corrected state is re-noised to resume ODE integration. Experiments on Wan2.2 demonstrate that SpecLoR significantly reduces physical artifacts and enhances motion coherence across multiple benchmarks with minimal computational overhead (4 additional NFEs).

AI.tldr: 提出SpecLoR，一种即插即用的推理方法，通过频谱前瞻校正来减少流匹配文本生成视频中的时空不一致性。
AI.motivation: 流匹配文本生成视频中，速度逼近和数值离散误差导致采样轨迹漂移，产生严重的时空不一致伪影。直接校正有噪声的潜变量存在两个挑战：时间步依赖的噪声掩盖了可靠的结构线索；空间干预可能破坏局部几何结构且计算成本高。
AI.method: SpecLoR：1) 在早期采样阶段，前瞻估计干净潜变量并计算其3D时空频谱；2) 修正幅度谱以匹配自然视频的通用统计先验，保持相位不变；3) 将校正后的状态重新加噪以恢复ODE积分。
AI.result: 在Wan2.2上，SpecLoR显著减少了物理伪影，增强了运动连贯性，仅需额外4次NFE计算。
AI.conclusion: SpecLoR是一种有效的即插即用推理方法，通过频域校正解决流匹配视频生成中的漂移问题，计算开销极小。

title: Semantic Grading of Written Answers in Low-Resource Language Bangla Using a Fine-Tuned Lightweight Language Model
summary: Bangla is among the world's most widely spoken languages, yet it remains underserved in educational NLP research. In many remote and rural regions, access to qualified subject teachers is limited, and written answers are consequently graded largely by hand, restricting timely and consistent feedback. Automatic assessment is challenging because semantically correct responses can vary substantially in surface form. We present a bilingual (Bangla-English) evaluation system designed for low-resource educational settings that prioritizes semantic correctness over lexical overlap. Our approach fine-tunes a lightweight language model to grade each response using the question, reference answer, and student answer, producing a numeric score and concise, context-grounded feedback suitable for classroom deployment. We also construct a synthetic bilingual dataset to enable controlled training and evaluation. Across proprietary and open-source LLMs evaluated under a unified protocol, our QLoRA-tuned Qwen3-8B confirms consistent improvement by producing the most leakage-resistant feedback (RoRa = 0.819) in synthetic evaluation and the strongest agreement with human scores (rho = 0.936, MAE = 0.725) in a dedicated human study.

AI.tldr: 针对孟加拉语（及英语）低资源教育场景，本文提出一个轻量级双语自动评分系统，通过QLoRA微调Qwen3-8B模型，基于问题、参考答案和学生答案生成数值评分和上下文反馈，在合成评估中达到最高防泄露分数（RoRa=0.819），人工评分一致性显著（Spearman ρ=0.936, MAE=0.725）。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语是全球广泛使用但在教育NLP研究中资源匮乏的语言；偏远地区缺乏合格学科教师，手写评分限制了及时一致的反馈；自动评估因语义正确的回答表面形式多样而具有挑战性。
AI.method: 构建双语（孟加拉语-英语）合成数据集；采用QLoRA微调轻量级语言模型（Qwen3-8B），输入问题、参考答案和学生答案，输出数值评分及简洁的情境化反馈。
AI.result: QLoRA微调的Qwen3-8B在合成评估中达到最高防泄露分数（RoRa=0.819）；在人工研究中与人类评分高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.936, MAE=0.725）。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了轻量级微调模型可在低资源双语教育场景中实现语义优先的自动评分，提供抗泄露的反馈，且在人工一致性上显著优于其他模型。

title: ParseFixer: An Agentic Framework for Document Parsing via Selective Multimodal Correction
summary: In this report, we present our third-place solution for the DataMFM Challenge Track 1: Document Parsing. This track requires models to recover structured Markdown documents from document page images while preserving textual content and document structure. To address the complementary requirements of accurate content recovery and faithful structure reconstruction, we propose ParseFixer, an agentic framework for backbone parsing and selective correction. ParseFixer consists of two key modules: Full-Page Backbone Parsing (FBP) and Agentic Selective Correction (ASC). FBP produces stable initial Markdown outputs with MinerU2.5 Pro, while ASC detects high-value parsing failures and repairs them through a verify-and-rollback correction process. By placing selective multimodal correction after open-source backbone parsing, ParseFixer improves the recovery of key document elements without rewriting reliable backbone predictions. On the test set, our final system achieves an overall score of 61.78 and ranks third in Track 1, demonstrating its effectiveness for accurate document parsing. Our code will be released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/CVPRW26-ParseFixer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ParseFixer框架，通过全页骨干解析(MinerU2.5 Pro)与智能体选择性校正模块相结合，在DataMFM Challenge Track 1文档解析任务中获得第三名(总体得分61.78)，实现了准确的文档内容恢复与结构重建。
AI.motivation: 文档解析任务需要同时满足准确的内容恢复和忠实结构重建这两个互补需求，现有方法难以平衡两者，因此需要一种能够在保持可靠骨干预测的同时对关键错误进行选择性修正的框架。
AI.method: ParseFixer包含两个核心模块：1)全页骨干解析(FBP)使用MinerU2.5 Pro生成稳定的初始Markdown输出；2)智能体选择性校正(ASC)检测高价值解析失败并通过验证-回滚校正流程进行修复。在开源骨干解析之后放置选择性多模态校正。
AI.result: 在测试集上总体得分61.78，在Track 1中排名第三，证明了其有效性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: ParseFixer通过将选择性多模态校正置于开源骨干解析之后，在不重写可靠骨干预测的前提下提升了关键文档元素的恢复质量，为文档解析任务提供了一种有效的agentic框架方案。

title: uva-irlab-conv at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Multi-Turn RAG with Learned Sparse Retrieval and Listwise Reranking
comment: SemEval-2026, The 20th International Workshop on Semantic Evaluation, collocated with ACL 2026, 9 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: This report describes our participation in SemEval-2026 Task 8 on multi-turn retrieval and question answering. The task evaluates conversational systems across four domains (finance, cloud documentation, government, Wikipedia), and includes unanswerable queries where the available collection does not contain sufficient evidence to produce a complete response. We propose a multi-turn retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that combines learned sparse retrieval with LLM-based reranking and generation. Using sparse retrieval as the primary retrieval method, we leverage its strong generalization across domains. In addition, we make use of the long-context capabilities of LLMs for conversational query rewriting, pointwise and listwise reranking, and generating the final response, each conditioned on the full conversational history. This multi-step design enables effective integration of conversational context throughout retrieval and generation, improving robustness across domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合学习型稀疏检索与LLM重排序/生成的多轮RAG流水线，用于SemEval-2026 Task 8的多轮检索和问答任务，涵盖金融、云文档、政府和Wikipedia四个领域，并支持不可回答查询的处理。
AI.motivation: 现有会话系统在多领域跨域泛化、处理不可回答查询以及有效整合会话历史方面存在不足，需要一种能在检索和生成阶段均充分利用多轮对话上下文的鲁棒方案。
AI.method: 提出多轮RAG流水线：(1) 采用学习型稀疏检索作为主要检索方法，利用其跨域泛化能力；(2) 利用LLM的长上下文能力进行对话查询改写；(3) 进行pointwise和listwise重排序；(4) 基于完整对话历史生成最终回答。
AI.result: 该多步设计在四个领域（金融、云文档、政府、Wikipedia）上均有效提升了跨域鲁棒性，并能处理不可回答查询场景。
AI.conclusion: 多步检索-重排序-生成的流水线能够有效将对话上下文整合到检索和生成全过程，从而提升跨领域会话系统的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: From Nominal Intensity to Equivalent Rainfall: A Path-Based Credibility Evaluation Framework for Simulated Rainfall in Autonomous-Driving Perception Tests
summary: Credible simulated-rainfall conditions are essential for identifying perception-system boundaries and supporting SOTIF-oriented risk assessment in automated driving. However, closed-field tests are often described only by nominal rainfall intensity or single-point measurements, making it difficult to align simulated rain fields with real rainfall and map test results to real-world scenarios. This paper proposes a path-based credibility evaluation method for simulated rainfall in autonomous-driving perception tests. Using the drop size and velocity joint distribution of real rainfall as the reference, each candidate path is represented by path-equivalent rainfall intensity, an uncertainty band, and a path-averaged Realism of Raindrop Distribution (RRD) score. Lidar target point-cloud count and mean reflectivity are further used for perception-consistency correction, quantifying the proxy capability of each simulated-rainfall path for real-rainfall perception effects. Experiments are conducted using about 10,000 real-rainfall raindrop-spectrum samples, 728 RainSense perception samples, and 45 spatial sampling points in a 2.4 m x 7.2 m simulated-rainfall area. Results show that spatial non-uniformity remains under the same nominal condition, confirming the need for path-based evaluation. The method identifies Path IV and Path VI as preferable candidates, with results of 11.54 +/- 0.31 mm/h, RRD = 0.43, and 8.28 +/- 0.34 mm/h, RRD = 0.46, respectively. These paths show more balanced performance in rainfall-intensity stability, raindrop-spectrum realism, and perception consistency. The proposed method supports path selection, condition description, and credible interpretation of autonomous-driving perception tests under rainfall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于路径的模拟降雨可信度评估方法，用于自动驾驶感知测试。通过实际降雨的雨滴谱数据作为参考，利用路径等效降雨强度、不确定带和路径平均RRD分数表征各候选路径，再结合激光雷达点云计数和平均反射率进行感知一致性校正。实验表明空间非均匀性存在，识别出Path IV和Path VI为优选路径，在降雨强度稳定性、雨滴谱真实性和感知一致性方面表现更均衡。
AI.motivation: 封闭场测试中模拟降雨条件通常仅用名义降雨强度或单点测量描述，导致模拟降雨场与实际降雨难以对齐，测试结果难以映射到真实场景，缺乏系统的可信度评估方法。
AI.method: 以实际降雨的雨滴尺寸和速度联合分布为参考，用路径等效降雨强度、不确定带和路径平均RRD分数表征候选路径，并采用激光雷达目标点云计数和平均反射率进行感知一致性校正，量化各模拟降雨路径对真实降雨感知效果的代理能力。
AI.result: 基于约10,000个实际雨滴谱样本、728个RainSense感知样本和2.4m×7.2m区域内45个空间采样点进行实验。结果表明相同名义条件下存在空间非均匀性，Path IV (11.54±0.31 mm/h, RRD=0.43) 和Path VI (8.28±0.34 mm/h, RRD=0.46) 为优选路径。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持自动驾驶降雨感知测试的路径选择、条件描述和可信解读，填补了模拟降雨与真实降雨之间可信度评估的空白。

title: Decoding Multimodal Cues: Unveiling the Implicit Meaning Behind Hateful Videos
summary: Hateful videos have become prevalent on online platforms, highlighting an urgent need for effective detection. However, existing studies primarily focus on binary classification and fail to provide contextual rationales that reveal the implicit meanings behind these judgments, significantly undermining model explainability. To fill this gap, we aim to achieve explainable hateful video detection, enabling models to provide contextual rationales that integrate relevant evidence and logical reasoning alongside decisions. This approach can comprehensively enhance the understanding of video content and the explainability of the decision-making process. We first introduce two datasets, Ex-HateMM and Ex-ImpliHateVid, for explainable hateful video detection. Each dataset provides fine-grained annotations of multimodal harmful elements, along with contextual rationales. We then propose an Information Augmentation and Reasoning Enhancement (IARE) framework designed for explainable detection. The framework employs an information augmentation phase that leverages the multimodal chain-of-thought to integrate harmful elements, thereby enriching rationale evidence. Additionally, IARE incorporates a reasoning enhancement phase, in which Direct Preference Optimization guides the model toward correct reasoning paths and away from incorrect ones, thereby improving the logical coherence of its justifications. We conduct extensive experiments on the two datasets, comparing multiple baselines with our proposed IARE framework. The results demonstrate that IARE achieves state-of-the-art performance while also generating accurate rationales.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可解释的仇恨视频检测任务，提出了Ex-HateMM和Ex-ImpliHateVid两个细粒度标注数据集，以及信息增强与推理优化（IARE）框架，该框架通过多模态思维链增强证据、利用直接偏好优化提升推理逻辑性，在两个数据集上取得了SOTA性能并生成了准确的解释性依据。
AI.motivation: 现有仇恨视频检测主要聚焦于二分类，无法提供揭示判断背后隐含含义的上下文解释依据，严重缺乏模型可解释性。
AI.method: 提出IARE框架，包含信息增强阶段（利用多模态思维链整合有害元素以丰富解释证据）和推理优化阶段（使用直接偏好优化引导模型走向正确推理路径、远离错误路径）。同时构建了两个带有细粒度多模态有害元素标注和上下文解释依据的数据集。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上的大量实验表明，IARE框架达到了SOTA性能，同时生成了准确的解释依据。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入可解释的仇恨视频检测任务，结合细粒度数据集和IARE框架，能够同时实现高性能检测和具备逻辑连贯性的可解释依据生成，显著提升模型可解释性。

title: FitVTON: Fit-aware Virtual Try-On via Body-Garment Size Control
summary: While diffusion-based virtual try-on has achieved impressive visual realism, most methods treat the task as 2D inpainting, prioritizing texture preservation over physical plausibility. Consequently, they often produce plausible-looking images that fail to reflect authentic garment fit across diverse body shapes. We present FitVTON, a Fit-aware virtual try-on model on different bodies in the wild. FitVTON encodes garment-body size through structured text prompts, and learn from simulated try-on triplets from parameterized garment model. To improve the fitting effects over garment silhouettes, we introduce two auxiliary head to predict the masks for both the garment and the exposed body. We further introduce a texture rectification stage to improve realistic appearance from simulated data. To evaluate the fitting fidelity, we curate a real-world dataset, FittingEffect3K, combining VLM-based scoring protocol. Both subjective and quantitive experiments show that FitVTON demonstrate authentic fitting fidelity, with significant sizing accuracy and shape preservation over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining competitive image quality. Project Page: https://zenoning.github.io/FitVTON/.

AI.tldr: FitVTON是一种基于扩散模型的体型感知虚拟试穿方法，通过结构化文本提示编码衣物-身体尺寸关系、参数化服装模型的模拟试穿三元组训练、双辅助头预测掩码以及纹理校正阶段，在保持图像质量的同时显著提升了不同体型下的穿搭真实性和合身度。研究还构建了FittingEffect3K真实数据集和VLM评分协议用于评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的虚拟试穿方法大多将任务视为2D修补问题，优先考虑纹理保持而非物理合理性，导致生成的图像虽视觉逼真但无法反映不同体型下衣物的真实贴合效果。
AI.method: 1) 通过结构化文本提示编码衣物与身体之间的尺寸关系；2) 利用参数化服装模型生成模拟试穿三元组进行训练；3) 引入两个辅助头分别预测衣物和暴露身体的掩码以改善衣物轮廓贴合效果；4) 设计纹理校正阶段提升模拟数据的真实感。
AI.result: 在主观和客观实验上，FitVTON相比现有最先进方法展现出更真实的贴合保真度、显著的尺寸准确性和形状保持能力，同时保持具有竞争力的图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过体型感知的建模和模拟-校正训练策略，FitVTON有效解决了虚拟试穿中物理合理性的关键问题，为不同体型用户提供更真实的试穿体验。

title: Agreement in Representation Space for Open-Ended Self-Consistency
summary: Self-consistency improves LLM reasoning by sampling multiple outputs and selecting the most consistent answer, but existing formulations largely rely on exact matching and therefore remain limited to tasks with categorical outputs. In this work, we study self-consistency in open-ended generation tasks such as code synthesis and text summarization. We hypothesize that consistency can be understood as a geometric property of the generation space, where semantically compatible generations concentrate in similar regions of representation space. To study this hypothesis, we introduce Embedding-Based Agreement (EBA), a simple training-free operationalization that estimates agreement by clustering sampled generations in embedding space. Through experiments on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and summarization, we show that agreement in representation space provides a robust and scalable signal of self-consistency for open-ended tasks. In particular, EBA consistently outperforms random selection and exhibits more stable scaling behavior than recent selection approaches based on LLM evaluation or uncertainty estimation. We further show that these agreement signals remain stable across model families and embedding spaces, even with native hidden representations. Finally, our analysis shows that the geometric location occupied by sampled generations is strongly correlated with generation quality: generations concentrated near central regions of representation space tend to correspond to more reliable outputs, whereas peripheral generations are substantially less accurate. Overall, our findings support viewing self-consistency as a property of the geometric organization of sampled generations rather than exact symbolic overlap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于嵌入空间聚类的自一致性方法EBA，将自一致性从精确匹配扩展至开放式生成任务，实验表明表示空间中的几何一致性可作为鲁棒的信号，且采样生成位于中心区域的质量更高。
AI.motivation: 现有自一致性方法依赖精确匹配，仅限于分类输出任务，无法应用于代码合成、文本摘要等开放式生成任务。本文旨在将自一致性推广到开放式场景。
AI.method: 提出Embedding-Based Agreement (EBA)，一种无需训练的方案，通过对采样生成的输出进行嵌入空间聚类来估计一致性程度，利用表示空间的几何结构而非符号匹配来衡量一致性。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和摘要任务上，EBA优于随机选择，且比基于LLM评估或不确定性估计的方法展现出更稳定的扩展行为；一致性信号在不同模型族和嵌入空间（包括原生隐层表示）中保持稳定；位于表示空间中心区域的生成质量显著高于边缘区域。
AI.conclusion: 自一致性应被视为采样生成在表示空间中几何组织的性质，而非精确符号重叠；表示空间中的一致性为开放式任务提供了鲁棒且可扩展的信号。

title: ViT-FREE: Efficient Face Recognition via Early Exiting and Synthetic Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (2026)
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have gained significant attention in computer vision and shown strong potential for face recognition (FR). However, their high computational cost makes deployment on resource-constrained devices challenging, motivating the need for methods that balance efficiency and accuracy. In this work, we investigate early exiting in pretrained ViTs as a simple yet effective training-free strategy for efficient FR inference. Leveraging the uniform feature dimensionality across transformer encoder blocks, we introduce ViT-FREE, a multi-exit framework that enables face verification directly from intermediate representations without modifying or retraining the backbone model, and thus, reducing inference cost. Empirically, we show that patch embeddings and attention maps evolve progressively across depth, exhibiting high similarity between consecutive ViT blocks and increasing alignment with the final representation. This indicates gradual feature refinement and attention convergence, suggesting that intermediate layers already provide stable and discriminative representations suitable for early exiting. Through extensive experiments on multiple FR benchmarks, we systematically analyze the accuracy-efficiency trade-off across exit depths. Our results demonstrate that later exits achieve a highly favorable balance, with exiting at layer 10 yielding up to a 20% speedup while incurring only a 1.5 drop in verification performance on benchmarks such as IJB-C. Also, we propose ViT-FREE_FT, a lightweight exit-specific fine-tuning strategy that adapts only the projection layers using a small synthetic dataset while keeping the transformer backbone frozen. This approach improves the performance of shallow exits while preserving the efficiency benefits and leaving deeper exits largely unaffected.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViT-FREE，一种基于预训练ViT的早期退出策略，在不重新训练模型的情况下，通过中间层特征进行人脸验证，实现推理加速（第10层退出可获20%加速，仅损失1.5%性能），并提出了轻量级微调方法ViT-FREE_FT以提升浅层退出性能。
AI.motivation: ViT在面部识别中表现出色，但其高计算成本限制了在资源受限设备上的部署。迫切需要一种能平衡效率与准确性的方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用ViT各编码器块特征维度一致性，构建多退出框架ViT-FREE，直接从中层表示进行人脸验证，无需修改或重训练主干。2) 提出ViT-FREE_FT，仅微调解耦投影层（使用小规模合成数据），冻结主干，提升浅层退出性能。
AI.result: 在第10层退出时，获得高达20%的速度提升，同时验证性能仅下降1.5%（IJB-C基准）。ViT-FREE_FT有效改善了浅层退出的性能，且不影响深层退出。
AI.conclusion: 预训练ViT的中间层已具备足够的判别性特征用于早期退出，通过适当的退出策略和轻量微调，可在保证高精度的前提下显著降低推理成本。

title: StanceNakba Shared Task: Actor and Topic-Aware Stance Detection in Public Discourse
summary: We present StanceNakba 2026, a shared task on stance detection in polarized social media discourse related to the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, organized as part of Nakba-NLP 2026 at LREC-COLING 2026. The task introduces two subtasks: Subtask A (Actor-Level Stance Detection), which classifies English social media posts as Pro-Palestine, Pro-Israel, or Neutral; and Subtask B (Cross-Topic Stance Detection), which identifies Favor, Against, or Neither stances in Arabic posts toward two conflict-related topics, normalization with Israel and refugee presence in Jordan. The task is grounded in an annotated dataset of 2,606 social media posts. A total of 7 teams participated in Subtask A and 6 teams in Subtask B. Participating systems primarily fine-tuned Arabic and multilingual transformer-based models, including MARBERT, AraBERT, and DeBERTa-v3 variants, with several teams employing cross-validation, ensemble methods, and topic-conditioned architectures. The best-performing systems achieved a Macro F1 of 0.9620 on Subtask A and 0.8724 on Subtask B, demonstrating that transformer-based approaches are highly effective for conflict-domain stance detection while highlighting persistent challenges in cross-topic generalization and neutral class prediction.

AI.tldr: StanceNakba 2026是一项关于巴以冲突相关社交媒体立场检测的共享任务，包含两个子任务：基于英语帖文的行动者级别立场检测（Subtask A）和基于阿拉伯语帖文的跨主题立场检测（Subtask B）。7支队伍参与Subtask A，6支参与Subtask B，最佳系统在Macro F1上分别达到0.9620和0.8724。主要方法为微调MARBERT、AraBERT、DeBERTa-v3等Transformer模型，采用交叉验证、集成学习和主题条件架构。
AI.motivation: 在高度极化的巴以冲突社交媒体话语中，立场检测面临标注数据稀缺、跨主题泛化困难、中立类别预测挑战等问题，现有研究缺乏针对该领域多语言、多粒度的系统性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建包含2,606条社交媒体帖文的标注数据集，设置两个子任务：Subtask A对英语帖文进行亲巴勒斯坦、亲以色列或中立三分类；Subtask B对阿拉伯语帖文针对两个冲突相关主题（与以色列正常化、约旦难民存在）进行赞成、反对或中立三分类。参与系统主要微调MARBERT、AraBERT、DeBERTa-v3等Transformer模型，采用交叉验证、集成方法和主题条件架构。
AI.result: Subtask A最佳系统Macro F1为0.9620，Subtask B最佳系统Macro F1为0.8724。Transformer方法在冲突领域立场检测中表现高效，但跨主题泛化和中性类别预测仍是持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型在冲突领域立场检测中具有高效性，但跨主题泛化能力和中立类别预测仍需进一步改进。

title: SpikeTAD: Spiking Neural Networks for End-to-End Temporal Action Detection
summary: Video understanding is a crucial part of computer vision, with numerous application scenarios. With the increasing popularity of mobile devices, an increasing number of efforts are trying to deploy video understanding models on them. However, existing video understanding models are difficult to deploy due to their large size and prohibitive power consumption. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown bioplausibility and low power advantages over Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), especially on neuromorphic chips which are regarded as essential components of future mobile devices. However, excessively long conversion time-steps and severe performance degradation problems limit their application. To solve the problems above, we explore the application of SNNs on temporal action detection (TAD), which is an important task in video understanding, and propose the first SNN-based end-to-end TAD architecture coined as SpikeTAD. While maintaining extremely low power consumption, SpikeTAD achieves an average mAP of 67.2% in THUMOS14 and 37.42% in ActivityNet-1.3, demonstrating the feasibility of a low-power TAD model. Our code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SpikeTAD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于脉冲神经网络(SNN)的端到端时序动作检测(TAD)架构SpikeTAD，在保持超低功耗的同时，在THUMOS14和ActivityNet-1.3数据集上分别达到67.2%和37.42%的平均mAP，解决了现有视频理解模型难以在移动设备部署以及SNN转换时间步长过长和性能退化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解模型体积大、功耗高，难以部署在移动设备上；而SNN虽具低功耗优势，但存在转换时间步长过长和性能退化严重的问题，限制了其在时序动作检测任务上的应用。
AI.method: 提出SpikeTAD架构，这是首个基于SNN的端到端时序动作检测模型，利用SNN的生物 plausibility和低功耗特性，设计适合TAD任务的网络结构。
AI.result: 在THUMOS14数据集上达到67.2%的平均mAP，在ActivityNet-1.3数据集上达到37.42%的平均mAP，同时维持极低的功耗水平。
AI.conclusion: SpikeTAD证明了低功耗时序动作检测模型的可行性，为SNN在视频理解领域特别是移动设备上的应用开辟了新路径。

title: FORT-Searcher: Synthesizing Shortcut-Resistant Search Tasks for Training Deep Search Agents
summary: Training deep search agents requires verifiable questions whose answers remain unavailable until sufficient evidence has been acquired through search. Existing synthesis methods often increase apparent difficulty by enriching graph structures, but structural complexity alone does not guarantee realized search difficulty: the intended search process can collapse through a cheaper identifying route. We formalize this gap with a shortcut-aware difficulty framework and identify four actionable shortcut risks: evidence co-coverage, single-clue selectivity, exposed constants, and prior-knowledge binding. To diagnose their realized effects, we use trajectory signatures including solving cost, answer hit time, and prior-shortcut rate. Guided by this framework, we introduce FORT, a Framework of Shortcut-Resistant Training-Data Synthesis. FORT constructs shortcut-resistant training data by controlling shortcut risks across entity selection, evidence graph construction, question formulation, and adversarial refinement. Experiments show that FORT induces longer pre-answer search and fewer shortcut patterns than existing open-source deep search datasets. Using the resulting trajectories, we train FORT-Searcher with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) only, and it achieves the best overall performance among comparable-size open-source search agents on challenging deep search benchmarks. Relevant resources will be made available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/FORT-Searcher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出短路感知的困难框架和FORT方法，通过控制四种短路风险（证据共覆盖、单线索选择性、暴露常量、先验知识绑定）来构建抗短路的训练数据，仅用SFT训练的FORT-Searcher在深度搜索基准上达到开源模型最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索智能体的训练数据合成方法通过丰富图结构来增加难度，但结构复杂性并不能保证真正的搜索难度，因为存在更廉价的识别路径（短路）使得预期的搜索过程失效。本文旨在形式化这一差距并提供解决方案。
AI.method: 提出FORT（抗短路训练数据合成框架），通过控制四种短路风险（证据共覆盖、单线索选择性、暴露常量、先验知识绑定）进行实体选择、证据图构建、问题表述和对抗性精炼，生成抗短路的训练数据。
AI.result: FORT生成的数据相比现有开源深度搜索数据集，能诱导更长的搜索前推理和更少的短路模式。基于此训练的FORT-Searcher（仅SFT）在具有挑战性的深度搜索基准上达到同等规模开源模型的最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 形式化定义了深度搜索中的短路风险，并证明通过系统化控制这些风险可以显著提升训练数据质量和搜索智能体的搜索深度与效果。

title: Vision Transformers for Face Recognition Need More Registers
comment: Accepted at the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (2026)
summary: Recent advances in Vision Transformers (ViTs) for face recognition (FR) have moved beyond the standard CLS-token paradigm. In this paradigm, a special classification token (CLS) is prepended to the patch embeddings and used as a representation of the input for downstream tasks. An alternative approach, Concatenated Patch Embeddings (CPE), instead leverages all patch tokens by concatenating them into a single vector, which is then projected into a compact face representation. CPE has been shown to improve recognition performance in comparison to CLS-based ones, but our qualitative analysis of attention maps showed the presence of artifacts that limit their interpretability. To address this issue, we incorporate register tokens, learnable tokens concatenated to the initial patch embeddings, and processed jointly through the ViT encoder blocks. This mechanism has been shown to produce more structured and interpretable attention maps compared to baseline ViT. We empirically demonstrate that these artifacts consistently appear across various ViT backbones, including small and large models, and that introducing register tokens effectively mitigates them. Adding four or eight registers significantly enhances interpretability, with eight registers providing the highest verification accuracies and smoothest attention structures. Our resulting model, ViT-8R, corresponds to a CPE-based ViT-B architecture augmented with eight register tokens achieves state-of-the-art performance among ViT-based FR models on large-scale IJB-B and IJB-C benchmarks. Also, ViT-8R produces substantially clearer attention maps compared with the baseline model, which offer deeper insight into the model's attention behavior (https://github.com/TaharChettaoui/ViT-FR-Registers)

AI.tldr: 本文针对ViT在人脸识别中采用CLS-token范式时注意力图存在伪影的问题，提出通过引入register tokens（可学习标记）来改善注意力图的结构化和可解释性。实验表明，添加4或8个register tokens能显著提升可解释性，其中8个寄存器的ViT-8R模型在IJB-B和IJB-C基准上达到了ViT-based FR模型的SOTA性能，同时生成更清晰的注意力图。
AI.motivation: CPE（拼接补丁嵌入）方法相比CLS-token范式在人脸识别中表现更好，但其注意力图存在伪影，限制了模型的可解释性。现有工作未系统解决这一问题。
AI.method: 在CPE-based ViT中引入register tokens（可学习标记），将其与初始补丁嵌入拼接，通过ViT编码器块联合处理。通过4或8个寄存器标记来缓解注意力伪影。
AI.result: ViT-8R（ViT-B + 8个register tokens）在IJB-B和IJB-C上达到ViT-based FR模型的SOTA性能；注意力图显著更清晰、结构化，伪影得到有效消除。
AI.conclusion: Register tokens能有效解决ViT人脸识别模型中注意力图伪影问题，同时提升识别性能与可解释性，为ViT在FR领域的应用提供了新的改进方向。

title: Debiasing Without Protected Attributes: Latent Concept Erasure from Textual Profiles
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. The paper is currently under review
summary: Most fairness research in NLP assumes direct access to protected attributes such as gender, race, or nationality. In practice, however, such information is often unavailable due to privacy constraints, missing metadata, or legal restrictions, even though models may infer it from indirect textual cues. This raises a key question: can debiasing succeed without direct access to sensitive attributes? We propose H-SAL, which performs post-hoc concept and attribute erasure using self-description text as an implicit debiasing signal. To support this setting, we introduce a multi-domain Stack Exchange-based fairness benchmark for helpfulness prediction that includes both explicit and implicit signals, enabling comparison between standard debiasing with protected labels and debiasing without access to sensitive information. Across encoder and decoder-only language models, we find that implicit self-description often matches or outperforms explicit-label-based debiasing. Our results broaden representation-level fairness research and provide a new benchmark for studying debiasing under realistic data constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出H-SAL方法，利用自我描述文本作为隐式去偏信号，在没有直接访问敏感属性（如性别、种族）的情况下实现去偏。在Stack Exchange多领域公平性基准上，隐式去偏效果往往匹配或超越基于显式标签的去偏方法。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中受隐私、法律或元数据缺失等因素制约，敏感属性往往不可直接获取，但模型仍可能从文本线索中推断出这些信息。需要探索不依赖显式敏感属性的去偏方法。
AI.method: 提出H-SAL（事后概念和属性擦除），利用自我描述文本作为隐式去偏信号；构建基于Stack Exchange的多领域公平性基准，包含显式标签和隐式信号两种设置。
AI.result: 在编码器型和仅解码器型语言模型上，基于自我描述的隐式去偏在多数场景下匹配或超越了基于显式敏感标签的去偏效果。
AI.conclusion: 扩展了表征层面的公平性研究，在现实数据约束下为无敏感属性访问的去偏任务提供了新的基准和方法。

title: Metadata-Aware Multi-Prompt Reasoning for Zero-Shot Accident Understanding
comment: Accepted at the AUTOPILOT Workshop, CVPR 2026 (non-archival). Workshop Paper ID 15
summary: In this paper, we address the problem of zero-shot understanding of accidents from surveillance videos by identifying when an impact event occurs, what type of impact it is, and where in the frame it occurs using natural language. We propose a three-stage pipeline that decomposes the accident understanding into when, what, and where. The first stage extracts a short temporal window around the impact using vision-language similarity. In the second stage, we perform metadata-driven multi-prompt reasoning with five complementary views (baseline, motion, geometry, contrast, and tiebreaker) and resolve disagreement via an entropy-gated pairwise adjudicator. Finally, we localize the impact of an open-vocabulary detector queried on the predicted accident type and scene layout, and aggregate detections across keyframes using a score-weighted centroid. Our pipeline achieves a substantial improvement in the harmonic-mean score over a centre-of-frame baseline on the zero-shot ACCIDENT @ CVPR benchmark. We show that decomposing zero-shot video understanding into temporal localization, semantic classification, and spatial grounding enable more reliable reasoning with vision-language models than direct prompting alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种三阶段流水线方法，用于从监控视频中零样本理解事故，通过自然语言识别碰撞事件的发生时间、类型和空间位置。该方法在零样本ACCIDENT@CVPR基准上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 解决监控视频中事故的零样本理解问题，即在没有针对特定事故类型训练的情况下，自动识别碰撞事件的发生时间、类型和空间位置。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流水线：(1) 利用视觉-语言相似性提取碰撞周围的短时间窗口；(2) 使用元数据驱动的多提示推理，包含五个互补视角（基线、运动、几何、对比、决胜），并通过熵门控成对裁决器解决分歧；(3) 利用开放词汇检测器基于预测的事故类型和场景布局定位碰撞，并通过得分加权质心聚合关键帧检测结果。
AI.result: 在零样本ACCIDENT@CVPR基准上，该流水线的调和平均分相比中心帧基线有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将零样本视频理解分解为时间定位、语义分类和空间定位，相比直接提示视觉-语言模型能实现更可靠的推理。

title: Augmenting Molecular Language Models with Local $n$-gram Memory
summary: Transformer-based language models for SMILES strings suffer from a locality gap: standard character-level tokenization fragments chemically meaningful motifs, forcing models to repeatedly learn local syntax at the expense of long-range dependencies. To address this without disrupting standard tokenizers, we propose MolGram, which integrates a conditional $n$-gram memory module into molecular language models. MolGram maps local string patterns to learned embeddings via scalable hash lookups and dynamically injects this regional context into hidden states. Evaluations across three tasks, including unconditional molecule generation, forward reaction prediction, and single-step retrosynthesis, show that MolGram consistently improves performance. Crucially, our analyses demonstrate that MolGram outperforms baselines with 3$\times$ more parameters, establishing explicit local pattern memory as a highly efficient inductive bias.

AI.tldr: MolGram通过在分子语言模型中集成条件n-gram记忆模块，以哈希查找方式编码局部字符串模式并动态注入隐状态，在不破坏标准分词器的情况下解决了SMILES字符级分词导致的局部性差距，在分子生成、正向反应预测和单步逆合成三项任务上一致提升性能，且仅需基线模型1/3的参数即可超越其效果。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的SMILES字符串语言模型存在局部性差距：标准字符级分词会破坏化学上有意义的基团（motifs），迫使模型反复学习局部语法规则，从而牺牲了长距离依赖关系的建模能力。
AI.method: MolGram提出一个条件n-gram记忆模块：通过可扩展的哈希查找将局部字符串模式映射为学习到的嵌入，并将这种局部上下文动态注入到Transformer的隐状态中，从而在不破坏标准分词器的情况下引入显式的局部模式记忆。
AI.result: 在无条件分子生成、正向反应预测和单步逆合成三项任务上，MolGram均一致提升了性能。关键分析表明，MolGram以3倍少的参数超越基线模型，证明显式局部模式记忆是一种高效归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: 显式局部模式记忆作为归纳偏置在分子语言模型中非常高效，能以更少参数获得更好性能，验证了该方法在化学信息学中的有效性。

title: MFEN:Multi-Frequency Expert Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-ID
summary: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) is challenging due to the large modality discrepancy between visible and infrared images. We contend that this discrepancy is largely related to differing lighting conditions, including differences in light wavelength and light source type. Recently, frequency-based VI-ReID approaches have achieved notable success because frequency information can better extract identity-relevant contours and details while excluding irrelevant lighting and color. However, existing methods either do not distinguish different frequency bands or focus on only one band, which is insufficient under diverse lighting conditions. To perform comprehensive frequency domain learning, we propose a Multi-Frequency Expert Network (MFEN) that enables multi-frequency modulation and adaptively combines different bands through a mixture-of-experts design. We further introduce Random Frequency Augmentation (RFA) and Frequency Auxiliary Optimization (FAO) to better train MFEN. The three modules are complementary and jointly capture critical frequency-domain details for robust representation learning. Extensive experiments on three VI-ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多频专家网络（MFEN），通过混合专家设计对不同频率波段进行自适应调制与组合，并引入随机频率增强（RFA）和频率辅助优化（FAO）来应对可见光-红外行人重识别中的模态差异问题，在三个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 可见光与红外图像之间的模态差异主要来源于光照条件（波长、光源类型）的差异，现有基于频率的方法要么不区分频带，要么只关注单一频带，无法在多样化光照条件下充分学习。
AI.method: 提出多频专家网络（MFEN），采用混合专家（MoE）设计对不同频率波段进行自适应调制与组合；同时引入随机频率增强（RFA）和频率辅助优化（FAO）来辅助训练。
AI.result: 在三个VI-ReID数据集上的大量实验证明了该方法的效果。
AI.conclusion: MFEN的三个模块互补，共同捕获关键的频域细节以实现鲁棒的表征学习，有效缓解了可见光-红外模态差异问题。

title: Detecting Sensitive Personal Information in Japanese Pre-Training Corpora for Large Language Models
summary: Sensitive personal information can appear in large-scale pre-training corpora for large language models (LLMs). Detecting and filtering such information is therefore essential to ensure compliance with privacy regulations and prevent unintended information leakage. However, in contrast to English and other languages, research into sensitive personal information has been limited in the Japanese language. In this study, we focus on sensitive personal data defined as special care-required personal information (SCPI) under Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI). We construct an SCPI dataset using LLM-based annotation and train machine learning models to rapidly detect SCPI in text. As a result, our SCPI classifier can effectively identify information related to SCPI. This study is the first to explore SCPI detection in Japanese text corpora, highlighting the challenges of accurate detection.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对日本《个人信息保护法》中定义的“需特殊照顾的个人信息”（SCPI），利用基于LLM的标注构建了SCPI数据集，并训练机器学习模型以快速检测文本中的SCPI。这是首次探索日语语料库中SCPI检测的研究，强调了准确检测的挑战。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练语料中可能包含敏感个人信息，需要检测和过滤以确保隐私合规并防止信息泄露，但日语领域相关研究有限。
AI.method: 基于LLM的标注构建SCPI数据集，训练机器学习模型进行快速检测。
AI.result: 所训练的SCPI分类器能够有效识别与SCPI相关的信息。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次探索日语文本语料库中SCPI检测的研究，揭示了准确检测面临的挑战。

title: Performance Analysis of YOLOv11 and YOLOv8 for Mixed Traffic Object Detection under Adverse Weather Conditions in Developing Countries
summary: In modern vehicular systems, robust performance under harsh conditions has become a critical problem of autonomous driving. Our study delivers a comprehensive evaluation of the newest iteration of the YOLO series, which is YOLOv11 Nano architecture benchmarked against the widely adopted YOLOv8 Nano as a baseline on a custom fused dataset that combines the Indian Driving Dataset (IDD) [1] and Berkeley Deep Drive Dataset (BDD100K) [2]. We have analyzed the trade-offs among detection accuracy, inference speed, and computational efficiency in high-entropy scenarios involving dense mixed traffic, rain, and low-light conditions. Specifically, YOLOv11n achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP@50) of 46.6%, with a notable 3.2% improvement in Precision over the baseline, effectively reducing false positives in cluttered scenes. Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits enhanced energy efficiency, requiring 22% fewer FLOPs (6.3G vs. 8.1G) while maintaining real-time inference speed of 70.9 FPS on a Tesla T4 GPU, offering an optimal trade-off for safety-critical edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究对YOLOv11 Nano与YOLOv8 Nano架构在自动驾驶场景下进行综合评估，使用融合IDD和BDD100K的自定义数据集。YOLOv11n在mAP@50达到46.6%，精确率提升3.2%，FLOPs减少22%（6.3G vs 8.1G），推理速度70.9 FPS，在密集混合交通、雨天和低光照等场景中实现了检测精度、推理速度与计算效率的最优权衡。
AI.motivation: 现代车辆系统在恶劣条件下实现鲁棒性能已成为自动驾驶的关键问题，需要对YOLO系列最新架构进行全面的性能评估。
AI.method: 将YOLOv11 Nano与YOLOv8 Nano在融合IDD和BDD100K的自定义数据集上进行基准对比，分析高熵场景（密集混合交通、雨天、低光照）下的检测精度、推理速度和计算效率之间的权衡。
AI.result: YOLOv11n在mAP@50达到46.6%，精确率较基线提升3.2%；FLOPs降低22%（6.3G vs 8.1G）；在Tesla T4 GPU上实现70.9 FPS的实时推理速度。
AI.conclusion: YOLOv11n在减少计算开销的同时提升了检测精度，为安全关键的边缘部署提供了最优权衡方案。

title: Soft-Prompt Tuning for Fair and Efficient LLM Benchmark Evaluation
summary: Benchmark scores often misrepresent a large language model's (LLM's) knowledge, because they rely, e.g., on the model's ability to follow specific formatting requirements. This especially penalizes base models that may know the correct answers but lack the ability -- typically introduced in post-training -- to structure them as instructed. To overcome this, we propose soft-prompt tuning, an efficient, fair, and architecture-agnostic model evaluation. By optimizing only 10 soft-prompt vectors (roughly 0.0006% parameters for a 7B model) over a short tuning period, we adapt models to specific benchmark formats, closing gaps in format-following and ensuring that underlying knowledge is accurately reflected in benchmark scores. This allows one to fairly compare different base models -- trained with various pre-training recipes -- on benchmarks without the need for full post-training. We evaluated soft-prompt tuning across 7 models and 7 datasets. The results show that (a) soft-prompt tuning saturates format-following within 80 steps (~640 samples) making it highly efficient, (b) soft-prompt tuning significantly outperforms zero- and few-shot prompting, surfacing base model knowledge that standard prompting misses, that (c) even post-trained models can benefit from soft-prompts to maximize format compliance, and that (d) soft-prompted base model performance predicts post-trained model rankings more reliably than zero- and few-shot baselines, offering a low-cost proxy for downstream model quality. Our contributions include (1) metrics which disentangle format-following and knowledge accuracy, (2) a fairer benchmarking protocol of LLM knowledge, and (3) a cost- and memory-effective recipe to identify optimal pre-training strategies early in LLM development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出软提示调优（soft-prompt tuning），通过仅优化10个软提示向量（约0.0006%参数）在80步内使基础模型适应评估格式，从而更公平地衡量LLM的真实知识水平，避免格式遵循能力差异对基准分数的污染。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试分数常因模型格式遵循能力差异而扭曲对LLM真实知识的评估，基础模型虽掌握正确答案却因缺乏后训练中的格式对齐能力而得分偏低，导致评估不公平。
AI.method: 提出软提示调优方法：仅优化10个软提示向量（约0.0006%参数，7B模型），在80步（约640样本）内快速适配模型至特定评估格式，无需完整后训练。同时设计了分离格式遵循与知识准确度的评估指标。
AI.result: 在7个模型和7个数据集上的实验表明：(a) 软提示调优在80步内饱和格式遵循能力；(b) 显著优于零样本和少样本提示，挖掘出标准提示遗漏的基础模型知识；(c) 后训练模型也可受益；(d) 软提示调优后的基础模型性能比零/少样本基线更可靠地预测后训练模型排名。
AI.conclusion: 软提示调优是一种高效、公平且架构无关的模型评估方法，可消除格式遵循差距，为LLM开发早期识别最优预训练策略提供低成本代理指标。

title: Tac-DINO: Learning Vision-Tactile Features with Patch Alignment
summary: Touch is the primary medium through which humans interact with the environment. Currently, tactile learning mainly focuses on image-level pretraining or alignment. However, tactile signals correspond to local object contact, while research into scale alignment and holographic matching remains limited and proper datasets and benchmarks also lack. To bridge this gap, we first construct a data collection system to acquire a large-scale tactile dataset, with over 20 K tactile contacts from 505 real-world objects. Building on this dataset, we design a Vis-Tac Holographic Matching Benchmark to evaluate vision-tactile local-to-global alignment ability. Then we propose Vision-Tactile Patch Alignment (VTPA) methods for vision-tactile representation learning. Experiments demonstrate that these exceed the performance of methods without alignment and align with whole-object images.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含505个真实物体、超过2万次触觉接触的大规模触觉数据集，设计了视觉-触觉全息匹配基准来评估局部到全局的对齐能力，并提出视觉-触觉补丁对齐方法进行表征学习，实验证明该方法优于无对齐方法并能与全局物体图像对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前触觉学习主要聚焦于图像级预训练或对齐，但触觉信号对应的是局部物体接触，而尺度对齐和全息匹配方面的研究仍十分有限，同时也缺乏合适的数据集和基准。
AI.method: 首先构建数据采集系统，从505个真实物体获取超过2万次触觉接触的大规模数据集；其次设计视觉-触觉全息匹配基准来评估局部到全局的对齐能力；最后提出视觉-触觉补丁对齐方法用于视觉-触觉表征学习。
AI.result: 所提出的视觉-触觉补丁对齐方法在性能上超过了无对齐方法，并且能够与全局物体图像实现对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过大规模数据集和全息匹配基准的建立，以及视觉-触觉补丁对齐方法的提出，有效弥补了触觉学习中尺度对齐和全息匹配方面的空白，提升了视觉-触觉表征学习的效果。

title: A Controlled Study of Decoding-Time Truthfulness Methods on Instruction-Tuned LLMs
summary: In this work, we introduce CHAIR (Classifier of Hallucination As ImproveR), a supervised framework for detecting hallucinations by analyzing internal logits from each layer of every token. Our method extracts a compact set of features such as maximum, minimum, mean, standard deviation, and slope-from the token logits across all layers, enabling effective hallucination detection without overfitting. Experiments on TruthfulQA and MMLU datasets demonstrate that CHAIR significantly improves detection accuracy, particularly in zero-shot scenarios, showcasing its robustness and generalizability. Beyond hallucination detection, CHAIR highlights the potential of using internal representations for designing advanced decoding strategies. By leveraging patterns in logits, we suggest that more sophisticated models and adaptive decoding methods could further reduce hallucinations and enhance text completion quality. CHAIR not only offers a practical solution for detecting hallucinations but also lays the groundwork for exploring richer representations in LLMs to improve their factuality and coherence.

AI.tldr: CHAIR是一个监督学习框架，通过分析每层每个token的内部logits特征（最大值、最小值、均值、标准差、斜率）来检测幻觉，在TruthfulQA和MMLU数据集上显著提升检测精度，尤其在零样本场景下表现出鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型存在生成幻觉（hallucination）的问题，缺乏有效的检测方法。作者希望通过分析模型内部表示（各层token的logits）来更准确地检测幻觉，而非仅依赖输出文本。
AI.method: 从每个token在所有层的logits中提取紧凑特征集：最大值、最小值、均值、标准差和斜率，基于这些特征训练监督分类器来检测幻觉。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA和MMLU数据集上，CHAIR显著提升了幻觉检测准确率，尤其在零样本场景下表现突出，证明了方法的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CHAIR不仅提供了实用的幻觉检测方案，还展示了利用内部logits模式设计更高级解码策略的潜力，为减少幻觉、提升文本完成质量奠定基础。

title: World Model Self-Distillation: Training World Models to Solve General Tasks
summary: Pretrained video generators are promising visual world models that exhibit emergent task-solving abilities; however, their reliance on detailed textual descriptions limits their direct use for planning and decision-making. Existing approaches either outsource this reasoning to language or vision-language models, or rely on supervised fine-tuning with paired task-execution videos, which are costly to collect and difficult to scale. We propose a scalable framework that elicits task-solving ability in such models by combining self-distillation with reinforcement learning. Given an unlabeled scene image, a vision-language model generates a candidate task and a detailed step-by-step solution. The solution conditions a pretrained video diffusion model, the Demonstrator; we distill its behavior into an Executor conditioned only on the image and a short task prompt. This transfers execution knowledge from caption-guided generation to instruction-conditioned task solving without curated task-video supervision. We further improve the Executor with reinforcement learning from VLM feedback, exploiting the asymmetry between judging whether a sampled video satisfies a task and generating the solution. Experiments on our proposed WorldTasks-Benchmark and the DreamGen robotics benchmark show that the Executor surpasses the Demonstrator under our VLM-based evaluation protocol and transfers competitively to robotic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合自蒸馏和强化学习的可扩展框架，利用预训练视频生成模型（Demonstrator）通过VLM生成的任务描述产生示范视频，然后将知识蒸馏到仅依赖图像和简短任务提示的Executor中，再通过VLM反馈强化学习进一步提升，从而在无需配对任务-视频监督的情况下赋予视频生成模型任务求解能力。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频生成模型展现出新兴任务求解能力，但依赖详细文本描述，限制了其在规划和决策中的直接使用；现有方法要么将推理外包给语言/视觉-语言模型，要么依赖昂贵的监督微调，缺乏可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段框架：1) 自蒸馏阶段：VLM生成候选任务和步骤解，作为条件输入预训练视频扩散模型Demonstrator生成视频，然后将Demonstrator的行为蒸馏到仅以图像和简短任务提示为条件的Executor中；2) 强化学习阶段：利用VLM反馈对Executor进行优化，利用判断视频是否满足任务（评判）与生成解决方案（生成）之间的不对称性。
AI.result: 在WorldTasks-Benchmark和DreamGen机器人基准上，Executor在VLM评估协议下超越Demonstrator，并在机器人任务迁移中表现出竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过自蒸馏和VLM反馈强化学习，成功将预训练视频生成模型从依赖详细文本描述的任务求解能力迁移到仅依赖图像和简短指令的条件设定中，无需昂贵的配对任务-视频监督，具有良好的可扩展性和迁移能力。

title: A Resource for Enthymeme Detection in Controversial Political Discourse
comment: 43 pages, to be submitted to the Language Resource and Evaluation Journal
summary: Enthymemes, arguments with unstated premises or conclusions, are pervasive in persuasive discourse, yet their annotation remains notoriously subjective. We present a resource of 1,482 tweets from politically controversial discourse, annotated by five annotators for the presence of enthymemes and their argument structure, designed to study label variation. We first revisit the definition of enthymemes and propose annotation guidelines anchored in Walton's argumentation schemes, offering a structured and constrained approach that nonetheless preserves room for the interpretive nature of the task. This contrasts with past resources, which tend to eliminate disagreement, obscuring its sources and preventing investigation of its potential benefits for model performance. We further propose a complexity analysis of the task, identifying where annotation imposes high cognitive load and may give rise to inconsistent annotation. Our preliminary experiments show that models trained on annotator disagreement outperform models trained on hard majority-vote labels. We close by reflecting on how structural openness in enthymeme definitions and guidelines enables the study of variation in subjective inferential processes for future resources and downstream NLP applications concerned with human inference.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含1,482条政治争议推文的省略三段论(enthymeme)标注资源，由五名标注员进行标注，提出基于Walton论证方案的标注指南，并发现基于标注者分歧训练的模型优于基于多数投票标签训练的模型。该资源保留了主观解释的空间，用于研究标注变异性及其在NLP中的应用。
AI.motivation: 省略三段论在说服性话语中普遍存在，但其标注高度主观且争议较大。以往资源倾向于消除标注者间的分歧，掩盖了分歧来源及其对模型性能的潜在益处，因此需要一种能够保留并研究标注变异性的资源和方法。
AI.method: 收集1,482条政治争议推特，由五名标注员标注省略三段论的存在及其论证结构；重新审视省略三段论定义并提出基于Walton论证方案的标注指南；提出任务复杂度分析方法；进行初步实验比较基于分歧训练与基于硬多数投票训练的模型性能。
AI.result: 基于标注者分歧训练的模型在性能上优于基于硬多数投票标签训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 省略三段论定义和指南中的结构开放性使得未来资源和下游NLP应用能够研究主观推理过程中的变异性，从而更好地处理人类推理相关的任务。

title: Non-frontal face recognition using GANs and memristor-based classifiers
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 1 Supplementary (22 pages, 16 figures, 6 tables, 4 supplementary notes)
summary: Face recognition systems have advanced significantly through deep learning techniques, delivering high performance and robustness in complex scenarios. However, these approaches incur substantial computational overhead, limiting their in situ applicability in resource-constrained platforms such as drones, where they can address challenges including non-frontal facial imagery. Memristor-based neuromorphic systems have emerged as a compelling approach for edge AI applications, combining biologically inspired processing with efficient and scalable computation. In this work, we propose a facial recognition framework that addresses non-frontal pose variations by integrating lightweight generative adversarial network (GAN)-based pose frontalisation with memristor-based neuromorphic recognition. The experimental results on two datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of combining adversarial learning with memristive technology, achieving up to 96% identification accuracy. The proposed approach alleviates the computational bottlenecks of conventional AI and offers a scalable, efficient solution for face recognition in dynamic real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合轻量级GAN姿态正面化与忆阻器神经形态识别的人脸识别框架，在资源受限平台（如无人机）上实现了高达96%的识别准确率，有效缓解了传统AI的计算瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习人脸识别系统计算开销大，难以在资源受限平台（如无人机）上部署，且面临非正面人脸图像的挑战。
AI.method: 集成轻量级生成对抗网络（GAN）进行姿态正面化处理，结合基于忆阻器的神经形态系统实现高效识别。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上达到最高96%的识别准确率，验证了对抗学习与忆阻技术的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架缓解了传统AI的计算瓶颈，为动态真实环境中的面部识别提供了可扩展、高效的解决方案。

title: Agentic Environment Engineering for Large Language Models: A Survey of Environment Modeling, Synthesis, Evaluation, and Application
summary: Environments serve as interactive systems for large language model (LLM) based agents across diverse scenarios and play a crucial role in driving the continual evolution of model capabilities. Despite this importance, existing work lacks a systematic categorization and deep analysis. This paper systematically studies current researches on agentic environments from the perspective of the environment engineering lifecycle, covering their modeling, synthesis, evaluation and application. Specifically, the paper first introduces representative environments from the perspectives of eight attributes and eight domains, providing detailed analyses of their development paths and highlighting their core capabilities. Second, for automated environment synthesis, two paradigms are introduced, such as symbolic synthesis and neural synthesis. This paper also shows different environment evaluation methods in each paradigm. Thirdly, the corresponding environment applications from the perspective of agent-environment co-evolution are discussed. In specific, the paper characterizes the primary pathways for agent evolution in dynamic environments from four complementary perspectives: memory-centric experience evolution, orchestration-centric workflow evolution, trajectory-centric offline evolution, and exploration-centric online evolution. And three paradigms of environment evolution are identified, namely neural-driven, difficulty-driven, and scaling-driven approaches. At last, several promising future directions are discussed, including Environment-as-a-Service, Multi-agent Environments, and Neural-Symbolic Environments.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于LLM的智能体环境工程生命周期，涵盖建模、合成、评估与应用，提出了八属性八域的环境分类、两种自动化合成范式（符号合成与神经合成）、智能体-环境协同演化框架，并展望了环境即服务、多智能体环境和神经符号环境等未来方向。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对智能体环境的系统分类与深入分析，亟需从环境工程生命周期的角度对已有工作进行梳理和结构化总结。
AI.method: 1) 从八种属性和八个领域维度对代表性环境进行介绍与分析；2) 提出符号合成与神经合成两种自动化环境合成范式及其评估方法；3) 从记忆中心、编排中心、轨迹中心和探索中心四个互补视角刻画智能体演化路径，并识别神经驱动、难度驱动和规模驱动三种环境演化范式。
AI.result: 建立了系统化的环境工程生命周期框架，明确了环境建模、合成、评估和应用各环节的核心方法，揭示了智能体与环境协同演化的多种路径和范式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM智能体环境研究提供了系统性分类与理论框架，指出环境即服务、多智能体环境和神经符号环境是未来重要发展方向。

title: ISAP-3D: Identity-Slot Aligned Part-Aware 3D Generation
summary: Part-aware 3D generation aims to synthesize structured objects with semantically meaningful components, yet often suffers from structural ambiguity due to identity-layout entanglement. Existing methods either infer part identity and spatial layout implicitly, which can lead to unstable part allocation (e.g., slot swapping or part merging), or rely on strong layout conditions that are difficult to obtain in practice. We attribute this ambiguity to identity-slot permutation freedom: without explicit identity-slot alignment, the correspondence between semantic parts and generation slots is not identifiable during training, allowing multiple slot assignments to fit the same supervision and leading to inconsistent decomposition. Based on this insight, we argue that stable part-aware generation requires identity-aligned one-to-one slot modelling. We therefore propose an identity-slot aligned framework, ISAP-3D, which anchors each part with semantic identity tokens and performs identity-conditioned one-to-one layout prediction, followed by layout-conditioned geometry synthesis. Structured local-global conditioning maintains identity alignment across semantic, spatial, and geometric stages. We also construct a part-level dataset with a unified semantic protocol to enable learnable and consistent identity-slot alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved structural stability, controllability, and robustness over state-of-the-art part-aware generation baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对部件级3D生成中的结构歧义问题（因身份-布局纠缠导致），本文提出身份-槽对齐框架ISAP-3D，通过语义身份标记锚定每个部件，进行身份条件的一对一布局预测和几何合成，解决了身份-槽置换自由问题，实现了更稳定、可控的部件级生成。
AI.motivation: 现有部件级3D生成方法存在结构歧义问题：隐式推理部件身份和空间布局导致不稳定分配（如槽交换或部件合并），而依赖强布局条件的方法在实际中难以获取。根本原因在于身份-槽置换自由——没有显式的身份-槽对齐，部件与生成槽之间的对应关系在训练中不可识别。
AI.method: 提出ISAP-3D框架：1) 用语义身份标记锚定每个部件；2) 进行身份条件的一对一布局预测；3) 布局条件下的几何合成；4) 设计结构化局部-全局条件机制，在语义、空间和几何阶段保持身份对齐；5) 构建带有统一语义协议的部件级数据集以实现可学习的身份-槽对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ISAP-3D在结构稳定性、可控性和鲁棒性方面均优于现有的部件级生成基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式的身份-槽对齐是稳定部件级3D生成的关键，ISAP-3D通过身份锚定的一对一槽建模有效解决了结构歧义问题。

title: Adaptive Multi-Resolution Procedural Knowledge Compression for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to tackle complex tasks with autonomous workflows. Recently, reusable natural language skills have emerged as a popular paradigm to inject procedural knowledge into LLM applications. Since popular skills are often invoked repeatedly, placing their full text in every context significantly increases prefill cost and latency. While text compression techniques have the potential to solve this problem, most existing methods are designed to compress factual knowledge in documents instead of procedural knowledge, making them insufficient for skill compression. In this paper, we argue that an effective skill compression method should: 1) preserve logical dependencies among workflows and tool protocols, 2) enable lightweight, offline compression for frequently updated community skills, and 3) be adaptable to varying complexities across skills. To address this, we present SKIM (SKIll coMpression), an adaptive multi-resolution soft token compression framework for procedural skills. Depending on the complexity of each skill, SKIM creates different numbers of soft tokens that not only improve the efficiency of LLM inference, but also preserve the effectiveness of skill usage. Experiments indicate that SKIM compresses skills to 30 to 60 percent of their original token length while preserving task performance better than existing compression methods.We have released our code at https://github.com/bebr2/SKIM .

AI.tldr: SKIM是一个自适应多分辨率软标记压缩框架，用于压缩LLM中的可重用过程性技能，将技能压缩至原始长度的30-60%，同时保持任务性能优于现有压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 可重用自然语言技能被频繁调用，完整文本放入上下文会显著增加预填充成本和延迟，现有文本压缩方法主要针对文档中的事实性知识而非过程性知识，不足以用于技能压缩。
AI.method: 提出SKIM（SKIll coMpression）框架，根据技能的复杂度自适应创建不同数量的软标记，实现多分辨率软标记压缩。
AI.result: SKIM将技能压缩至原始令牌长度的30-60%，在保持任务性能方面优于现有压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: 有效的技能压缩方法应保留工作流中的逻辑依赖关系和工具协议、支持轻量级离线压缩、适应不同技能的复杂度差异，SKIM满足这些需求。

title: MSUE: Multi-Modal Soccer Understanding Expert
summary: This paper presents our solution to the 2026 SoccerNet VQA Challenge. We first develop a cost-effective data synthesis pipeline driven by a Vision-Language Model (VLM), which systematically restructures raw domain data into diverse VQA samples, including concise answers and long-form responses. Second, we propose MSUE, a multi-expert question answering architecture that employs a Large Language Model (LLM) to dynamically dispatch questions to text, image, and video experts. These experts are instantiated as a strong text baseline Gemini3-Flash, a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL, and an external knowledge base, respectively, working collaboratively to enhance VQA performance. MSUE achieves an accuracy of \textbf{0.95} on the challenge benchmark, securing third place in the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文针对2026 SoccerNet VQA挑战赛，提出了一种低成本数据合成管道（基于VLM）和多专家问答架构MSUE（动态调度文本、图像、视频专家），最终以0.95准确率获得第三名。
AI.motivation: 体育视频问答领域缺乏高质量训练数据，且单一模型难以同时处理文本、图像、视频等多模态信息，需要一种成本高效且具备多专家协作能力的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 基于VLM的数据合成管道：利用视觉语言模型对原始领域数据进行系统性重构，生成包含简短答案和长文回答的多样化VQA样本；2) MSUE多专家架构：由LLM作为调度器，动态将问题分配给文本专家（Gemini3-Flash）、图像专家（微调Qwen3-VL）和视频专家（外部知识库），三者协同回答问题。
AI.result: 在挑战赛基准上达到0.95准确率，位列排行榜第三名。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的低成本数据合成与多专家协作架构在体育视频问答任务上表现优异，验证了该方法在资源受限条件下的有效性。

title: Can News Predict the Market? Limits of Zero-Shot Financial NLP and the Role of Explainable AI
summary: Can financial news reliably predict short-term stock movements? Despite advances in large language models, this question remains unresolved. We revisit this problem using a zero-shot natural language processing framework, investigating whether models can extract actionable signals from financial news without domain-specific training. We design a structured pipeline that combines zero-shot natural language inference with temporal aggregation, explicitly modelling recency and event-dependent impact horizons when integrating information across articles. To address the need for transparency in high-stakes settings, we introduce a multi-layered explainability framework that links predictions to token-level, article-level, and aggregate evidence, and produces grounded natural language rationales. Across multiple models and prediction horizons, we find that zero-shot approaches consistently fail to outperform simple baselines, with particularly weak performance on negative movements, suggesting deeper structural limitations in mapping news sentiment to short-term price dynamics. However, explainability signals reliably distinguish between trustworthy and unreliable predictions, offering practical value even when accuracy is limited. These findings highlight the limits of zero-shot financial NLP and motivate a shift toward decision-support systems that prioritise transparency and uncertainty awareness. Code: https://github.com/alimert05/zero-shot-stock-xai

AI.tldr: 本文研究了零样本自然语言处理框架在金融新闻预测短期股票走势中的有效性，发现其无法超越简单基线，尤其在负向运动预测上表现薄弱，但可解释性信号能可靠区分可信与不可信预测。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型取得了进展，但金融新闻能否可靠预测短期股票走势仍是一个未解决的问题。作者希望重新审视零样本方法在金融新闻预测中的能力，探讨模型是否能在没有领域特定训练的情况下从新闻中提取可操作的信号。
AI.method: 设计了一个结构化流水线，结合零样本自然语言推理与时间聚合，显式建模时效性和事件依赖的影响时间窗口。引入多层可解释性框架，将预测链接到token级、文章级和聚合级证据，并生成有依据的自然语言解释。
AI.result: 零样本方法在多个模型和预测时间跨度上始终无法超越简单基线，对负向运动的预测表现尤其薄弱。但可解释性信号能够可靠地区分可信和不可信的预测，即使在准确率有限的情况下仍具有实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了零样本金融NLP的局限性，呼吁转向优先考虑透明度和不确定性意识的决策支持系统。

title: Q-Fold: Query-Aware Focus-Context Spatio-Temporal Folding for Long Video Understanding
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Code will be made publicly available
summary: Long-video understanding remains challenging for multimodal large language models, because temporally extended videos often contain thousands of frames and are therefore expensive to process exhaustively. Existing methods usually construct compact visual inputs from long videos under a limited visual budget. However, most of them still follow a frame-centric paradigm and apply similar representations to retained content regardless of its importance. This makes it difficult to preserve both high-fidelity visual evidence and broad temporal coverage. To address this issue, we propose Q-Fold, a training-free input construction framework for long-video understanding. Instead of treating isolated frames as the basic modeling unit, Q-Fold operates on contiguous temporal segments and constructs a heterogeneous Focus--Context representation under query guidance. Query-relevant segments are preserved as high-fidelity Focus Frames, while less relevant segments are folded into chronology-preserving contextual layouts. In this way, Q-Fold preserves critical visual evidence and broad temporal coverage, while better maintaining local temporal continuity within short segments. Experiments on four long-video benchmarks with multiple Video-MLLMs show that Q-Fold consistently improves performance without increasing the input budget. Notably, it achieves gains of up to 9.1 percentage points on an ultra-long video benchmark. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: Q-Fold是一种面向长视频理解的无需训练的输入构建框架，通过将连续时间片段组织为查询引导的异质焦点-上下文表示，在有限视觉预算下同时保留高保真视觉证据和广泛时间覆盖，在多个长视频基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解方法遵循帧中心范式，对保留内容采用相似表示，难以同时兼顾高保真视觉证据和广泛时间覆盖。
AI.method: Q-Fold以连续时间片段为基本建模单元，在查询引导下构建异质的焦点-上下文表示：查询相关片段保留为高保真焦点帧，不相关片段折叠为保留时序的上下文布局。
AI.result: 在四个长视频基准上使用多种视频多模态大语言模型进行实验，Q-Fold在不增加输入预算的情况下持续提升性能，在超长视频基准上提升高达9.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Q-Fold通过片段级异质表示有效解决了长视频理解中保真度与覆盖范围的权衡问题。

title: On The Effectiveness-Fluency Trade-Off In LLM Conditioning: A Systematic Study
summary: Controlling the output of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a central challenge for their reliable deployment, yet a clear understanding of the involved trade-offs remains elusive. Current approaches to conditioning are often evaluated with a narrow focus on their effectiveness at injecting or removing a target concept, neglecting generation quality. We systematically investigate a range of conditioning methods in both injection and removal scenarios. We find that efficient steering methods frequently achieve conditioning at a steep cost to fluency. Furthermore, we identify a critical yet previously overlooked interaction with the training paradigm: activation steering methods are far less effective on instruction-tuned models than on their base counterparts. Simple prompting and full-fledged supervised fine-tuning, on the other hand, are viable options for concept injection, but are not as good at concept removal. Finally, cheaply computed textual metrics highly correlate to costly LLM-as-judge scores, and provide insights on the behavior of conditioning methods.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM条件控制方法在概念注入与移除场景下的表现，发现高效引导方法常以牺牲生成流畅性为代价，且激活引导方法在指令微调模型上效果远不如基础模型。简单提示和全监督微调适合概念注入但不适合移除。廉价文本指标与昂贵LLM评估高度相关。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM条件控制方法评估仅聚焦于目标概念的注入或移除效果，忽视了生成质量，且缺乏对各类方法在两种场景下系统性的比较和理解。
AI.method: 系统性地在概念注入和移除两种场景下比较了多种条件控制方法（包括简单提示、激活引导、全监督微调等），并在基础模型和指令微调模型上分别评估，同时考察了文本指标与LLM-as-judge评分之间的相关性。
AI.result: 高效引导方法常以牺牲流畅性为代价；激活引导方法在指令微调模型上效果远不如基础模型；简单提示和全监督微调适合概念注入但不适合概念移除；廉价文本指标与昂贵LLM评估高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 不同条件控制方法在概念注入和移除场景下各有优劣，评估时需同时考虑有效性和生成质量；指令微调范式与激活引导方法之间存在重要但被忽视的交互作用；廉价文本指标可作为LLM评估的有效替代。

title: AGE-MIL: Anchor-Guided Evidence Learning for Patient-Level Prediction
summary: Existing computational pathology methods predominantly operate within whole-slide image (WSI)-level multiple instance learning (MIL) paradigms, while patient-level modeling remains underexplored. In routine pathological practice, however, pathologists derive diagnostic and prognostic conclusions by integrating evidence across multiple WSIs rather than relying on any single slide. This discrepancy creates a fundamental misalignment when patient-level supervision is directly imposed on conventional MIL frameworks, often leading to unstable optimization and degraded predictive reliability. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-Guided Evidence MIL (AGE-MIL), a weakly supervised framework for patient-level prediction. AGE-MIL constructs a patient-level anchor from slide representations to capture global pathological context and guide the retrieval and integration of diagnostically relevant local patches, enabling robust patient-level modeling. Patient-level risk is further modeled as an evidence accumulation process, promoting stable optimization under weak supervision. AGE-MIL is evaluated on six clinically relevant patient-level prediction tasks from two independent cohorts. Experimental results show that the proposed framework consistently outperforms eight state-of-the-art MIL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/wodeniua/AGE-MIL.

AI.tldr: 针对现有计算病理方法局限于WSI级别的多实例学习（MIL），而临床实际中病理学家需整合多张WSI进行诊断的问题，本文提出Anchor-Guided Evidence MIL (AGE-MIL)，一种弱监督患者级别预测框架。该方法通过构建患者级别的锚点捕获全局病理上下文，引导诊断相关局部斑块的检索与整合，并将患者级别风险建模为证据累积过程，实现弱监督下的稳定优化。在两个独立队列的六个临床任务上，AGE-MIL一致优于八种最先进MIL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多基于单张WSI进行MIL建模，但临床实践中病理学家需综合多张WSI得出诊断结论。这种范式不匹配导致患者级别监督直接施加于传统MIL框架时，会出现优化不稳定和预测可靠性下降的问题。
AI.method: 提出AGE-MIL框架：1) 构建患者级别锚点（从多张滑片表示中聚合），以捕获全局病理上下文；2) 通过锚点引导检索和整合诊断相关局部斑块；3) 将患者级别风险建模为证据累积过程，实现弱监督下的稳定优化。
AI.result: 在两个独立队列的六个患者级别预测任务上，AGE-MIL一致优于八种最先进MIL方法。
AI.conclusion: AGE-MIL通过构建患者级别锚点和证据累积建模，有效解决了传统MIL框架在患者级别弱监督预测中的范式不匹配问题，显著提升了预测性能与优化稳定性。
