title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) addresses the high inference costs of LLMs by having lightweight drafters generate candidates for large verifiers to validate in parallel. Existing draft-verify methods use binary decisions: accept or fully recompute. Yet we find that many rejected tokens can be verified correctly by a slim submodel derived from the full verifier via intra-model routing, instead of the full verifier. This motivates our slim-verifier to handle tokens requiring moderate verification resources, reducing expensive large-model calls. We propose Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding (VIA-SD), a multi-tier framework using a routed slim-verifier. Draft tokens are processed hierarchically: direct acceptance for high-confidence cases, slim-verifier regeneration for medium-confidence cases, and full-model verification for uncertain cases. Across four representative tasks and multiple model families, VIA-SD reduces rejection rates by 0.10-0.22 and delivers 10-20% speedups over strong SD baselines, while achieving 2.5-3x acceleration over non-drafting decoding. Moreover, VIA-SD is compatible with existing SD frameworks without modifying their training procedures. Our results suggest multi-tier SD as a general paradigm for scalable and efficient LLM inference. Project page: https://zju-xyc.github.io/VIA-SD-Project-Page/

AI.tldr: VIA-SD提出了一种基于模型内路由的多层验证框架，通过引入轻量级slim-verifier处理中等置信度的草稿token，减少对完整大模型的调用，在兼容现有投机解码框架的同时实现10-20%的加速。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码（SD）方法使用二元决策（接受或完全重计算），但研究发现许多被拒绝的token可以通过完整验证器内部的轻量子模型（slim submodel）正确验证，无需调用完整大模型，从而减少昂贵的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出VIA-SD多层级框架：1）高置信度token直接接受；2）中等置信度token由slim-verifier重新生成；3）不确定token由完整模型验证。slim-verifier通过模型内路由（intra-model routing）从完整验证器中提取轻量子模型实现。
AI.result: 在四个代表性任务和多个模型家族上，拒绝率降低0.10-0.22，比强基线SD方法加速10-20%，比非草稿解码加速2.5-3倍。
AI.conclusion: 多层投机解码（multi-tier SD）可作为可扩展且高效的LLM推理通用范式，且VIA-SD无需修改训练过程即可兼容现有SD框架。

title: Time-Conditioned and Multi-Time Survival Prediction from 2D PET/CT Projections in Lung Cancer
summary: Accurate prediction of overall survival (OS) from positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) can support personalized treatment and follow-up strategies in oncology. However, the impact of temporal modeling on imaging-based survival prediction remains insufficiently explored. We investigate how different temporal formulations influence survival prediction by developing two complementary approaches: Attention-guided Time-Conditioned Survival (ATCS) and Multi-Time Survival (MTS). We retrospectively analyzed pre-treatment PET/CT images from 848 patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including 556 for model development and 292 for held-out testing. A previously proposed Time-Conditioned Survival (TCS) model was used as a baseline. Models were trained using 5-fold cross-validation and evaluated on the test set using time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) at 6-month intervals from 0.5 to 5 years. Both ATCS and MTS outperformed the baseline TCS model, achieving mean AUCs of 0.794 and 0.793, respectively, compared to 0.767. ATCS performed better at earlier time points (0.5-3 years), whereas MTS performed better at later intervals (3.5-5 years). Combining tumor-specific and tissue-wise PET/CT features improved performance over either input alone. Finer temporal discretization improved short-term prediction, while coarser intervals provided more stable long-term estimates. These findings demonstrate that temporal modeling and input design influence PET/CT-based survival prediction. The proposed approaches enable time-specific survival estimation from pre-treatment imaging and may support improved risk stratification and clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了时间建模对PET/CT影像生存预测的影响，提出两种新方法（ATCS和MTS），在848例NSCLC患者数据上均优于基线模型TCS（平均AUC分别为0.794、0.793 vs 0.767）。ATCS在早期（0.5-3年）表现更好，MTS在后期（3.5-5年）更优。肿瘤特异性与组织级特征融合可提升性能，时间离散化粒度影响短期与长期预测的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 时间建模在影像组学生存预测中的影响尚未得到充分探索，现有方法缺乏对时间维度的显式建模能力。
AI.method: 提出两种方法：Attention-guided Time-Conditioned Survival (ATCS) 和 Multi-Time Survival (MTS)。基于848例NSCLC患者治疗前PET/CT影像，采用5折交叉验证训练，时间依赖AUC评估（0.5-5年，6个月间隔）。
AI.result: ATCS和MTS的平均AUC分别为0.794和0.793，优于基线TCS的0.767。ATCS在早期（0.5-3年）更优，MTS在后期（3.5-5年）更优。融合肿瘤特异性和组织级特征优于单一输入。细粒度时间离散化改善短期预测，粗粒度提供更稳定的长期估计。
AI.conclusion: 时间建模方式和输入特征设计显著影响PET/CT生存预测性能，所提方法可实现治疗前影像的时间特异性生存估计，有助于风险分层和临床决策。

title: Reassessing High-Performing LLMs on Polish Medical Exams: True Competence or Bias-Driven Performance?
comment: 26 pages total with references and appendix, preprint
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in medicine are mainly evaluated using multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), which can overestimate real clinical ability due to guessing strategies and answer biases. To address these limitations, we introduce an expanded and more challenging benchmark based on Polish medical exams, adding over 15,000 questions, two new domains, and four structural modifications that reduce MCQA-specific artifacts and better test reasoning. We evaluate 21 LLMs and show that evaluation design strongly affects results. Under our harder setup, the best model (Qwen3.5-122B) drops by 28.4 and 31 pp on English and Polish exams, respectively. Despite low evidence of data contamination, standard MCQA scores do not reliably reflect true medical competence. To facilitate further research, we make our benchmark publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医学领域大型语言模型评估中MCQA方法的局限性，构建了一个包含15000+问题、两个新领域和四项结构改进的波兰医学考试基准，发现标准MCQA评分高估了模型的真实临床能力，最佳模型在改进后的基准上性能下降显著（英文28.4pp，波兰文31pp）。
AI.motivation: 现有医学LLM评估主要依赖MCQA，但这种方法因猜测策略和答案偏差而高估模型的真实临床能力，需要更严格、更少人为偏见的评估基准。
AI.method: 基于波兰医学考试扩展基准，新增15000+问题和两个新领域，实施四项结构修改（减少MCQA特有伪影），并评估21个LLM的表现。
AI.result: 评估设计对结果影响显著；Qwen3.5-122B在改进后的基准上，英文考试下降28.4个百分点，波兰文考试下降31个百分点；数据污染证据较低，但标准MCQA分数不能可靠反映真实医学能力。
AI.conclusion: 标准MCQA评估高估了LLM的医学能力，本文提出的改进基准能更准确反映模型真实临床推理水平，建议未来采用更具挑战性的评估设计。

title: TopoCap: Learning Topology-Agnostic Motion Priors for Monocular Video-to-Animation
summary: The explosion of generative 3D assets has created a massive demand for animation, yet current motion capture methods remain brittle, restricted to species-specific templates (e.g., SMPL) or requiring labor-intensive manual rigging. We introduce TopoCap, the first unified framework capable of extracting motion from monocular video and retargeting it onto characters with arbitrary, unseen skeletal topologies, i.e., from bipeds to hexapods and inanimate objects, without test-time optimization. Our key insight is that while skeletal structures are combinatorial and discrete, the underlying physics of motion occupy a continuous, low-dimensional manifold. We materialize this insight via a two-stage generative pipeline. First, we learn a Universal Motion Manifold using a Graph CVAE that compresses heterogeneous kinematic chains into a shared, fixed-length latent code. By explicitly conditioning the decoder on a structural embedding of the target rig, we disentangle motion dynamics from skeletal topology. Second, we treat video-to-animation as a conditional flow matching problem, predicting these topology-agnostic codes from visual features. To learn this generalized prior, we introduce Mobjaverse, a massive-scale dataset curated from Objaverse-XL. Comprising over 5,000 unique skeletal topologies and 2 million frames, it exceeds the structural diversity of existing datasets by two orders of magnitude. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \MethodMotion outperforms specialist models on human and quadruped benchmarks while enabling zero-shot retargeting for the long tail of 3D creatures. Dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/duckduckplz/Mobjaverse.

AI.tldr: TopoCap 提出首个统一框架，能从单目视频提取运动并重定向到任意拓扑骨架（从双足到六足乃至无生命物体），无需测试时优化。核心是通过图条件变分自编码器学习通用运动流形，将运动动力学与骨架拓扑解耦，并引入含5000+独特拓扑和200万帧的大规模数据集 Mobjaverse 实现零样本重定向。
AI.motivation: 当前动作捕捉方法局限性强：依赖特定物种模板（如 SMPL）或需要繁重的手动骨骼绑定。随着3D资产爆炸式增长（大量非人体、非四足角色），急需一种能处理任意拓扑骨架的统一运动提取与重定向方法。
AI.method: 两阶段生成流水线：(1) 图条件变分自编码器（Graph CVAE）学习通用运动流形，将异构运动链压缩为固定长度潜码，解码器以目标骨架的结构嵌入为条件，解耦运动与拓扑；(2) 将视频到动画建模为条件流匹配问题，从视觉特征预测拓扑无关的运动潜码。同时构建大规模数据集 Mobjaverse（5000+骨架拓扑，200万帧）。
AI.result: 在人体和四足动物基准测试上超越专家模型，并实现了对长尾3D生物的零样本重定向能力。
AI.conclusion: 证明了将离散骨架拓扑与连续运动流形解耦的统一范式是可行的，大规模拓扑多样性数据是跨物种运动迁移的关键。

title: Beyond Fully Random Masking: Attention-Guided Denoising and Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
comment: 13 pages. Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer an efficient alternative to autoregressive models through parallel decoding, yet existing post-training methods largely rely on random masking strategies that overlook intrinsic token dependencies. In this work, we present an empirical analysis of attention in dLLMs and show that tokens attending more strongly to unmasked context exhibit greater generation stability and play a critical role in reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose AGDO, an attention-guided denoising and optimization framework that aligns both training and optimization with attention-derived dependencies. AGDO determines the denoising order based on attention structure and emphasizes attention-critical tokens during supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical and coding benchmarks demonstrate that AGDO consistently improves reasoning performance, outperforming state-of-the-art post-training methods for dLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于注意力引导的去噪与优化框架AGDO，通过利用dLLM中token的注意力依赖关系来确定去噪顺序并强化关键token的训练，在数学和代码推理任务上显著优于现有后训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散大语言模型的后训练方法多采用随机掩码策略，忽略了token之间固有的依赖关系，限制了模型在推理任务上的性能。
AI.method: 首先通过实验分析发现dLLM中注意力更强的token具有更高的生成稳定性且对推理至关重要；基于此提出AGDO框架，利用注意力结构决定去噪顺序，并在监督微调和强化学习中重点强化注意力关键token。
AI.result: 在数学和代码推理基准测试上，AGDO持续提升了推理性能，超越了当前最先进的dLLM后训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 注意力引导的策略比随机掩码更有效，AGDO为dLLM的后训练提供了一种对齐token依赖关系的新范式。

title: OpenMedReason: Scientific Reasoning Supervision for Medical Vision-Language Models
comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 24 tables. Dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/neginb/OpenMedReason
summary: High-stakes clinical use of large vision-language models (LVLMs) requires reasoning that is grounded in visual evidence and clinical knowledge, not just correct final answers. We introduce OpenMedReason, a large-scale, open multimodal medical reasoning corpus comprising approximately 450K image-question-answer instances whose reasoning traces are primarily derived from curated biomedical, human-authored scientific articles. OpenMedReason provides high-fidelity supervision beyond synthetic chains of thought, covering diverse medical domain vision modalities such as radiological scans, microscopic images, visible light photographs, charts, and others. We complement it with OpenMedReason-Bench, a held-out benchmark that allows fine-grained evaluation of LVLMs along three complementary axes of capability, including perception, medical knowledge, and rationale, enabling diagnostic evaluation beyond final-answer accuracy. OpenMedReason is a rich training resource that exhibits its effectiveness in both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement-based alignment. Training with OpenMedReason yields a 20% average improvement in VQA accuracy over the base model and achieves performance within 4.2% of the strongest comparable-scale medical LVLMs. Fine-grained performance analysis confirms that the gains are not concentrated in any single axis: OpenMedReason improves perception, medical knowledge, and rationale jointly, and its reasoning traces are preferred over those of the base model in 86.1% of pairwise comparisons. We release the code and dataset at huggingface.co/datasets/neginb/OpenMedReason.

AI.tldr: OpenMedReason是一个包含约45万条医学多模态推理数据的大规模开放数据集，配有用于细粒度评估的基准测试集OpenMedReason-Bench。训练该数据集可在VQA准确率上提升平均20%，并在感知、医学知识和推理三个维度上实现联合改进，推理轨迹在86.1%的成对比较中优于基座模型。
AI.motivation: 高风险临床场景下，大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的推理需要基于视觉证据和临床知识，而不仅仅是给出正确答案。现有医学多模态数据集缺乏高质量的、非合成性的推理轨迹数据，无法支持模型在感知、医学知识和推理链三个维度的细粒度诊断评估。
AI.method: 从经过策展的生物医学科学文献中提取约45万条图像-问题-答案实例及其推理轨迹，覆盖放射影像、显微图像、可见光照片、图表等多种医学视觉模态。同时构建保持集基准OpenMedReason-Bench，从感知、医学知识和推理三个互补维度进行细粒度评估。
AI.result: 在监督微调（SFT）和基于强化学习的对齐中均表现出有效性：VQA准确率平均提升20%，性能达到最强可比规模医学LVLM的4.2%以内；感知、医学知识和推理三个维度均获得提升；推理轨迹在86.1%的成对比较中优于基座模型。
AI.conclusion: OpenMedReason作为丰富的训练资源，能够有效提升医学LVLM的多维度推理能力，其开放性和细粒度评估设计为医学多模态推理研究提供了重要基准。

title: Measuring Epistemic Resilience of LLMs Under Misleading Medical Context
summary: Large language models (LLMs) now reach expert-level scores on medical licensing exams, encouraging the assumption that high scores imply safe medical judgment while patients increasingly use them for health advice. We show this assumption is fragile: when misleading context is injected into questions that LLMs originally answer correctly, they abandon the correct answer. We call the ability to maintain correct judgment under adversarial context epistemic resilience, and introduce MedMisBench to measure it. MedMisBench contains 10,932 medical question items and 48,889 misleading context-option pairs spanning medical reasoning, agentic capability, and patient-journey evaluation. Across 11 model configurations, mean accuracy falls from 71.1% on original questions to 38.0% under focused misleading context, with 51.5% attack success. The most damaging injections are formal, rule-like fabrications: authority-framed falsehoods reach 69.5% attack success and exception-poisoning claims reach 64.1%. A 14-member clinical panel from 7 countries identified serious potential harm in 38.2% of reviewed cases. MedMisBench exposes a structural blind spot in LLM evaluation in medical settings: existing benchmarks measure what models know, but not whether they preserve correct medical judgment under misleading context.

AI.tldr: LLMs在医学考试中虽取得高分，但在误导性上下文下正确判断能力大幅下降（准确率从71.1%降至38.0%），攻击成功率高达51.5%。本文提出MedMisBench基准（10,932个问题，48,889个误导对）和"认知韧性"概念，揭示现有评估体系忽视模型在对抗性语境下保持正确医学判断的能力，14位国际临床专家评审发现38.2%案例存在严重潜在危害。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM医学评估仅关注模型"知道什么"（知识准确度），忽略了模型在误导性语境下能否保持正确判断这一关键安全维度。随着患者越来越多地使用LLM获取健康建议，这一评估盲区可能导致严重医疗危害。
AI.method: 构建MedMisBench基准数据集（10,932道医学问题+48,889个误导性上下文-选项对），覆盖医学推理、代理能力和患者旅程评估三个维度。在11种模型配置上进行评估，并组织14位来自7个国家的临床专家小组审查潜在危害。
AI.result: 平均准确率从原始问题的71.1%骤降至误导性上下文下的38.0%，攻击成功率达51.5%。权威框架式虚假陈述（攻击成功率69.5%）和例外投毒表述（64.1%）是最有效的误导形式。38.2%的审查案例被专家认定为存在严重潜在危害。
AI.conclusion: 现有医学LLM评估存在结构性盲区——只测知识不测判断韧性。MedMisBench揭示了高分数不等于安全判断的脆弱假设，在误导性信息日益蔓延的医疗环境中，评估"认知韧性"应成为模型安全部署的必要条件。

title: Beyond Dark Knowledge: Mixup-Based Distillation for Reliable Predictions
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) and mixup have proven effective at inducing smoothness in class boundaries; KD captures inherent class relationships in probability distributions, and mixup enforces them through convex combinations of inputs. Their interaction, however, remains poorly understood, particularly when mixup is applied only during student training. In this setting, the teacher is queried on inputs drawn from a vicinal distribution it never saw during training, a controlled mismatch whose effect on knowledge transfer has not been characterised. We show that this mismatch causes the teacher's supervisory signal to be dominated by distributional confusion rather than inter-class structure. Despite it, the student does not merely imitate the teacher: it independently acquires greater linearity in the vicinal region, a structural property that the teacher lacks, and goes beyond dark-knowledge transfer. KD with mixup consistently improves student accuracy and reduces overconfidence by an order of magnitude relative to the baseline, across CIFAR and ImageNet with varying-capacity teachers. Crucially, calibration propagates from teacher to student independently of accuracy transfer, and temperature scaling governs a measurable accuracy-calibration trade-off that becomes more pronounced under vicinal training. These results reframe mixup distillation not as a degraded version of standard KD, but as a richer transfer channel that simultaneously shapes discriminative performance, uncertainty estimation, and representational geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了知识蒸馏中教师模型仅使用原始数据训练而学生模型使用mixup增强训练时产生的分布不匹配问题，发现这种不匹配导致教师输出被分布混淆主导，但学生并未简单模仿教师，而是独立获得了更强的线性结构和更好的校准性能，将mixup蒸馏重塑为一种更丰富的知识迁移通道。
AI.motivation: 现有的知识蒸馏和mixup技术都能有效平滑分类边界，但二者的交互机制尚不清晰，尤其是在mixup仅应用于学生训练而教师从未见过mixup数据的情况下，这种分布不匹配对知识迁移的影响尚未被系统性表征。
AI.method: 系统分析了教师（仅在原始数据上训练）对学生（接受mixup增强训练）进行蒸馏时的分布不匹配问题，通过CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上不同容量教师模型的实验，量化了校准传递、准确率-校准权衡以及表征几何特性。
AI.result: 1) 分布不匹配导致教师监督信号被分布混淆主导而非类间结构信息；2) 学生并未简单模仿教师，而是独立获得了教师所缺乏的邻域线性结构；3) KD+mixup持续提升学生准确率，并将过度自信降低一个数量级；4) 校准传播与准确率传播解耦；5) 温度缩放控制一个可测量的准确率-校准权衡，且在邻域训练下更显著。
AI.conclusion: mixup蒸馏不应被视为标准知识蒸馏的退化版本，而是一种更丰富的知识迁移通道，能同时塑造判别性能、不确定性估计和表征几何结构。

title: Measuring Semantic Progress in Multi-turn Dialogue via Information Gain
summary: Evaluating multi-turn dialogue is challenging because quality emerges across turns rather than within individual responses. We focus on a key dimension of information-seeking dialogue: semantic progress, defined as the accumulation of new, question-relevant, and non-redundant information over the course of a conversation. We formalize semantic progress as question-conditioned uncertainty reduction and introduce an information-theoretic metric that approximates it in embedding space. Our main estimator uses a tractable Gaussian formulation with closed-form updates, while a complementary maximum-entropy argument shows why log-determinant structure arises more broadly when only second-order embedding information is retained. This formulation yields desirable theoretical properties, including monotonicity, additive decomposition of total information gain across turns, and diminishing returns for redundant evidence. Unlike LLM-as-a-judge approaches, our metric requires no autoregressive inference at evaluation time and is fully reproducible for a fixed embedding model. Experiments on MT-Bench, Chatbot Arena, and UltraFeedback show that the proposed metric achieves competitive agreement with human judgments despite targeting only semantic progress, with improved alignment on MT-Bench and UltraFeedback compared to several LLM-based judges. Notably, the method remains effective with lightweight embedding models under CPU-only execution, indicating that semantic progress can be captured without reliance on large model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信息论的语义进展度量方法，通过高斯闭式解量化多轮对话中问题相关的新信息积累，无需自回归推理即可评估对话质量，实验证明其与人类判断高度一致且计算高效。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话评估具有挑战性，因为对话质量体现在跨轮次的整体语义推进而非单轮响应。现有LLM评判方法需要昂贵的自回归推理且不可完全复现，亟需一种原则性强、计算高效且可复现的自动评估指标。
AI.method: 将语义进展形式化为以问题为条件的不确定性缩减，提出信息论度量在嵌入空间中近似；核心估计器采用含闭式更新的高斯公式化，最大熵论证表明仅保留二阶嵌入信息时对数行列式结构自然出现；支持单调性、信息增益可加性分解及冗余证据的递减回报。
AI.result: 在MT-Bench、Chatbot Arena和UltraFeedback上，该方法与人类判断的一致性在多个基准上达到或超越LLM评判器（如MT-Bench和UltraFeedback上更优），且仅用CPU运行的轻量嵌入模型即可有效工作。
AI.conclusion: 语义进展可以通过信息论度量在嵌入空间中有效捕获，无需依赖大模型能力。该指标完全可复现、计算开销低，为多轮对话质量评估提供了一种原则性替代方案。

title: DynaTok: Token-Based 4D Reconstruction from Partial Point Clouds
summary: We address 4D reconstruction from partial point cloud sequences, where depth-sensor observations are incomplete, unordered, and lack explicit temporal correspondences. This geometry-only setting is challenging due to missing observations and ambiguous dynamics. While recent progress has largely relied on image-based methods, existing point-based approaches typically focus on single objects, assume relatively complete inputs, or require explicit correspondences. To address these limitations, we propose DynaTok, a point-based framework for correspondence-free 4D reconstruction from partial point cloud sequences without images. DynaTok encodes frames into compact latent tokens, aggregates incomplete observations over time with a Transformer-based spatiotemporal encoder, and decouples geometry and motion through residual tokens in a unified model. A flow-matching decoder then reconstructs complete, temporally consistent 4D point-cloud sequences conditioned on the latent tokens. Experiments on object- and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and temporal coherence from partial point cloud observations. Project page: https://wrchen530.github.io/dynatok/.

AI.tldr: DynaTok是一种基于点的4D重建框架，能够从部分点云序列中实现无需对应关系的完整时空重建，在物体和场景级别基准上均取得了更优的重建质量和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有4D重建方法主要依赖图像信息，而基于点的方通常仅关注单一物体、假设输入相对完整或需要显式的帧间对应关系，难以处理深度传感器观测中存在的缺失、无序和缺乏时序对应的问题。
AI.method: DynaTok将各帧点云编码为紧凑的潜在令牌，通过基于Transformer的时空编码器聚合不完整观测，利用残差令牌在统一模型中解耦几何与运动信息，最后通过流匹配解码器重建完整且时序一致的4D点云序列。
AI.result: 在物体级和场景级基准上，DynaTok从部分点云观测中实现了更优的重建质量和时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需图像、无需显式对应关系的纯点云4D重建方案，有效解决了部分观测下的动态场景重建难题。

title: ALIGNBEAM : Inference-Time Alignment Transfer via Cross-Vocabulary Logit Mixing
summary: Domain fine-tuning degrades the safety of large language models: fine-tuned specialists readily comply with harmful prompts framed in domain language. Existing inference-time defenses that mix logits from a safe anchor model require both models to share a vocabulary, which rules them out for the cross-family specialists where safety is most degraded. We present ALIGNBEAM, a training-free method that lifts this restriction by translating anchor logits into the target model's vocabulary token-by-token at each decoding step; a small LLM judge then selects the safest among K candidate continuations. No weights are changed, and the safety-utility trade-off can be tuned at deployment without retraining. Across both cross-vocabulary and same-vocabulary evaluation pairs, ALIGNBEAM substantially raises refusal on adversarial benchmarks while keeping task accuracy and inference overhead within practical bounds. The results show that safety alignment can be transferred between model families at inference time, without touching either model's weights.

AI.tldr: ALIGNBEAM是一种无需训练的安全对齐方法，通过在解码时将安全锚点模型的logits逐词翻译到目标模型词汇表，并用小型LLM法官选择最安全的候选续写，从而在跨模型家族（不同词汇表）的微调场景下提升安全性，同时保持任务准确率和推理开销在可接受范围内。
AI.motivation: 领域微调会严重降低大语言模型的安全性，微调后的专家模型容易被有害提示（以领域语言表述）突破。现有推理时防御方法（如混合来自安全锚点模型的logits）要求两个模型共享同一词汇表，因此无法应用于安全性退化最严重的跨模型家族场景。
AI.method: ALIGNBEAM：训练无关方法，在每个解码步骤将锚点模型的logits逐词翻译为目标模型的词汇表；然后使用小型LLM法官从K个候选续写中选择最安全的输出。无需改变任何模型权重，安全-效用权衡可在部署时调节而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在跨词汇表和同词汇表评估组合上，ALIGNBEAM显著提高了对对抗性基准的拒绝率，同时将任务准确率和推理开销控制在实用范围内。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐可以在推理时在不同模型家族之间转移，无需触及任何模型的权重。

title: InternVideo3: Agentify Foundation Models with Multimodal Contextual Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in foundation models has shifted toward agentic behavior involving multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, open-source efforts largely focus on text-dominant settings, leaving long-horizon multimodal tasks underexplored. This gap is evident in video tasks requiring sustained temporal understanding and iterative interaction. We present InternVideo3, a framework enhancing these capabilities via Multimodal Contextual Reasoning (MCR). MCR treats understanding as a closed-loop process over a shared, evolving context containing observations, instructions, reasoning, tool actions, and memory. This frames long-video understanding as evidence accumulation and verification. To ensure efficiency, we introduce Multimodal Multi-head Latent Attention (M^2LA), a token-preserving reparameterization compressing KV-cache states while retaining the full token stream. Our staged training includes continued pretraining, short-to-long supervised fine-tuning, rule-based reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Experiments show InternVideo3 achieves strong performance on benchmarks like Video-MME, MLVU, and EgoSchema. We further instantiate the model as a video agent with retrieval tools, demonstrating robust evidence-grounded behavior. Our results suggest that efficient context handling and closed-loop reasoning are vital for adapting open multimodal models toward long-horizon visually grounded agency.

AI.tldr: InternVideo3通过多模态上下文推理（MCR）和多头潜在注意力（M^2LA）机制，将长视频理解建模为证据积累与验证的闭环过程，在Video-MME、MLVU和EgoSchema等基准上取得强性能，并展示了基于检索工具的视频智能体能力。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型在智能体行为（多步推理、工具使用）方面取得进展，但开源工作多聚焦于文本主导场景，长时序多模态任务（如视频理解）仍未被充分探索，尤其是在需要持续时间理解和迭代交互的视频任务中存在明显差距。
AI.method: 提出多模态上下文推理（MCR）框架，将理解视为包含观测、指令、推理、工具动作和记忆的共享演化上下文上的闭环过程；引入多模态多头潜在注意力（M^2LA），通过token保留重参数化压缩KV-cache状态；采用分阶段训练：持续预训练、短到长监督微调、基于规则的强化学习、在线策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和EgoSchema等视频理解基准上取得强性能；实例化为配备检索工具的视频智能体，展现出鲁棒的基于证据的行为。
AI.conclusion: 高效的上下文处理与闭环推理对于将开放多模态模型适配到长时序视觉引导的智能体任务至关重要。

title: Verifiable Environments Are LEGO Bricks: Recursive Composition for Reasoning Generalization
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable environments has emerged as a powerful approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior research demonstrates that scaling environment quantity improves RL performance, existing manual or individual construction methods suffer from linear scaling limits, thereby hindering scalable reasoning generalization. This paper introduces RACES (\textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{A}utomated \textbf{C}omposition for \textbf{E}nvironment \textbf{S}caling), a framework that conceptualizes verifiable environments as composable building blocks that can be recursively assembled. The key insight is that when the codomain (output type) of one environment matches the domain (input type) of another, they can be automatically fused into a new verifiable environment, enabling recursive composition. RACES is implemented with 300 individual environments and defines a set of composition operators (\textsc{SEQUENTIAL}, \textsc{PARALLEL}, \textsc{SORT}, and \textsc{SELECT}) that induce diverse reasoning patterns. Extensive experiments show that RL training on these composite environments consistently enhances reasoning generalization. Specifically, RACES improves DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B by an average of 3.1 points (from 48.2 to 51.3) and boosts Qwen3-14B performance from 58.8 to 61.1 on six benchmarks, which are unseen during the construction of training environments. Moreover, RACES achieves performance comparable to training on 300 individual environments using only 50 base environments, demonstrating significant efficiency in environment utilization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RACES框架，通过递归组合可验证环境（单个环境视为可组合模块，当输出类型匹配输入类型时可自动融合）来扩展RL训练环境数量。定义SEQUENTIAL、PARALLEL、SORT、SELECT四种组合算子，仅用50个基础环境即可达到300个单独环境的训练效果，在多个未见基准上显著提升LLM推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RL训练中，环境数量对提升LLM推理能力至关重要，但手动或单独构建环境的方式存在线性扩展瓶颈，难以实现规模化推理泛化。
AI.method: 提出RACES框架，将可验证环境视为可组合构建块，当环境A的输出类型匹配环境B的输入类型时自动融合为新环境，并定义SEQUENTIAL（顺序）、PARALLEL（并行）、SORT（排序）、SELECT（选择）四种组合算子，递归生成多样化的复合环境。
AI.result: 在六个未见基准上，RACES使DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B平均提升3.1分（48.2→51.3），Qwen3-14B从58.8提升至61.1；仅用50个基础环境即可达到300个单独环境的训练效果。
AI.conclusion: RACES通过环境递归组合策略，有效突破了环境数量线性扩展的限制，在显著降低环境构建成本的同时提升了RL训练的推理泛化能力，验证了组合式环境扩增的可行性与高效性。

title: SHERPA: Seam-aware Harmonized ERP Adaptation for Open-Domain 360$^\circ$ Panorama Generation
summary: Panoramic imagery is increasingly used in world-generation, games, and simulation, where users may need not only photorealistic scenes but also stylized and non-photorealistic environments. Large-scale text-to-image diffusion and flow models provide broad style and semantic priors for this goal, but planar image training misaligns them with the wrap-around topology and polar regions of $360^\circ$ panoramas represented in equirectangular projection (ERP). We present SHERPA, a lightweight adaptation framework that combines frequency-selective Circular RoPE, Circular Latent Encoding/Decoding, image-side FFN adapters, and a Dual-Path Training Scheme. Circular RoPE replaces only the seam-sensitive high-frequency horizontal RoPE band with integer-periodic harmonics while preserving the pretrained lower-frequency spectrum. The Paired Panorama Path supervises geometry, while the Unpaired Style Path uses self-supervised yaw consistency for target-free stylized prompts. As a result, SHERPA generates $360^\circ$ panoramas across both photorealistic panorama domains and open-domain stylized prompts.

AI.tldr: SHERPA是一种轻量级适配框架，通过频率选择性Circular RoPE、循环潜在编码/解码、图像侧FFN适配器和双路径训练方案，将平面预训练的文本到图像扩散/流模型适配到360°全景等矩形投影（ERP）生成，支持写实和风格化全景图像生成。
AI.motivation: 全景影像在地图生成、游戏和仿真中需求日益增长，用户不仅需要逼真场景，还需要风格化和非真实感环境。然而，现有大规模文本到图像扩散和流模型基于平面图像训练，与360°全景的环绕拓扑和极地区域存在错位，无法直接用于等矩形投影（ERP）全景生成。
AI.method: SHERPA框架包含四个核心组件：1）频率选择性Circular RoPE——仅将接缝敏感的高频水平RoPE带替换为整数周期谐波，保留预训练的低频频谱；2）循环潜在编码/解码（Circular Latent Encoding/Decoding）；3）图像侧FFN适配器（image-side FFN adapters）；4）双路径训练方案（Dual-Path Training Scheme）：配对全景路径监督几何结构，非配对风格路径通过自监督偏航一致性实现无目标风格提示。
AI.result: SHERPA能够生成360°全景图像，覆盖写实全景域和开放域风格化提示，实现了从平面预训练模型到全景拓扑的有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量级适配框架，无需大规模重新训练即可将平面预训练生成模型适配到360°全景生成任务，兼顾了几何一致性和风格多样性。

title: Which Models Are Our Models Built On? Auditing Invisible Dependencies in Modern LLMs
summary: Modern LLM training pipelines increasingly rely on other models to generate data, filter corpora, judge outputs, and guide development decisions. These dependencies are recursive: a model may depend on an upstream artifact whose own dependencies are documented only in separate releases and artifacts. As a result, the full dependency structure is fragmented across heterogeneous public artifacts, with complexity and recursive depth far outpacing humans' ability to trace. We introduce ModSleuth, an agentic system that recursively reconstructs LLM dependency graphs from public artifacts with source-grounded evidence. We find that the primary challenge is no longer information extraction, but defining what constitutes a dependency and reconciling artifact references across inconsistent documentation. We address these challenges through a formalization that distinguishes direct and indirect dependencies, represents heterogeneous pipeline roles through operation-centered relationships, and resolves artifact identities across names, versions, and repositories. Applying ModSleuth to four public-artifact-rich LLM releases, we recover 1,060 source-verified dependencies and construct large-scale dependency graphs of modern LLM development. These graphs reveal multi-hop license obligations, train-evaluation coupling, discrepancies between released and training-time artifacts, and documentation inconsistencies that would otherwise be difficult to uncover. We release ModSleuth and the resulting dependency graphs to support transparent analysis of the increasingly complex ecosystems underlying modern LLMs.

AI.tldr: ModSleuth是一个能够从公开工件中递归重建LLM依赖图的智能体系统。应用于四个LLM发布案例后，恢复了1,060个经过源验证的依赖关系，揭示了多跳许可义务、训练-评估耦合、发布与训练时工件不一致以及文档矛盾等问题。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM训练流程日益依赖其他模型生成数据、过滤语料、判断输出和指导开发决策，这些依赖是递归的且分散在异构的公开工件中，递归深度远超人工追踪能力。
AI.method: 提出ModSleuth智能体系统，通过形式化区分直接与间接依赖、以操作为中心的关系表示异构流水线角色、跨名称/版本/仓库解析工件标识，从公开工件中以源证据为基础递归重建LLM依赖图。
AI.result: 在四个富含公开工件的LLM发布中恢复了1,060个源验证的依赖关系，构建了大规模依赖图，揭示了多跳许可义务、训练-评估耦合、发布与训练时工件不一致以及文档不一致等难以发现的问题。
AI.conclusion: ModSleuth支持对现代LLM日益复杂的生态系统进行透明分析，系统及生成的依赖图已公开发布。

title: MLT-Dedup: Efficient Large-Scale Online Video Deduplication via Multi-Level Representations and Spatial-Temporal Matching
summary: The explosive growth of user-generated video content on online platforms is accompanied by the emergence of numerous near-duplicate videos--videos that are identical or highly similar but differ by partial edits. These duplicates degrade user experience and increase storage and bandwidth costs, making large-scale video deduplication a critical task. Existing video deduplication frameworks face a fundamental challenge in retrieving sufficient high-quality candidates under a limited index budget, as well as trade-offs between efficiency and precision. To address these issues, we propose MLT-Dedup, an efficient large-scale online video deduplication framework with Multi-Level representations and spatial-Temporal matching. Our approach employs a Multi-Level Video Encoder (ML-VE) to extract both fine-grained frame-level and sparse clip-level embeddings: sparse embeddings support efficient candidate retrieval, while fine-grained embeddings are loaded for precise pairwise matching. During matching, we introduce DiF-SiM, a Differential Feature-enhanced Similarity Module capable of locating duplicated temporal segments and providing reliable similarity evidence to support policy-driven deduplication decisions. Extensive experiments on a real-world large-scale platform demonstrate that MLT-Dedup reduces online repetition rates by 91% at 90% precision. Furthermore, our sparse retrieval design achieves a 5x increase in indexing capacity, enabling broader candidate coverage in real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出MLT-Dedup，一种基于多级表示和时空匹配的大规模在线视频去重框架，通过细粒度帧级嵌入和稀疏片段级嵌入结合差分特征增强相似性模块，在真实平台实现91%的重复率降低和90%的精准率。
AI.motivation: 用户生成视频内容爆炸式增长导致大量近重复视频出现，影响用户体验并增加存储和带宽成本。现有去重框架在有限索引预算下难以检索足够高质量候选，且效率与精度之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出MLT-Dedup框架，包含：(1) 多级视频编码器(ML-VE)提取细粒度帧级嵌入和稀疏片段级嵌入；(2) 稀疏嵌入用于高效候选检索，细粒度嵌入用于精确成对匹配；(3) 差分特征增强相似性模块(DiF-SiM)定位重复时间片段并提供可靠相似性证据。
AI.result: 在真实大规模平台上，MLT-Dedup在90%精准率下将在线重复率降低91%；稀疏检索设计使索引容量提升5倍，实现更广泛的候选覆盖。
AI.conclusion: MLT-Dedup通过多级表示与时空匹配有效解决了大规模视频去重中的候选检索与精度权衡问题，在实际部署中展现出显著效果。

title: System Report for CCL25-Eval Task 5: New Dataset and LoRA-Fine-Tuned Qwen2.5
summary: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have achieved promising progress in the fields of classical Chinese translation and the generation of classical poetry. However, domain-specific research on precise translation and affective-semantic understanding of classical poetry remains limited. The main challenge is that most studies treat the poetic appreciation task as a general-domain problem, neglecting the distinctive features of poetic appreciation, while high-quality and domain-specific datasets are extremely limited. To address this limitation, we decompose the task into three subtasks: term interpretation, semantic interpretation, and emotional inference. Based on multiple open-source datasets, we perform data cleansing and alignment to construct the Classical Chinese Poetry Instruction Pair Dataset (CCPoetry-49K), which comprises 49,404 high-quality instruction-response pairs explicitly optimized for this domain. We then propose a domain-specialized LLM, called PoetryQwen, by applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tune the Qwen2.5-14B model. Experimental results on the CCL25-Eval Task 5 benchmark demonstrate that PoetryQwen achieves a score of 0.757, representing a 9.7% improvement over the Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct baseline (0.690). These findings clearly indicate that PoetryQwen significantly enhances performance in precise translation and emotional understanding of classical poetry. We present new dataset and methodological considerations intended to support the domain-specific optimization of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对古诗词精准翻译与情感语义理解任务，构建了CCPoetry-49K高质量指令数据集，并提出基于LoRA微调Qwen2.5-14B的领域专用模型PoetryQwen，在CCL25-Eval Task 5基准上达到0.757分，相比基线提升9.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将古诗词鉴赏视为通用域问题，忽视了诗词鉴赏的独特特征，且缺乏高质量领域专用数据集，导致古诗词精准翻译与情感语义理解性能有限。
AI.method: 将古诗词鉴赏任务分解为术语解释、语义解释和情感推断三个子任务；基于多个开源数据集进行数据清洗与对齐，构建包含49,404条高质量指令-响应对的CCPoetry-49K数据集；采用LoRA方法对Qwen2.5-14B模型进行领域微调，得到PoetryQwen模型。
AI.result: 在CCL25-Eval Task 5基准上，PoetryQwen得分为0.757，较Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct基线（0.690）提升9.7%。
AI.conclusion: PoetryQwen显著提升了古诗词精准翻译与情感理解能力，为LLMs的领域专用优化提供了新的数据集和方法论参考。

title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising route for robot manipulation by using video generation models to model future scene evolution before producing control actions. However, our empirical observations reveal a phenomenon: generating plausible visual futures does not always guarantee the extraction of accurate actions. To diagnose this failure, we conduct action-head attention analysis and causal interventions. We find that the action decoder fails to focus on task-relevant interaction regions and remains sensitive to perturbations in task-irrelevant areas. This reveals a representation mismatch: hidden states optimized for visual reconstruction are not inherently organized in a form useful for low-level action control. In this paper, we propose AGRA, an Action-Grounded Representation Alignment objective that regularizes the world-action interface by aligning intermediate video diffusion features with spatially coherent semantic representations from a foundation visual encoder. We evaluate AGRA on real-world manipulation tasks. Experiments show that AGRA makes world model representations more action-grounded: by focusing the action decoder on the correct interaction regions, it improves object localization accuracy and affordance understanding, and makes the policy more robust to perturbations in task-irrelevant regions. As a result, AGRA consistently improves both in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization over the baseline world action model.

AI.tldr: 本文发现世界动作模型（WAMs）中视觉重建与动作控制之间存在表征不匹配问题，并提出AGRA方法，通过将中间视频扩散特征与基础视觉编码器的语义表征对齐，使动作解码器聚焦于任务相关交互区域，从而提升操作任务中的物体定位精度、 affordance理解和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: WAMs通过视频生成建模未来场景再提取动作，但生成合理的视觉未来并不能保证提取出准确的动作。作者观察到动作解码器未能聚焦于任务相关的交互区域，且对任务无关区域的扰动敏感，说明隐藏状态在视觉重建最优与动作控制之间存在表征不匹配。
AI.method: 提出AGRA（Action-Grounded Representation Alignment），通过将中间视频扩散特征与基础视觉编码器产生的空间连贯语义表征进行对齐，正则化世界-动作接口，使表征更适用于动作控制。
AI.result: 在真实世界操作任务上，AGRA使动作解码器聚焦于正确的交互区域，提升了物体定位精度和affordance理解，增强了策略对任务无关区域扰动的鲁棒性，持续改善分布内性能和分布外泛化。
AI.conclusion: 视觉重建与动作控制之间存在表征不匹配，通过表征对齐可以使世界模型表征更"动作接地"，从而提升操作策略的性能和泛化能力。

title: Doc-to-Atom: Learning to Compile and Compose Memory Atoms
summary: Long input sequences are central to document understanding and multi-step reasoning in Large Language Models, yet the quadratic cost of attention makes inference both memory-intensive and slow. Context distillation mitigates this by compressing contextual information into model parameters, and recent work such as Doc-to-LoRA amortizes context distillation into a single forward pass that generates one LoRA adapter per document. However, producing a single monolithic adapter for all queries leads to irrelevant-query interference, limited compositional recall, and poor scalability to long-document reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose Doc-to-Atom (Doc2Atom), a compositional parametric memory framework that decomposes each document into semantically typed knowledge atoms. Each atom is compiled into an independent micro-LoRA adapter and a provenance retrieval key. At inference time, a lightweight query router selects and assembles only the relevant atoms into a query-specific adapter, which is then injected into a frozen base model. The entire system is trained end-to-end through a multi-objective distillation framework. Experiments on six diverse QA benchmarks demonstrate that Doc2Atom outperforms Doc-to-LoRA baselines while reducing the memory cost of document internalization.

AI.tldr: Doc2Atom将文档分解为语义知识原子，每个原子编译为独立的微LoRA适配器和溯源检索键，推理时通过轻量查询路由选择相关原子组装成查询特定适配器，以解决Doc-to-LoRA中单一适配器导致的无关查询干扰、组合回忆能力有限和长文档推理扩展性差等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文蒸馏方法（如Doc-to-LoRA）为每个文档生成单一LoRA适配器，导致无关查询干扰、组合回忆能力差，且难以扩展到长文档推理任务。
AI.method: 将文档分解为语义类型化的知识原子，每个原子编译成独立的微LoRA适配器和溯源检索键；推理时由轻量查询路由选择并组装相关原子为查询特定适配器，注入冻结基座模型；整个系统通过多目标蒸馏框架端到端训练。
AI.result: 在六个多样化的QA基准测试上，Doc2Atom优于Doc-to-LoRA基线，同时降低了文档内部化的内存成本。
AI.conclusion: Doc2Atom通过分解文档为原子并动态组装查询特定适配器，有效解决了单一适配器的干扰和扩展性问题，提升了长文档推理性能并降低了内存开销。

title: Adapting Prithvi-EO for Fallow Detection for Food-Water Nexus: ViT-Adapter Necks and Parameter-Efficient Backbone tuning of Geospatial Foundation Model
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Preprint. Submitted to ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026
summary: Understanding spatial distribution of fallow land is important for optimizing the food-water (FW) nexus, given fallowing's role in crop rotation and water conservation. Fallow is a low accuracy class in USDA Cropland Data Layer (CDL). Geospatial foundation model (GFM), Prithvi-EO has shown strong transferability across computer vision tasks. However, its Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone produces features at a single spatial scale that are ill-suited for the multi-scale features required by object detection heads. Existing approaches synthesise multi-scale pyramids through scaling of single stride tokens, sacrificing spatial heterogeneity, and full backbone fine-tuning is computationally prohibitive for GFMs. We evaluate a fallow detection pipeline combining two parameter-efficient fine tuning (PEFT) schemes: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and a hybrid PEFT, with three neck designs: pseudo multi-scale, Lite ViT-Adapter, and Full ViT-Adapter. Our best configuration, Lite ViT-Adapter with a one-stage head, achieves a mAP@50 of 0.9479 with the Diou loss, suggesting the effectiveness of center-aware localization for irregular fallow field detection. ViT-Adapter free one-stage detection under LoRA improves the adapter-free anchor-based approach by 6.42%, and the best configuration improves baseline adapter-free anchor-based approach by 25.70%. These results demonstrate that lightweight spatial prior fusion and selective backbone unfreezing enable Prithvi-EO to capture local fallow patterns more effectively, outperforming approaches that rely on reshaped single-stride ViT tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合参数高效微调（LoRA和混合PEFT）与多种颈部网络设计的休耕地检测方法，利用地质基础模型Prithvi-EO进行检测。最佳配置（Lite ViT-Adapter + 单阶段检测头）在mAP@50上达到0.9479，较无适配器的锚点基线方法提升25.70%，证明了轻量级空间先验融合和选择性骨干网络解冻能更有效捕捉局部休耕模式。
AI.motivation: 休耕地空间分布信息对优化粮食-水资源关系至关重要，但休耕地在USDA作物数据层（CDL）中属于低精度类别。地质基础模型Prithvi-EO的Vision Transformer（ViT）骨干网络仅产生单空间尺度特征，不适用于目标检测头所需的多尺度特征。现有方法通过缩放单步长token合成多尺度金字塔，牺牲了空间异质性，且完全微调骨干网络计算成本过高。
AI.method: 评估了结合两种参数高效微调方案（LoRA和混合PEFT）与三种颈部网络设计（伪多尺度、Lite ViT-Adapter、Full ViT-Adapter）的休耕地检测流程。采用Prithvi-EO作为基础模型，通过轻量级空间先验融合和选择性骨干网络解冻进行微调。
AI.result: 最佳配置（Lite ViT-Adapter + 单阶段检测头 + Diou损失）达到mAP@50为0.9479。ViT-Adapter无颈部网络的单阶段检测在LoRA下比无适配器的锚点方法提升6.42%。最佳配置比基线无适配器锚点方法提升25.70%。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级空间先验融合和选择性骨干网络解冻使Prithvi-EO能够更有效捕捉局部休耕模式，优于依赖重塑单步长ViT token的方法。

title: Context-Driven Incremental Compression for Multi-Turn Dialogue Generation
summary: Modern conversational agents condition on an ever-growing dialogue history at each turn, incurring redundant attention and encoding costs that grow with conversation length. Naive truncation or summarization degrades fidelity, while existing context compressors lack cross-turn memory sharing or revision, causing information loss and compounding errors in long dialogues. We revisit the context compression under conversational dynamics and empirically present its fragility. To improve both efficiency and robustness, we introduce Context-Driven Incremental Compression (C-DIC), which treats a conversation as interleaved contextual threads and stores revisable per-thread compression states in a single, compact dialogue memory. At each turn, a lightweight retrieve, revise, and write-back loop shares information across turns and updates stale memories, stabilizing long-horizon behavior. In addition, we adapt truncated backpropagation-through-time (TBPTT) to our multi-turn setting, learning cross-turn dependencies without full-history backpropagation. Extensive experiments on long-form dialogue benchmarks demonstrate superior performance and efficiency of C-DIC; notably, C-DIC shows stable inference latency and perplexity over hundreds of dialogue turns, supporting a scalable path to high-quality dialogue modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种上下文驱动的增量压缩方法（C-DIC），通过可修改的跨轮次对话记忆和轻量级检索-修订-写回机制，实现长对话中稳定高效的上下文压缩，解决了现有方法在长对话中信息丢失和错误累积的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对话智能体在每轮处理不断增长的对话历史时，存在冗余注意力与编码开销；简单的截断或摘要会降低保真度，而现有上下文压缩器缺乏跨轮次记忆共享或修订机制，导致长对话中信息丢失和错误累积。
AI.method: C-DIC将对话视为交织的上下文线索，为每个线索存储可修改的压缩状态于紧凑的对话记忆中；通过每轮的检索-修订-写回循环实现跨轮次信息共享和过时记忆更新；并引入TBPTT适应多轮场景，在不进行全历史反向传播的情况下学习跨轮次依赖。
AI.result: 在长对话基准上表现出优越的性能和效率；特别是在数百轮对话中保持稳定的推理延迟和困惑度。
AI.conclusion: C-DIC为高质量对话建模提供了一条可扩展的路径，兼顾了长对话中的效率与鲁棒性。

title: An Electric Potential-Augmented Benchmark Dataset for Physics-Guided Image Reconstruction of Electrical Capacitance Tomography
summary: While deep learning has significantly advanced image reconstruction of Electrical Capacitance Tomography (ECT), most data-driven methods map directly between capacitance and permittivity distribution, treating the sensor as a black box. This overlooks the electric potential field -- the fundamental physical link governing the nonlinear and ill-posed ``soft-field'' effect. To address this, we propose an electric potential-augmented ECT benchmark dataset designed to explicitly integrate latent physics behind ECT into the learning process. Generated via a COMSOL-MATLAB pipeline for an eight-electrode sensor as an example, the dataset comprises 20,000 randomized samples across four typical flow patterns. Crucially, alongside the conventional capacitance vectors and permittivity distributions depicted as images, each sample preserves eight excitation-wise full-field potential maps. Beyond data release, we provide illustrative evaluation protocols for both forward and inverse problems of ECT. Through comprehensive testing on both in-distribution (IID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, we systematically demonstrate how the inclusion of electric potential maps enhances modeling accuracy and robustness. Fundamentally, the explicit inclusion of latent field information significantly lowers the barrier to integrating physical laws into ECT modeling, thereby establishing a standardized foundation for future physics-guided machine learning of ECT image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个电势增强的电容层析成像基准数据集，在传统电容和介电常数数据基础上，显式包含了激励方向的电势场信息，以引入潜在物理规律，并通过实验验证了该方法在正向和逆问题中提升建模精度和鲁棒性，为物理引导的机器学习图像重建建立标准化基础。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习ECT方法将传感器视为黑箱，直接学习电容到介电常数的映射，忽略了作为非线性“软场”效应根本物理联系的电势场信息，限制了建模精度和物理可解释性。
AI.method: 通过COMSOL-MATLAB管道生成八电极传感器数据集，包含20,000个随机样本（四种典型流型），每个样本除传统电容向量和介电常数图像外，还保存了八个激励方向的完整电势场图，并提供了面向正问题和逆问题的评估协议。
AI.result: 在分布内和分布外场景下，显式引入电势场信息显著提升了ECT建模的精度和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式包含潜在场信息降低了将物理规律融入ECT建模的门槛，为未来物理引导的ECT图像重建机器学习建立了标准化基准。

title: Damage-TriageFormer: A Foundation-Model Framework for Typology-Based Building Damage Assessment from Mono-Temporal Imagery
summary: Decision-relevant building damage assessment is critical for prioritizing resources and recovery after a disaster, yet most automated methods either flatten damage into a single severity scale (no damage, minor, major, destroyed) or require paired pre- and post-event imagery that is often unavailable for emerging hazards. This paper presents Damage-TriageFormer, a single-image, post-event, footprint-conditioned model that produces a damage typology rather than a severity scale. We contribute: (1) DamageTriage-Bench, a new benchmark built from NOAA Emergency Response Imagery across Hurricane Michael (2018), Hurricane Helene (2024), and the 2025 Los Angeles wildfire complex, with five typology classes that distinguish roof damage from structural damage and, within each, partial from total extent; and (2) Damage-TriageFormer, which extends a DINOv3 ViT-L backbone with a Simple Feature Pyramid for higher-resolution instance pooling, a two-stage gated damage head, and an auxiliary severity-regression objective. Our model achieves macro F1 of 0.624 on validation and 0.619 on a held-out stratified test set, performing strongest where operational triage needs it most, with per-class F1 of 0.91 and 0.84 on undamaged buildings and total structural collapse, respectively. While the rare Total Roof Damage class remains difficult due to its limited examples and an inherently ambiguous label boundary, our results show that single-image post-event imagery can support actionable building damage typing, enabling targeted emergency response and resource allocation without a pre-event reference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Damage-TriageFormer，一种基于单张灾后图像的建筑物损伤分类模型，区别于传统的严重程度分级，它采用损伤类型学分类（区分屋顶损伤与结构损伤，并细分为局部/全部），并在飓风和野火数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化建筑损伤评估方法存在两个缺陷：一是将损伤简化为单一严重程度等级（无、轻微、严重、倒塌），丢失了损伤类型信息；二是大多需要配对灾前/灾后影像，而紧急情况下灾前影像往往不可得。因此需要一种仅依赖灾后单张图像、能输出可操作损伤类型的方法，以支持应急资源调配。
AI.method: 基于DINOv3 ViT-L骨干网络，扩展Simple Feature Pyramid实现更高分辨率实例池化，设计两阶段门控损伤头（two-stage gated damage head），并引入辅助严重程度回归目标。同时构建DamageTriage-Bench基准数据集，包含5种损伤类型类别（区分屋顶损伤与结构损伤，各再分局部/全部）。
AI.result: 验证集macro F1为0.624，分层测试集macro F1为0.619。在无损建筑和完全结构倒塌两个类别上表现最强（F1分别为0.91和0.84），完全屋顶损伤类因样本稀少且标签边界模糊而表现较弱。
AI.conclusion: 单张灾后图像足以支持可操作的建筑损伤分类，无需灾前参考影像即可支持定向应急响应和资源分配。

title: Bridging Day and Night: Unsupervised Cross-Domain Re-Identification with Synergistic Prompt and Prototype Learning
summary: Cross-domain day-night re-identification (ReID) is fundamentally challenged by the substantial visual appearance discrepancies between daytime and nighttime scenes. Existing fully supervised methods rely heavily on labor-intensive annotations, which are costly and exhibit limited generalization across domains. In this work, we investigate unsupervised day-night ReID and propose a novel framework that synergistically combines prompt learning and prototype-based representation learning to associate identities across domains without requiring manual labels. Our approach follows a progressive two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, we exploit the vision-language model to generate instance-specific textual prompts in an annotation-free manner. We employ an instance-level alignment mechanism to embed visual features and textual prompts into a unified semantic space, aligning unlabeled day/night images with learnable prompts via instance-aware dynamic-bias adaptation. In the second stage, we construct domain-specific prototype memory banks and introduce two complementary modules: i) an intra-domain identity association module to enhance feature discriminability within each domain, and ii) a cross-domain prototype matching module to reliably identify positive and negative prototype pairs, thereby establishing robust identity correspondences across day and night. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method. Under the unsupervised setting, our framework attains Rank-1 accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art fully supervised methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督的跨域昼夜行人重识别框架，结合提示学习与原型表示学习，通过两阶段训练策略（实例级文本提示对齐 + 域内外原型匹配）实现无需人工标注的昼夜身份关联，在无监督设置下达到与全监督方法可比的Rank-1精度。
AI.motivation: 昼夜场景间巨大的视觉外观差异导致跨域行人重识别极具挑战，现有全监督方法依赖昂贵的人工标注且跨域泛化能力有限，因此本文探索无监督昼夜ReID方法以消除对标注的依赖。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练框架：第一阶段利用视觉-语言模型以无注释方式生成实例级文本提示，通过实例感知动态偏置适应机制对齐视觉特征与文本提示到统一语义空间；第二阶段构建域特定原型记忆库，设计域内身份关联模块增强特征判别性，以及跨域原型匹配模块识别正负原型对以建立昼夜间的鲁棒身份对应关系。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，所提无监督框架的Rank-1精度与最先进的全监督方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 无监督昼夜ReID通过提示学习与原型表示学习的协同，能够在无需人工标注的情况下有效关联跨域身份，证明其可替代全监督方法。

title: VOID: Defeating Unauthorized Mimicry in Latent Diffusion Models
comment: To appear in the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026)
summary:
While Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have revolutionized visual synthesis, they are increasingly exploited for unauthorized mimicry of individuals. Existing defenses inject deceptive perturbations to steer the generated images toward irrelevant targets. However, this approach hinges on an ungrounded assumption: subtle perturbations can maintain their deceptive efficacy throughout an LDM's extensive generation process. In reality, the model's innate restoration mechanism will remove such perturbations and cause individual identities to re-emerge in the images generated.
  We propose VOID, a defense framework that overcomes this conundrum by manipulating an LDM's intrinsic stochasticity. VOID perturbs the diffusion pipeline in two novel ways: 1) amplifying the latent encoding errors to shatter an image's semantic structure, and 2) counteracting the target guidance signals to suppress the model's restoration capabilities. This results in a semantic corruption that thwarts any unauthorized mimicry. Notably, the security gain does not come at the price of visual utility, as VOID simultaneously manages to confine perturbations to human-imperceptible regions of protected images. Our comprehensive evaluation of 24 state-of-the-art defenses against 10 mimicry attacks on 5 datasets demonstrates VOID's unprecedented protection power: it increases the average Frechet Inception Distance (FID) from 113 to 365, a 223% improvement over the strongest defense to date.

AI.tldr: VOID是一种针对潜在扩散模型（LDM）的防御框架，通过操纵LDM的内在随机性（放大潜码编码误差、抵消目标引导信号）实现语义破坏，有效阻止未经授权的个人模仿攻击，同时在23%的FID提升（从113到365）中保持视觉效用，性能超越现有最强防御223%。
AI.motivation: 现有防御方法依赖向受保护图像注入欺骗性扰动，期望其在LDM的整个生成过程中持续生效。然而LDM固有的修复机制会在生成过程中消除这些细微扰动，导致个体身份在生成的图像中重新浮现，防御失效。
AI.method: VOID通过两种新颖方式扰动扩散管道：1) 放大潜码编码误差以破坏图像的语义结构；2) 抵消目标引导信号以抑制LDM的修复能力。两者协同实现语义破坏，且将扰动限制在人眼不可感知的图像区域。
AI.result: 在5个数据集上对24种最先进防御方法进行测试，针对10种模仿攻击的全面评估显示：VOID将平均FID从113提升至365，相比现有最强防御提升223%。
AI.conclusion: VOID通过操纵LDM内在随机性实现了前所未有的保护能力，在显著提升安全性的同时不牺牲视觉效用，有效解决了现有防御中扰动被模型修复机制消除的根本问题。

title: Finding Sparse Subnetworks in One Training Cycle via Progressive Magnitude-Based Pruning
summary: Neural network pruning reduces model size by removing less important parameters while aiming to preserve predictive performance. Although the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH) shows that sparse subnetworks can match dense networks when trained from suitable initializations, its iterative pruning procedure requires multiple complete training cycles. This work evaluates progressive magnitude-based pruning as a single-cycle alternative. The method gradually increases sparsity during training using a linear schedule and updates pruning masks based on active weight magnitudes. We conduct systematic experiments on CIFAR-10 and MNIST across ResNet, VGG-style, and LeNet architectures, comparing the proposed method with representative iterative and initialization-based pruning baselines, including LTH, SNIP, and GraSP. On CIFAR-10, the method achieves 95.12\% accuracy on ResNet-18 at 72.9\% sparsity, compared with 90.5\% reported for LTH. At extreme sparsity, it achieves 93.13\% accuracy on a VGG-like architecture at 97\% sparsity, compared with approximately 92.0\% for SNIP, and 93.44\% accuracy on VGG-19 at 97.97\% sparsity, compared with 92.19\% for GraSP at 98\% sparsity. A sparsity-accuracy analysis on ResNet-18 further shows that accuracy remains within 0.1 percentage points of the dense baseline across 70--85\% sparsity. These results indicate that progressive magnitude-based pruning provides an effective single-cycle approach for neural network sparsification under the evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出渐进式基于幅值的剪枝方法，作为彩票假说（LTH）迭代剪枝的单周期替代方案。该方法在训练过程中线性增加稀疏度并动态更新剪枝掩码。在CIFAR-10和MNIST数据集上，对ResNet、VGG风格和LeNet架构进行系统实验，与LTH、SNIP和GraSP等方法相比取得了有竞争力的结果，例如ResNet-18在72.9%稀疏度下达到95.12%准确率，优于LTH的90.5%。
AI.motivation: LTH的迭代剪枝需要多次完整训练，计算成本高。作者希望寻找一种仅需单次训练即可获得高质量稀疏子网络的方法。
AI.method: 采用渐进式幅值剪枝策略：训练过程中按线性调度逐步提高网络稀疏度，并基于当前活跃权重的幅值动态更新剪枝掩码，整个过程只需单次训练。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上ResNet-18在72.9%稀疏度下准确率95.12%（LTH仅90.5%）；VGG风格架构在97%稀疏度下准确率93.13%（SNIP约92.0%）；VGG-19在97.97%稀疏度下准确率93.44%（GraSP在98%稀疏度下92.19%）。ResNet-18在70-85%稀疏度范围内准确率与稠密基线差距在0.1个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式幅值剪枝是一种有效的单周期网络稀疏化方法，在多种架构和稀疏度设置下均能取得有竞争力的性能。

title: Findings of the MAGMaR 2026 Shared Task
comment: Findings of the 2nd workshop on Multimodal Augmented Generation via Multimodal Retrieval (MAGMaR); Resources at this url: https://github.com/rekriz11/MAGMAR_2026
summary: This overview paper presents the results of the shared task for the second workshop on Multimodal Augmented Generation via Multimodal Retrieval (MAGMaR). In this shared task participants submitted systems focused on either (i) video retrieval or (ii) grounded generation of articles given retrieved videos. Teams could submit to either task. For the retrieval task, we had 2 participating teams that submitted a total of 17 systems -- all of which beat a baseline derived from the winner of last year's shared task. On the generation side, we had 4 teams submit 16 systems. All teams had at least one generated report that was labeled the best by a human annotator.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MAGMaR第二届多模态增强生成与检索共享任务的结果，涵盖视频检索和基于检索视频的生成两个子任务，共有6个团队提交了33个系统。
AI.motivation: 推动多模态检索与生成领域的研究进展，通过共享任务形式评估和比较不同系统在多模态增强生成任务上的表现。
AI.method: 设立两个子任务：(i) 视频检索，(ii) 基于检索视频的文章生成。参与者可任选其一或两者均参与。通过基线系统（基于去年冠军）对比评估检索任务，采用人工标注评估生成质量。
AI.result: 检索任务：2个团队提交17个系统，全部超越去年冠军基线；生成任务：4个团队提交16个系统，每个团队至少有一个生成报告被标注为最佳。
AI.conclusion: 本届共享任务表明多模态检索与生成领域取得显著进展，多个系统在检索任务中超越历史最佳基线，生成任务中各团队均有高质量产出。

title: CellNet -- Localizing Cells using Sparse and Noisy Point Annotations
comment: Conference poster at Biology at Scale: From Variants to Cellular Programs and Functions
summary: Counting living cells is an important step in many biological research workflows. Our collaborators at the Wellcome Sanger Institute study vital genes in humans via large scale saturation genome editing screening, which requires repeatedly counting cells a great number of times. Computer Vision based automation is crucial for high throughput and resource efficiency. In this work, we develop a regression-based deep learning computer vision algorithm to detect and count cells in phase-contrast microscopy images. To reduce annotation effort, which in practice often becomes a bottleneck, we focus on counting cells only using sparse point annotations, which are fast and easy to acquire. By comparison to state-of-the-art 0-shot methods, we show that regression-based counting is a promising alternative in low data regimes. Through developing methods to automatically count living cells in microscopy images, we contribute to valuable research on the human genome. The code is available at https://github.com/beijn/cellnet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于回归的深度学习算法CellNet，利用稀疏点标注在相差显微镜图像中检测和计数活细胞，以减少人工标注成本，并在低数据场景下展现出优于零样本方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 在大规模饱和基因组编辑筛选中需要反复计数大量细胞，手动标注耗时且成为瓶颈，现有方法依赖密集标注，效率低下。
AI.method: 采用基于回归的深度学习计算机视觉算法，仅使用稀疏点标注（快速易获取）训练模型，在相差显微镜图像中进行细胞检测与计数。
AI.result: 与最先进的零样本方法相比，回归式计数在低数据场景下表现出有竞争力的性能，有效减少了人工标注负担。
AI.conclusion: 回归式细胞计数是低数据场景下自动化细胞计数的有效替代方案，有助于高通量人类基因组研究，代码已开源。

title: Bridging the Modality Gap in Forensic Image Retrieval
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, paper submitted to Elsevier journal
summary: Automated image retrieval plays an increasingly critical role in modern forensic analysis, supporting investigative workflows that rely on efficient comparison of visual evidence. While prior work has focused primarily on developing and optimizing multimodal retrieval systems, limited attention has been paid to evaluating the forensic applicability of these technologies across diverse real-world scenarios. In this study, we present a unified retrieval framework adapted to four key forensic tasks: (1) tattoo image retrieval given a tattoo query image; (2) tattoo retrieval guided by human-expert textual descriptions, modelling the common situation where a witness verbally describes a tattoo; (3) tattoo retrieval from hand-drawn sketches; and (4) face retrieval from forensic face sketches. Our system leverages a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to automatically generate structured textual descriptions for all queries and gallery images, followed by sentence-transformer embedding for text-based comparison. We evaluate retrieval using visual-only embeddings, text-only embeddings and a multimodal fusion strategy that combines text- and image-based similarity scores derived from state-of-the-art visual feature extractors relevant to each task. The fusion of modalities consistently improves retrieval precision and robustness, especially in scenarios where visual information is limited or noisy (e.g., sketches, partial tattoos, or fragmented witness statements). This work highlights the forensic value of a unified multimodal retrieval pipeline and demonstrates how modern MLLMs can operationalize challenging forensic tasks that traditionally rely on manual expert analysis. Our results position multimodal retrieval as a promising tool for supporting investigative workflows involving tattoos, facial composites, and witness descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的多模态检索框架，利用多模态大语言模型(MLLM)自动生成结构化文本描述，结合视觉嵌入、文本嵌入及多模态融合策略，解决四项法医关键任务：纹身图像检索、基于目击者文字描述的纹身检索、手绘草图纹身检索以及法医人脸素描检索。实验证明多模态融合策略在视觉信息有限或噪声场景下显著提升检索精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要关注多模态检索系统的开发与优化，但缺乏对这些技术在多样化真实法医场景中的适用性评估。法医学中纹身检索、人脸素描检索等任务长期依赖人工专家分析，亟需自动化的统一检索框架来支撑调查流程。
AI.method: 构建统一检索框架：(1) 利用MLLM自动为所有查询和图库图像生成结构化文本描述；(2) 采用sentence-transformer进行文本嵌入，实现基于文本的相似度比较；(3) 分别使用纯视觉嵌入、纯文本嵌入以及融合文本与视觉相似度得分的多模态融合策略进行检索。其中视觉特征提取器采用针对各任务优化的SOTA模型。
AI.result: 多模态融合策略在所有任务中持续提升了检索精度和鲁棒性，尤其在视觉信息有限或噪声场景（如草图、部分纹身、碎片化目击者陈述）中表现显著优于单一模态。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态检索管道具有法医应用价值，现代MLLM能够将传统依赖人工专家分析的法医任务自动化操作。多模态检索有望成为支撑纹身、人脸合成及目击者描述等调查流程的有力工具。

title: Natural-Language Temporal Grounding in Hour-Long Videos is a Search Problem: A Benchmark and Empirical Decomposition
summary: Temporal grounding--returning the interval $[t_s, t_e]$ for a natural-language query over a video--is the language interface to long-form video, yet has been studied on short videos; the dynamics of hour-scale natural-language grounding remain underexplored. We take the position that at hour-scale, the binding constraint is search, not recognition: Video-LLMs are bottlenecked not by localizing a nearby event, but--given a natural-language query--by searching for the relevant region of a long video. To test this, we release ExtremeWhenBench, the first open hour-scale grounding benchmark (2,273 queries over 194 videos, mean 75.7 min, max 9 hr) with an open-form query distribution. Every open Video-LLM collapses while a frame-level retrieval baseline outperforms them; a failure taxonomy attributes 85% of failures to search; and a retrieve-then-ground hybrid recovers 6.7x over the monolithic Video-LLM--mirroring retrieve-then-read in open-domain QA.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在小时级视频时间定位中，核心瓶颈是搜索而非识别。作者发布了首个小时级基准ExtremeWhenBench，发现所有开放视频大模型均不如帧级检索基线，85%的失败归因于搜索问题，而检索-定位混合方法比单一模型提升6.7倍。
AI.motivation: 现有时间定位研究局限于短视频，小时级长视频的自然语言定位机制尚不明确。作者提出假设：在小时级尺度下，限制因素不是局部事件识别，而是从长视频中搜索相关区域的能力。
AI.method: 1) 发布ExtremeWhenBench基准（2,273个查询，194个视频，平均75.7分钟，最长9小时）；2) 系统对比多种视频大模型与帧级检索基线；3) 构建失败分类法；4) 提出检索-定位混合方法。
AI.result: 所有开放视频大模型均表现不佳，帧级检索基线优于它们；85%的失败由搜索问题导致；检索-定位混合方法比单一视频大模型提升6.7倍性能。
AI.conclusion: 小时级视频时间定位的核心瓶颈是搜索而非识别，检索-定位混合范式（类似开放域QA中的检索-读取）是有效解决方案。

title: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations for Multimodal Image Fusion
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Multimodal image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a fused image that preserves rich local details while maintaining globally consistent appearance. Existing approaches build shared representations on 2D feature grids, which excel at modeling local structures but offer limited leverage over image-level global appearance factors. To balance these objectives, we introduce a compact 1D token interface based on a frozen pretrained image tokenizer for modeling non-local appearance/base factors. Rather than using the tokenizer as a reconstruction backbone, our design uses the 1D token space as a global carrier while retaining the 2D spatial pathway for local structure restoration. Specifically, we introduce Selective Token Editing (STE), which sparsely updates/replaces a small set of critical tokens, providing a lightweight mechanism to steer global appearance coherence while keeping the fusion backbone unchanged and avoiding extra losses. Experiments on four commonly used benchmarks show that our method achieves the best overall performance, with consistent, multi-metric improvements in both global coherence and local fidelity. Project page: https://zju-xyc.github.io/1D-Fusion-Project-Page/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于1D token接口的多模态图像融合方法，利用冻结的预训练图像分词器作为全局外观载体，并引入选择性Token编辑（STE）机制，在保持融合主干不变的情况下稀疏更新关键token以协调全局一致性和局部保真度，在四个基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法基于2D特征网格构建共享表示，擅长建模局部结构但难以控制图像级全局外观因素，导致局部细节丰富性与全局一致性难以平衡。
AI.method: 利用冻结的预训练图像分词器构建紧凑的1D token接口作为全局外观载体，保留2D空间路径用于局部结构恢复；引入选择性Token编辑（STE）机制，稀疏更新/替换少量关键token以引导全局外观一致性，无需改动融合主干或添加额外损失。
AI.result: 在四个常用基准数据集上，该方法在全局一致性和局部保真度两方面均实现了多指标的一致改进，取得了最佳综合性能。
AI.conclusion: 1D token接口作为全局载体与2D局部路径相结合的范式，以及轻量级的STE编辑机制，有效平衡了多模态图像融合中的全局与局部目标，且具有较好的通用性。

title: Slots, Transitions, Loops: Learning Composable World Models for ARC
summary: ARC tests in-context rule induction: given a few input-output demonstrations, a model must infer the hidden rule and apply it to a new query. While many approaches express ARC rules through language, code, or symbolic programs, ARC itself is visual-symbolic: rules appear as grid transitions over objects, colors, shapes, and spatial relations. We introduce Loop-OWM, an object-centric world-modeling architecture that learns these rules as composable transitions over structured states. It combines color-prototype slots, demonstration-conditioned task summaries, and a looped transition model with dense propagation and slot-conditioned correction. On both ARC-1 and ARC-2, Loop-OWM outperforms non-looped and looped baselines with comparable or fewer parameters. These results suggest that ARC rules can be learned not only as language descriptions or searched programs, but also as transitions over visual-symbolic world states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Loop-OWM，一种以对象为中心的世界建模架构，通过将ARC规则学习为结构化状态上的可组合转换，在ARC-1和ARC-2上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: ARC任务本质上是视觉-符号的，规则体现为网格上对象、颜色、形状和空间关系的转换，而现有方法多通过语言、代码或符号程序来表达规则，未能充分利用其视觉-符号特性。
AI.method: Loop-OWM结合了颜色原型槽、示范条件任务摘要、循环转换模型（含密集传播和槽条件校正），以对象为中心的方式学习规则作为结构化状态上的可组合转换。
AI.result: 在ARC-1和ARC-2上，Loop-OWM以可比或更少的参数量，优于非循环和循环基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ARC规则不仅可以作为语言描述或搜索程序来学习，还可以作为视觉-符号世界状态上的转换来学习。

title: Anatomically Conditioned Recurrent Refinement for Topology-Aware Circle of Willis Segmentation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at EUSIPCO 2026
summary: Segmenting the Circle of Willis (CoW) from Magnetic Resonance Angiography (MRA) is challenging due to complex topology and thin vascular structures that are prone to fragmentation. Standard Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) often fail to capture these topological constraints, resulting in "broken vessel" artifacts. To address this, we propose the Anatomically Conditioned Recurrent Refinement U-Net (AC2RUNet). Our architecture decouples segmentation into two streams: a Static Stream that extracts invariant anatomical features and a lightweight Dynamic Stream that iteratively refines topological errors over time. We further introduce a dynamic curriculum learning strategy that transitions from high-recall geometric supervision to topology-aware constraints. Validated on the TopCoW dataset, AC2RUNet substantially reduces Hausdorff Distance (4.72 mm vs 9.17 mm) and Betti number errors (0.19 vs 0.40), improving topological connectivity over the nnU-Net baseline while maintaining comparable volumetric Dice.

AI.tldr: 针对MRA影像中Willis环分割易出现的血管断裂问题，提出AC2RUNet，通过静态流提取不变解剖特征与轻量动态流迭代修正拓扑错误，结合动态课程学习策略，在TopCoW数据集上将Hausdorff距离从9.17mm降至4.72mm，Betti数误差从0.40降至0.19，显著提升拓扑连接性。
AI.motivation: 标准CNN由于难以捕捉复杂拓扑约束，在分割Willis环时会产生"血管断裂"伪影，影响分割结果的拓扑连通性。
AI.method: 提出AC2RUNet，将分割解耦为两个流：静态流提取不变解剖特征，轻量动态流随时间迭代修正拓扑错误；并引入动态课程学习策略，从高召回率几何监督过渡到拓扑感知约束。
AI.result: 在TopCoW数据集上，Hausdorff距离从9.17mm降至4.72mm，Betti数误差从0.40降至0.19，在保持相似Dice系数的同时显著提升拓扑连通性。
AI.conclusion: AC2RUNet通过双流架构与课程学习有效解决了脑血管分割中的拓扑断裂问题，在拓扑指标上大幅超越nnU-Net基线。

title: Echoes of the Prior: A Computational Phenomenology of Forgetting
summary: Memory is not merely the storage of data; it is the scaffolding of reality. When biological memory fades, the world does not simply turn black; it regresses into an unrecognizable chaos. Echoes of the Prior is an interactive installation that attempts to visualize this subjective phenomenology of forgetting. By inducing controlled synaptic decay within a Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction model, we create an artistic analogy for the erosion of the brain's predictive priors. We position the Neural Network not as a tool for engineering, but as a cognitive proxy - a silicon brain whose structural degeneration evokes the disorienting, poetic, and terrifying experience of losing one's grip on the world. Ultimately, we offer this framework as a catalyst, inviting the wider community to explore the uncharted potential of neuromorphic aesthetics in visualizing the fragility of intelligence. Interactive demo see https://decart-4d.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为"Echoes of the Prior"的交互式装置艺术，通过在前馈3D重建模型中诱导受控的突触衰减，模拟人类遗忘的主观现象学体验，将神经网络定位为认知代理，探索神经形态美学在可视化智能脆弱性方面的潜力。
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过艺术化手段可视化生物记忆衰退的主观体验，将神经网络从工程工具重新定位为认知代理，以表达遗忘过程中世界的解体和混乱感。
AI.method: 在前馈3D重建模型中引入受控的"突触衰减"机制，模拟大脑预测先验的侵蚀过程，通过模型的逐步退化来映射遗忘的主观现象学体验。
AI.result: 生成了一个能够可视化记忆衰退过程的交互式装置，展示了神经结构退化如何导致世界认知从有序滑向混乱的视觉表现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为催化剂，邀请更广泛的社区探索神经形态美学在可视化智能脆弱性方面的未开发潜力。

title: Atlas H&E-TME: Scalable AI-Based Tissue Profiling at Expert Pathologist-Level Accuracy
summary: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining is the cornerstone of histopathology, yet scalable, quantitative analysis of H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) remains a central challenge in computational pathology. We present Atlas H&E-TME, an AI-based system built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models that predicts tissue quality, tissue region, and cell type labels across multiple cancer types, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution. A key challenge to validating such systems is overcoming morphological ambiguity inherent to H&E-only ground truth and the limited scalability of more informed references drawing on modalities such as immunohistochemistry (IHC). We address this with a dual validation framework combining biologically grounded depth with technical and morphological breadth. For depth, we propose an IHC-informed multi-pathologist consensus protocol that substantially improves inter-rater agreement over conventional H&E-only annotation. This yields a molecularly grounded reference against which we compare Atlas H&E-TME and pathologists working from H&E alone. For breadth, we benchmark Atlas H&E-TME on over 200,000 high-confidence H&E-only pathologist annotations across 1,500+ cases spanning eight cancer types and their most common metastatic sites, with subtypes covering >90% of clinical cases per cancer type, drawn from 25+ sources and 8+ scanner models. Benchmarked against the IHC-informed consensus, Atlas H&E-TME matches or exceeds pathologist H&E-only performance and generalizes consistently and robustly across this broad morphological and technical scope. In doing so, Atlas H&E-TME turns the H&E slide -- the most ubiquitous data in pathology -- into a scalable, quantitative window into the tumor and its microenvironment, laying a foundation for the next generation of tissue-based biomarkers in translational and clinical research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Atlas H&E-TME，一个基于病理基础模型家族Atlas的AI系统，可预测多种癌症类型的组织质量、组织区域和细胞类型标签，每张全切片图像输出超过4,500个细胞级定量指标。通过结合IHC共识的多病理学家标注协议和超过20万H&E标注的大规模验证，该系统在跨8种癌症类型、25+数据源、8+扫描仪型号上匹配或超越病理学家仅凭H&E的诊断性能，将H&E切片转化为可量化的肿瘤微环境分析工具。
AI.motivation: H&E染色是病理学的基石，但全切片图像的可扩展定量分析仍是计算病理学的核心挑战。现有H&E-only标注存在形态模糊性，而IHC等参考模态虽更精确但可扩展性有限，因此需要一种既能提供分子水平深度验证又具备技术形态广度泛化能力的AI系统。
AI.method: 1）构建Atlas病理基础模型家族作为骨干；2）提出IHC-informed多病理学家共识协议，显著提高H&E-only标注的一致性，形成分子水平的深度验证基准；3）在超过20万高置信度H&E-only标注（1500+病例、8种癌症类型、25+数据源、8+扫描仪型号）上进行广度泛化验证；4）系统输出组织质量、组织区域和细胞类型标签，每张切片生成4,500+定量指标。
AI.result: Atlas H&E-TME在IHC-informed共识基准测试中匹配或超越病理学家仅凭H&E的诊断性能，并在跨癌症类型、数据源和扫描仪型号的广泛范围内展现出一致且稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Atlas H&E-TME将最普遍的H&E切片转化为可扩展、定量的肿瘤微环境分析窗口，为下一代基于组织的转化研究与临床生物标志物奠定基础。

title: DepthMaster: Unified Monocular Depth Estimation for Perspective and Panoramic Images
summary: While monocular depth estimation has achieved significant progress, achieving generalized metric depth estimation for both narrow field-of-view (FoV) perspectives and $360^\circ$ panoramas remains an unsolved challenge. Existing methods are often tailored to specific camera types and struggle to produce accurate metric depth that generalizes across diverse settings. This limitation stems from two key challenges: the inherent geometric discrepancy between perspective and panoramic cameras, and the scarcity of panoramic training data with metric annotations. In this work, we introduce DepthMaster, a unified metric depth estimation framework. Rather than employing specialized networks to learn spherical distortions, we reformulate the problem by decomposing panoramic images into overlapping perspective patches. Crucially, distinct from prior projection-based methods that rely on ad-hoc architectural modifications to handle boundaries, we introduce a novel Correspondence Consistency Loss (CCL) and inject virtual projection cameras as geometric priors, allowing us to seamlessly stitch the patches while avoiding specialized operators and keeping the backbone largely compatible with standard Transformer designs. This strategy also resolves the geometric differences by unifying all inputs into a canonical perspective representation, and effectively circumvents data scarcity by directly unlocking powerful metric priors from vast perspective datasets. Trained on a mixed dataset that contains only one panorama dataset, DepthMaster achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on 13 diverse datasets, outperforming not only universal methods but also leading specialist models in both perspective and panoramic domains.

AI.tldr: DepthMaster是一个统一的度量深度估计框架，通过将全景图像分解为重叠透视块、引入对应一致性损失和虚拟投影相机几何先验，实现了对窄视野视角和360°全景图的通用度量深度估计，在13个数据集上达到最先进零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的度量深度估计方法通常针对特定相机类型设计，难以在透视相机和全景相机之间泛化，主要面临两个挑战：透视相机与全景相机之间固有的几何差异，以及带有度量标注的全景训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: DepthMaster将全景图像分解为重叠的透视块，统一为规范透视表示；引入对应一致性损失和虚拟投影相机作为几何先验，实现无缝拼接，保持主干网络与标准Transformer兼容，避免特化算子。
AI.result: 在仅使用一个全景数据集混合训练的情况下，DepthMaster在13个多样化数据集上实现了最先进的零样本性能，超越了通用方法和透视及全景领域的专业模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一输入为规范透视表示并利用透视数据集中的度量先验，DepthMaster有效解决了几何差异和数据稀缺问题，实现了跨相机类型的通用度量深度估计。

title: A Turbo-Inference Strategy for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation
comment: Preprint version of an article published in Computer Vision and Image Understanding
summary: Object detection and instance segmentation tasks are closely related. Existing top-down instance segmentation methods usually follow a detect-then-segment paradigm, where an initial detector is used to recognize and localize objects with bounding boxes, followed by the segmentation of an instance mask within each bounding box. In such methods, the detection accuracy directly influences the subsequent segmentation performance. However, previous research has seldom explored the impact of the instance segmentation task on object detection. In this paper, we present a turbo-inference strategy for the top-down methods that leverages the complementary information between detection and segmentation tasks iteratively. Specifically we design two modules: turbo-detection head and turbo-segmentation head, which facilitate communication between the tasks. The two modules form a closed loop that interlaces the detection and segmentation results without retraining the model. Comprehensive experiments on the COCO, iFLYTEK, and Cityscapes datasets demonstrate that our method substantially enhances both detection and segmentation accuracies with a certain increase in computational cost. The proposed method represents a tradeoff between prediction accuracy and inference speed. Codes are available at https://github.com/zhaozhen2333/Turbo-Learning.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于自顶向下实例分割的涡轮推理策略，通过设计涡轮检测头和涡轮分割头，在检测与分割任务间迭代传递互补信息，无需重新训练即可同时提升两项任务的精度，并在COCO、iFLYTEK和Cityscapes数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自顶向下实例分割方法遵循"先检测后分割"范式，检测精度直接影响分割性能，但鲜有研究探索实例分割任务对目标检测的反向促进作用。本文旨在利用检测与分割任务间的互补信息，通过迭代推理相互增强。
AI.method: 提出涡轮推理策略，设计涡轮检测头和涡轮分割头两个模块；二者构成闭环，在不重新训练模型的情况下，迭代地交换检测与分割结果，实现任务间的信息互补。
AI.result: 在COCO、iFLYTEK和Cityscapes数据集上的实验表明，该方法在增加一定计算开销的前提下，显著提升了检测和分割的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在预测精度与推理速度之间实现了有效的权衡，为自顶向下实例分割中检测与分割任务的协同优化提供了新思路。

title: Illumination-Robust Camera-Based Heart-Rate Estimation for Physiological Sensing in Robots
summary: Physiological awareness is important for service, social, and assistive robots that interact with humans in everyday environments. Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart-rate (HR) estimation from an RGB camera, making it a promising sensing modality for robot-mounted vision systems. However, illumination variation remains a major barrier to robust deployment. This paper presents an end-to-end spatial-temporal transformer framework for remote HR estimation on a new dataset with varied illumination. Our estimator integrates PRNet-based 3D face alignment, clip-level illumination augmentation, the Residual Temporal Standardization Module, and controlled hybrid temporal-frequency supervision. The training objective combines a Soft-Shifted Pearson waveform loss with a spectral Kullback-Leibler divergence loss, where a tuned weight ($\mathbfβ$) controls the contribution of frequency-domain heart-rate guidance. Experiments on a static all-level mix protocol covering three illumination levels show that $\mathbfβ=5$ provides the strongest result among the tested beta settings, achieving a best-run HR mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.79 bpm and an HR correlation of 0.982. Compared with the PhysFormer baseline evaluated on our dataset, our estimator reduces HR MAE by 93.6 %, while increasing HR correlation from 0.088 to 0.982, making it usable when illumination varies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端的时空Transformer框架，用于在光照变化条件下通过机器人视觉系统进行远程心率估计，结合PRNet三维人脸对齐、光照增强、残差时间标准化模块和混合时频监督，在光照变化数据集上将HR MAE降至0.79 bpm，相比PhysFormer基线提升93.6%。
AI.motivation: 生理感知对于与人类交互的服务、社交和辅助机器人至关重要，而rPPG技术可实现非接触式心率估计。然而，光照变化是其在机器人视觉系统中鲁棒部署的主要障碍。
AI.method: 提出端到端时空Transformer框架，集成PRNet三维人脸对齐、剪辑级光照增强、残差时间标准化模块，以及受控混合时频监督（Soft-Shifted Pearson波形损失 + 频谱KL散度损失，通过β权重调节频域心率指导的贡献）。
AI.result: 在覆盖三种光照水平的静态全级别混合协议上，β=5取得最优结果，最佳HR MAE为0.79 bpm，HR相关系数为0.982。相比PhysFormer基线，HR MAE降低93.6%，HR相关系数从0.088提升至0.982。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架在光照变化条件下实现了高精度、高相关性的远程心率估计，显著优于现有基线方法，具备在机器人平台部署的实用潜力。

title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can describe scenes and reason about them in language, yet still struggle to ground their actions in the dense 3D world around them. Existing approaches either inject features from a frozen 3D foundation model without an objective that ensures the policy uses them, or constrain geometry with sparse box and map losses that provide no dense spatial signal. We introduce VLGA, the first vision-language-action model supervised to reconstruct the dense 3D world it drives through. VLGA introduces geometry as a fourth modality alongside vision, language, and action through a dedicated expert supervised by a per-pixel pointmap regression loss against LiDAR. Extensive experiments conducted on challenging nuScenes and Bench2Drive datasets for open-loop and closed-loop evaluations, respectively, show the superiority of VLGA over counterpart VLA methods. In particular, on open-loop nuScenes, VLGA sets a new state of the art among VLA methods without ego status, with the lowest L2 (0.50\,m average) and 3-second collision rate (0.18\%). On closed-loop Bench2Drive, VLGA attains the state-of-the-art driving score of 79.08, +0.71 over the strongest prior VLA, at comparable efficiency and comfort.

AI.tldr: VLGA是首个将稠密3D几何重建作为第四模态的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过逐像素点图回归损失监督，在nuScenes和Bench2Drive数据集上达到了VLA方法的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在语言推理方面表现良好，但难以将动作锚定在稠密3D世界中。先前方法要么使用冻结的3D基础模型注入特征但缺乏策略使用目标的监督，要么使用稀疏的框和地图损失约束几何但缺乏稠密空间信号。
AI.method: 提出VLGA，将几何作为第四模态（与视觉、语言、动作并列），通过专用专家模块和逐像素点图回归损失（以LiDAR为真值）进行监督训练。
AI.result: 在开环nuScenes上达到VLA方法SOTA（无自我状态）：平均L2误差0.50m，3秒碰撞率0.18%；在闭环Bench2Drive上达到驾驶分数79.08，超越最强先前VLA方法0.71分。
AI.conclusion: 引入稠密3D几何重建作为监督信号能显著提升VLA模型在自动驾驶场景中的空间 grounding 能力，同时不牺牲效率和舒适性。

title: How Seemingly Inconsequential Design Choices Dictate Performance of LLMs in Pathology
summary: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) are routinely used as baselines when evaluating specialized pathology models on whole-slide images (WSIs). Because WSIs exceed contemporary model context limits, LLM baselines routinely use small, high-magnification patches processed independently via majority voting, without systematic evaluation of seemingly inconsequential design choices such as patch size, patch count, and magnification. Generalist LLMs have consistently underperformed specialized systems, reinforcing the perception that domain-specific training or architectural adaptation is necessary for pathology tasks involving WSIs. Here, we conduct a systematic factorial analysis of four input design factors: inference mode, patch size, magnification, and patch count. We demonstrate that prior studies have overstated the gap between specialized models and general-purpose LLMs by choosing non-optimized input configurations. On the MultiPathQA benchmark, switching to a single balanced configuration (large patches at lower magnification, processed jointly) raises GPT-5 from 15.1% to 39.5% on cancer-type classification (TCGA) and from 38.1% to 62.9% on organ classification (GTEx). Per-task optimization yields further gains up to 43.9% (TCGA) and 71.6% (GTEx). The same configuration generalizes to two other models and to a fully held-out CPTAC cohort, where it improves Gemini 3 Flash by 23.4 percentage points without any task-specific tuning.

AI.tldr: 通过系统因子分析发现，以往研究因选择了非优化的输入配置（如小补丁、高倍率），导致通用大语言模型在病理全切片图像分析任务上被严重低估。只需将输入配置改为大补丁、低倍率、联合推理，就能将GPT-5在癌症分类任务上的准确率从15.1%提升至39.5%，并在多个模型中泛化。
AI.motivation: 以往使用通用LLM作为病理WSI任务基线时，设计选择（补丁大小、补丁数量、倍率、推理模式）缺乏系统评估，导致通用模型性能被低估，强化了"病理任务必须领域特化训练"的错误认知。
AI.method: 对四个输入设计因素（推理模式、补丁大小、倍率、补丁数量）进行系统因子分析，在MultiPathQA基准上评估GPT-5等模型，并在CPTAC队列上验证泛化性。
AI.result: 单一平衡配置（大补丁、低倍率、联合推理）使GPT-5在TCGA癌症分类上从15.1%升至39.5%，GTEx器官分类从38.1%升至62.9%；每种任务独立优化后可进一步提升至43.9%和71.6%。该配置在Gemini 3 Flash和第三个模型上也有效，在CPTAC上无任务特化调优即提升23.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM在病理WSI任务上的能力被系统性低估了，简单的输入配置优化即可大幅缩小与专业模型的差距，挑战了"必须领域特化"的普遍假设。

title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) project images into hundreds to thousands of visual tokens, making decoder inference expensive in both attention computation and KV-cache memory. Existing visual-token reduction methods largely follow a rank-and-remove paradigm: they score visual tokens, keep a compact subset, and permanently discard the rest. We show that this irreversible action is fragile because visual-token importance changes across decoder depth; tokens ranked low at one stage may become relevant in later layers, especially for grounding-sensitive queries. We propose Reroute, a training-free plug-in that replaces removal with recoverable routing. At each routing stage, selected vision tokens pass through decoder blocks, while deferred tokens bypass the stage and re-enter the candidate pool at the next routing decision. Reroute reuses existing attention-score ranking rules and stage-wise schedules, preserving the theoretical TFLOPs and KV-cache budget class of the pruning method it augments. Across FastV, PDrop, and Nüwa variants on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen backbones, reroute improves grounding under aggressive token reduction while maintaining general VQA performance. These results suggest that VLM token reduction should not be viewed only as irreversible pruning, but also as recoverable routing. The code can be found here: https://github.com/elmma/mllm-reroute/

AI.tldr: Reroute是一种无训练的即插即用方法，通过可恢复路由代替永久丢弃的方式，在视觉语言模型的视觉token缩减中保留被延迟的token以便后续层重新使用，从而在保持VQA性能的同时提升接地性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token缩减方法遵循"排序-丢弃"范式，但视觉token的重要性会随解码器深度变化，早期得分低的token可能在后续层变得重要，直接永久丢弃是不鲁棒的。
AI.method: Reroute在每个路由阶段，选中的视觉token正常通过解码器块，而被延迟的token则跳过该阶段并在下一个路由决策时重新进入候选池，实现可恢复路由而非永久丢弃。
AI.result: 在FastV、PDrop、Nüwa等变体及LLaVA-1.5和Qwen骨干上，Reroute在激进token缩减下提升了接地性能，同时保持了通用VQA性能。
AI.conclusion: VLM的token缩减不应仅被视为不可逆的剪枝，也应被视为可恢复的路由。
